rows.name: Hero Pack
rows.short_description: Hero Pack lets you build a powerful team from a diverse roster of heroes. Equip them with items, conquer levels, and compete in tournaments. Enjoy idle gameplay, collect new heroes and items, and earn free tournament tickets every hour. Prove your strategy and emerge victorious!
rows.description_html: Step into the world of Hero Pack, where strategy meets excitement in an epic quest for glory! Build your ultimate team from a diverse roster of heroes and embark on thrilling adventures, conquer challenging levels, and compete in intense tournaments against other players. Key Features: Assemble Your Squad: Choose from a variety of unique heroes to form a powerful three-member team. Each hero comes with distinct abilities and strengths, allowing for countless strategic combinations. Equip and Upgrade: Enhance your heroes by equipping them with various items such as weapons, armor, helmets, rings, and shields. Strategically boost their stats to prepare for the challenges ahead. Idle Gameplay: Enjoy the convenience of idle gameplay as your heroes continue to fight and progress even when you're offline. Collect valuable rewards and resources to further strengthen your squad. Conquer Levels: Test your team's might by advancing through increasingly difficult levels. Each level presents new enemies and obstacles that will challenge your tactical prowess. Compete in Tournaments: Enter tournaments to face off against other players' teams. Prove your skills and earn prestigious rewards by climbing the ranks and dominating the competition. Collect Heroes and Items: Unlock new heroes and items through gameplay. Every battle and tournament offers the chance to expand your collection and enhance your squad's capabilities. Time-Based Rewards: Earn free tournament ticket every hour of gameplay, adding an extra layer of excitement and reward as you play. Join the adventure in Hero Pack and experience the thrill of strategic battles, hero collection, and epic competition. Can you build the ultimate team and emerge victorious?

rows.name: World Crafter TD: Prologue
rows.short_description: A highly addictive survival crafting tower defense game! Gather, craft, build turrets, shoot guns, and expand the land to defend against waves of enemies! The prologue for the full game, World Crafter TD!
rows.description_html: A highly addictive survival crafting tower defense game! Gather, craft, build turrets, shoot guns, and expand the land to defend against waves of enemies! Gather resources and craft materials. Craft useful equipment, turrets, and structures. Beat waves of enemies using turrets and melee/ranged weapons. Expand the land to reveal new resources and crafting recipes. Tight and addicting gameplay loop. This is the prologue for the full game, it includes the first biome and the first 16 waves from the full game. Your save will persist to the full game.

rows.name: Beat Around The Bush
rows.short_description: Beat Around the Bush is a series done over YouTube shorts where the top comment got the next addition to the game. Beat Around the Bush is a game where your primary goal is to Beat around the Bush. Once you do, you did it. You won. Therefore, there's no more reason to keep playing this game.
rows.description_html: Ever wanted to beat around the bush…literally? Get ready for a satisfying game where your main goal is simple: smack around that bush and see what happens. Around the bush spawns red circles that you're supposed to hit, which gives you money. You buy things in a shop to help you progress throughout the game. But that’s just the start – as you progress, the game gives you some surprised that you may enjoy. Perfect for both active and casual play, “Beat Around the Bush” is your new go-to for relaxation, humor, and endless bushes to beat! You technically beat this game the moment you beat around the bush. No need to continue. This game is 1 of many games that are going to be 'Literal' games. This was also uploaded to YouTube as a YouTube shorts series where the top comment got the next addition to the game. Which is why there's so many weird things. Beat Around the Bush is a meme game. Beat Around the Bush is not meant to be taken seriously!

rows.name: Unplayable
rows.short_description: UNPLAYABLE is a funny/artsy compilation of absurd video games, each in a specific genre: beat'em up, puzzle game and platformer. An art project with meaning.
rows.description_html: UNPLAYABLE is a DIGITAL ART PROJECT presenting a funny compilation of absurd video games, each in a specific genre: INVISIBOY: A platform game with an invisible hero. As he plays the game, the player can slightly guess where his character is by the responsive scrolling of the background, the collecting of coins that give a hint of his location as well as the sounds that indicate his jumping actions. GHOST FIGHTER: A beat’em up hero who can’t fight because he’s a ghost…this is an unbrawlable brawler… BLOCK SHOCK: A Tetris-like puzzle game with impossible shapes. UNPLAYABLE explores the videogame medium as an artistic tool. Just like using a camera to make video art, we use video games and their specific language as an instrument for emotional and artistic expression. By having a series of (nearly) unplayable games, we want to contemplate the absurdity of our lives and mankind’s obsession with rules and our illusion of control. We also want to convey a sense of intrigue and most of all: a sense of fun. Here, we should be asking ourselves: why do such useless games exist? Are they really useless as there is meaning attached to it? Or am I taking this, as well as myself, too seriously? :-)) Main Features Three games in one! Cool pixel art graphics Short & fun game experiences Share the games with your friends Use them as a party game! How far can you get in these impossible games? Note: This game is unplayable. It is an art project and is meant to describe the feeling of not being in control, being lost, being stuck. Your purchase supports our studio in developing meaningful games and art projects. Our other games can actually be played so please check them out if you enjoyed Unplayable .

rows.name: Zugnaex
rows.short_description: Zugnaex is a very powerful demon. If you say its name correctly, every single little tiny syllable, you will summon the demon & bring forth the apocalypse. But Zugnaex has never faced a foe like you. Battle online with your friends & overcome different challenges to ultimately face the demon itself.
rows.description_html: The Game Zona Pugna Exitium, or Zugnaex for short, are Latin words meaning Zone Battle Doom. It's classic FPS gameplay with a unique multiplayer experience. The Story In ancient times, a powerful demon, known only by the forbidden name Zugnaex, was imprisoned by forgotten gods to prevent the destruction of reality itself. The prison, an interdimensional cage bound by immortal blood, is impenetrable, indestructible... and smells really bad. However, the gods did not realize there is one way the demon can escape. If any mortal speaks its name perfectly, every single little tiny syllable, the demon will tear through dimensions, bypass its eternal prison, and return to annihilate humankind. It’s game over and humanity is out of quarters. But Zugnaex has never faced a foe like you. Only you and your friends can defeat the demon Zugnaex and save humanity. The Battles The online service hosts many battle variations. Here are some that you can experience: A Demon a Day  - work together with your friends to defeat demons. Each kill counts for all active players but be careful as friendly fire is enabled. Help each other to get the highest score and become a demon slaying legend. That Guy  - complete different mission objectives with your friends but there's a twist. The demons are powerful and the marines may succumb to their will. Who is your ally and who is your enemy? Play to find out. Pennies from hell  - demons drop pennies and you collect them. It's a PvP party where the best players will wallow in the riches offered by the denizen of hell. Ready or Knot  - it's time to play hide & seek but old school FPS style. It's PvP where all players are against 'it.' If 'it' survives the other players explode just like in the movie. And many more including speed running, co-op adventures and the ultimate confrontation with Zugnaex itself. The Source Code Some of it was written by me. Most of it was written by you. You can use all of it to make something amazing yourself! Use the included source code to build your own battles. zugzug.zip - This is the source code for zugnaex (the client) and zugsrv (the server). See the README file for instructions on how to build. (License: GPLv2) zugbat.zip - This is the source code for an example battle, 'Kneed Time.' Try to finish a random UV E1 map in par. See the README file for instructions on how to setup and run the battle. (License: MIT) zugnite.zip - This is the source code for a companion launcher for Zugnaex that enables Steam achievements and authentication. (License: MIT-0) See source files for setup, build, and licensing details. Important! Please read Zugnaex is an unofficial DOOM® client. This game comes with no playable content. To play or battle, DOOM® and DOOM II® must be licensed and installed on your PC. Licensing details and, for online play, age requirement, terms of use, and privacy policy are included with the game. Photosensitive Warning: This game and its downloadable content have flashing lights and visual patterns that could trigger seizures, discomfort or nausea in players. Please take appropriate precautions. Region Restrictions: To provide the online service, we host servers in North America and Europe. Players outside these regions may not be able to connect or may have slower network speeds. In addition, our application has very limited localization support. The English language is the only officially supported language for the game.

rows.name: Vasilisa and Baba Yaga: Prologue
rows.short_description: Level up the magical assistant doll Vasilisa the Beautiful from the famous fairy tale, who fights evil spirits at night, so that later the path to Baba Yaga will be easier!
rows.description_html: I am a magic helper doll. I was given to Vasilisa by her mother before she died. If you feed me and say the right words, I come to life and help my mistress. After the death of his wife, Vasilisa's father grieved and grieved, but ended up remarrying. The stepmother does not like Vasilisa, every day she makes her do a lot of housework. Vasilisa feeds me in the evenings, and I help her. I do the work and at night I watch out for evil in the house. And there's actually a lot of evil around the stepmother's house! An action adventure game in which you, as a magic doll, will fight evil spirits at night. You will be met by malicious opponents - a bannik, a ovinnik and a kikimora. Find a way to defeat them in a fair fight and teach them a lesson so that they will remember it for a long time! • Explore the yard, the wheat field and the river bank • Collect a collection of strange objects • Learn more about the evil spirits that live in the area • And teach these evil spirits a lesson!

rows.name: Banana & Tomato
rows.short_description: Banana & Tomato is a fun clicker game! Click Banamatos, get and collect unique items, play minigames and get even more, click and level up for better rewards, change Banamato skins, earn rare achievements, and much more! Read the full description to learn about all the exciting features!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Banana & Tomato World! Banana & Tomato is a clicker game where you collect unique Banamato items to build a special collection. Drop System: Get a Banamato item every 3 hours automatically. Special effects and sounds will alert you when you receive an item so you never miss your beautiful moments! Mini Games: Play a minigame once an hour to get even more items and a great chance to win unique items you can use to increase your clicks. We are working hard to implement more fun minigames ASAP! Drop Chances: Increase your chances of getting rare items by clicking more. Click, level up and win! Inventory: Use your collected items as skins for your Banamato. Open the inventory and equip the desired skin. Consume special items won in the minigame to get even more clicks, thus, more chances to win better items! Achievements: Collect various challenging achievements in the game. P.S. New skins, features, and minigames are in development. Stay tuned! Feedback: We value your opinion! Share your thoughts and suggestions in the reviews or email us. We respond to every opinion we receive! With love, Banana & Tomato Team! Good luck! <3

rows.name: Alterworld
rows.short_description: Explore the infinite world! Play with the fully destructible voxel terrain! Craft and split items! Build and customize a house or any building! And many more! This is the ultimate sandbox survival game where you can do almost anything you can dream!
rows.description_html: Have you ever wanted to play a videogame where you can do almost anything ? Well, this is the game for you! Take a stroll around the infinite procedurally generated world ! Yup, the terrain is fully destructible ! Climb up the mountains , explore the caverns or swim across the tides of the ocean ! Combine or split items to get more items! Build and customize your dream house! And so much more coming soon! Start your alternate world! This is your Alterworld !

rows.name: Rayadium
rows.short_description: Rayadium is a 2D Platformer about overcoming weaknesses in which the protagonist, Raya, must save time-traveling miners from a cave after a radioactive explosion occurred from the innermost core of a mysterious new crystal.
rows.description_html: Delve deeper into a dangerous and mysterious cave and the remnants of miners from the future within it. As time-travelers make use of an otherwise useless radioactive crystal in Raya's town, there is a sudden explosion deep in the mines and Raya knows she must save the miners within. Bounce off of surfaces with Raya's trusty Rapier- who knows what other purposes it may serve? Explore each of the 6 layers of the cave, each with their own visuals, gimmicks, and gameplay elements! Delve deeper with Grim Paths- alternate, harder levels with contrasting visuals and unique gameplay to their counterparts. Collect Kodinium for an additional and completely optional challenge. Collecting 4 in a layer unlocks its Grim Path!

rows.name: The Midnight Bus
rows.short_description: A short narrative horror experience, in which you find yourself in the middle of nowhere in a snowstorm without knowing what has happened to the driver or the other passengers in the vehicle, you just know that there is something out there lurking.
rows.description_html: A SHORT HORROR GAME The Midnight Bus After a day of exhausting work, it's finally time to go home, but all the roads in the city are closed because of the snow, your only hope is to take the last bus of the day that passes at midnight; a vehicle in questionable conditions. The driver has taken a route not very passable because of the situation, tiredness overcomes you, and when you wake up you find yourself alone in the bus in the middle of nowhere... or not? A series of disturbing discoveries will make you realize that being trapped in a snowstorm is not the worst thing that will happen to you that day! Time 15 - 20 minutes of gameplay. Key Features Atmospheric environment: The confined space, snow and external sounds are all part of the immersive experience. Psychological horror: The game presents situations in which you do not know if they are real or in your head. If you pay attention you will discover some interesting details. The game has a unique ending, which in turn will be part of a series of stories around Volmor City. Would you be willing to visit this godforsaken place more than once?

rows.name: War of the Gods: Prologue
rows.short_description: Come and defeat the evil gods! Create your personal outfit, overcome the siege of numerous monsters and leaders, and usher in a new victory! Gods Wars is a pixel ARPG Rogue like Game. You can obtain epic artifacts, upgrade epic skills, choose your epic pet, face the powerful evil gods!
rows.description_html: Gods Wars : infinity Epic is a pixel action role-playing game with rogue-like elements. Through a series of choices, players acquire epic artifacts, enhance epic equipment, upgrade epic skills, choose their epic pets, and ultimately confront formidable evil gods! This is a casual pixel fantasy-style game, where the flames of war engulf the continent and gods of various races descend to the earth. In order to compete for resources and divine power, survive as much as possible. Collect coins and soul crystals from each battle to strengthen yourself and your companions, and welcome the ultimate victory together! Collect more artifacts to enhance your abilities. Choose a set of equipment that suits you, handy skills, and specialize in one aspect (critical strike, elemental, physical, summoning, speed, area, projectile). Challenge epic bosses to obtain fragments of their divinity. Choose suitable pet companions; the more of the same race, the more bonuses provided. Tips: At the respawn point, choose your profession, artifact, and deity. Complete the NPC task in the first level as soon as possible and unlock the merchants in the Divine Kingdom. Before starting the level, talk to the blacksmith and craft a handy weapon. Take a stroll around the city to acquire some initial items and pets. Supports mouse, keyboard, and controller.

rows.name: 重生之我是小虾米
rows.short_description: With armor-clad horses and swords in hand, we roam the world, fighting for justice in a martial arts realm full of change and turmoil. Clad in cold garments and wielding iron swords, we march thousands of miles; who in the world does not know of us?
rows.description_html: 【Flying snow shoots the white deer, wishing to fulfill a dream in the martial arts world.】 With the clanging of weapons and the sword in hand, we roam the world, striving to uphold justice in the ever-changing martial arts world. With cold garments and iron swords, we march thousands of miles; who in the world does not know of us? Scholars and beauties, love and hatred, behind the flashing swords lies a hidden life of passion and affection. The ages-old saying 'Emotions only leave regrets' holds true, as one pities those who turn grey before growing old. Astounding events, stirring emotions, startling dreams, and heart-wrenching moments—only after all these shocking experiences do we understand that this journey through storms is called 'roaming the martial arts world.' 【Game Features】 Open-world and plot settings with freedom to roam the martial arts world. rows.name: Alphabet
rows.short_description: Alphabet is an exciting clicker that will immerse you in the world of letters and words. In this game you can get letters of different rarity for the time spent in the game. Collect letters, discover new words and use them to create unique items.
rows.description_html: Item Rarities and Drop Rates: The game features a diverse range of items, each with its own rarity and corresponding drop rate: Common (50%) Uncommon (24%) Rare (12%) Epic (7%) Exotic (4%) Mythical (2%) Legendary (1%) These probabilities determine how frequently you’ll obtain each rarity type. Common items are abundant, while legendary items are extremely rare and highly sought after. Steam Marketplace Integration: The game integrates with the Steam Marketplace, allowing players to acquire items from the market. This enriches the game's ecosystem, providing access to a wide array of items beyond those available in the in-game drop system. Crafting and Item Drops: Players can craft new items by combining five items of the same rarity. The crafted item will have a higher rarity, offering players a way to upgrade their inventory. Time-Based Item Drops: Every 30 minutes of gameplay, players receive a new item drop. This system ensures a steady influx of items, encouraging continued play and engagement. Showcase Feature: Players can use the items they collect to create words in their Steam profile showcase. This feature allows for a personalized touch, as players can arrange items to spell out their favorite words, messages, or names. The showcase adds a social and creative element to the game, making each item more valuable and meaningful.

rows.name: The Pauser
rows.short_description: 'The Pauser' is a narrative adventure game, developed by a student who drop out to make games. Player can stack blocks or 'pause' them mid-air to help the character pass levels.You can choose to watch 'ads' to 'speedrun' the game. But, is that really what you want? It all depends on you!
rows.description_html: 'The Pauser' is a narrative adventure game, independently developed by a university student who took a break from studies to create this game. Mr. Egg has finally awakened... after a nightmare. However, as he moves forward, he realizes something strange— the world seems... paused. In this game, players take on the role of a father on a journey to find his child. You'll need to use paused blocks to progress, but beware—numerous ads will pop up along the way. If you choose to watch them, the game's difficulty will drop significantly. Sounds great, right? ......right? This game satirizes the growing trend of 'watch ads to get rewards' in games and the increasing ads on social media and video platforms. The developer, frustrated by constant ad interruptions while watching videos, created this game to purposely disrupt the player's experience, giving you a taste of that frustration and expressing dissatisfaction with the current digital landscape. Welcome to try this game and enjoy it. This game is entirely free! The author made this game with 'love'. If you'd like to support my continued game development, you're welcome to make a small donation via my Instagrant 'ya_make game_ ya' where has a link to 'buy me a coffee'. The minimum amount on that platform is about $5. If you'd prefer to donate a smaller amount, please wait for the release of the DLC and purchase it. Please note: The DLC will not contain any additional game content. It is simply a way to support the author. Please carefully consider and evaluate your ability before purchasing. Thank you! How To Control： A/D ：left/right Space：jump Enter： Dialogue If any wrong happends,please use 'load game' button.

rows.name: Signs Of Life
rows.short_description: A meditative, non-combative point-and-click mystery set in a surreal, stop-motion inspired world. Explore dreamlike environments, uncover hidden objects, and piece together quiet clues to unravel fragments of forgotten meaning. Designed for players seeking a thoughtful, atmospheric experience.
rows.description_html: Signs of Life is a non-linear, surreal story driven adventure game. You are thrown into a bizarre scenario: a small woman with a mask is asking for your help to investigate a disembodied head she found in the backyard's hedge maze. Who is friend, who is foe, and how did we end up here? Play to find out. Features Non-linear story driven adventure game. Unique hand drawn 2D Art-Style and 2D animation with customizable character. Explore and click around to solve puzzles, play mini-games, and find objects including: Journal entries Books Objects to complete quests Slide puzzle Rhythm game Interactive objects to discover along your journey, such as singing flowers and a moon that talks back. Original Soundtrack by Caleb Jordahl.

rows.name: Sim Solver
rows.short_description: With the help of a companion, the program charged with running these simulations. You'll debug viruses by solving puzzles, shooting your way through hostile code, platforming around any number of obstacles, and exploring areas for key items that take you deeper into the simulation!
rows.description_html: Deploy into Sim Solver and play as a debugging software with a bit of a twist! A handful of nasty viruses have corrupted a series of varied simulations which at one point allowed people to explore and live out their wildest fantasies in a number of settings and styles. Only now they have become death traps and filled up with glitches and hazardous code that you need to debug! With the help of a companion, the program charged with running these simulations. You'll debug these viruses by solving puzzles, shooting your way through hostile code, platforming around any number of obstacles, and exploring areas for key items that take you deeper into the simulation! Start your journey now and start solving this sim!

rows.description_html: Synopsis. Many people have been invited to celebrate the Penguin Hotel's 18th anniversary. You are one of them. But no one could have predicted it. No one expected it to turn out that way... Freeze Camera This camera is a wonder. It can trap the subject inside the picture. Use this camera to solve mysteries and fight threats. Of course, you can also use it normally. Big Pen One of the characters in this hotel. He is a robot, so he doesn't move at night... Not a fan of horror? Want to enjoy the world and the story! We try to create games that both those who are good at horror games and those who are not good at horror games can enjoy. Series There is no ending branch. This game is Chapter 1. Chapter 2 will be available in the future. About video production and distribution Please include the name of this game in the distribution and video title. Please put a link to SETAM in the summary section. Other than the above, we do not specify anything else. Please use common sense. We want many people to know this game. So videos and distribution are welcome.

rows.name: Animals
rows.short_description: Animals is an engaging clicker game where every click counts. Explore unique habitats like Aerial, Arboreal, Terrestrial, and Aquatic, and collect diverse animals. Earn regular and rare drops influenced by your click activity. Join our community to help shape the game and build a vast metaverse.
rows.description_html: About the Game Welcome to Animals , a dynamic clicker game where your clicks matter! Collect unique animals and grow your collection as you explore different habitats. Why Play Animals? • Interactive and Engaging : Your efforts directly impact your rewards. The more you play, the more you earn! • Community Driven : Our game evolves with input from our community. Join us and have your say in the game’s development. • Strategic Clicking : With varied habitats and adaptive drop rates, each play session offers new strategies and challenges. Gameplay : • Active Clicking: The more you click, the better your chances of receiving rare and legendary items. • Animal Habitats: Explore four distinct verticals - Aerial, Arboreal, Terrestrial, and Aquatic. Each habitat offers unique animals and influences your click strategy. • Adaptive Drop Rates: Your drop chances are influenced by the avatar and habitat you’re exploring. Each vertical has its own drop rates for rare and legendary items. And of course, you'll recieve an animal from your active avatar's habitat. • Your Active Avatar: You can select any of your animal avatars from the inventory to click on, each group has their boosts and attributes. But be careful when selling them, as if you only have 1, you won't be able to click on it. You will still be receiving drops, but wasting the ability to increase your chances by session + today + history clicks. Features : • Animal Collection : Discover and collect a variety of animals, each with its own unique traits. • Boosts and Enhancements : Rare and legendary items provide significant boosts to your clicks per second (CPS), increasing your chances of finding more valuable items. • Regular Drops : Receive a common avatar drop almost every 3 hours (2.5h to be accurate, where chances from 80% to 100% depending on the rarity of your active animal avatar), and a rare or legendary item drop every 3 hours, with chances affected by your clicking activity. Take into account you'll receive animal drops from your active avatar habitat. • Community Integration : Submit your animal designs via Discord and see them come to life in the game! Join our vibrant community and contribute to the game’s evolution. Community Driven: • Collaborative Creation : We are in constant contact with our community, and our vision is to have players design new inventory items and animals. Your creations could be the next big hit in the game! • Building a Metaverse : Our goal is to create a larger metaverse. Animals is just the beginning. Future games, like a Tycoon game, will allow you to use your collected avatars, maintaining continuity and adding depth to your gaming experience. Join us in Animals and see how your clicks can lead to an extraordinary collection of animals! Join our Discord!

rows.name: Quacker Bros : First Heist
rows.short_description: Quacker Bros is a roguelike TD game about protecting your bounty from the intercepting chicken Mafia! Survive until the help comes and you can finally enjoy the blood and sweat of your heist!
rows.description_html: Your ducks have worked tirelessly to amass a fortune in gold and diamonds, but their hard-earned treasure has caught the eye of a ruthless chicken gang. These feathered fiends are on a mission to plunder your wealth and decimate your duck army. With addictive gameplay, endless challenges, and a touch of feathered fun, Quacker Bros offers hours of entertainment for strategy enthusiasts and casual gamers alike. It's time to quack back! Upgrade your ducks, unlock new and powerful units, and fortify your defenses to withstand the increasing ferocity of the chicken onslaught. Build and command an unstoppable force of ducks, each with unique abilities. Strategically deploy your troops to protect your bounty from wave after wave of chicken invaders. But beware! The chickens are cunning and relentless. They'll hatch new tactics and stronger birds to challenge your defenses. Can you outsmart these feathered foes and secure your fortune? Only the most strategic and fearless duck commander will prevail.

rows.name: California Escapades
rows.short_description: In this simulation and adventure game, explore 19th-century Gold Rush California. Join Jim and Emma to build and manage your farm and city. Plant crops, raise animals, construct buildings, complete missions, uncover secrets, and collect treasures. Start your adventure now!
rows.description_html: Hey, adventurers, welcome to California Escapades! Explore historical California's rich and dangerous lands while building up and maintaining your own farm and city with Jim, a gold miner, and Emma, a country farm girl. Everyone knows chasing after gold and treasure has its risks, no matter how careful you are. Join Jim and Emma on their adventures and find some rare treasure along the way! Features: • Build up your city with unique buildings, factories, production buildings, and decorations! • Complete various missions to explore and unlock the secrets of Gold Rush California! • Build and maintain your own farm with animals and crops! • Meet all kinds of bizarre characters and join special events during your adventure exploring the mysterious land! • Collect and produce items to build your own commercial empire through quests and completing orders! • Explore mysterious and magical lands! Let's explore historical Gold Rush California! Enter the game and start your adventure through a magical land of lush valleys, vast deserts, pristine snowfields. The home base has the perfect land to build your own farm where you can raise animals and harvest crops. Expand your farm into a city where you can buy and sell real estate, decorate with unique decorations, and conduct business transactions. When you're feeling adventurous, embark on a journey through the mysterious wilderness. Who knows what you'll find and who you'll meet! Play California Escapades now!

rows.short_description: Tap to the rhythm based on the shapes that emerge!
rows.description_html: Tap to the rhythm based on the shapes that emerge! This rhythm game features 3 main notes: Circle, Square and Triangle Single tap, hold-release and double tap for the different notes respectively. Try to reach the end without missing a note, or simply play through the level and test your accuracy! Features: 10 levels with different music Increasing difficulty of notes and timings with level progression 3 main modes (Normal, Hard and Accuracy) Practice mode for all main modes Settings customization for smoother gameplay Others: It is highly recommended to set your input and music offsets before playing. You can also change your input key-binds to best suit your needs.

rows.name: Mageanoid
rows.short_description: Silly computer game about a mage
rows.description_html: Dive into the heart-pounding action of Mageanoid. As a powerful mage, your task is to fend off relentless waves of undead skeletons with your magical powers. Each second counts as you unleash your spells and dodge the deadly strikes of their swords. How long can you survive in this epic twin-stick shooter? Source Code available on GitHub Features Pixel art graphics that bring the undead world to life Fast-paced twin-stick shooting action Endless waves of enemies to test your skills Disclaimer: Mageanoid is a simple game created in just one week to learn the Bevy game engine and the Rust programming language. Don't expect a lot of content; this is my first project with both tools.

Then do it again and again to become the ultimate Splatter! Collect coins to bid for upgrades and gain advantage over your opponent! Upgrade your upgrades Upgrades in the auction get more powerful for the underdog player, enabling comeback strategies!   Splat Splat contains: 15+ 'Balanced' Upgrade options 5 Dynamic Arenas Character Customization Local & Online Multiplayer 1v1 or 2v2

rows.name: HeartWare
rows.short_description: Yours decisions matters, leading to multiple unique endings that reflect your influence on Iris’s fate.
rows.description_html: HeartWare is an interactive visual novel that invites players into a captivating story centered around Iris. The game explores her journey as she seeks meaningful connections and a sense of purpose. As the player, you will guide Iris through various scenarios, making choices that shape her experiences and determine the course of her story. In HeartWare, every decision matters, leading to multiple unique endings that reflect your influence on Iris’s fate. Immerse yourself in a beautifully crafted world and uncover the depth of Iris’s personality as you navigate her journey. With rich storytelling, HeartWare offers an unforgettable experience that will keep you hooked from start to finish. Are you ready to explore the heart and mind of Iris?

rows.name: SCP: CARDTAINMENT BREACH
rows.short_description: SCP: CARDTAINMENT BREACH is a single-player turn based deck building card game based on the universe of the SCP foundation. You play as D-9341 who has been trapped in a room by 079 but has promised that on finishing of the game will unlock the gates and allow you to escape
rows.description_html: SCP: CARDTAINMENT BREACH is a singleplayer free-to-play strategy deck building game based on the SCP Foundation universe, an open source horror/fantasy writing project starring hundreds of anomalous objects and creatures. THE STORY In this game, you play as a human prisoner designated D-9341 who has found themselves inside of SCP-079s containment chamber due to a containment breach in which dozens of entities have escaped and caused havoc. You then find out that 079 was the one who instigated the breach, and similarly to you, has the same goal as you: freedom. 079 is willing to form an uneasy alliance, as you would make its job much easier. However, it does not fully trust in your capabilities, and due to the nature of the facility, cannot trust you unless you are useful to it. 079 needs to know if you are capable and intelligent enough to be useful, and luckily has a program built into itself that the foundation used to play with it to test its capabilities. If you fail the game, 079 states it will have to dispose of you through lethal means. This game however, to prevent 079 from learning even more data about the outside world, was based entirely off of the creatures and objects stored in the facility. This allowed 079 to piece together how the creatures worked and how to best exploit their weaknesses and strengths, and was able to formulate a plan for a containment breach. THE GAMEPLAY In this game, you put together a deck of 8 cards, including: 5 entity cards (SCPs like 173, 096, 106, 049, etc.) 2 item cards (131, 009, 500, etc.) 1 passive card (001, 207, 018, etc.) The game has a turn based structure in which both you and 079 will place down one entity card and one item card per turn. Afterwards, the cards enter the 'combat' stage, in which every card on the board, from top-left to bottom-right, will use their abilities. Some cards have special abilities, other cards can be stacked to build up their stats, known has horde cards. Certain passive cards have abilities based on the daytime, which is only visible if a daytime based card is on the board. Every 3 days, the day/night cycle will change. You and the opponent both have 10 HP, and to attack your opponent, your entity cards must enter the combat stage without having a card on the opposing side, thus leaving them open. Max HP can be configured before starting the game. Once you've proven yourself to 079, you can attempt again to see if you can beat it with a different or better strategy. This time, 079 does not threaten you with fatal consequences if you lose. You can play as many times as you want, as even if you lose and are 'disposed of' you may re-enter the game and try again.

rows.name: Muramasa Burden
rows.short_description: Wield a cursed katana to defend the world of living against Yokai spirits from other realm.
rows.description_html: The world is invaded by the Yokai spirits. The resistance is destroyed and the hope is lost, but the whispers are calling you to accept the burden. Embrace the curse of mysterious katana with all of its power in order to reach the heart of invasion and defeat the God of Yokai. Everything requires a sacrifice… The game narrative is inspired by Japanese mythology and built in the genre of dark fantasy. You will fight armed with the cursed sword on two unique looking locations with multiple arenas and bosses in the end of each location. Unique part of this Hack and Slash game is its health system. Instead of typical health points you have a timer, which represents the curse. You need to defeat enemies in battle in order to receive time. The curse also gives you superhuman abilities like instant dash and you can launch a deadly projectile with your sword. Another unique mechanic is a demonic rage. Less time you have left - stronger rage becomes. It has two stages which trigger automatically and each stage increases your attack and movement speed, damage and It also enchances your abilities. If you want - you can manually activate special stage of rage. This stage will unleash the beast within Samurai, giving even more bonuses, but the timer will run significantly faster. Use these gifts of the curse to defeat Yokai and banish them from our world! After you beat the game - your record will be saved in the global leaderboard and you will be able to compete with other players for the fastest completion of the game! The game is made by the student team of University of Applied Sciences Darmstadt, Germany. There are 5 members in internal team,2 sound production students and independent music composer.

rows.name: Command & Conquer™ Tiberium Alliances
rows.short_description: From the genre-defining RTS franchise Command & Conquer comes a unique, free-to-play strategic warfare MMO experience!
rows.description_html: The beloved online browser-based C&C title has arrived on Steam! Invite your friends to join the battle! Enter the legendary Command & Conquer universe, where the epic conflict between the formidable Global Defense Initiative (GDI) and the mysterious Brotherhood of Nod (NOD) continues. Command & Conquer: Tiberium Alliances introduces an innovative twist on classic gameplay, immersing you in a dynamic, ever-evolving world of endless strategic possibilities. This captivating free-to-play browser game offers a rich experience within the cherished Command & Conquer universe. Choose between two iconic factions—GDI and NOD—each with unique buildings, offensive units, and defensive units. Forge powerful alliances, strategize with friends, and dominate the battlefield in a game that rewards tactical skill and cooperation. Enjoy months of gameplay as you expand your base, enhance your units, and rise through the ranks in this dynamic, resource-driven war. Join the fight today and experience the next evolution in Command & Conquer! BUILD YOUR EMPIRE Choose your side and style of battle to secure victory. Construct your base with 15 different buildings. Build an army with 14 unique offensive units and 15 defensive units per faction. Research new tactics and weapons to make your forces unstoppable. CRUSH YOUR ENEMIES Unleash your strategic mind on a grand scale, collect resources, and empower your forces. Team up with friends and forge strategic alliances in-game. Storm the battlefield and destroy enemy bases in Player vs. Player and Player vs. Environment battles. CONQUER THE WORLD Prove your strategic prowess on a global stage. Join the Command & Conquer: Tiberium Alliances World Championship and compete against top players worldwide. Form alliances, strategize with friends, and dominate the competition to become the ultimate champion.

rows.name: Uncle Unco
rows.short_description: GET TO THE BUS!
rows.description_html: Uncle Unco is the cutest, fluffiest, most lovable character who just can’t catch a break... or his bus! Will Uncle Unco make it to the bus on time? That’s up to you! Key Features: Fast-Paced Fun: Dodge hazards with a unique control system and race to the bus stop. Hand-Drawn Art: Enjoy stunning visuals with a nostalgic pop-up book feel. Relaxing Yet Challenging: Easy to pick up, but offers more for those seeking to master the movement. Fully Accessible: Free to play, with full controller support for a seamless experience. Easy To Play, Hard to Master Appeal - casual players, speed-runners and completionists. Rage  - great for all audiences and streamers to rage at! Game-Feel - smooth yet goofy controls make it hilarious yet unique. Indie Game Community an award winning game and a hidden gem in the indie game scene. A jonniemadeit game

rows.name: Until Oblivion
rows.short_description: Until Oblivion is an atmospheric narrative game that follows 17 year old nobody Emma Wilson as she tries to rekindle a dying relationship in a dying world. Join her in an increasingly nightmarish Halloween party and find out if anything (or anyone) is worth anything at all.
rows.description_html: Harold they're destroying the universe Until Oblivion is a slightly horrific narrative game that follows 17 year old nobody Emma Wilson as she tries to rekindle a dying relationship in a dying world. Join her in an increasingly nightmarish Halloween party and find out if anything (or anyone) is worth anything at all. Featuring an atmospheric hand-crafted world, striking gothic imagery, and teenage takes on faith, work, and interpersonal relationships, Until Oblivion is a unique psychological experience whose horror is only usurped by its heart. And there are lesbians. Features: 2.5D stylized artwork Interactive dialogue with branching paths Themes of loneliness, love, and loss Time-loop yuri Gradually building horror Dark secrets and hidden lore He's watching you Flashing lights, bright colors, mild gore, implied self harm, mild jumpscares, disturbing imagery, depictions of hallucinations/insanity, swearing, possibly grating noises. I would like to honor the following people who helped during the development process, and whose contributions made this game a reality: Oli Remmy Lily Vivian Thank you so much for reading and checking out my game's page. This game is a pure passion project of mine and will always be 100% free, but you can help out by wishlisting if you're interested!

rows.name: Gladiate!
rows.short_description: Play with 6 unique decks and fight your way through a gauntlet of foes. Not only do you need to fight to survive, but also pull off combos to maximize your spectacle points and please the crowd. Can you make it to the final boss and emerge victorious?
rows.description_html: Friends. Romans. Countryfolk. CYBORGS! The fall of Rome never came to pass. Chariot races and gladiator fights abound, and the coliseum has become the default building on the streets of the world. Blood sport is the sole reason for the living, to beat up your fellow Romans to a pulp with enhanced limbs and senses. Can you make it to the final boss and emerge victorious? Gameplay Gladiate is a spectacle fighter card game, where its not about how fast you win, its about how cool you look doing it. Choose your deck and compete against mighty enemies for the adoration of the crowd, and maybe even a thumbs up from emperor Cybigula himself! Key Features 6 Unique playable decks with high score saved for each. 27 Unique cards to delight and destroy with 19 combos to dazzle the crowd 4 card classes 7 battles to fight through Custom music tracks to get stuck in your head. Day night cycle 1 Bossy Boi About Gladiate This is the first project from Teicsoft. A bunch of friends who decided to set themselves the task of making a game from scratch, in a month, with little to no experience. A whole lot was learned, skills we didn't know we had were found, and we hit our deadline to be able to present gladiate to you!

rows.name: Lost quest
rows.short_description: Bring your best weapon, this is a massive, ancient structure designed for one purpose: trapping the unwary. This isn't just a maze; it's a living entity, and you are its prey in this action/adventure game !
rows.description_html: Escape the Labyrinth: The Premise: You are the Prey, an unwilling participant trapped within a massive, ancient labyrinth. Its singular purpose hunts you. This is an Action/Adventure FPS focused on shooting ennemies, suspense, and survival. I. The Goal: Escape the Labyrinth The primary objective is straightforward, but the means are complex: Find the single, elusive exit and escape The Labyrinth. II. Character Progression: Adaptation and Augmentation A. Mastery and Insight (Non-Numeric Progression) Effect: Unlocks new Tactical Insights on the HUD (e.g., 'The Stone-Walkers are deaf to non-metallic sounds,' 'This floor tile always collapses after two steps'). This allows for non-combat bypasses. Weapon Familiarity: Simply using your 'best weapon' over time doesn't increase its damage. Instead, it improves the Character's Handling of it. III. Game Mechanics: Resource Scarcity, Tension, and The Labyrinth's Sentience The core gameplay loop is built around the terror of running out of resources while being stalked by an environment that actively opposes you. A. The 'Every Bullet Counts' System Resource Scarcity: Ammunition is incredibly scarce. A standard engagement might cost 5-10 bullets, but you might only find 2-3 in the entire next room.

Game Mechanics: Resource Scarcity, Tension, and The Labyrinth's Sentience The core gameplay loop is built around the terror of running out of resources while being stalked by an environment that actively opposes you. A. The 'Every Bullet Counts' System Resource Scarcity: Ammunition is incredibly scarce. A standard engagement might cost 5-10 bullets, but you might only find 2-3 in the entire next room.

rows.short_description: You, Youtuber James Pink, go into a haunted orphanage in order to get footage for your upcoming video. You are faced with paranormal activity in the orphanage while recording your footage.

rows.name: Szikra
rows.short_description: A relaxing, 2.5D side-scrolling short game set in a unique steampunk/fantasy environment. Find your way through vast fields, magical forests, and giant gears in a steaming factory to reach the twisted circus where your friend is locked up. Jump, find switches, push boxes around to get there.
rows.description_html: Szikra (Spark in Hungarian) is a relaxing, 2.5D side-scrolling short game set in a unique steampunk/fantasy environment. You have to find your way through vast fields, magical forests, and giant gears in a steaming factory to reach the twisted circus where your friend is locked up. There is no combat, no dying, and no way to fail. However, you will still need a few well-timed jumps, and you must find switches and push boxes around to get to your destination. Visual style The world and visual style of the game were inspired by the beautiful paintings of Anita Tóth (Worlds Within). In many places, you can find the original paintings in the game. Free to play Szikra was created in about 10 months by a sole developer as a fun project and is free to play. If you enjoyed playing the game, please consider supporting me by buying the Soundtrack DLC.

rows.name: PockeDate! - Pocket Dating Simulator
rows.short_description: Your Pocket-Sized Dating Simulator! Every launch brings a new date with unique dialogues! Spend endless hours with your adorable, love-struck virtual girlfriend.
rows.description_html: PockeDate! – Your Pocket-Sized Dating Simulator! Every launch brings a new date with unique dialogues! Spend endless hours with your adorable, love-struck virtual girlfriend. Meet Akari – your virtual sweetheart, head over heels for you. But be careful not to let her down! You wouldn't want to make her sad, would you? PockeDate! isn’t just a fun game – it's also a training ground for real-life dating! Through engaging interactions and unique scenarios, you'll learn how to communicate better, handle awkward moments, and make your date feel special. Get ready to boost your dating skills and confidence while having a blast with Akari! Features: Free! Familiar date spots with unique twists each time. Adorable girl who forgives all your awkwardness! Cozy, heartwarming atmosphere. Secret dates to discover! Charming pixel art graphics. Original soundtrack. Get ready for the cutest, most heartwarming dates of your life with PockeDate! PockeDate! - Pocket Dating Simulator is a visual novel where players read text, make choices, and influence the story's outcome. The game has an auto-save and auto-load function. The game does not guarantee the appearance of a real girlfriend after gaining experience in this game. Dear Participant, Your experience in PockeDate may include unsettling or frightening moments. While Akari is here to comfort you, her current state may occasionally become unstable due to unresolved system issues. We advises caution. Unexpected events are part of this experiment. Thank you for your participation.

rows.name: Gorble
rows.short_description: Gorble is a short marble-based dungeon crawl.
rows.description_html: Gorble is a short marble-based dungeon crawl. You are a marble and you explore a dungeon and fight enemies. Estimated play time 10-20 minutes. Gameplay Use the mouse to aim and flick the marble. You can charge the flick to make it stronger, and you can aim in any direction. Tips You can charge your flick ability while in the air. While charging in the air you fall slower.

rows.name: Don't Drop The Cake: Prologue
rows.short_description: Let’s deliver the cake. To reach your goal, you must cross a space crawling with monstrous creatures. If fear makes you tremble or you panic and drop the cake, it’s all over. This challenge isn’t for cowards. Only the brave and composed will make it through. Are you up for it?
rows.description_html: This horror game is impossible for cowards to beat 'Don't Drop The Cake' is a horror game where you must carry a wobbly cake while navigating a space infested with terrifying creatures. No matter how hard you try to hide your fear, it's obvious Even if you say, 'Fear is not in my vocabulary,' deep down, you might be scared. In this game, you must use your mouse to balance the cake and prevent it from falling. If your hands start to shake or you panic, the cake will fall, and your fear will be exposed for everyone to see. Face Unique and Terrifying Creatures In this game, you'll encounter uniquely designed, terrifying creatures unlike anything you've seen before. Use your wits and courage to avoid getting caught by them. Regarding Video Streaming Feel free to stream. This game is a prologue version. It is based on the first stage of the main game, but the content and presentation differ from the final version.

rows.name: My Dear Delirium
rows.short_description: Within this fully voice-acted Visual Novel, meet Elliot, and the vortex of conflicting truths he has become trapped in. Reach each ending to discover reality for yourself.
rows.description_html: Elliot is a troubled boy with a troubled mind, desperately clinging to the world around him. What would happen if his reality were called into question? Where do lies begin and end? Learn the different truths at play over the multiple endings the game has to offer. Voice Acting My Dear Delirium comes fully voice acted! The incredible cast are the stars of this show, so please enjoy as they bring each of the characters to life. Multiple Endings The game features two distinct endings! You can expect a short and sweet playthrough of each, with the whole game completable in an hour. Animated CGs A number of CGs within My Dear Delirium have been given that extra flair, making them even more impactful when it counts!

rows.name: Cashew Clicker
rows.short_description: Cashew Clicker is a simple idle game with prestige, upgrades, boosts and unlocks. Unlock the stars and take flight on your cashew production dreams.
rows.description_html: Cashew Clicker is an Idle Clicker with a combination of autoclickers, prestige points and bag upgrades. Using the tools at your disposal increase your production and become the master of the cashew enterprise. Autoclickers provide cashews per autoclicker bought. buying multiple autoclickers will provide prestige points when milestones are met. Prestige points can be used to lower the cost increase percent, autoclickers gather amount and total idle time. Cashew bags are filled by you and the autoclickers to be sold for money. making a certain number of bags will unlock the next bag that you can buy.

rows.name: Blackout: Director's Cut
rows.short_description: Upon abandoning your previous life, you find your past has finally caught up to you. Your world has gone dark, and you aren't alone. You must use your eyes to navigate through the dark and uncover the truth of the Meyer City Prison. You can't escape your inner demons. Your end is near.
rows.description_html: Upon abandoning your previous life, you find your past has finally caught up to you. Your world has gone dark, and you aren't alone. As a dark threat emerges, you find yourself cornered at an abandoned prison facility as you take refuge inside. You must use your eyes to navigate across dark environments and uncover the truth of the Meyer City Prison. You can't escape your inner demons. Your end is near. Don't be afraid of the dark Play through a 30+ minute single-player 2-D retro horror story, exploring a mostly dark world. Use your eyes as a tool to navigate through the darkness. Hunted As a dark entity targets the player, little defense is provided. The player must run, hide, die, or find another means of survival. Choose your path Exploration is inviting to players who seek different story events. This experience is filled with a dark atmosphere throughout its terrifying world. Flashing lights and loud noises will are also included. Play at your own risk.

rows.short_description: The ONLY clicker game with wear value on items! Collect and trade unique items by opening a LOOTBAWX! You'll be occasionally awarded loot boxes that are free to open. Join our discord where you can contribute and have some fun.
rows.description_html: EARLYBIRD 5000 USER SPECIAL LOOTBAWX We'll be releasing an extra special LOOTBAWX for the first 5000 players. Be sure to wishlist this game so you can launch on release date! NEW BAWXES SINCE RELEASE - Crawly gnome bawx - Revolver bawx (our first interactable gun bawx!) - Clicker bawx (collect all your favorite clicker loot!) - Meme bawx (collect your favorite memes!) About the Game LOOTBAWX let's you collect unique loot by opening free loot boxes. You will be awarded a free loot box between every 30 minutes and 2 hours as long as you are playing the game. It is your choice whether to open the crate, sell the crate, or even trade your loot on the marketplace to other fellow LOOTBAWXers! REGULAR DROPS Loot crates dropped every hour and new ones released weekly. WEAR VALUE, ITEMS GUARANTEED UNIQUE Loot has WEAR VALUE meaning each item you receive is UNIQUE. NO OTHER CLICKERS HAVE THIS! Each item also has rarity and special effects can be rolled too! INTERACTABLES Interactable items such as guns which actually shoot! SHOP, BUY AND SELL Shop where you can SELL your low tier loot for COINS and BUY crates. VIRTUAL PLINKO We even have PLINKO where you can roll to get coins buy even more crates! Party system! Join your friends to get loot faster! ... And many more features - Tons of steam achievements - Friendly discord ^_^ Upcoming features Beyond looting, we're also close to releasing a few features to make this an even better experience including both a FLEX and WAGER mode. In FLEX mode you get paired against a fellow player in a minigame and can flex your loot; WAGER mode is a winner-takes-all minigame where you can wager your loot and the winning player takes all the spoils. Please join our discord and give feedback on what you would like to see!

rows.name: Catastrophic Cat Command
rows.short_description: Command thousands of cats on their journey to find a new home! Catastrophic Cat Command is an arcade-style game where you manage multiple mini-games at once! It’s the perfect game for a quick 5-minute break from work!
rows.description_html: Command thousands of cats on their journey to find a new home! Catastrophic Cat Command is an arcade-style game where you manage multiple mini-games at once! It’s the perfect game for a quick 5-minute break from work! There are currently a total of 12 mini-games that take only a few seconds to complete. You’ll start with only one game active, but every 60 seconds, a new game spawns that you have to manage simultaneously. It gets stressful pretty fast, so bring a sweatband. The game starts in Tutorial Mode, where you can try out all available mini-games in a less stressful environment. Once you’re familiar with all the games, you can start the main mode by pressing Enter. Here, you’ll try to save as many cats as you can until you inevitably fail.

rows.name: Dungeon Divers Prologue
rows.short_description: Dungeon Divers Prologue is a dungeon-themed roguelike puzzle game about clearing derelict dungeons. As the newest employee of Dungeon Divers Inc., you must advance through multiple levels, use your wits, and tools you acquire along the way to get to the core to defuse it and bring home the cash.
rows.description_html: Prologue Features 2/3 main campaigns 0/10 challenge campaigns 24/48 items can be unlocked 8/12 secret room types included All progress carries over to the main game! Dungeon Divers is a dungeon-themed roguelike puzzle game about clearing derelict dungeons. As the newest employee of Dungeon Divers Inc., you must advance through multiple levels, use your wits, and tools you acquire along the way to get to the core to defuse it and bring home the cash. Test Your Wits With nearly a dozen different types of rooms to disarm each with their own conditions, quirks, and logic to solve what starts off as a simple task will become increasingly complex and difficult to decipher. Choose carefully as you only have a finite number of tries before your mission is deemed a failure. An Arsenal At Your Disposal As you progress through the dungeon you're clearing, objects of power may be uncovered to assist in your journey. Some simply help you survive mistakes, other may grant you the ability to uncover vital clues for your efforts, and some grant you extra riches. Choose wisely as you can only carry so many artifacts at once. Every Dungeon Is Different No two dungeons share the same layout. Procedural generation means that every delve is different providing countless hours of entertainment as you clear level after level.

rows.name: Breakout Epilepsia
rows.short_description: A fast-paced Breakout-style arcade with a bold black-and-white aesthetic. Engage in space battles against stunning yet deadly alien foes who are determined to destroy you. Intense visuals, thrilling gameplay, and a challenge that will test your reflexes.
rows.description_html: Breakout Epilepsia ⚠ Epilepsy Warning ⚠ The name Epilepsia is not random. This game contains fast flashing lights, intense patterns, and strong visual effects that may trigger seizures in people with photosensitivity or epilepsy. If you're prone to seizures or feel this game could affect you, we strongly advise against playing it. Play responsibly and prioritize your health. Dive into a fast-paced retro arcade experience that blends classic Breakout gameplay with boss battles inspired by Space Invaders. Smash blocks, dodge incoming attacks, and take on fierce enemies that will test your skills and reflexes. Follow the journey of Scarlet, a Russian-Mexican heroine on a mission to recover the three stolen crystals that have drained all color from Earth. To restore balance, she must defeat their guardians: Bella, an unpredictable gamer with borderline personality disorder; Kira, a tentacled alien inspired by Kraken legends; and Luna, a gothic girl who acquired dark powers during her time on Earth. 🎮 Features ✅ Striking black-and-white aesthetic with hypnotic effects. ✅ Fast-paced and challenging gameplay, perfect for short sessions. ✅ Three intense boss battles with unique mechanics. ✅ Classic Arkanoid/Breakout mechanics with a fresh twist. ✅ Space Invaders-style shooting sections during boss fights. 🎮 Developed by: Victoria “Cataxis” Pérez 🎵 Soundtrack by: LosthinK 🎨 Art by: Camila Deloris, Death Voice & Quetzalcoutl 🎤 Voice Acting : Camila Deloris, Dafne “Blakes” Muñoz , Ilce S Perez C, Kar “Pinkchocoball” Chávez, Neko Chibioso & Yulisa Viridiana Meza Gonzáles 🛠 Testers: Evangelo Ruiz, Celeste “Levalotte” Uribe, JuanGdev, kaydev, Diego A. Gómez, Bryan Hernández Cabrera, Ilce S Pérez C, Lalo Rejón, Eduardo Emmanuel Barba Aldana, Eliana Ricci

rows.name: YanYueDao Kill
rows.short_description: It's a simple and exhilarating command-based battle game. Slay monsters with well-timed strikes, explore maps, solve puzzles, collect items, interact with NPCs, and defeat bosses.
rows.description_html: This is a simple yet exhilarating command-based dungeon RPG. 1. Explore dungeons filled with rich and interesting map elements: open treasure chests, defeat bosses, and collect special items. 2. Super exhilarating command-based battles. Combat uses only two buttons for attack and defense. Perfectly defend against enemies by inputting the correct commands, while accumulating combos through timely attacks to unleash powerful finishing moves! 3. Cultivate your character with a stat upgrade system. Even when encountering powerful enemies, you can enhance your attributes and return to challenge them to achieve a comeback victory. 4. Encounter all kinds of travelers in the dungeon. Meet various people, listen to their strange experiences, and unravel the mysteries within the tower.

rows.name: obi3011-prologue
rows.short_description: This is a cyberpunk-themed pixelated psychological horror, romance, and adventure game. Amidst a chance encounter in the rain and a forced gathering, an unexpected journey unfolds—a humorous romance and adventure story between you, a robot, and your furry companions.
rows.description_html: This store page features the free prologue content of 'Obi 3011', which will take approximately 4 hours to complete. If you're interested, please add our full game 'Obi 3011' to your wishlist. Thank you! The English and Japanese versions may contain minor bugs and translation issues. If you encounter any problems, please do not hesitate to reach out to me! You can provide feedback in our community or through reviews, and I will make the necessary corrections promptly. Thank you! Korean and Western ban'ya languages are being added!  -Game Introduction- In the game, you play as an unnamed robot who is reclusive, loves staying at home, and is addicted to alcohol. Once again, after excessive drinking, you collapse on the street and are picked up by an unknown canine furry and taken back to your own home. But through a series of coincidences, he suddenly loses his memory! During this process, you meet other furry companions and embark on an adventure to search for his memory! However, in this tumultuous era, adventure is fraught with danger. As you help him regain his memories, your bond grows stronger, and at the same time, some hidden secrets gradually surface, making everything seem different... Faced with these harsh realities, can you make the right choices to ensure he remains the same person, and your relationship remains unchanged? -Game Features- ■ The game's storyline revolves around a sweet and humorous adventure-filled daily life. If you have a particular fondness for beastmen, younger partners, shota, non-human, robots, romance, comedy, adventure, cyberpunk, pixel art, psychological horror, and more, then this game is a must-try! ■ Exceptional gameplay presentation, featuring exquisite pixelated CGs, UI, and backgrounds, with many visual effects animated! ■ An abundance of character illustrations! Nearly two dozen distinct illustrations for the canine beastman and other characters, with over a hundred separate facial expressions, all animated! ■ Five different endings (though not an overwhelming number)! ■ A lengthy gameplay experience, with the demo lasting around 5 hours and the full game expected to take around 15 hours to complete, featuring approximately 300,000 words of text. ■ The protagonist, as a robot, lacks a traditional, fixed gender. ■ Care for an adorable, clingy canine beastman and embark on an adventure while nurturing a sweet romance! -Worldview- This is a cyberpunk world dominated by fierce beastmen, filled with technology, chaos, and violence. Once a highly advanced technological civilization, humans genetically engineered beastmen—new species with immense strength and unique appearances. However, a century ago, an unforeseen global upheaval struck, and no one knows what exactly happened. This disaster devastated the world, leading to the extinction of most species, including humans. Amidst the ruins, the surviving beastmen gradually rose to power. The once-prosperous technological civilization has collapsed, and most high-tech devices and knowledge have been lost. Over the past hundred years, beastmen have studied and researched the lost technology, mastering most basic scientific principles and technologies, but many human-made high-tech devices are damaged or non-functional. In this context, almost all beastmen resent humans, even though they've been extinct for a century. -Character Settings- Protagonist An android created by humans before the great catastrophe of the last century, almost indistinguishable from humans except for their lack of gender and the ability to access the internet and play games within their minds. Though capable of living for over a hundred years, they spend most of their time in hibernation until discovered and studied by beastmen ten years ago. Equipped with an omnipotent AI, their emotional intelligence seems lacking, perhaps to make them appear more human. They have no name, often referred to as 3011 due to being the last model of their kind, a title they dislike. Obi A canine beastman who has lost his memory, and no one knows his identity. Unlike other beastmen, his appearance is more human-like. what's their story? ---------------------------------------------------------------- !Important Note! The game contains depictions of gender identity, and psychological horror, which may not be suitable for everyone. Additionally, the game includes bright, flickering visuals that may be distressing or trigger seizures for individuals with photosensitivity. Please proceed with caution.

rows.name: Recycling Center Simulator: Prologue
rows.short_description: Recycling Center Simulator: Prologue is a free business simulator game in which you make money from garbage. Collect raw materials for your recycling center from different locations, recycle them, make money by producing new products and improving your factory.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Recycle Center Simulator: Prologue! Dive into the world of sustainable resource management in Recycle Center Simulato: Prologuer, where you take charge of collecting, sorting, recycling, and selling materials to build a prosperous recycling enterprise. Key Features: Build and Manage Your Recycling Base: Start with a humble warehouse, your central hub for gathering and processing raw materials. Expand and upgrade your facilities to maximize efficiency and production. Venture Beyond Your Base: Explore diverse locations outside your warehouse to collect recyclable materials. Receive tips and leads from online sources to uncover valuable resources, for which you pay a fair price. Fulfill Online Requests: Engage with virtual clients online who contract you to gather specific quantities of materials. Negotiate prices to ensure a profitable deal and expand your business reach. Employ a Skilled Workforce: Hire employees to assist with sorting and processing materials. Delegate tasks strategically to optimize workflow and increase productivity. Dynamic Market Economy: Adapt to a fluctuating market where prices for materials change based on supply and demand. Stay competitive by adjusting your strategies and seizing profitable opportunities. Become the Recycling Tycoon: From a small-scale operation to a leading recycling powerhouse, every decision shapes your success in Recycle Center Simulator: Prologue. Contribute to environmental sustainability while growing a thriving business that turns waste into valuable resources. Are you ready to transform trash into treasure and lead the way in eco-friendly entrepreneurship? Start your journey in Recycle Center Simulator: Prologue today!

In this first chapter, the protagonist sets out to find his missing brother, who vanished while searching for hidden treasures. Face the harsh elements, encounter unique creatures, and experience the thrill of exploration as the story of Haut begins to unfold. rows.name: Pixel Restorer
rows.short_description: As the last pixel restorer in the city, your job is to restore faded photographs that have been sealed away for a long time to their original glory.
rows.description_html: As the last pixel restorer in the city, your job is to restore faded photographs that have been sealed away for a long time to their original glory. **Gameplay**: 1. After entering the game, the image will automatically be divided into regions. You need to fill each region completely with rectangles of varying sizes based on the numbers provided. 2. Each rectangle must contain one number, and the number must equal the total number of cells in that rectangle. Once all regions are correctly filled, the level is complete. 3. Hold down the mouse button and drag over the cells to draw a rectangle. To erase a rectangle, hold down the mouse button and drag over it. 4. The three buttons on the left side of the screen allow you to refresh the region, get a hint, and view the full image. **Game Features**: 1. Retro pixel style 2. Carefully designed pixel artwork 3. Levels that are easy but still challenging 4. Simple and intuitive controls 5. A large number of levels 6. Relaxing background music

rows.short_description: Embark on a journey to learn the fundamentals of financial literacy through the practice of starting a cottage industry, managing resources, restoring the environment, and participating in a multi-regional economy.
rows.description_html: Explore the region of Venture Valley and discover the world beyond in Terracian Trails: Financial Frontier! Trek across iconic scenes reminiscent of the American Wild West, and uncover the secrets of Wild Wood, a mysterious and fantastical forest of magical origins. Engage in food cultivation, foraging, horse care, geological excavation, town management, wealth accumulation, and more, as you observe the world around you change for the better through your actions of working with the the inhabitants of both regions to develop a shared economy! Embark on a journey to learn the fundamentals of financial literacy through the practice of starting a cottage industry, managing resources, restoring the environment, and participating in a multi-regional economy. Financial Frontier's numerous activities are designed to emulate nature-based play and exploration, and encourage the development of an understanding of complex financial concepts and the natural world. rows.name: Cards of Heart
rows.short_description: Join Amalia on her journey to confront her inner Shadows! Complete errands for town residents, build your deck, face Shadows in gripping card battles, and uncover Amalia’s memories in this cozy, narrative-driven, deck-building RPG.
rows.description_html: This is the story of a girl who faced her Shadows… who, in the face of darkness, found her light. Amalia is a librarian’s assistant living in the small fantasy town of Respite who’s haunted by Shadows- dark beings born from her negative inner thoughts. But when a wisp named Ljos appears and gives her the ability to create cards of light from her everyday life, Amalia must use this power to face her Shadows and learn how to move forward while acknowledging the pain of her past. Developed in consultation with clinical psychologists and therapists, Amalia's abilities in the game are inspired by real-life therapeutic techniques. Amalia’s journey highlights both the uncomfortable reality of living with mental health challenges like depression and anxiety and the power of finding ways to manage them. Explore the town of Respite. Complete errands for townsfolk ranging from baking macarons to story time in the library! As you face more Shadows, you’ll unlock more of the town, giving you more areas to explore. Collect cards from Amalia's everyday experiences and build your deck. With each quest Amalia completes, she’ll create a card with stunning hand-drawn art and its own unique effects. What happens if you collect them all? Face Amalia’s Shadows in card battles. Learn the patterns of each Shadow, then counter them using techniques and strategies drawn from therapeutic practices. Will you combine cards to create chains of thought and reflect Shadow’s cards back at them? Or will you use Techniques to add extra cards to your hand and remove devastating debuffs from Amalia? How you approach each one is up to you! Upgrade your cards after every loss. Take a step back with Amalia and practice self care to make your cards even stronger! Uncover Amalia’s memories . Experience a story of love and loss as Amalia processes her past with her light spirit companion, Ljos. Where did the Shadows come from, and what memories are they hiding? Pet the dog. Yes, you do get a card for that. Cards of Heart was developed as a Master’s thesis project at the University of Southern California. Directed by Marielle Brady, the game was made over the course of a year by a team of 30+ students passionate about normalizing stories about mental health challenges and ways to manage them. Content note: Cards of Heart deals with themes of anxiety, depression, loss, and mental health challenges. Please consider whether these topics are right for you. If you need to seek help, there are a number of resources available online.
