rows.name: Entity Onboard
rows.short_description: In this sci-fi survival horror game, you'll use tools such as a flashlight and tape recorder to survive while a mysterious entity chases you. Hide in the light and don't let it touch you. Power up each floor to escape!
rows.description_html: Welcome to the B.B.S.S., a top of the line research space station that is studying a planet before its inevitable collapse into the near by black hole. During one of their trips to the planet, they come across an unknown entity which they bring onboard as a research specimen. In their keycard secured lab, everything is going fine until the entity breaks free, leaving the station without a crew. As you awake from cryogenic sleep, you find yourself alone. With no friends/crew mates around, just a tape recorder and flashlight to assist, you must avoid the unknown entity and reach the escape pod before you drift into the black hole. The station is in emergency power mode so, you must power each level to access the elevators. Can you escape with the help of your friends’ tapes or will you be consumed by this entity? Dive into this space station and use a variety of mechanics at your disposal to keep yourself alive. Balance your sanity and oxygen while hiding within the light. Try not to make too much noise and bring attention to yourself. This game hosts two game modes, a free-play as well as story mode that allows you to progress. There are also a number of collectables hidden throughout the levels for you to find! Can you find them all?
rows.about_html: Welcome to the B.B.S.S., a top of the line research space station that is studying a planet before its inevitable collapse into the near by black hole. During one of their trips to the planet, they come across an unknown entity which they bring onboard as a research specimen. In their keycard secured lab, everything is going fine until the entity breaks free, leaving the station without a crew. As you awake from cryogenic sleep, you find yourself alone. With no friends/crew mates around, just a tape recorder and flashlight to assist, you must avoid the unknown entity and reach the escape pod before you drift into the black hole. The station is in emergency power mode so, you must power each level to access the elevators. Can you escape with the help of your friends’ tapes or will you be consumed by this entity? Dive into this space station and use a variety of mechanics at your disposal to keep yourself alive. Balance your sanity and oxygen while hiding within the light. Try not to make too much noise and bring attention to yourself. This game hosts two game modes, a free-play as well as story mode that allows you to progress. There are also a number of collectables hidden throughout the levels for you to find! Can you find them all?

rows.name: Face The Abyss
rows.short_description: The experiment has failed. The facility that was supposed to control the monster has stopped working, and now your only hope is to escape the facility before the monster hunts you down.
rows.description_html: Description 'Face the Abyss' is 1 vs 3 PvP game. One player takes on the role of the monster, or 'Stalker', who hunts down the survivors with its powerful psychic abilities. The other three players are the survivors, or 'Crew', who must find a way to escape. Indoor Chase The Stalker chases the Crew through a narrow and complex facility, relying on sound and terrain features. The Crew must overcome and utilize the limitations of restricted vision in this complex indoor environment to achieve their goal. Escape scenarios Escaping the facility won't be simple. The Crew must complete one of the 'escape scenarios' to make their way out. Observe the current situation carefully and figure out the most appropriate way to escape. Cooperate with other Crew members to achieve the goal quickly. Escape the facility before being overwhelmed by the Stalker's abilities. Stalker and Abilites The Stalker has various abilities at its disposal. Decrease the Crew's sanity with powerful psychic abilities. A Crew member with low sanity is much easier to hunt down. Erode the facility and destroy doors to leave the Crew with nowhere to run. Crew and Items The Crew can find plenty of items throughout the facility. Use these itmes wisely to delay the Stalker's pursuit and stay alive. Some items are essential for completing escape scenarios.

rows.name: Gumballs & Dungeons
rows.short_description: Embark on a free, exciting roguelike adventure with Gumballs & Dungeons! Collect and find hundreds of Gumballs, all with their own unique abilities, and create a synergistic team to tackle procedurally generated dungeons, discovering secrets and a trove of easter eggs as you explore!
rows.description_html: Dive into this charming and unique roguelike dungeon crawler. Start off on a great adventure, and lead a growing cast of unique Gumballs to defeat the Evil Dominator of the Erathia Continent! Explore procedurally generated dungeons full of different mechanics, devastating bosses, and quests to complete. Discover and team up with hundreds of Gumballs, each with their own unique abilities and design, as well as uncovering numerous easter eggs and surprises. Gumballs & Dungeons is Free-To-Play FOREVER on Steam, with no additional purchases. Come and remember what the pure passion for gaming is all about! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *Compared to the original version, the Steam version is playable offline, and makes dungeon expeditions the core gameplay loop. This means areas and things like the Sky and Space domains have been removed and adjusted appropriately. As it is also a separate version, the profiles cannot be imported or exported between either version. Features Click to reveal your path through the shadows of the dungeon. They could reveal a fierce enemy, an extraordinary event, a cave of mysteries, or...!     Explore over twenty different dungeons, each with their own themes and surprise mechanics!     A Labyrinthian hoard of easter eggs for you to stumble across and enjoy! Make sure to explore every path (both visible and hidden ones)!     Hundreds of unique Gumballs to collect and upgrade, from four different factions and all with unique abilities and skillsets! Link gumballs together to borrow their powers during expeditions!     How deep can you go with our unique Endless Mode? How many powerful bosses can you overcome before you eventually falter?     A space-time rift has opened up to the world one thousand years later. This dungeon is full of nostalgic sights that are now twisted in certain manners...

rows.name: In Your World (I Own)
rows.short_description: After a productive session, Yaldız and Gece find themselves in unexpected places and situations. Can you join forces with Inanna to defeat Utu, the god tormenting this duo?
rows.description_html: IMPORTANT!! We are having some issues about scaling. If you are a Mac user please change your resolution to 1280x800. If you are a Windows user please change your resolution to 1920x1080. Three musician friends are recording in their studio when everything changes. Utu, the evil god living in an old castle, attacks and throws the world into chaos. Now, the universe and time are in danger. In Your World (I Own) is a 2D RPG game where you join this epic adventure. Utu’s evil plans trap Yaldız in Inanna's universe. Your goal is to explore these dangerous worlds, interact with NPCs, complete quests, and collect five powerful spellements through fun mini-games. When you collect all the spellements, you can reach Gece and restore order to the universes. Your friends' fate is in your hands! Features: Deep story and rich world, Interact with NPCs and complete quests, Fun mini-games and puzzles, Classic 2D RPG gameplay and exploration, Beautiful music and graphics, Join the adventure in In Your World (I Own), collect the talismans, and save the world! Press the space bar to skip dialogues and use the arrow keys to move. Have fun! (ps: if you’d like to give an in depth feedback please don’t be shy and reach us at instagram: @https.tahta @suedakaraahmet or mail us: inyourworldiown@gmail.com)

rows.name: Native Isekai Defense: Prologue
rows.short_description: As part of the Pioneer Corps, form a party with other players and take on missions to protect humanity's last remaining land and reclaim the contaminated territories from the enemies!
rows.description_html: Wishlist The Full Version About the Game Prologue Native Isekai Defense: Prologue is the FREE prologue version and does not reflect the final version of the game. Here you will be able to play co-op with your friends up to 4 players, more stages, characters, and features will be available in the full version. Story Native Isekai Defense takes place in a world called Lumina. Hundreds of years ago, those who called themselves the Progenitors introduced themselves on the world stage. With armies of monsters under their command, the world of Lumina was plunged into an endless great war. Centuries passed, the Progenitors and their monster armies managed to conquer and contaminate one-third of the world. However, hope was not yet lost. The genius alchemist, Ariel, succeeded in creating the Ethereal Nexus, an artifact capable of purifying the land of Lumina that had been contaminated by monsters. With this creation, the time to strike back had arrived. Thus, Project Eden was launched. The Pioneer Corps was formed to go forth and reclaim the lands that had been contaminated! Pioneer Corps Join the Pioneer Corps alongside other players and become an elite soldier of Lumina! Form parties with various characters and take on different missions! Project Eden The time has come to reclaim the lands of Lumina! Activate the Ethereal Nexus in the corrupted lands and protect it from monster attacks until the land is fully purified! Watch Out for Friendly Fire! Watch every move you make! Look around—are your allies nearby? Make sure you don’t hurt them! But if it happens, remember, this is war! Friendly fire is inevitable! There is no war without sacrifice! Become a Hero! In every mission, you will charge into enemy-occupied territory! Use your skills and weapons, and fight alongside your comrades! Protect the Ethereal Nexus with your life, or the life of your comrades! Survive and reclaim our land! And become a hero of Lumina! Waves of Monsters! An endless onslaught of monsters! And there’s a big boss too?! Still, you must survive! Even if it means stepping over the lives of your comrades! For the future! Let’s reclaim and free our land from their filthy hands!

rows.name: Skill Legends Royale
rows.short_description: This is a free multiplayer PvP strategy game that incorporates rogue-like and auto chess elements, players need to equip their auto-battling heroes with the right treasures and skills to ultimately defeat all other players and become the champion.
rows.description_html: Android mobile game test Skill Legends Royale is a free multiplayer PVP strategy game. Blending rogue-like and auto chess elements, it delivers a fresh gaming experience. Players must equip their auto-battling heroes with the right treasures and skills to outlast all other contenders and secure victory. 12 Unique Archetypes *The game features 12 distinct archetypes, with more to come in future updates. Random Selection of 8 Archetypes *Each match features 8 randomly selected archetypes, ensuring a unique experience every time. Freely Combine Archetypes *Different archetypes complement each other—experiment to craft the most powerful combination. Rich Content *Over 100 skills for endless build possibilities. *60+ treasures to mix and match. *30+ unique heroes, each with distinct traits. Auto Battler-like *Eight players face off online, with everyone fending for themselves. Easy to Pick Up *Everything can be randomized, and heroes auto-battle, letting you play with ease. Thank you for playing our game—we hope it brings you joy. We first developed this gameplay in the Warcraft 3 Editor, where it was enjoyed by over 300,000 players on the KK platform. With over 10,000 reviews and a 9.5 rating, it’s the authentic original “Electronic Fighting Insects” experience. We are committed to keeping the game fresh with continuous updates and look forward to your support.

rows.name: Merge Donut
rows.short_description: Merge Donut is a delightful clicker game where you click on Donuts! Every 3 and 18 hours, receive a surprise Donut to grow your vibrant collection. Can you gather them all?
rows.description_html: About the Game Welcome to the whimsical world of Donuts! Dive into a delightful merge adventure where your mission is simple yet endlessly entertaining: merge on Donuts! Every 3 hours and 18 hours, a surprise Donut will appear, ready to join your vibrant collection. Can you gather them all? Features: A Bounty of Donuts : Discover a diverse array of quirky Donuts, each with its own unique charm. Collectible Items : Find special items to enhance and grow your Donut collection. Merge System : Combine Donuts to unlock new and exciting variations, increasing their value and rarity. Achievement : Unlock a unique achievement as you expand your Donut empire. Endless Fun : With so much to explore and collect, the fun never stops in the world of Donuts! Get ready to collect, merge, and build your way to Donut greatness!

rows.name: Blackwoods
rows.short_description: Alternate history Cold war FPS. Join the Blackwoods unit and unravel a conspiracy which threatens to end your resistance once and for all.
rows.description_html: Blackwoods is a story focused FPS with short to medium-length levels, 'bullet-time', weapon throwing mechanics and no weapon reloading to encourage scavenging and the use of enemy weapons. You are 'Hawk'- an untrained, partisan soldier with little weapon training so controlling the Cold-war era weapons is difficult and constant movement is encouraged. Blackwoods takes place in an alternative history diverging shortly after the onset of the cold war. The resistance in the Baltic countries is not suppressed as readily early on which emboldens them and enables them to last far longer than they did in reality. Decades later, the resistance is very close to being a private army with scavenged uniforms and weapons but lacking the training- however, the enemy will not simply sit idle and allow you to grow more powerful. You will be joined in this fight by other members of the Blackwoods unit as well as some unknown characters who have simply been caught up in this battle. The nature of this unit means nobody's true intentions can ever be known so who can you really trust when everything is on the line? Use an array of popular period-appropriate weapons as well as some more rare and experimental weapons from throughout the cold war. Over 40 different weapons can be collected and some may even be used akimbo to really give you some firepower!

rows.name: Doner Master Simulator: Prologue
rows.short_description: 'Run your own döner restaurant in Döner Master Simulator! Prepare delicious döner, satisfy your customers, and grow your business. Become a master döner chef and own the most popular spot in town!'
rows.description_html: Welcome to Döner Master Simulator! Prologue: Döner Master Simulator In the heart of the city, known as the capital of döner, you are taking your first steps towards becoming a döner master. You've seized the chance to take over the legendary döner shop, and this is not just a job; it's an adventure that will change your life. Your task is to prepare delicious döner and maximize customer satisfaction. In this fantastic döner shop, you need to win the customers' favor and grow your business. On your first day, you'll get to know the shop, learn how to use the equipment, and discover how to prepare various ingredients. But it's not just about slicing ingredients and cooking döner. You'll need to customize orders according to the different preferences of your customers. Using all your skills to respond to each customer's needs, satisfy them, and serve the best döner will be crucial. Success depends on how you manage your business. Managing your shop correctly, using the equipment effectively, and preparing perfect döner will make you the best döner master in the city. Are you ready? Start this adventure and become the capital of döner!

rows.name: Spell of Infinity
rows.short_description: Play for Free !! Enter the world of swords and magic now. Team up with your friends in the fantasy world of your dreams, strategically select your heroes, and conquer your enemies.
rows.description_html: - 'Spell of Infinity' is a 3D MOBA game set in a world of swords and magic. You can team up with other players and fight in 4:4 battles or compete in boss mob raids. Also, most of the content is open so you can enjoy the game without any separate purchases, so there is no burden! Join the online battlefield right now! - Strategically select 16 heroes to subdue your enemies! (Tank type STR, damage dealer CON, supporter and special magician WIS, ADP who is good at fast growth and non-magical skills) ※ New features, pets, skins, DLC, and heroes will be added regularly! Tens of thousands of years after the creation of the world, the gods fell into eternal sleep, and human greed led them to forbidden magic. The Kingdom of Cory made some kind of deal with 'Darkside' to invade the neighboring Principality of Kudarin and the entire continent beyond, and the 'Eternal Crystal', the source of life and magic power, is gradually losing its power. To determine the future of the world, which is like a light in the wind, the time of the decisive battle between new heroes - those who want to protect and those who want to take over - is imminent. - Free to Play: Get multiple free hero acquisition coupons when you sign up and achieve major achievements - Crystal System: Summon magic crystals anywhere on the map, easily trade with merchants, and manage your inventory. When upgrading the crystal, cast buffs/debuffs and active skills as a supporter of your allies. - Raid Boss Mode: Become a dragon slayer and gain additional Rank Points. - The 'Talisman' item blocks the opponent's CC or debuff skills several times. Also, if you throw the 'Void Orb' at the opponent, the buffs will be removed. Use it at the right time. - The basic pets are powerful, but there are also more special pets available. - Accumulate victory points to increase your rank and raise your country's flag high on the leaderboard. - Eliminate special mobs to earn advanced items or team rewards.

rows.name: Cactiverse
rows.short_description: The world of Cactiverse, where gardening meets dragon-fueled fun! Grow your cacti, unleash waterballs, and join a vibrant community on Discord. With weekly tournaments and hilarious gameplay, Cactiverse is your next obsession. Fun, challenging, and social—what more could you ask for?
rows.description_html: Welcome to Cactiverse where cactus-growing meets dragon-flying in a bizarrely epic mashup! Start with a tiny cactus and water it every four hours. Add more cacti, and the watering schedule speeds up, getting you drops faster! Who knew cacti could be this exciting? But wait, there’s more! rows.name: Car Dealer Simulator: Prologue - Early Days
rows.short_description: Free introduction to the full Car Dealer Simulator game takes you on a journey from being Little Sam’s assistant to owning the business. Discover deals, buy low, repair cars, and sell them for a profit.
rows.description_html: Roadmap About the Game Car Dealer Simulator Early Days is a free prologue to the full Car Dealer Simulator game. Little Sam, the quirky owner of the business, will introduce you to its secrets. He’s not great at keeping things in order, so your task is to buy low, fix up, and sell high. In the full game, if you handle the initial tasks well, you’ll have the chance to take over the business, and then… Everything will be in your hands! Build a business that fulfills your customers’ automotive fantasies. From budget-friendly cars to extravagant rides, seize opportunities, hire the best, provide excellent service, and maximize profits. Grow your company day by day. The key to achieving high profits lies in negotiating when buying old cars. Look for great deals, and during price haggling, stay firm and professional. Not all purchased cars are in working condition, so you’ll need to use a tow truck to transport them. Every car requires diagnostics and preparation before being sold. At Little Sam’s request, you’ll perform your first mechanical and bodywork repairs. In the prologue, the available tools are quite limited. Presenting a car to the customer requires a few tricks. Washing, good photos, and an engaging advertisement will be your allies. Little Sam will guide you through tasks such as washing, taking photos, and creating a sales listing. Remember, customers buy with their eyes, so use the shine of the paint, a full tank, and quality photos to your advantage. Your profits will allow you to continually grow your company. In the prologue, you’ll have the chance to upgrade the car wash, while in the full game, you’ll unlock additional tools, repair zones, and the customer service office.

rows.name: Grimstone Valley
rows.short_description: Grimstone Valley is a third-person supernatural action game set in the wild west. Utilize a lasso-like eldritch arm to control your enemies and your environment, taking advantage of deadly and alien objects to defeat your foes in fast-paced, tactical combat.
rows.description_html: Grimstone Valley is a third-person supernatural action game set in the wild west. Utilize an eldritch arm comprised of powerful tendrils to reposition enemies and control your environment, taking advantage of deadly and alien objects to defeat your foes in fast-paced, tactical combat. Save your home. A doomsday cult attempted to sacrifice you to an unknowable power. They failed. You survived, but the ordeal cost you your arm. In its place now grows a powerful mass of tendrils that move as though they’re alive. Now, the cult’s machinations have twisted the whole of the valley into a nightmarish hellscape overrun with monsters. With your newfound power and a tenuous connection to the force on which the cult calls, you may be the only person capable of stopping them. Master your tendrils. Your alien arm gives you complete control over the world around you. With keen eyes and quick thinking, you can use your surroundings to deal devastating blows to the valley’s alien invaders. Smash them, impale them, burn them, even blow them to kingdom come. Enemies are vulnerable as well; control their movement and launch them across the battlefield to keep yourself out of harm’s way. Eldritch growths and mundane defenses alike can be turned against your foes with smart positioning and practiced aim. Work with the people of the valley. Grimstone Valley may be nearing destruction, but its people are still holding on. Survivors hide out at The Last Spike, a saloon on the outskirts of town that’s been turned into a hub for the local rail workers’ union. The Spike is home to a host of survivors that you can speak to, learn from, and lean on for support. You may be the valley’s last line of defense, but this fight isn’t yours alone.

rows.name: BirdLingo: A birdsong learning game
rows.short_description: Welcome to BirdLingo, a game designed for honing your bird song recognition skills. Immerse yourself in a cute and relaxing atmosphere as you learn the songs of the 44 most common birds in Europe.
rows.description_html: Welcome to BirdLingo, a game designed for honing your bird song recognition skills. Immerse yourself in a cute and relaxing atmosphere as you learn the songs of the 44 most common birds in Europe. Explore various habitats such as grasslands, gardens, farmlands, parks and seaside. The more you play, the more birds you unlock! The Bird Library is your companion, helping you track your journey, learn from your mistakes and discover fascinating facts about each bird you’ve encountered. Real-World Applicability Birdlingo simulates the complexities of real-life birdwatching. In the final levels, you’ll face the challenge of identifying multiple bird songs simultaneously across different habitats, mirroring real-world scenarios. Progressive Learning Curve The game starts with helpful assistance that gradually scales back. This scaffolding approach ensures a smooth, progressive increase in difficulty, allowing you to build confidence as you advance. Mastery Through Repetition Birdlingo emphasizes learning through repetition. With multiple games for each habitat and varied recordings of the same song, it reinforces your memory and recognition skills through repeated practice. Thoughtful Design It’s more than a simple quiz. Each challenge is crafted to pair birds with similar calls, striking the perfect balance of difficulty. Our help buttons act as clever guides, providing hints that lead you to the answer through your own discovery, without giving it away. Fun and Addictive Gameplay Birdlingo’s charming visuals make the game both fun and relaxing while the engaging gameplay ensures that you learn without even realizing it. Personalized Learning Experience Your learning journey is in your hands. Whether you prefer an in-depth dive or a lighter touch, the game allows you to tailor your experience. All habitats and levels are endlessly replayable, enabling you to set your own pace. Our bird library is available for those seeking more knowledge, but it’s always optional. When you’re ready for the ultimate challenge, the final stage lets you choose the difficulty you want to tackle. Free and accessible to all.

rows.name: Big City Dreaming
rows.short_description: An open world visual novel filled with lots of intrigue and stories.
rows.description_html: Big City Dreaming is story based point and click adventure open world visual novel. The game is free to play and nowhere near fully completed but still has plenty of content for you to explore. This is a one man team game and the visuals were created with the use of A.I. image generative tools, that's why it's free to play. You play as Harry, an aspiring musician who is looking to find his place in the world. There are plenty of characters to interact with and places to discover as you uncover the secrets of the Big City. This game was made with the Renpy engine.

rows.name: Before the Dawn: SENARA Prologue
rows.short_description: You must attempt a life-or-death escape from the SENARA — a 6,000-ton vessel meticulously recreated from a real-world ship. This first-person survival horror prologue tells the story of a different survivor, set before the events of 'SENARA: The Sacrament'.
rows.description_html: About Before the Dawn: SENARA Prologue is a first-person survival horror game where you infiltrate the SENARA disguised as a follower to uncover the truth behind a dangerous cult. But once your cover is blown, you're imprisoned—and now, your only goal is to escape. Navigate the claustrophobic corridors of a massive, 6,000-ton ship meticulously recreated from a real vessel. As the truth slowly unravels, you'll come face to face with a grounded, suffocating sense of fear. In this eerie world ruled by faith and fanaticism, you must avoid the eyes of ever-watchful sentinels, collect clues, recover a vital investigation journal, and find your way out. This game is both a standalone experience and a prelude to SENARA: The Sacrament , shedding light on how one key character became entangled in the events to come. Key Features Hyper-immersive realism grounded in reality Experience unparalleled tension and immersion inside a lifelike environment meticulously modeled after a real large-scale vessel. Clue collection & puzzle-based exploration Gather scattered documents, equipment, and items hidden throughout the ship. Solve puzzles to open up your escape route. Hallucinations & auditory illusions in silence Surrounded by hallucinations and whispers in the unnerving silence of the ship, you must maintain your sanity. If your mind breaks—so does reality. The ones who stand in your way Someone—or something—is always watching. Move carefully to avoid patrolling sentinels and uncover the path to truth and escape. Coming Next This game serves as a prologue to the main title SENARA: The Sacrament, shedding light on the origins of the incident and one of its key characters. In the full game, players will follow the protagonist’s attempt to escape a mysterious sinking incident aboard the twin ship of the SENARA, featured in the title SAVE . As you investigate the ship's sinking, you’ll uncover chilling ties between a fanatical cult and the entities lurking in the abyss. Face the full truth—and overwhelming terror—in the upcoming SENARA: The Sacrament .

rows.name: IDUN Prologue - Frontline Survival
rows.short_description: Step into the arena with IDUN: Prologue, a thrilling slice of our full-length defense RTS where real-time strategy meets rogue-lite chaos. Fight your way through unique mission objectives with overwhelming swarms of enemies.
rows.description_html: IDUN: Prologue is a single-player action RTS with a story campaign. The prologue lets you try a portion of the main game with only a limited number of turrets, tools, and heroes. Step into the arena with IDUN: Prologue, a thrilling slice of our full-length defense RTS where real-time strategy meets rogue-lite chaos. Get a sneak peek at the intense arena mode, where you’ll face overwhelming enemy swarms with a diverse arsenal of turrets, tools, and heroes—just a taste of the full IDUN game that awaits. Each run throws you into procedurally generated arenas filled with unpredictable challenges, unique mission objectives, and an ever-evolving environment. Adapt quickly as massive hordes flood the screen, and leverage destructible terrain to your advantage. With branching paths, powerful upgrades, and varied mission modifiers, every playthrough delivers a fresh and dynamic experience. Real-time Tactical Flexibility Break free from traditional tower defense gameplay—deploy and reposition your units freely, taking full command of the battlefield. Dynamic Battlefield Experience ever-changing missions as the battle against relentless enemy swarms reshapes the terrain. Destruction and enemy remains create new challenges and opportunities, demanding constant tactical adaptation. Play Your Way: Full Control Anywhere Enjoy the freedom to play IDUN however you like! The game offers seamless support for Mouse & Keyboard, Gamepad, Touch, and is now fully optimized for Steam Deck. Take advantage of extensive customization options for both visuals and controls, ensuring the perfect gameplay experience tailored to your preferences.

rows.name: Zombie Siege City
rows.short_description: Grab your weapon, enjoy the thrill of zombie shooting, and don't stop firing until every last zombie is... well and truly dead. Earn rewards for your efforts, unlock new weapons, upgrade existing ones, and exterminate as many walking dead as possible.
rows.description_html: The world has plunged into terror as gruesome hordes of zombies overrun it. As the hero in this on-rails shooter, you'll navigate the zombie frontier amidst floating brains and intense action. Defending against zombie attacks and protecting survivors is crucial, adding depth to the captivating storyline unique to zombie shooters and apocalypse survival games. Tracking various enemies in the chaotic horde defense can be challenging, but once you unleash your inner demon, nothing can stop you from becoming the ultimate survivor! Trust us on that! Immerse yourself in 'Zombie Siege City,' an FPS zombie shooter set in a terrifying near future where a deadly epidemic has turned the world into a zombie-infested battleground. Fight off a variety of zombies—from zombie prisoners and zombie dogs to epic boss monsters—using over 10 different weapons! Enjoy vibrant cartoon graphics and enhance your 3D pixel gun for greater damage, accuracy, reload speed, or ammo capacity. No zombie, no matter how relentless, can survive your determination to ensure humanity's survival. FPS zombie games have never been this thrilling! Don't miss out if you enjoy action-packed shooting games! Key Features: -Stunning 3D pixel cartoon graphics -Realistic zombie reactions to hits, each type of zombie disintegrates uniquely -User-friendly controls for a more engaging zombie-killing experience -Over 20 types of zombies, including shooting zombies, zombie dogs, and more -Formidable boss monsters -A diverse arsenal featuring 10+ weapons, from revolvers to devastating weapons like rocket launchers -Precision targeting with headshots for instant kills -Skill-based FPS gameplay rewards health management, high headshot percentages, and offers bonus rewards -Rail shooter mechanics The post-apocalyptic world teeming with zombies poses many dangers, but you're prepared for every challenge it throws at you! Grab your weapon, enjoy the thrill of zombie shooting, and don't stop firing until every last zombie is... well and truly dead. Earn rewards for your efforts, unlock new weapons, upgrade existing ones, and exterminate as many walking dead as possible. In 'Zombie Siege City,' your survival skills are put to the ultimate test. Will you be the hero who saves humanity, or will you become another zombie's dinner?

rows.description_html: Whoopi is an engaging clicker game where you interact with a cute monster named Whoopi. Choose to feed or attack Whoopi by clicking the respective buttons. As you click, you earn Whoopi coins, which can be used to buy cases containing unique and valuable skins. Watch as Whoopi grows to the size of a galaxy or shrinks to the size of a molecule. The more you play, the more chances you have to collect rare skins and sell them on the marketplace for real money. Dive into this simple yet rewarding game and start your adventure with Whoopi today! Key Features: Interactive gameplay with feeding and attacking options Dynamic transformations of Whoopi from a galaxy to a molecule Collectible skins with real-world value Marketplace integration for buying and selling skins

rows.short_description: After receiving a mysterious invitation to a summer camp, you are captured by Sister Madeline inside Eagle's Junior High School. Now, your mission is to escape the school before Sister Madeline manages to complete her evil plan.
rows.description_html: After receiving a mysterious invitation to a summer camp, you are captured by Sister Madeline inside Eagle's Junior High School. Now, your mission is to escape the school before Sister Madeline manages to complete her evil plan. Explore the school as you escape from Sister Madeline in your quest to regain your freedom. Solve puzzles and challenges until you find one of the multiple escape routes in the game. Discover the secrets hidden in the laundry room and the mysterious boy with blue hands to complete the game 100%. Some features: ★ The most famous horror game! ★ Fun puzzles: Solve clever puzzles to escape from the school. ★ Mini-games: Complete puzzles in the form of mini-games and challenges that will test your skill. ★ Multiple escape routes: Discover all available ways to escape from the school. ★ Large map: Freely explore a large map with many secrets to discover. ★ Intriguing story: Discover all the truth hidden behind the walls of Eagle's Junior High School. ★ Different difficulties: Play at your own pace and explore without risk in Ghost Mode, or take on Sister Madeline in different difficulty levels that will test your skill. ★Customize your games: Unlock new weapons, school decorations and skins for Evil Nun to customize the game to your tastes. ★ A terrifyingly fun game suitable for everyone! If you want to have a scary time, playFrightening Monastery now and try to escape from this horror school. Frights are guaranteed. It is recommended to play with headphones for a better experience. ★The game includes gameplay such as 'horror' and 'violence'. Players who mind should choose carefully!

rows.name: Floodcore
rows.short_description: Floodcore is a puzzle adventure game in which you explore an ancient civilization in a flooded world, and discover a mysterious power to overcome the temple's challenges.
rows.description_html: We are developping Floodcore into a full game! Join our discord server for updates and chat with the devs! Floodcore is a puzzle adventure game in which you explore an ancient civilization in a flooded world, and discover a mysterious power to overcome the temple's challenges. This game is a vertical slice made by 5 French students within 8 months as a graduation project. You can expect 15 to 30 minutes of gameplay depending on your affinity with puzzle games and your sense of spatial awareness in a 3D environment. Your power allows you to swap positions with specific objects in the world, or swap them together. Delve further into the temple and solve puzzles that require you to become a part of them. Each area expands on the swap mechanic and makes you use it in different ways. Some will challenge you and require you to anticipate several moves ahead, while others will need you to figure out every possibility, and there are often several different solutions for them! You will discover multiple ruins laid by an ancient civilisation, each with its own visuals and purpose. From the temple's surface to its underground, all the way to a luxuriant garden, you will experience each area differently with their puzzles and atmosphere. At any point in time, you can take a step back and enjoy the calm atmosphere with the sound of waves, birds, wind and waterfalls.

rows.name: Mark Sharp & The Bar Thieves
rows.short_description: Welcome to the Thieves’ cave! Do you have what it takes to become a bartender for Mark Sharp & the Bicycle Thieves? In this 2D bar simulator you have to fulfil orders from the band members. There's no time for mistakes! Are you ready for your first day?
rows.description_html: Are you looking for a job? Aye, we need a new bar staff in the Thieves’ cave. The tipsy thieves are very demanding customers! There is no time for mistakes! If you make the boys wait too long they’ll be raging. If you mess up you're done here! So are ya ready for your first day? Game mechanics You are a bartender trying to make money for your favourite band's gig. To your surprise, the band members are regular customers at the bar. Fulfil their orders as quickly as possible. The longer you take the more angry they get so make sure to check the anger meter! Pick up drinks and snacks at the bar and bring the ordered refreshments to the band members. The boys might ask you to play a certain song using the jukebox. If you want a break from your job, you can have fun using the karaoke machine. Apart from orders, each day one of the members has a quest for you. Be a good person and help them! Will you make it to your dream gig?

rows.description_html: Welcome to Crumble Party! You are a cake nanite. Your job is to rebuild the towns through cooperatives, sustainability, and pound cakes. Make your way across the board, discovering this new baked goods world! Trade with fellow nanites for new abilities Pay folks for their aid in revitalizing the town Invest in environmental groups to stabilize new ecosystems Avoid sabotage from Halbert, the mischievous AI that wants all the pound cakes for himself Explore a small world that runs on a sustainable solidarity economic system. Cake Harvester Mini-Game                                                                                                     Harvest Pound Cake Cake pieces will fall after you've harvested them. Harvest as many pieces of the cake as you can before time runs out!                                                                     Beware of Sabotage A selfish AI named Halbert sends their minions to push you off the cake. Don't let yourself fall off the cake!                                                                       Rebuild Your Town Gather as much pound cake as you can without dying and without harvesting all the cake. Pound Cake slices will be exchanged for the coveted Cake Tokens that will provide Sol Energy resources for the town. Will you get enough Cake Tokens to help rebuild your town?                                                                       Developers Wayne M Messam II Mattia Sicuro Maggie H MISTER ACXION Tim S Davis Mia Ginaé Dave (ViRiX) McKee Megan Frazier Danielle Wallace ShadowF Terence Tolman Dotun Oseni-Adegbite Zubaydah Bashir                                                                               Controls: W = Move Up A = Move Down S = Move Right D = Move Left SHIFT = Dash SPACE = Harvest Left Mouse Click = Shoot Attack

With his brave and unyielding spirit, he stands as the last hope against the dark wizard Nachtengel . As shadows loom and danger grows, Jaxx must rise to save his people and reclaim his destiny, that was once a dream, and shall be realized! Do not give up, no matter how difficult it gets. The town depends on you! ... and finally, always head towards the gate!

rows.name: Hydrangea
rows.short_description: A yandere psychological horror visual novel. Choose a sweetheart to romance, but beware the petals of obsession.
rows.description_html: Your sweetheart fell ill with a mysterious illness. Thankfully, you changed your mind about breaking up with them. Now, you're even closer to them. Too close. A romance/psychological horror visual novel inspired by the Hanahaki disease trope. Immerse yourself in a romance with a sweetheart you can customize. But beware, as affection turns to obsession, the petals of love may suffocate. Features: - Choose your name, as well as your sweetheart's name, pronouns, and appearence. - Contains four endings. Aim to see the first three to unlock the true end. - Original soundtrack, backgrounds, portraits, and CGs! - Story length: 20k words. ----------- ABOUT: Meiri Games is a Brazilian indie dev making free horror visual novels. Meiri lead a team of volunteers to create Hydrangea. Sprites and CG: Misha Background art: Banh-mi andJam Music: Eric Jeffrey Tan GUI: Abby Jocson / craboozled Promo pixel art: Mary Coding: Shie Technical Artist: Joshua Bowles Additional CGs and Special Thanks: Nevi Voice of Yuu: David Finley Voice of Yua: Liyah Pon Casting and Directing: Phebe Fabacher (Very Berry Studios) Mixing: Hayden Davis (Very Berry Studios) Trailer Edited by Hayden Davis (Very Berry Studios) ---------------- HINTS: - Ending 3 is not unlocked by default. - There are some secrets you might not find at a first glance...

Of course, we will continue to add new combat units, gameplay, and maps in future updates

rows.name: The Qubit Factory
rows.short_description: The Qubit Factory is an open-ended puzzle game incorporating real-life concepts from the cutting-edge field of quantum computing. Design and build logic circuits that manipulate bits and qubits (quantum bits) to solve devious computational challenges!
rows.description_html: // New Employee Onboarding: Quantum Computing // Below are classical bits , which all regular computers operate on. Boooooring!                    Much more exciting are  quantum bits  (or qubits for short), which are not limited to simple {0,1} states.                     Qubits are so hot right now! They are the building blocks of newfangled  quantum computers . As newly-minted employees of The Qubit Factory you will have the privilege of processing qubits in our state-of-the-art production lines. By harnessing the power of quantum entanglement and superpositions you will help up deliver exciting new computational products to our valued customers!  // ---------------------------------------------- // The Qubit Factory is an open-ended puzzle game about building logic circuits to solve computational tasks, inspired by classic titles from developer Zachtronics. Based on authentic representations of quantum bits and components,  The Qubit Factory  features puzzles based on key concepts and algorithms from the field of quantum computing. Open-Ended Puzzles - Factory employees are encouraged to design their own unique solutions to given tasks. Bonuses will be awarded to those meeting strict efficiency criteria. Convoluted and/or poorly-optimized solutions will be frowned upon. Faithful Physics - Designed and programmed by a real (semi-successful) research scientist in the field of quantum computing: key concepts and algorithms from quantum computing are conveyed accurately, allowing players to build genuine knowledge about quantum computing! Accessible - Core concepts are built slowly, with players encouraged to build foundational understanding in classical computing before progressing to quantum analogues. No prior computer/physics knowledge is assumed!

rows.name: TimeKeeper
rows.short_description: This is an idle casual game where you can shake the tree pole again when the number on the time board turns green and shows '0' to drop fruits from the tree. When you can shake the pole again, you'll find that several days have passed.
rows.description_html: There is a 'tree' here, which forever stands in this place, incapable of doing anything on its own, yet you can shake it. When you do, the tree will drop various fruits, which you can pick up and place in your inventory（ When the numbers on the time sign all turn green and display '0', please use the left mouse button to click and hold the 'tree trunk'. Then, vigorously and rapidly shake the mouse with large movements until the fruit falls off. ）; these are the fruits of your efforts in shaking the tree. Once the tree has dropped its fruits, it enters the next phase. You must wait quietly, as it will take several days before you can harvest your next yield. If time passes and you do not collect your fruits, they will remain on the tree forever. After the tree has provided you with fruits several times, it will disappear, leaving behind a stump that evokes nostalgia. But do not worry, it will reappear.

rows.name: Arkadia
rows.short_description: Explore Arkadia. Confront the evil beings, uncover their schemes, and fight for justice. Strategize and strengthen your characters to achieve victory.
rows.description_html: Explore Arkadia. Confront evil beings, uncover their schemes, and fight for justice. Strategize, strengthen your characters, and seize victory. Strategic Gameplay Arkadia is a turn-based strategy simulation game. Control player characters, each with unique personalities, and find the most efficient strategies to win battles within limited action points. Gather resources, gain experience, and upgrade equipment and skills to enhance your characters and expand your strategic options. Diverse Storylines Become the fallen general Cardenio and embark on a journey of revenge. Throughout your journey, you will face many choices. The choices you make will lead to significant changes in your journey. You can form alliances with companions or fight as a noble wolf... There is no right answer. The path you take will define your journey. Customizable Character Growth Create your own strategy through equipment configuration and skill enhancement. Characters can lead battles in new directions based on the equipment they wear and the skills they enhance.

rows.name: Potato Vs Potato
rows.short_description: Potato Vs Potato is a fun and addictive game where you click on potatoes to grow your potato empire! Join us and participate in exciting events, and collaborate with fellow potato enthusiasts. Together, we’ll cultivate the ultimate potato paradise and grow into something truly awesome!
rows.description_html: Dive into the delightful world of Potato vs Potato, an engaging and addictive game where every click on a potato can lead to exciting discoveries and endless fun! This isn’t just about clicking—it's about uncovering hidden treasures and building your ultimate team of unique potato heroes. Gameplay Overview: In Potato vs Potato each click on a potato not only adds more potatoes to your collection but also gives you a chance to dig out rare and unique potato heroes after three hours. These heroes come in various forms and unique appearances that make them stand out. Uncover Unique Potato Heroes: Every three hours, you will unearth a Potato Hero. These heroes range from normal to legendary. Collect Them All - Coming Soon : Your goal is to collect all the best potato heroes. Some heroes might boost your clicking power, while others might offer defensive or offensive capabilities for future battles. Upgrade and Enhance - Coming Soon : As you gather more potatoes, use them to upgrade your army, making it stronger and more effective. Enhance their abilities to prepare them for the ultimate challenge. Exciting PvP Area - Coming Soon : Once you've collected your potato heroes, get ready to test your skills in the upcoming PvP area. This feature will allow you to pit your potato team against other terrifying potato teams in thrilling battles. Use the unique abilities and equipment of your potato heroes to devise strategies and outsmart your opponents. Start clicking today, uncover your unique potato heroes, and prepare for the exciting PvP challenges on the horizon. Join our community and be a part of the ultimate potato-growing adventure. Together, let's dig, discover, and dominate!

rows.name: Sort of Justice - Chapter 1
rows.short_description: Sort of Justice is an immersive adult visual novel set in the dark side of society. As you plot your revenge against your backstabber, you will encounter many personalities, discover relationships and uncover buried secrets.
rows.description_html: You are a man with no particular goals or ambitions. Living through each day like the previous one. Perhaps the only thing that keeps you motivated each day is your co-worker, whom you consider your best friend. However, your life takes a dark turn when she frames you for a crime you didn't commit. After seven years in prison, you are released with the ambition to seek revenge on your backstabber. You enter the world of crime and violence, encountering many different personalities, both friends and foes. Along the way, you slowly learn that not everything is as it seems. Choices... matter Sort of Justice is a semi-kinetic adult visual novel. While there are no choices that can affect the plot, there are choices that can affect relationships between you and the characters. This means some choices might enable/disable dialogues, renders and animations in the future. Action Packed This game is strongly defined by its action elements. Expect constant gunfights, intense foot and car chases, thrilling hand-to-hand combat, and potentially more weapon play in the future. The goal is to effectively utilize the 'visual' aspect of visual novels and create a unique immersive experience for players. Intricate World Setting Just because you can't see it doesn't mean it's not there. Underneath the surface of our society, lies a foundation that may as well uphold the operation of the entire world. You think the world is run by the government? Well, ask yourself this. Who's running the government? Romance For those who love engaging in romantic relationships with fictional characters, this game got you covered. In this game, you will encounter many different love interests with unique personalities and backstories. Uncover their secrets and work to gain their trust. However, if you find the chemistry between you and any one of these love interests lacking, it is your choice whether you want to develop this relationship further. Immersive Experience The primary goal of this game is to immerse the player into the story as much as possible. To do this, I had to create and gather images, music and sound effects that complement each other. Here's a summary of Chapter 1's content: Render Images - 1,088 Animation - 5 Music - 19 Sound Effects - 112 Work in Progress This is the DEMO version of the game! This game is currently still in development. Future chapters will be released one by one, but not on Steam. (Check Discord) There will be no further updates until the whole season is completed Join my Discord (Link in side tab) to learn more about the development of Sort of Justice!

rows.name: Idle Saga
rows.short_description: Welcome to the world of Idle Saga, a magnificent world of swords and magic! Enjoy diverse gameplay, splendid equipment, and transformations into gods and demons that allow you to dominate all realms. With cool elves and powerful mercenaries by your side to battle ferocious bosses!
rows.description_html: Game Features 【New & Relaxing Experience】 Idle vertical MMORPG allows you to play the game freely with one-hand operation. Quick leveling up , smart feedback, and easy gameplay grant you total relaxed experience. Experience the pleasure anywhere you want. 【Transform as you like and get glorious customized style】 The customized system can help you to transfer as you like and rebirth when reached the peak. Gain exclusive peak badge, cool master skills and customized style. Switch between thousands of outfit and design your own fashionable style! 【High chance of dropping rate for Boss hunting】 Reaping the whole screen and dropping endless rewards. Hunting bosses in the game world is the main way of getting rare equipment and materials. Original designed gear evolution system can help you to stack gear stats and forge gears with exclusive attributes! 【Fair drop rates】 The drop rate in the game is fair for everyone. The more you challenge, the more you get! In addition, you will be also rewarded with equipment and skins by participating in events and by completing the quests.

rows.name: Dine 'n Bash
rows.short_description: In a world of daunting beasts, brave heroes, and dangerous bandits, someone has to serve up the grub! Become the new owner of The Belligerent Dweller, the most popular tavern in the town of Thurgon. Dash around delivering orders, stacking items, and dodging projectiles that fly your way!
rows.description_html: In a world of daunting beasts, brave heroes, and dangerous bandits, someone has to serve up the grub! Become the new owner of The Belligerent Dweller, the most popular tavern stop in the medieval town of Thurgon. Dash around the tavern to pick up and deliver eager customers their orders as fast as possible. You've only got one set of hands, so make sure you stack your dishes efficiently! But be warned; this town isn't known for its hospitality. Your patrons are quick to temper, and quick to violence! Angry orcs will hurl axes, sly rogues will toss daggers, and impatient wizards will channel fiery arcane magics. Its your job to dodge the projectiles they send your way to deliver tasty meals swiftly, racking up a high score! Just like any other restaurant, The Belligerent Dweller has its regulars! Meet Sir Reginald the Knight, Qlunk the Orc, and other fun characters that will be sure to write you a lengthy review each time you serve them. Your job may not be as glorious as others in this fantastical world, but it's harder than it looks! Master the pathways you take through the restaurant, optimize the order in which you pick up and deliver dishes, and hone your axe-dodging skills to become the greatest waiter this magical world has ever seen! Traditional restaurant grab-and-go style gameplay Angry customers that throw projectiles at the waiter Streak multipliers that reward flawless performance Recurring characters that leave customer reviews This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Madness Arena
rows.short_description: Enter the ultimate battleground, where chaos reigns and survival is everything. Every decision could be your last—will you rise to the challenge or descend into madness? Master powerful abilities, crush your enemies, and prove your worth in Madness Arena.
rows.description_html: Note: Madness Arena is currently still a game under going many changes and development, and many features are still in development, including boss fights, equipment shops, new maps, and various quality-of-life improvements. We invite all players to join and support us in this journey by purchasing the game, playing it, and sharing constructive feedbacks. Welcome to the stealth launch of Madness Arena, an exhilarating peer-to-peer PVPVE experience for up to 16 players (starting with 8 players). The game features a unique blend of anime-inspired art set against semi-realistic environments, enhanced with dynamic manga-style effects. Our primary focus is on delivering a fun and chaotic experience. In the coming months and years, we plan to continuously expand the game with new characters (10+ characters every quarter planned), exciting features, and much more. We invite you to be part of this adventure as we strive to create one of the most mind blowing game ever, built with passion by gamers for gamers. Let's rock the world together! The Backstory Amidst daily stress, a manga artist finds solace in his dreamland, where his characters spring to life from ink and paper. In this vibrant realm, his creations reflect his inner struggles and aspirations. Their epic battles become a canvas for confronting his fears and frustrations, transforming his dreams into a sanctuary of creativity and catharsis. Illustrative, Anime-Styled Characters and VFX Unique, anime-inspired player characters and special effects that visually captivate and engage players. Realistic and Anime-Blended Environments Familiar, real-world environments combined with anime aesthetics, creating an immersive and visually stunning play area. Boss Raids and Events Special raids and in-game events that enhance skills and increase damage, providing new challenges and excitement during battles. Expanded Player Capacity (Up to 16 Players): Increased player slots to support up to 16 participants, allowing for more intense and competitive gameplay experiences. Character Customization Diverse outfit options for characters, enabling extensive customization and providing monetization opportunities through in-game purchases. Robust and Secure Gameplay: Advanced security measures to ensure fair play and prevent cheating, maintaining a balanced and enjoyable gaming environment. PlayFab Multiplayer System Feature: Integration of PlayFab for competitive ranking, matchmaking, and multiplayer system enhancements, ensuring a smooth and competitive online experience. In-House Motion Capture Beautifully crafted motion captures for creating unique movesets and animations, distinguishing our game from competitors who rely on off-the-shelf solutions.

rows.name: Work Inc.
rows.short_description: Brace yourselves for Corporate Calamity in Work Inc, a First Person Arena Shooter with a conglomerate twist! Arm yourself with staplers and sharpeners to bash and shoot your way through the hordes of employees like your life (and your job) depend on it.
rows.description_html: I don't wanna see you slacking again! Don't make me take this further... Work Inc.: The shoddy (and somewhat illegally run) company that you've wasted years of your life at to earn a sliver of a paycheck. Why were you here again? What did Work Inc. offer you? Why not quit? The Boss had you sharpen his Big Ol' Pencil again, giving you a jab in the back before he 'asked.' You're so over it... About The Game Work Inc. is a goofy wave shooter where you play as a disgruntled employee, fighting their way through the whole of Work Inc., which is also the company you work (worked?). Armed with four silly weapons, test your mettle against increasingly crowded waves of three different enemy types! Whatever you do... Don't get fired! As the fight goes on, you can spend your hard-looted cash (that you definitely did  not  steal from your co-workers' payslips) to unlock one of many hand-crafted areas in the maze-like Office, or to buy one of three weapons at random from the Printer! Be warned, though, as all your ranged weapons have limited ammunition!  If you run out of stationary and/or dirt to fling at your foes, or you're close to defeat, the Union recently got some vending machines installed in the office: find them and spend your money on either more health, or purchase ammunition one magazine at a time! As the game progresses, enemies will spawn more frequently and in greater numbers, with three different classes being unlocked as the game goes on. Enemies don't get stronger, and nor do your weapons, but they can quickly become overwhelming if you don't deal with them! The Enemies Worka The Worka (said like Worker) is the basic enemy you fight. Easily beaten in a few pencil hits or a body-slam, you can take these down in mere seconds. They'll move towards you at a reasonable speed before trying to hit you with their keyboards! You can take quite a few hits, but don't let the gang up on you, because you'll soon be feeling keyed up! Shoota The Shoota is the second enemy, this one armed with a stapler similar to the one you can get. The weapons aren't  just for you, y'know. They'll keep their distance, trying to pick you off from slightly further, but they won't move while they've got a lock on you, their aim isn't the best. They're fragile, too! You can easily take them down with a couple well-placed shots. Big Guy The Big Guy is... Well, he's a pretty big guy. You'll know him and his silly yellow top when you see him. Similar to Worka, Big Guy will come after you, albeit a little slower than Worka. Don't be fooled, though, a few hits from Big Guy and you'll be out on the streets! These guys have a Ballinium-plated keyboard that does HUGE damage, and those big bellies can absorb more hits. The Weapons In Work Inc., there are four weapons, all hand-crafted and animated! Big Ol' Pencil The Big Ol' Pencil is exactly that: its a Big. Yellow. Pencil. The BOP is a melee weapon with decent range and damage that combos well with the Dash. It can take down the Worka in three hits! Staple-o-Matic This is the most well-rounded ranged weapon of the three in Work Inc. - Semi-automatic, 16 staples in a mag, and good damage at most ranges, this one is a valuable addition to your arsenal. It's pretty accurate too. Sharpenator The Sharpenator is a rapid-fire electric sharpener with booming SFX and funky particles too! Let 30 high-speed pencils loose and watch it shred your opponents! Its slightly weaker than the Staple-o-Matic, though it makes up for it with high fire rate. SuperSuck The SuperSuck is a faulty vacuum cleaner that fires big globs of muck and dirt at your opponents, exploding in a big brown stinky boom and dealing damage to nearby enemies. With a long charge-time and cooldown, and only five shots per magazine, this vacuum compensates by taking down all enemies in one shot! Other Bits Work Inc. was developed by a team of four university students over a period of eight weeks (initially, at least), who have now graduated from DMU's BSc Games Production with flying colours. Dylan: Gameplay Programmer, Character Designer, 'Sound Guy' Lunar-Skie: Character Programmer, Animator, 'Heavy Weapons Girl' Dimitrios: Prop Artist, UI Artist, 'Texture Wizard' Kacper: Game Designer, Level Designer, 'Guy who Shrinks the Map' Special Thanks to Salim Hasshu! This entire project could not have been possible without the fantastic opportunity Additional Assets Used: Github: starikcetin/ Eflatun.SceneReference - Provides us with easy-to-use scene referencing. Thanks, gamer! simonoliver/ InputSystemActionPrompts - Helps us change our input prompts based on the player's current input device! Music by XtremeFreddy on Pixabay

As the game progresses, enemies will spawn more frequently and in greater numbers, with three different classes being unlocked as the game goes on. Enemies don't get stronger, and nor do your weapons, but they can quickly become overwhelming if you don't deal with them! The Enemies Worka The Worka (said like Worker) is the basic enemy you fight. Easily beaten in a few pencil hits or a body-slam, you can take these down in mere seconds. They'll move towards you at a reasonable speed before trying to hit you with their keyboards! You can take quite a few hits, but don't let the gang up on you, because you'll soon be feeling keyed up! Shoota The Shoota is the second enemy, this one armed with a stapler similar to the one you can get. The weapons aren't  just for you, y'know. They'll keep their distance, trying to pick you off from slightly further, but they won't move while they've got a lock on you, their aim isn't the best. They're fragile, too! You can easily take them down with a couple well-placed shots. Big Guy The Big Guy is... Well, he's a pretty big guy. You'll know him and his silly yellow top when you see him. Similar to Worka, Big Guy will come after you, albeit a little slower than Worka. Don't be fooled, though, a few hits from Big Guy and you'll be out on the streets! These guys have a Ballinium-plated keyboard that does HUGE damage, and those big bellies can absorb more hits. The Weapons In Work Inc., there are four weapons, all hand-crafted and animated! Big Ol' Pencil The Big Ol' Pencil is exactly that: its a Big. Yellow. Pencil. The BOP is a melee weapon with decent range and damage that combos well with the Dash. It can take down the Worka in three hits! Staple-o-Matic This is the most well-rounded ranged weapon of the three in Work Inc. - Semi-automatic, 16 staples in a mag, and good damage at most ranges, this one is a valuable addition to your arsenal. It's pretty accurate too. Sharpenator The Sharpenator is a rapid-fire electric sharpener with booming SFX and funky particles too! Let 30 high-speed pencils loose and watch it shred your opponents! Its slightly weaker than the Staple-o-Matic, though it makes up for it with high fire rate. SuperSuck The SuperSuck is a faulty vacuum cleaner that fires big globs of muck and dirt at your opponents, exploding in a big brown stinky boom and dealing damage to nearby enemies. With a long charge-time and cooldown, and only five shots per magazine, this vacuum compensates by taking down all enemies in one shot! Other Bits Work Inc. was developed by a team of four university students over a period of eight weeks (initially, at least), who have now graduated from DMU's BSc Games Production with flying colours. Dylan: Gameplay Programmer, Character Designer, 'Sound Guy' Lunar-Skie: Character Programmer, Animator, 'Heavy Weapons Girl' Dimitrios: Prop Artist, UI Artist, 'Texture Wizard' Kacper: Game Designer, Level Designer, 'Guy who Shrinks the Map' Special Thanks to Salim Hasshu! This entire project could not have been possible without the fantastic opportunity Additional Assets Used: Github: starikcetin/ Eflatun.SceneReference - Provides us with easy-to-use scene referencing. Thanks, gamer! simonoliver/ InputSystemActionPrompts - Helps us change our input prompts based on the player's current input device! Music by XtremeFreddy on Pixabay

rows.name: GUNPYRE
rows.short_description: Hold your Gunpyres akimbo in this fast-paced twin-stick shooter, set in the Crypt Alchemist’s semi-procedural dungeon. Remember, Vampyres are your guns and blood types are your bullets, so be assured to brutally steal them from your enemies in order to collect upgrades and take down your target.
rows.description_html: An AKIMBO TWIN STICK SHOOTER Use a pair of Vampyric Guns -the Gunpyres indeed- to slay hordes of dangerous creatures created by the infamous Crypt Alchemist: each monster is packed with Blood with unique colors and abilities that you can absorb with your Gunpyres. One Gunpyre for each hand, no one is safe A never-ending horde of enemies to slay and then some more Challenge The Crypt Alchemist and his Elite Experiments to escape the Dungeon DIFFERENT BLOODS = DIFFERENT PROJECTILES Upon brutally executing an enemy with a finisher you can receive one of four different Blood Types. Every Type generates a unique Bullet that will behave differently when shot based on its Color and its unlocked upgrades. Use them wisely according to the situation in order to survive. Human, Freeze, Thunder and Iron Bloods are your weapons of choice Lots of upgrades - Blood Type specific - that change shooting features at your favor Unlock the rare Perfect Barrels, an Ultimate Upgrade for each Blood Type EVERY BULLET COUNTS Your Gunpyres can only shoot Blood Projectiles: hopefully it will be the Enemy’s Blood. Miss too many shots and you will have to sacrifice your own Blood to reload the Gunpyres, by stabbing yourself. 6 Bullets per Gunpyre, choose hastily your next victim to absorb their Blood to Enemies are weak to their own Blood Type: Shoot the right color to the right enemy to maximize the damage ROGUE-LIKE PROGRESSION Explore the insidious layout of the Crypt Dungeon: its structure will change in every new attempt, so be careful not to spoil your occasion. You have 10 Rune Keys, plan your route and gain powerful upgrades along the way (or keep the keys and let the Crypt Alchemist absorb them for an extra challenge!) Access to the Dungeon Rooms is limited by the Rune Keys you possess Explore the Dungeon for secret challenges and unexpected character benefits Obtain Gold from Enemies to obtain unique upgrades from the Shop ◉ Gunpyre started as an academic project by AIV - Accademia Italiana Videogiochi aimed at adding a production experience to the teaching carried out in the various courses, from the creation of the game concept to commercial publishing. The objective of this initiative is to give students the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues from other courses in the development of a video game project in which everyone can put the skills acquired during the lessons to the test and at the same time perfect their soft skills. ◉

rows.description_html: You've clicked on so many bananas, but have you clicked on peaches ? 🤔 Get a random peach every 3 hours and grow your collection! 😍 Drop pool chances*: 50% Normal 32% Common 15% Rare 2% Ultra Rare 1% Legendary * Subject to change ◻️ Features: - Peaches 🍑 - More peaches 😊 - Variety of peaches 🔥 - Controller support 🎮 - Leveling system for special skins 😲 - Mini Peaches to help you gather Big Peaches! 🤯 - Daily tree watering to get you MORE Peaches! 🌳

rows.name: Muhaboy
rows.short_description: Step into the shoes of Muhaboy! Dash and smash muha-s in this hardcore beat 'em up, saving humanity from the looming Second Muha War! Battle it out with limited resources and adapt to the ever-changing chaos. Buzzopolis is waiting for its hero—time to show those muha-s who’s boss!
rows.description_html: After the great invasion, the muha-s mutated and are gearing up for war again! Buzzopolis is the first line of defense. We can't let the city fall to the enemy! Save Buzzopolis, and then the whole world! Brave hero, MUHABOY! Chase down muha-s and cleanse the city of mutants while dealing with limited resources, tricky enemies, and challenging battle scenarios In the game, you’ll encounter various types of muha-s. Each type has its own personality, habits, reaction speed, and level of cowardice. And they complement each other beautifully. Find the best strategy for any combination of enemies, because your muha swatters have limited durability. Use muha swatters with different effects The game offers several types of muha swatters, each with its own unique effects. They aren’t tied to specific types of muha-s, giving every player a chance to get creative. Find your favorite muha swatter, combine them, or develop a strategy that lets you make the most of your resources in any combat situation. Earn coins and redistribute your resources Your muha swatters have limited durability. But you can buy and sell durability, exchanging actual hits for coins. There’s no penalty for buying and selling, so even if you purchase durability or a muha swatter, you can sell them later without losing a single coin. This opens up extra opportunities for experimentation. Craft your own strategy, be quick, do whatever it takes—just save Buzzopolis!

rows.name: Landon's Puzzle ParTAY
rows.short_description: Landon's Puzzle ParTAY™ is a game where you complete puzzles as fast as you can without running out of time! Enjoy all of the fun and wacky minigames with a C.I. Puppet Friends™ flair! Create your own profile and compete for the high score!
rows.description_html: The C.I. Puppet Friends™ star in their first ever full video game: Landon's Puzzle ParTAY™! 'Hey everyone, It's me Landon! I'm inviting you to my first ever Puzzle ParTAY! ( not  a 'party') I just know you'll have lots of tons of fun, so come on down! (chips and dip not  included)' -Landon Landon's Puzzle ParTAY is a fast-paced, arcade-style, time-attack, puzzle game! This game features various puzzle types with a C.I. Puppet Friends twist! - Put together classic puzzles with Landon! - Help Josie cross different terrains! - Guide Chef Paisano through the grocery store to find all of the ingredients! - Help (paper doll) Landon find the right pose! - Find hidden secrets!  All while being cheered on by your favorite Puppet Friends! In this game, you'll race against the clock to complete all sorts of different puzzles!  Including: Jigsaw puzzles Mazes Slide puzzles Problem solving Crosswords Patterns Platforming challenges as bonus rounds And more to come! Each puzzle gets more difficult as you complete them. After your first puzzle, each round will have you race through with a completely different pattern. Each puzzle you solve adds 1 point  to your score! How many puzzles can you solve before running out of time? Compete with others in an online leaderboard to see how many puzzles you can solve!  - Unlock special badges with each rank, as you race for the high score! - Create your own profile, with your favorite character as an avatar! (remember, chips and dip are not included, stop asking, Elvin)

rows.name: Space Valkyries
rows.short_description: Year 2979, the cosmic entity 'IT' threatens to destroy Earth. Take command of the Valkyria Zenith Serenity and use all your skills to face this threat alongside your beautiful operators.
rows.description_html: Year 2979, the cosmic entity 'IT' threatens to destroy Earth. Take command of the Valkyria Zenith Serenity and use all your skills to face this threat alongside your beautiful operators. Save the world! The objective of the game is quite simple: protect Earth from the cosmic entity known as 'It'. This game is compatible with touchscreen, and it is recommended to play with a keyboard and mouse. Different ways to play On board the Valkyria, you'll find multiple operators, each with a different playing style. Upgrade your ship The Valquiria Zenith Serenity features an onboard shop that allows you to upgrade the statistics of all your operators. Test your luck The casino module includes a small roulette wheel that allows you to exchange tickets obtained for large amounts of money. (This is not a microtransaction) Accelerate the growth of your relationship with the operators You can buy various pastries for your operators and discover a little more about them.

rows.name: Fear of the Light
rows.short_description: A survival horror game where light is scarier than darkness. Use your radar and other tools to stay out of the light, sneak around dangers, explore the quarantined ship, and find a way to escape. But be careful, monsters are hunting you and are aware of your every mistake!
rows.description_html: Fear of the Light is a stealth-based survival horror game where light is scarier than darkness and where surveying monsters keep you on edge. You’re the lone survivor on a spaceship infested by moths and other dangerous creatures. Explore the ship, override quarantine lockdowns, and find a way to escape. Use your radar and other tools to avoid enemies, keep out of the light, sneak around dangers, and find your way forward. But be careful, monsters are lurking around, searching for you, and are aware of your every mistake! Key features 20-45 min of playtime Horror twist where light is more dangerous than darkness Intelligent monsters Handheld radar, heat visor, and EMP Diegetic UI tools and terminals Background The first version of this game was made in seven weeks with a core team of ten members for a course at Futuregames Stockholm and Karlstad. The team continued working on the game afterward, eventually leading to a nomination for Best Design at the Swedish Game Awards and the Steam release. The game is made in Unreal Engine 5 and almost all the assets aside were created from scratch by the team.

rows.name: Dumbz Snake
rows.short_description: Crawl across the island controlling a lively and agile snake, make it grow by absorbing orbs of light, and blast your enemies with your skills!
rows.description_html: Dumbz Snake is an action game. Fight on a dynamic desert island Move strategically around this sunny desert island, but be careful: the sea level is rising steadily. And earthworms don't like the sea... Use your spells to fight Survive other players' attacks, and use strategy to attack them with your spells! Grow your Snake by absorbing orbs Glowing orbs of different colors appear every 30-45 seconds. Eating orbs will allow you to increase the length and size of your Snake to gain an advantage!
