rows.name: Marvel Contest of Champions
rows.short_description: The ultimate Super Hero fighting game is now on Steam! Collect and upgrade iconic Super Heroes and Villains from the Marvel Universe, engage in fast-paced 1v1 battles, and unleash powerful abilities in Marvel Contest of Champions!
rows.description_html: MARVEL CONTEST OF CHAMPIONS IS NOW ON STEAM The ultimate Marvel contest has arrived on PC! Step into The Battlerealm and experience epic 1v1 combat featuring your favorite Super Heroes and Villains from across the Marvel Universe — now fully optimized for mouse, keyboard, and controller on the big screen! BUILD YOUR MARVEL DREAM TEAM As a Summoner chosen by The Collector, assemble a powerful team from a roster of over 300 Champions — including iconic Avengers, X-Men, Guardians of the Galaxy, Spider-Verse heroes, and more! Whether you're teaming up Iron Man and Wolverine or pitting Deadpool against Venom, the combinations are endless and the stakes are high. FIGHT YOUR WAY TO VICTORY Engage in fast-paced battles against enemies and players from around the world. Master intuitive combat mechanics and unleash special attacks as you battle through cinematic storylines, competitive arenas, and time-limited events. Every fight brings you closer to becoming the Champion of The Battlerealm! EPIC QUESTS, ICONIC STORIES Dive into an evolving narrative with thrilling Marvel-style storytelling. Explore new chapters, face powerful bosses, and uncover multiversal mysteries as you quest through The Battlerealm. Every update brings fresh content and new Champions to collect! TEAM UP AND RISE TO THE TOP Join forces with other Summoners in powerful Alliances. Coordinate strategies, take on global events, and dominate Alliance Wars and Alliance Quests to earn valuable rewards and climb the competitive ranks. PLAY YOUR WAY, ANYWHERE Marvel Contest of Champions has been rebuilt for Steam, offering native support for controllers, keyboard, and mouse with customizable bindings. Enjoy full cross-platform support — start your journey on mobile and continue seamlessly on PC. Wherever you play, your progress goes with you. THE CONTEST AWAITS The fate of the Marvel Universe rests in your hands. Will you rise to the challenge and lead your Champions to victory?

rows.name: Tiny Duck Hunt 3D
rows.short_description: Next generation arcade game in a cute cartoon 3D world. Sweet graphics, nice gameplay, unique control system focused on handheld and joypad gaming.
rows.description_html: DISCLAIMER   Tiny Duck Hunt 3D is not affiliated with, sponsored by, approved by, endorsed by, or in any way connected to Nintendo video game company or Duck Hunt (TM). FEATURES A nostalgic hand eye coordination activity that's not as messy or too much when you want to relax and enjoy the game Enhanced mixture of 2D and 3D graphic assets with a slight paralax effect Exciting scoring system adds to the fun Unique control system focused on handheld and joypad gaming Suitable for left-handed people GRAPHICS Next generation arcade game in a cute cartoon 3D world. GAMEPLAY The gameplay includes simple retro-arcade mechanics and modern competitive process. Interesting rounds, reworked levels, bonuses, enemies, bosses.  CONTROLS The unique control system 'Smart and Convenient' focused on handheld and joypad gaming. You can enjoy the game without a lightgun or mouse. Suitable for left-handed people. rows.short_description: Explore an entire fantasy world, explore Cat City the beating heart of cats, defeat small or huge bosses, also remember to give Astra some cookies or a cup of Tè before you leave.
rows.description_html: Lore Astra an all-powerful goddess controls the multiverse and the universes so that they do not collapse into each other, one day his girlfriend Shade creates a game The Big Adventure where she puts two old but remastered games into one. Sometimes it can happen of Astra interacting with Pixel universe where the game is present. In this game you explore, fight, survive several epic bumps and above all enjoy the remastered version of the two games. Details Remasters of Exploration in Mia Body and Serve Your Goddess in one game, the game supports LGBT in that Astra and Shade are lesbians of which Shade likes to wear men's clothes to feel comfortable. New and well done dialogues and also new interactions with NPCs, challenge epic small or huge bosses, explore Cat City a fictional independent from United Kingdom remember to use Cat Coin for payments as they don't accept British Pound. rows.name: Boned
rows.short_description: Boned is a silly, fast-paced multiplayer party game, inspired by arcade beloved Killer Queen and other multi-player frenzies. Take the role of a canine cadet and get into space-- collect toys, eliminate opponents, and get that bone!
rows.description_html: Funded Day 1 on Kickstarter Thank you to all our Boned Backers! We will be using this money to develop a DLC featuring new maps, new characters, and more hats! Expect to see this DLC in the Spring of 2025 for more ways to Bone! About the Game Boned is a silly, fast-paced multiplayer party game, inspired by arcade beloved Killer Queen and other multi-player frenzies! Take the role of a canine astronaut and launch into space. Drill through planets, slingshot around gravitational fields, and bring your team to victory. Collect toys by drilling into the planet cores, then fire it off to eliminate enemies, or take it back to home base to score for your team. Make sure to keep an eye out for “The Bone”, too! Achieve victory in one of three exciting win conditions: Exhaust all of your opponents’ lives. Deliver 8 toys to your home base. Dig up “The Bone” and hold onto it in a tug-of-war! Boned has plenty of awesome features that’ll keep you coming back for more and more: Lovingly crafted retro-futuristic style 4 Different Dogs to choose from. Earn titles based on your performance. Dedicated bark button. So what are you waiting for? Get Boned today! Note: A controller is required for local multiplayer.

rows.name: Lu[Idle]
rows.short_description: Lu[Idle] is an Incremental game with Idle and Clicker elements as well as pixel art visuals and music.
rows.description_html: Disclaimer: Lu[Idle] does not have a large amount of content and there is a lot of waiting, hence the 'idle' part of the name. I put Lu[Idle] on steam as a way to showcase my creation. There are planned updates but no plan on when they will be worked on, and If you have any criticism or feedback, you are welcome to share it with me on my discord server. In Lu[Idle] you play as a game developer making a Lua game but instead of coding you are clicking. Make your game huge by clicking and getting Bytes which is the amount of storage your game takes up and as we all know more Gigabytes = better game. Type commands into the console to make code that brings your games storage up automatically, upgrade your mouse to gain more bytes per click and drink some coffee for a boost and purchase a server to make your game even bigger. Get immersed and become a Lua game developer today in Lu[Idle]. This game is very early access and is lacking a lot of features that I intend to add and the price will most likely increase as updates come. Key Features Upgradable Code Snippets to Increase your Bytes per Second Console to Input various Commands found in the Commands Folder Tab Upgrades Tab to Increase your Games Size even more Release your game and gain sales to make your future games better (prestige)

rows.name: 萍城异闻录
rows.short_description: This is a different chicken eating game, where you can choose a main battle character to fight, defeat other players and monsters in the scene to earn currency, form your team lineup, and have rich combos to bring a different experience.
rows.description_html: PingCity, officially tested on PC PingCity, officially tested on PC, join the player group and give us feedback At present, the official player group has been opened, and first-hand information will be updated synchronously in the group. Internal testing and other welfare activities will be held, and there is also a chance to participate in the competition and win physical rewards such as JD cards. Welcome to join the discussion together, young heroes! QQ1：1015905671     QQ2：342072404      Discord：awTwCJB About the Game Pingcheng Chronicles: Tales of the Unusual Anime-style graphics meet fast-paced, high-octane combat—redefining the ARPG competitive experience! Unleash smooth combo chains at your fingertips, with seamless links between normal attacks and skills. Harness fire, water, thunder, and other elemental fusion mechanics to dish out devastating full-screen damage—maximizing that unbeatable combat thrill! Innovative Gameplay: Ditch Traditional Tropes Break the 'Search-Fight-Evacuate' Loop : Upload on-field supplies to lock ownership instantly. No evacuation needed—keep hunting other players and plundering massive resources for doubled competitive excitement! Per-Match Support Synergies : Collect gold to unlock support lineups. Trigger exclusive bonds between characters to stack powerful buffs—your strategic combinations determine the battle’s outcome! Freeform Soul Card System : Gather three types of soul cards (Damage, Support, Utility) in-game. With hundreds of combinations, craft your unique combat build for a fresh experience every match! Free Economy: Stress-Free Farming & Monetization Built-in open marketplace: Freely price and trade dungeon drops, plundered loot, and more—easily monetize your grind! No binding restrictions: Rare items go live and circulate instantly. Even casual players can achieve resource freedom through strategy and grit! Game Features 【Support for War】 In the game, you can recruit auxiliary characters at any time to form a match with your main battle character and trigger super powerful combination skills. 【 Bonds 】 Heroes have a binding effect on each other, forming a suitable lineup and triggering the binding effect, making battles more profound and nurturing. 【Soul Cards】 Master soul cards to trigger fusion damage—they are the key to victory whether you fight, defend, advance or retreat! Controls: Right-click to bring up the wheel menu, left-click to activate. Experience the thrilling rush of intense combat! 【Search · Battle · Upload】 Search chests, jars and other containers to seize high-value supplies! Stay vigilant against the covetous enemies lurking nearby while plundering—always be ready for battle! Take all your supplies to the designated upload point, hold your ground until the upload is complete, and your loot will be instantly stored in your warehouse! 【Hide and Seek】 The hide and seek system has been added, allowing you to take on various forms within the scene to evade the pursuit of other players, plot against them, or provide a safe environment for yourself to search for battle heroes. 【Elemental Reaction】 The game has 8 types of elemental damage, and all 7 elements except physics can react with each other. Different elemental reactions have different negative effects on the target, which also affects your lineup selection. 【The Great Demon King】 In the game, you can defeat the dragon beasts in the scene to obtain a dragon soul. The dragon soul will transform you into a great demon king, increasing your damage but also causing you to suffer higher damage. At this point, you will become the most prominent one on the field. 【Evasion, blocking, floating pursuit, lightness skill】 Combat involves diverse ways of behavior, use them flexibly, and become a master of combat. 【Rich PVE content】 A large amount of PVE content has been completed and will be presented to everyone in the future.

rows.name: Compass of Destiny: Istanbul Prologue
rows.short_description: In Compass of Destiny: Istanbul Prologue, action and adventure are at the core of the story of a prince trying to prevent the Ottomans from capturing a castle in Venice.
rows.description_html: FULL GAME About the Game Compass of Destiny: Istanbul Prologue is a free version of Compass of Destiny: Istanbul. Experience the core gameplay and get a taste of the experience that awaits in the full game. PROLOGUE FEATURES: Free access to the prologue and galley episodes. Short gameplay introducing the game and universe before Istanbul. It is the 17th century and the Ottoman Empire is at the height of its power, forming a transcontinental realm stretching across Europe, Asia, and Africa. However, it is locked in a deadly struggle with Venice, for resources and power, centered around the richest of its provinces, create. You are an impoverished patrician from Venice, exiled in Istanbul. The accidental discovery of a mysterious compass sets you on a course for vengeance against the Ottoman commander responsible for the death of your family and your disgrace. Vendetta Across Worlds The Compass is your only chance at finding justice. By day, explore the meticulously recreated Istanbul at its richest and most beautiful, running into characters ripped straight from the pages of history. Meet Ahmed Dede, astronomer, poet, and historian, who played an unlikely role in your hero's past, and a vital ally of Sultan Mehmed IV, whose rule saw the Empire reach its greatest territorial extent. By night, descend into Fitrat, the realm of dreams where everything is possible. Draw and redraw the course of your destiny, peer into the lives of others, from petty merchants to mighty kings. But beware, the compass can only take you so far. Beyond that, you'll need strength of arms, wits, and a keen eye for secrets. Overcome, Grow, Conquer Every time you descend into Fitrat, you have the opportunity to grow stronger and push closer to the truth. Fight enemies trying to keep you from changing fate, using a light RPG system featuring skills, weapons, and armor to build your disgraced patrician the way you like. But this realm is more than just violence: You'll need to explore in depth, tackle challenging puzzles and show off your agility in platforming sections, if you want to learn the complete truth. The Compass will be your irreplaceable aid. A Blend of Reality and Fantasy Compass of Destiny was created using meticulous research, to give you an authentic glimpse into the Ottoman Empire at its peak, challenged for supremacy by the Serene Republic of Venice. The brutal Cretan War defined the balance of power in the Mediterraneans for centuries to come, making it the perfect moment in history to combine with exploring fantasy concepts and the personal struggles of people caught in the middle of a titanic struggle between superpowers.

rows.name: Grandpa: Bread Adventure
rows.short_description: Who said that old age is no fun? Grandpa: Bread Adventure is a crazy reimagining of the runner genre. Run around the city, overcoming obstacles, dodging hated scooter riders and geese.
rows.description_html: Try yourself as a grumpy grandpa who was sent to the store for bread. Try on the role of a grumpy grandpa who was sent to the store for bread. Have a race playing as a grandpa! Throughout the entire journey, you will be constantly hampered by geese, electric scooters and your own health, which you need to monitor so that the race does not end too soon! But grandpa also has a couple of aces up his sleeve: • Thanks to the special pills that he takes, obstacles in grandpa's path disappear and then reappear. • Having collected enough coins, grandpa will be able to buy himself an energy drink and super boots, which will increase his endurance, and even improve his physical characteristics! • Vending machines are located here and there on the streets, where you can buy useful things. • Advertising posters with memes to boost morale • Grandpa appreciates street benches and can have a good rest on them Yes, in our runner you can stop in the middle of the run to catch your breath, sit on a bench and even ride a few stops on the bus. Help Grandpa uncover the secrets of his past and come face to face with his greatest fear!

rows.name: Hide Time
rows.short_description: Hide Time is a story-driven horror game where you play as new employee of Passion Oasis. Explore that huge complex, do your tasks and uncover mysteries of your past.
rows.description_html: Hide Time is a story-driven horror game filled with huge variety of puzzles where you play as an new employee of Passion Oasis. Explore that huge complex, do your tasks and uncover mysteries of your past. Welcome to Passion Oasis, a place where you can express yourself and have lots and lots of fun. Your main job will be to make sure the place is ready for the grand opening next week. This game is centered around solving puzzles. Use all equipment around the area to complete your job - Prepare Passion Oasis for the opening day! Fix mechanisms, use your flashlight to navigate through dark areas, hide in lockers if needed! Do everything to make sure the location is in perfect state and most importantly have fun! You play as John Evans - a brand new employee at Passion Oasis. Stay in touch with your manager - Mark Smith via walkie-talkie as he guides you towards your next objective. Uncover the past of the DJ Cat's brand as well as your own. Passion Oasis hides a lot of secrets waiting to be discovered. It is a huge mall full of many attractions and fun activites. This place can offer you tasty food and drinks in places such as Cozy Corner Coffee and Sweet Lounge. Meet the all time favorite mascot - DJ Cat and enjoy your time in locations such as Party Rooms. Do not forget to have fun because fun should always be number one. Meet DJ Cat - the best dj in the world who is the main face of Passion Oasis. His first design was made in 1993 and even though his apperance has changed many times his personality never changed. He is a very cool cat who always wishes best for his friends. -Intriguing and complex story, -Varied gameplay, -Many distinct looking places and locations, -Original art-style, -Tons of secrets and lore elements to find.

FEATURES: - Attach to various enemies and pull them towards you to chop them into pieces as you speed through. - When facing larger veggies pull yourself towards them to swing through the stages at high speeds. - Finish stages as fast as possible to impress your proctor.

rows.name: Agents of SPLEEF
rows.short_description: A crazy, single- or multi-player spleef game. Die the least amount of times to win.
rows.description_html: Join the ranks of the best SPLEEF agents on flat earth, where bombs are your weapons, and your friend is your nemesis. In this chaotic third-person multiplayer mayhem, you'll take on the role of a fearless agent, armed with nothing but your trusty bomb launcher and an insatiable appetite for mayhem. Forget about traditional shooting combat; here you'll be knocking out your foes directly or creating treacherous holes to send them (or, ahem, you) plummeting into the abyss. But beware! Your opponents are equally armed and equally devious. One wrong move, and you might find yourself plunging into the depths, cursing the day you ever enlisted. It's a delicate dance of destruction, where strategy and reflexes reign supreme. Prepare for intense multiplayer matches where friendships will be tested, alliances betrayed, and the only rule is to spleef or be spleefed. Join the ranks of the SPLEEF elite, and prove your worth in the ultimate battle of bombs and brutality! The rules are simple: Shoot a bomb directly at your opponents for an instant kill, or blow a hole in the floor and knock them in with the bomb's impact. The player that dies the least number of times wins the round. There are four players per round (including bots). For single-player mode : Host a private server so no one can join your game. For multi-player mode : Host a public server so your friends can find your game. Please keep in mind that your friends may experience a slight lag.

rows.name: 天月麻雀 (Amatsuki Mahjong)
rows.short_description: Amatsuki Mahjong is a ACG style mahjong game that offers real-time multiplayer online matches. It features four styles of mahjong: Japanese, Sichuan, Taiwanese, and Hong Kong Mahjong. Enjoy a variety of play styles tailored to your preferences.
rows.description_html: Amatsuki Mahjong Features Amatsuki Mahjong is a free online Mahjong game featuring Taiwan, Hong Kong, Japanese (Riichi), and Sichuan Mahjong, brought to life with a vibrant anime style and popular voice actors from Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Japan. 4-Style Mahjong in One with Real-Time Players Enjoy real-time, cross-platform multiplayer matches featuring four distinct Mahjong styles: Taiwan, Hong Kong, Japanese (Riichi), and Sichuan, allowing you to play anytime, anywhere. In addition to challenging ranked matches, the game features casual rooms, friend matches, and more modes, providing mahjong enthusiasts with a rich variety of gameplay options. Popular Voice Actors from Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Japan Every character comes with localized voiceovers in Mandarin, Cantonese, and Japanese, letting you fully immerse yourself in every single match! Featuring an all-star voice cast including Yūki Kana(優木かな), Ogura Yui(小倉唯), Hikasa Yoko(日笠陽子), Uchida Maaya(内田真礼), Kito Akari(鬼頭明里), Tsumugi Risa(紡木吏佐), Amasaki Kohei(天﨑滉平), Maeda Seiji(前田誠二), and more... they are all ready to meet you! Each character comes with an eye-catching winning animation, stunning animated live portraits, and quirky-themed stickers. With voiceovers in Japanese, Cantonese, and Mandarin by popular voice actors, immersing players in this vibrant mahjong world. Build relationships with your favourite characters to unlock exclusive costumes and more special voice lines! Customize Your Mahjong Experience Mix and match various accessories and winning effects to personalize your matches, making each win feel like a spectacular achievement. Amatsuki Mahjong also introduces themed match scenes, truly bringing the experience to life on the mahjong table for an unprecedented immersive experience! Easy Learning with Comprehensive Tutorials New to any of the four styles of mahjong? No worries! The game features a user-friendly tutorial assistant that guides you through the rules, winning combinations, and scoring in four-style mahjong. With this support, you’ll go from novice to mahjong master in no time. Plus, automated shuffling, drawing and cutting systems ensure smooth gameplay, enhancing your gaming experience. Participate in Official Tournaments to Connect and Improve Join our regular online and offline mahjong tournaments, where players can hone their skills and connect through competition. Participation is free, with plenty of exclusive rewards available, giving you the chance to compete for the top honor of 'Celestial Moonlight'. Stay tuned on the latest events by following the Amatsuki Mahjong community: ※ This game is intended for players aged 18 and above. ※ The game does not offer real-money gambling. All in-game currency, items, and characters are virtual assets and cannot be exchanged for cash or any form of tangible rewards.

rows.name: One Shot Arena
rows.short_description: One Shot Arena is a multiplayer game of precision and perfect timing, where quick reflexes and sharp strategy make all the difference. Are you ready to outsmart and outplay your rivals?
rows.description_html: One Shot Arena is a fast-paced multiplayer arena where precision and agility are the keys to victory. Every hero can be taken down with a single hit, making each move critical. However, the game isn't just about avoiding danger; it's about mastering a wide range of abilities to dodge, deceive, and outsmart your opponents. Engage in intense battles where every move counts, and only the most skilled players will emerge as winners. Key Features • Diverse Abilities Each hero has unique abilities and their own learning curve. Master your favorite heroes to gain an advantage on the battlefield. Learn the strenghts and weaknesses of each hero to leverage your chances. • Multiplayer Fights Battle against friends and foes in dynamic arenas. Available in 1v1, 2v2 and Free For All formats. You can play each mode in ranked or unranked. • Skill-Based Gameplay Collect victories and improve your rating to climb the leaderboards. • Instant Eliminations Every hit counts. Reflexes and strategic thinking are crucial to defeat your enemies and win rounds. Dive into One Shot Arena and experience the thrill of high-speed combat where every move matters. Can you outlast and outplay your rivals? The arena awaits your legend to be written.

rows.name: Island Clicker
rows.short_description: Island Clicker: Embark on a thrilling adventure! Collect resources, upgrade tools, and tame loyal companions. Uncover hidden secrets, explore mysterious bunkers, and battle fierce enemies. Every click reveals new challenges. Are you ready to discover what this island hides?
rows.description_html: Welcome to Island Clicker – where every click opens the door to an unexplored world! 🌴 Explore the Island: Chop down your first tree, crack open your first stone, and step by step, delve deeper into the mysteries of this enigmatic island. The further you venture, the more resources you find, and with each upgraded tool, you become even stronger! 🐒 Tame Loyal Companions: Don’t face this adventure alone! Find and tame a monkey to work tirelessly by your side, a wolf ready to tear through your enemies, or a cat that brings you the kind of luck you’ve only dreamed of. 🏠 What Do the Shadows Hide?: The island is filled with secrets – from a strange broken totem by the lake to a mysterious bunker hidden among the trees. What are these places, and how can you access them? What secrets do they hold? Perhaps the answers lie behind doors that are still locked. Can you unravel all the mysteries that this land holds? ⚔️ Test Your Strength: Eventually, your journey will lead you to the island's darkest secret... What horror awaits in the Acidic World? Only those prepared for the final challenge will face the true inhabitants of this grim realm head-on. Island Clicker isn’t just a game – it’s a real adventure, packed with mysteries and astonishing discoveries. Are you ready for the journey? Start clicking and discover what this mysterious island hides.

rows.name: Velvet 89
rows.short_description: How did the communist regime in Czechoslovakia fall? This hidden-object game tells the story of ordinary people taking part in the peaceful demonstrations that changed the course of history. Big crowds hide those, who want to tell you why they took to the streets.
rows.description_html: What do people making a stand against the unjust regime dream of? What do they fear? To find out, you’ll need a sharp eye. The color of clothes, hairstyle or the surroundings will be your clues in our historical hidden-object game. Velvet 89 takes you on a trip across the revolting country – from cautious ecology-themed protests to huge crowds. Investigate the moments before police brutally attacked a peaceful demonstration and unveil the stories of those who decided to speak up. Velvet 89 was developed with experts from the renowned Czech project Stories of Injustice. Every piece of the story in the game is based on actual testimonies. It shows how the revolution gained momentum, from the border regions onto the squares of Prague and further. History comes alive in a visual style reminiscent of paper cut-outs, used videotapes or faded photo albums. The game combines handcrafted atmosphere with real historical footage. takes place in five cities and at six protests that made the Velvet Revolution happen features a hidden-object gameplay with more than 40 stories uses stylized visuals that combine handcrafted graphics and actual historical footage was made with experts and is based on real testimonies The game was developed in cooperation with educational programme One World in Schools to commemorate the 35th anniversary of the Velvet Revolution. It was created as a part of the Stories of Injustice project, which aims to introduce our country’s modern history to young people.

rows.description_html: SpellBit is a fast-paced mini battle royale game designed for 12 players per match. It draws major inspiration from games like Fortnite and Spellbreak, offering a smaller scale experience with even more excitement! Unleash devastating spells and manipulate the very fabric of reality to outwit and overpower your opponents. Engage in fast-paced , strategic combat, combining precise spellcasting with cunning tactics to emerge victorious. Engage in intense fights against other mages! Master your flying skills! Customize your mage, choosing from a diverse range of spell schools and unlocking unique characters . Find epic loot to help you win battles!

rows.name: Sivi's Factory
rows.short_description: Sivi's Factory is a single player first-person horror game in which you play as Felix. You are looking for your brother on the scientific factory. Solve puzzles on the locations, explore new rooms, fight your enemy and go deeper into factory.
rows.description_html: Sivi's Factory is a dark first-person horror game where you play as Felix, desperately searching for his brother in a massive scientific factory. From the very first steps, you're surrounded by a mysterious atmosphere, with dangers lurking around every corner. The factory is a labyrinth of various workshops, hidden passages, and unknown rooms, where every new discovery brings new threats. You'll need to solve puzzles, explore dark rooms, and fight off a terrifying enemy that chases you throughout the factory. One of the unique mechanics in the game is a watch with a cartridge that can be printed using a 3D printer to unlock various functions to progress through levels. Printers will also help create key items, such as access cards, which will open new locations and allow you to delve deeper into the depths of the factory. You'll encounter four unique locations, each filled with its own secrets and traps. Dive deeper into the complex, solve engaging puzzles, and uncover the truth about what happened at the factory, where your brother is... and what secrets hide in the shadows. Get ready for a tense atmosphere, challenging puzzles, and dangerous battles in Sivi's Factory.

rows.description_html: Your GOD has forsaken you, raining the fury of the heaven realm upon your very feet. Turning fellow friends to foes, for domination in the demon realm. Play as one of the 7 deadly sins in this fast paced Action Roguelike to kill god. Precision Based Combat Partake in violently fast paced combat that tests your ability to parry and dodge enemy attacks. Break your enemies' defenses with relentless attacks to further crush their souls. Fight in unique modes that allow you to unlock Side characters with slightly different move-sets, or a boss only mode. Each mode allows you to play against the clock to see how well you've done. Challenging Bosses Take on angels, demons, spirits, and nightmares as everyone against you fights for your flesh and bones. Each enemy testing you on your path. Be wary of devastating enemy combos, and their potential mix-ups. Hit Even Harder Use modifiers bestowed upon you by the sin of Greed to crush your foes even more efficiently. Different modifiers allow you to specialize in different areas, letting you craft completely different playstyles.

Complete all 20 levels! With each level, the number of doors increases, there are more enemies, there are closed doors to which you need to look for keys! At the same time, the game remains both challenging and relaxing at the same time! For every 10,000 points, a mini bonus game is given. Score as many points as possible so that everyone knows that you are the best in the game!!!

rows.name: Cursed Ones
rows.short_description: Cursed Ones is a co-op horror stealth survival game. Play as the Crane siblings as you hunt down the worst kinds of spirits and continue your late parents' legacy. Make sure you both don't die in the process.
rows.description_html: Cursed Ones is a 1-2 player co-op horror stealth survival game. Play as the Crane siblings as you continue your late parents' legacy to purge the world of sinister spirits. Track down the items used to summon the spirit by any means necessary. Make sure you both don't die in the process. Protect each other : Play with a friend as you HIDE , RUN , or CONFRONT the spirit that is hunting you down. Singleplayer Mode : Ditch your sibling and take on the supernatural yourself. Scavenge the map : Find items around the map that will help you survive. Find out what happened : There are clues around the world that hint at how tragedy struck those who were there before you. Equipment : As ghost hunters, you always carry the right equipment for the job. Each map will have unique equipment for that particular map. The Crane Curse : Cursed blood runs through the Crane family line, and each sibling has a special curse. Find out what it is. Getting Caught : If you're caught there are no second chances. Make sure to protect each other. The Goal : Track down and destroy the items that were used to bring the spirit into our world & MAKE IT OUT ALIVE

rows.short_description: A simple 2d game where you roll for different items! These items you get will become rarer and rarer as you collect them.

There is also a shop in the game where you can get more luck. This can help you get more and better items along the way. COMING SOON Achievements and other stuff... HAVE FUN!

rows.name: Orbit Puzzle
rows.short_description: An astronomical puzzle game about discovering the rotational speeds and radii of epicycles.
rows.description_html: 'Orbit Puzzle' is a puzzle game that lets you unravel the mysteries of ancient astronomy! Analyze the complex orbit of a given celestial body and accurately determine the rotational speed and radius of both the deferent and epicycle. Understand the geometric principles of epicycles and complete the path of the celestial body. Each level presents more challenging orbits, testing your logical thinking and problem-solving skills. Embark on an exciting journey to uncover the secrets of the universe from the perspective of an ancient astronomer!

rows.name: Pixeplorer
rows.short_description: Explore an infinite amount of pixelated worlds in this adventure sandbox game, and find villages, enemy camps, and quests along your journey!
rows.description_html: Explore an infinite amount of pixelated worlds in this adventure sandbox game, and find villages, enemy camps, and quests along your journey! In Pixeplorer, you spawn into a procedurally generated world with only a sword and a set of basic armor. Your task? Explore. Trek through grasslands, savannas, deserts and more to collect resources, which then you can use to upgrade your items and fight enemies with. Will you get lost in the game's boundless biomes collecting trees and fighting enemy hordes? Or, will you find a village and change the tides of battle, allowing you to sweep through fiercer enemy outposts? The choice is all yours in Pixeplorer. GAME FEATURES: Infinite procedurally generating worlds, ranging from 512 x 512 tiles up to 2048 x 2048 tiles each Enemy outposts and cave systems for intense combat, with 7 unique different enemy types total Villages filled with NPCs and options to upgrade items Trackable quest system to use resources and get powerful loot ... And much more!

rows.name: Finn Dorset's Institute For Livestock Replication
rows.short_description: An animated incremental game about cloning livestock. Make as many moon sheep as you can. Research technology, upgrade your operation and become a clone farm billionaire!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Finn Dorset's Institute For Livestock Replication You play as Finn Dorset, a humble clone farmer starting out on a grassy dwarf planet. Begin with a single moon sheep, a small paddock and a cloning machine. Expand your enterprise clone-by-clone until you have the greatest wool production business in the sector! Purchase upgrades and automate your clone production with your hard earned Moon Money! Deploy futuristic gadgets to produce large amounts of livestock and develop various transport methods to sell your wool! Defend your farm from hungry hawks and other hazardous hostiles! Features - Animated cartoon graphics - Totally free game (no paid bonuses, loot boxes or coins. You will never be asked for money) - Hundreds of upgrades and progression levels - Fully illustrated hand drawn artwork - Space goose! - Dynamic evolving visuals - Hours of game-play - In-game and Steam achievements What even is this? Another crackpot hand-drawn cartoon game from the developer of Snowflake's Chance and Metal Voyager. FDIFLR is an incremental game in the spirit of titles such as Universal Paperclips and Cookie Clicker. The genre is often characterized by minimalist visuals so the idea was to have the units and upgrades illustrated as much as possible. It is an idle/clicker game so there are short to medium periods of waiting to progress. Is there sound? Due to the game being designed to be played while multitasking or in the background there is no game audio, players are encouraged to listen to a podcast or watch approved educational programming on a second monitor. Who has made this? Game and artwork was made by Carl Morgan (CarlMorganArt). Special thanks to Dante Morris for naming the title. So this is free? Yep. Who is Finn Dorset? Stop digging.

rows.name: Little Knight
rows.short_description: Become a Little Knight and use your oversized weapon to fling, slash and dash around 2D arenas set in a medieval blacksmith. Master the goofy physics to beat your family and friends and claim the crown.
rows.description_html: Little Knight is a 2.5D party game that supports 2-4 players. Leverage your oversized weapon of choice to swing and fling yourself across various arenas and bring the fight to your friends and family. Master the goofy physics and show off your skills in frantic matches to try and come out on top. Collect and protect your horde of gold to win in the collection game mode or dominate your opponents in death match mode. Play with up to four friends in local multiplayer Fling yourself around as you master the goofy physics movement Choose from four unique weapons

rows.name: Geometry Shooter
rows.short_description: Unleash your aim in this free, hand-drawn arcade game! Fire from a moving cannon, break various shapes, and rack up crazy combos in a puzzling and exciting gameplay experience. Can you master the art of the perfect shot?
rows.description_html: Dive into the charming, hand-drawn world of this free arcade game where every shot counts! Your goal is to fire from a moving cannon into a field of shapes—circles, squares, triangles, and more. Once hit, the shapes expand, but it takes multiple hits to break them and score points. Timing and precision are key as you aim to break multiple shapes with a single shot, triggering crazy combos for maximum points. The game’s cute art style and puzzling, yet exciting, gameplay make it perfect for quick sessions or longer playthroughs. Get ready to challenge your friends!

rows.name: Metroloop
rows.short_description: Loot post-apocalyptic metro tunnels in side-scrolling mode and survive waves of monsters at stations in top-down twin-stick shooter mode. Upgrade your skills and weapons endlessly. How far will you get?
rows.description_html: Reach the furthest stations in the postapocalyptic top down shooter and platformer looter. Loot tunnels in side scrolling mode and survive from waves of monsters on the stations in a top down twin stick shooter mode.  How far will you go? Destroy boxes to find crucial loot in tunnels, between stations. Boxes contain upgrades, weapons, ammo and coins and you have only 40 seconds to find whatever you need during platformer tunnel phase. Light shuts down every 5 seconds, during which you will have to move forward. Upgrading your axe skill will make smashing boxes faster. Keys found in monsters bodies will open boxes faster. Shoot your way through stations in a top down twin-stick shooter phase of the game. Quantity and thoughness of enemies go slowly up with every next station, along your upgrades and weapons. 20 different types of enemies will be waiting for you at the stations. You can hold and use two weapons at the same time, manage your ammo responsibly. Additionally you will have special abilities at your disposal, such as landmines, shield, glue trap and teleporter, that will help you leave every station alive. Upgrade temporarily and permanently. Open boxes with green arrows to find upgrades of your skills and weapons. Each upgrade improves your stats by small amount but you can keep upgrading endlessly.  Buy permanent weapon upgrades for collected coins. Unlock achievements for permanent upgrades of your character's skills. Survive as many stations as possible. Fighting enemies will not always be the best solution, sometimes you can avoid them or run away from them. Every tunnel has a healing chamber at the end of it. The more time you will save, the more life points you will restore before all lights shut down.

rows.name: King Of The Pirates
rows.short_description: Can you rule this mighty sea?
rows.description_html: About This Game Embark on an epic journey in sea war, a thrilling naval combat game where strategy, skill, and bravery determine your fate on the high seas. Command your own ship, upgrade it, and become the most feared pirate captain of all time. Key Features: Ship Customization: Upgrade your ship with powerful cannons, elite cannonballs, and a highly skilled crew. Equip special materials and unique items to give you an edge over your enemies. Naval Battles: Engage in intense naval battles against other players in real-time. Use your strategic prowess to outmaneuver your foes and send them to the depths. Fleet System: Build or join a fleet to conquer islands and dominate the seas. Coordinate with your fleet members to execute massive attacks and defend your territory. Daily Quests & Events: Complete daily quests to earn experience points and speed up your progression. Participate in regular events to showcase your skills and earn exclusive rewards. Leaderboard: Prove your dominance by climbing the ranks. The strongest and most skilled players will see their ship names featured prominently on the game’s leaderboard. Open World Exploration: Explore a vast open world filled with hidden treasures, dangerous foes, and mysterious islands. Each journey offers new challenges and opportunities. Multiplayer: Join forces with friends or challenge other players in exciting multiplayer modes. Strengthen your alliances and show the world your might. Stunning Graphics & Sound: Experience the beauty and danger of the seas with stunning graphics and immersive sound effects that bring the world of Sea War to life. Set sail, captain, and carve your legend in the treacherous waters of Sea War. Whether you seek glory, treasure, or simply the thrill of battle, the seas await your command.

rows.name: Cycle of Steel
rows.short_description: Cycle of Steel is a pixel-art roguelike where tyrannical robot knights run amok. Arm and upgrade your robot to fight through a perilous factory. End the knight’s reign of terror!
rows.description_html: Cycle of Steel is a fast paced roguelike adventure, where you make it through a randomly generated dungeon, utilizing various weapons to shoot down enemies along the way. Explore a destopic scenery, ravaged by heartless robots, all drawn in satisfying pixel art. It's free, give it a shot. Control a hacked robot against the AI’s army, The Knights of the Holy Code. Search for the one controlling them all, and bring them, or it, down to ruin. Pick up your weapon and fire, with a top down perspective shooter, and roguelike elements to keep the game interesting. Keep respawning and purchashing upgrades to get further every time. Figure out your playstyle with differing weapons, taking it slow and steady with a laser rifle, or hot and fast with piercing shotgun rounds! And more details to find, like environmental effects, in this indie game created by a team with a passion. You can't give up, if your robot is destroyed, you must make more to break the cycle of steel.

rows.name: Alchemy
rows.short_description: Discover what lies beyond our reality with Alchemy. A portal-like experience that will challenge you to think with potions while trying to solve the mysteries of this strange new place.
rows.description_html: Alchemy is a 3D Puzzle platformer taking place at Chemical Laboratories, a company that discovered a powerfull substance capable of giving superhuman characteristics. Chemical labs will be hosting an event for investors were a gateway to another reality will be opened, what could go wrong? Find your way out trough chambers and try to understand what is going on at this bizarre shuffle of what chemical labs used to be. Alchemy introduces a new way of solving puzzles centered on movement. Includes: • 20 Main chambers + extra levels. • 7-10 hours of gameplay. • A storyline. • Unique mechanics.

rows.name: Infiltrate & Extract
rows.short_description: A top-down 3D stealth game where remaining undetected is of utmost priority. Take down security guards and stay in the shadows to reach the vault and extract a highly valuable relic.
rows.description_html: Mission brief: You are deployed to a heavily guarded compound to infiltrate and extract a highly valuable relic. Remaining undetected is of utmost priority. If anyone spots you, the mission is over. Use your surroundings carefully to avoid detection and reach the vault. The ultimate test of strategy and patience awaits you. Harder challenges will become available for the elite who accomplish their extraction. Do you accept your mission? Infiltrate and Extract will test your problem solving and decision-making skills. This game has no mercy against those who don’t plan ahead, and heavy punishments for not being patient. Only the best of agents returns home, and the very best can beat the hardest challenges the game has to offer. Are you up for the challenge? 10 unique locations. Unlockable “First Person” Mode. Unlockable “Sudden Death” Mode. Est. Mission length: ~ 1 hour. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

If anyone spots you, the mission is over. Use your surroundings carefully to avoid detection and reach the vault. The ultimate test of strategy and patience awaits you. Harder challenges will become available for the elite who accomplish their extraction. Do you accept your mission? Infiltrate and Extract will test your problem solving and decision-making skills. This game has no mercy against those who don’t plan ahead, and heavy punishments for not being patient. Only the best of agents returns home, and the very best can beat the hardest challenges the game has to offer. Are you up for the challenge? 10 unique locations. Unlockable “First Person” Mode. Unlockable “Sudden Death” Mode. Est. Mission length: ~ 1 hour. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

Choose from a variety of blocks to find the most profitable strategy! Try Local Multiplayer with up to 4 friends! (Note: At least one controller is required to play Local Multiplayer with more than 2 people)

rows.name: Mini Mania

rows.description_html: Mini Mania is a new single player game from Pixel Playground Studio. Set in your Grandad's mysterious Laboratories, Mini Mania has been Nominated as one of the most innovative new games from UWE's Graduates and will offer up to an hours of unique gameplay. The game is designed to change the way players approach, manipulate, and surmise the possibilities in a given environment; similar to how Portal™'s Portal Gun innovated new ways to leverage an you're environment in any given situation. Players must solve physical puzzles and challenges by using a shrink ray to manipulate the size of objects, and themselves, through space.

rows.name: Bite-Sized Scares
rows.short_description: Kick back, relax, and grab some snacks as you enjoy a variety of short, indie horror games in the 'Bite-Sized Scares' collection. There's a little something for everyone in this fun and spooky package!
rows.description_html: Bite-Sized Scares Is a completely free, small collection of short and sweet, bite sized indie horror games created and curated by Aaron Wise & D. Zenith. The games are playable through a fun and interactive launcher, with each game featuring their own unique setting, narrative, and gameplay mechanics. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- FEATURED IN THIS COLLECTION: Statuam Your friends dared you to enter the mysterious maze, dubbed 'Domum Statuae'. Stories of a demonic statue that stalks its prey throughout the maze are all that runs though your mind, but you aren't one to chicken out. Get in, get out. How hard can it be? The Bewdley Incident A short game of 'Guess Who' where a Skinwalker has taken over the small town where you live. Assess the situation, look for the signs, and execute the Skinwalker before it's too late! Randomly selects a new Skinwalker with each playthrough with 4 endings to find. A Date to Remember Sometimes it's best to let sleeping corpses lie. You take the role of a young, single woman, attempting to find love in these trying times. The person you've taken an interest in, invites you to dinner at his beloved grandmother's house. Though as with all dates, people don't show their true colors right away. The Nest Something lives down inside the darkest part of the mines. With the creature on the prowl, you must avoid detection, find resources to build a makeshift bridge & escape. Be careful, though. It's not the only thing down there. Booi's Spooky Vacation Booi, the ghost, decided to explore the sea during it's vacation, but an unfortunate event happens and the path towards new waters is blocked by a big ghost ship. Now Booi will need the help of the local folks to discover the dark secrets behind the ghost ship in order to get inside it and release all the tripulation being held by an evil entity! Booi's Spooky Vacation is a point and click game. It's Outside Can you survive the night?  Step into the eerie sounds of rain & silence, where something sinister lurks just beyond the windows. Inspired by Five Nights at Freddy's , this tense, atmospheric horror game challenges you to keep a terrifying entity at bay, armed with nothing but your wits, your ears, and a powerful photo flash. Garage A short and sweet psychological horror game which takes place in the mind of a troubled husband. He goes about his business as usual, however; things don't end particularly well for him. Do you have what it takes to assist our hero and release him from his torment? PROCESS_HIDE A rogue virus has been corrupting and taking over the network. You take the role of an antivirus stealth-unit. You must make your way to the core of the network to release more antivirus units to combat the virus. Sneak your way through 3 distinct levels and avoid detection at all costs! Kakashi Based on the Japanese folklore, 'Kakashi'; torments a local farmer. With missing people on the rise, and strange dreams that haunt you as the week progresses. Can you solve the mystery behind the missing persons and survive these strange occurances?

rows.name: Delivery to Graveyard Manor
rows.short_description: Gather the disguises and collect all the deliveries!
rows.description_html: Ding Dong! There is a package at the door, and Graveyard Manor’s resident skeleton will need to collect items from the previous occupants of this old Victorian mansion in order to receive it on time without scaring the delivery courier. Each Family member has a portrait featuring three items the skeleton will need in order to summon their visage. Make sure you find the right combination in order to achieve your task. In this puzzle/adventure game items can be found on shelves, in cabinets, behind locked doors or even stolen by mice. Will you collect all of the packages in time before the main event?

rows.name: Virtuále: Heist Simulations
rows.short_description: A turn-based heist game where you get to mastermind your own high-profile job. This game’s rich atmosphere and sense of style underpin the simple but fun strategy gameplay. Sneak, hack, and smash your way to riches in Virtuále: Heist Simulations!
rows.description_html: THE STORY There's a big house at the top of Townstate, and you want what's inside. The value of these goods is beyond what you could possibly imagine. The only problem? Security. Electronic locks, heavy vault doors with magnetic seals, and guards galore fill this mansion. Luckily, you have a team: Alpha Vlad, a bodybuilder and weapons expert; Scarlett, femme fatale and soccer mom extraordinaire; John Doe, the mysterious and stealthy agent of chaos; and finally, Zoomer, a speedy genius with a knack for high-profile theft. These four make up your crew, and with their skills and your careful strategy, you all may be able to finally make it big—and make enough to pay those pesky Townstate HOA dues. THE GAMEPLAY The gameplay of Virtuále: Heist Simulations is very straightforward. On a large grid representing your mark's house, you use your four operatives, turn by turn, to deal with guards and obstacles to escape with as much value as possible. But be careful: you only have so much time to reach the quota, and if the guards get too suspicious, they'll call the cops. Break in and break out with the most valuable loot, and see how high you can make the number go! You have abilities such as Hack, which allows you to bypass more difficult locks (such as the vault), or abilities like Swoon, which allows you to use an operative to distract guards for a bit while you make off with your steals! A WORD ABOUT THE GAME'S SCOPE This game was made by just four people over the course of ten weeks. As such, the game was designed to be as tight and replayable as we could possibly make it. While there is just one playable house, there are a huge number of ways to succeed in the world of Virtuále: Heist Simulations, so try out as many as you possibly can!

rows.name: Forest Dump: Prologue
rows.short_description: Forest Dump: Prologue is a free version of the upcoming roguelike card-flipping adventure game. Explore a mysterious woodland as a fox, meet strange creatures, and uncover the first secrets of your corrupted home in this beautiful journey.
rows.description_html: Dive into a world of surprises, where every card flip could be your ticket to victory or trouble. The prologue showcases a part of the mysterious forest that changes with every game. Can you master the art of strategic card flipping and uncover the first plot mysteries? Get a taste of a larger adventure that combines tactical thinking, luck, and exploration in this captivating roguelike experience. Features of the Prologue: Strategic Combat: Experience the core gameplay where every decision matters. Learn to choose your cards wisely and plan your attacks carefully. Roguelike Elements: Discover how collecting scrolls can make you stronger. Vibrant World: Explore part of the atmospheric forest with beautiful graphics. Cards: Try out a limited set of cards, giving you a taste of the variety in the full game. First Story Beats: Meet key characters and uncover the beginning of the mysterious plot that unfolds in the full version. Replayability: Each playthrough of the prologue offers a unique experience thanks to the changing forest. Try out gameplay elements that fans of Slay the Spire, Inscryption , and similar card-based roguelikes will find both familiar and fresh.

rows.name: The Wungo Dungo Surprise
rows.short_description: The Wungo Dungo Surprise is a physics based local 1v1 fighting game, with no combos or roster, just 1 simple enemy to beat repeatedly. The main moves are punching, kicking and dodging, and some extra tools, a few weapons and powers.
rows.description_html: The Wungo Dungo Surprise is a physics based local 1v1 fighting game. There’s no combos or moveset, or roster. There’s no lore or story. The goal is just to win every encounter and see how many times you can win. There’s a single player mode against a bot, and a local 1v1 mode, first to 3. There are no extra characters or stages. Health isn’t automatically regained at the end of each round so it’s a case of seeing how many rounds you can go for in a row. For the gameplay, there’s a punch, a kick, 4 dodges, 3 weapons, and 11 powers. The core of the gameplay is reacting to the punch direction of the enemy, and the other moves are sprinkles of variation/decision making on top of that. At the end of each round you get the choice of one of 11 powers, and to regain health/dodges/kicks. The game itself is fully physics based, i.e. every limb of the character is fully controlled by physics and obeys newtons laws, allowing for some interesting interactions, such as being able to ragdoll at any time. As part of the physics system, momentum is conserved, and as such while in the air you’re purely at the whims of momentum and gravity, which means stuff like throwing objects or front flips must be well timed, which can lead to some fun moments and difficulty.

rows.name: Countin' Stars
rows.short_description: Countin' Stars is a procedurally generated puzzle game that challenges you to count the stars in the sky. Destroy or create stars to match the possible answers before time runs out.
rows.description_html: Countin' Stars is a procedurally generated puzzle game that’s as original as it is unique. Carefully observe the night sky and count how many stars you see, but stay focused—other celestial objects will complicate your task. You’ll be presented with three possible answers, but only one will be correct. However, be warned—sometimes none of them will be right. In those moments, you’ll need to use black holes to destroy stars or create new stars to make the count match the available options. If you choose incorrectly or run out of time, it’s game over. Key Features Procedurally generated gameplay, ensuring no two sessions are ever the same. Relax with our cozy music and graphics style. Destroy or create stars to align with the possible outcomes. Enjoy the challenge of counting stars under pressure and improve your high score.

rows.name: Cast Iron Flowers
rows.short_description: a VR experience of the Chinese intangible cultural heritage program - Cast Iron Flowers
rows.description_html: This game is a VR experience of the Chinese intangible cultural heritage program - Cast Iron Flowers. You can experience the process of Cast Iron Flowers in the game! You move and manipulate objects through the use of the VR grip, experiencing each process of Cast Iron Flowers and ultimately realizing it by gripping the willow sticks (Hua Bang)! You can feel the stunning immersion effect far beyond the normal video. The optimized process is presented in the game as the following parts: - Pick up the basket with broken iron pieces and pour the iron pieces in the basket into the designated furnace. - Pick up the willow sticks (Hua Bang) used for Molten Iron Firework and go to the furnace to get liquid iron. - Go to the bottom of the trellis (Hua Peng) and hit the willow sticks (Hua Bang) to complete the flower making process and enjoy the beautiful scenery. As long as you follow the guidance in the scene to operate, you can feel the unique charm of the Chinese intangible cultural heritage program of Cast Iron Flowers, come and try!

rows.name: Discover Old D'Hanis
rows.short_description: Step into the past and unravel the rich history of Old D'Hanis. Explore this 19th-century town, from Alsatian and German settlers of 1847 to Black and Mexican families post-Civil War. Unearth archival fragments, archaeological photos, and oral histories to piece together the town's alluring stories.
rows.description_html: Discover. Learn. Preserve. Discover Old D'Hanis is an immersive educational experience that invites you to explore the history of the old town of D’Hanis, TX. The game is based on data from the Old D’Hanis Archaeological Mapping Project, a real archaeological project that examined the ruins, stories, and landscapes of the historic town, alongside community members, in 2018. Enter D’Hanis and you will find yourself in front of the ruin of its Catholic church, grass beneath your feet, the sound of wind and the occasional bird in a landscape empty of people. You stand at the intersection of past and present. Walking through the historic streets, you will find virtual reconstructions of white-walled cottages from the 19th century alongside 21st century ruins scanned by archaeologists. Scattered throughout the landscape are pieces of D’Hanis’ story – a 19th century photograph, archaeological field notes, a quote from an oral history, a newspaper article. Alone, these provide small snapshots of the town or the archaeological project through time. Together, they paint a fuller picture of D’Hanis and its residents, from the Alsatian and German migrants who founded the town in 1847 to the Black and Mexican families who made it their home following the Civil War and Mexican Revolution. Your role: to explore, to collect fragments, and to piece together the stories of the Old D’Hanis. Based on the history of a real Texas town, Discover Old D’Hanis features ruins, historically-informed landscape and sound design, interactive features, artistic reconstructions, and an original musical composition based on old German folk songs. It provides a glimpse into a real archaeology project and demonstrates how we come to understand the past through its fragments. Discover Old D'Hanis is more than just a game; it’s an invitation to join the efforts preserve and share the historical legacy of an historic place. Are you ready to uncover the stories and experience the old town?

Together, they paint a fuller picture of D’Hanis and its residents, from the Alsatian and German migrants who founded the town in 1847 to the Black and Mexican families who made it their home following the Civil War and Mexican Revolution. Your role: to explore, to collect fragments, and to piece together the stories of the Old D’Hanis. Based on the history of a real Texas town, Discover Old D’Hanis features ruins, historically-informed landscape and sound design, interactive features, artistic reconstructions, and an original musical composition based on old German folk songs. It provides a glimpse into a real archaeology project and demonstrates how we come to understand the past through its fragments. Discover Old D'Hanis is more than just a game; it’s an invitation to join the efforts preserve and share the historical legacy of an historic place. Are you ready to uncover the stories and experience the old town?

rows.name: 100th Bug Brigade
rows.short_description: 100th Bug Brigade is an accessible, story-rich, tactical, team-based roleplaying game featuring very cute bugs in a very uncute time.
rows.description_html: 100th Bug Brigade is an accessible, story-rich, tactical, team-based roleplaying game featuring very cute bugs in a very uncute time. Expected playtime: 1 hour. Don't let the Robugs win! Lead the underdog forces of the 100th Bug Brigade and defend your home tree! Though the battle is dire, hope rests with you! Clever tactics utilizing each member's unique active and passive abilities can turn the tide of the war. Possess your enemies, throw your allies, or put your life on the line for an ultimate attack. Use the ability tooltips to exploit every aspect of your team's abilities to overcome the odds. Manipulate the battlefield to your advantage (or the Robugs will!). Dynamic battlefields altered by your actions and the story combined. Retake conquered areas, revealing new bosses and environmental mechanics. But beware! If the Robugs can't chomp on you- they'll chomp on your defenses. Understand the emotions of the 100th Bug Brigade to discover hidden strengths and weaknesses. The Robugs may not have feelings, but your team does. Use clues from their dialogue on the battlefield to uncover strategies against the unfeeling Robugs. But if the Robugs don't feel, what motivates them...? You are not alone! Though you are their leader, the 100th Bug Brigade will serve not just as your soldiers, but also your advisors during battle. New to tactics or roleplaying games? Don't worry. The 100th Bug Brigade, and the development team behind them, have got your back. We designed the game to be accessible to new players, while retaining the depth of strategy that veterans expect.

rows.name: Old Timer Transport
rows.short_description: Hop on your turbocharged mobility scooter as a grumpy old driver! Race through Bompidorm with friends, commit vehicular manslaughter, and deliver your victims to the hospital to dodge lawsuits!
rows.description_html: Mobility scooters, chaos, and laughs—welcome to the wildest ride of your life! Ready to unleash some ridiculous scooter-driven mayhem? Take on the role of an old, grumpy driver in a turbocharged mobility scooter as you race through the city of Bompidorm. Your mission? Pick up humans scattered throughout the madness and deliver them to safety—all while outmaneuvering your equally grumpy rivals. PvP? Oh, you bet. Ragdoll physics? Absolutely. Laughs? Guaranteed. It’s you versus everyone else! Whether you're blasting rivals off the track with a well-timed explosion or speeding toward the hospital, the only thing standing between you and victory is a city full of chaos. Who will be the ultimate grumpy champion? Expect the unexpected —because in this game, anything can (and will) happen. From scooters flipping out of control to pedestrians being hilariously thrown across the map, it's all part of the fun. Embrace the unpredictability, and just go with the flow (or the crash). What's better than causing chaos alone? Causing chaos with friends, of course! Play with your buddies, or make some new enemies—because nothing brings people together like throwing them off their scooters in hilarious fashion. Think you have what it takes to be the ultimate grumpy driver? Grab your scooter, rally your friends, and dive headfirst into the most ridiculous game of your life. The city’s waiting—just don’t crash (too hard). 🚀 'Buckle up, it’s going to be one wild ride!' Get ready to laugh, rage, and everything in between. Join the madness, and remember: scooters aren’t just for getting around—they’re for domination. 🏆

rows.name: Text Your Life
rows.short_description: Who did you kiss that night? Text Your Life is a mobile phone chat simulator that lets you put yourself in the shoes of our protagonist, a female university student with a group of eccentric friends and a love life that has suddenly turned somewhat... complicated.
rows.description_html: As a fourth-year Law student with a part-time job at the Catal Café, you might as well end up going bald from stress. Fortunately, you can keep in touch with your peculiar group of friends and Daniel, your long-distance boyfriend, through your favorite messaging app (😉). They help you see the fun side of your busy life, as well as keep every hair in its place (or not). Now you've just moved out of home and into your new apartment, and everyone knows that means... party time! Music, alcohol, laughter, kisses... Wait, what?! Kisses?! Your memories are blurry, but somehow you clearly recall the feeling of someone's lips on yours. A warm and pleasant feeling. Hold on!! Pleasant!? 😳 Who did you kiss that night? Will you be able to find out with the help of your girlfriends-turned-detective? How will that kiss affect your relationship with Daniel? And most importantly - how much does a good wig cost 😱? Text Your Life is a mobile phone chat simulator that lets you put yourself in the shoes of our protagonist, a female university student with a group of eccentric friends and a love life that has suddenly turned somewhat... complicated. -Play as if it were a real messaging app. Chat, receive and make calls, browse the profiles of your contacts... -Shape the protagonist's personality with every choice you make, as well as her level of affinity with every character. Your personality and your choices will affect the course of the story. -The complete game will have a total of 10 chapters (Common route: chapters 1-4. Specific love interest’s route: chapters 5-10). 7 different routes, and 6 unique love interests. Will you continue your relationship with Daniel, or will you catch feelings for someone else? Surely you won't end up in a love triangle with two best friends, right...? -Only Chapters 1 and 2 are available for now, with more than 73,600 words of content and roughly 644 choices (about 7 hours for playthrough). Make a choice every 20 messages at most! Already finished the available content? Play again and change your choices to experience completely different playthroughs! -This game was originally written in Spanish, and it's been completely translated into English. What are you waiting for? Log in, create your profile, put an inspiring quote that makes no sense as your status, and start chatting right now! ⏳ Why does the game take so much time to load, especially after choosing/changing the language? 👉 On some devices, the Android version of TYL may take a few minutes to load. This happens because the game needs to restart, while also deleting any existing save games in order to prevent it from getting buggy after the language change. We would love to give you a solution to this problem, but we have yet to find one 😞 We recommend giving the game a bit more time and wait a few more minutes, and in case the problem persists, exit the game and leave it running in the background, then return to it, since doing this has worked for some players. 🤔  Can I choose the main character’s gender/pronouns? 👉 We are sorry, but that’s not possible. TYL’s story revolves around a female protagonist, and her gender/pronouns along with some other information about her (such as, for example, her degree or the members of her family) are set from the beginning. Even so, we hope that this does not keep you from enjoying the game and having a fun time with the Supergroup 😊 Thank you for your understanding. ⏩ I’m a fast reader. Can I increase the speed of the messages? 👉  Yes! 🥳 You can do so by adjusting the 'Messages speed' bar on the 'Settings' screen.  Keep in mind that the messages speed plays a big role in the storytelling  (doubting when typing, deleting messages, etc). Speeding up the messages might not let you appreciate those details.  📝 Does my progress automatically save (autosave)? 👉  No, you must save your game manually. You can do this from the game menu (bottom left corner of the screen). Keep this in mind so you don't lose your progress! 😨 Also remember that changing the language will cause all your saved games to be deleted. 📊 Where can I keep track of my personality stats, and my friendship/romance progress with the characters? 👉  You can do so by accessing the “Stats” screen from the game menu. There, you can: ✔️ Keep track of the changes in your friendship/romance levels with every character ❤️ ✔️ See how the choices you’ve made are affecting your personality stats 😎

rows.name: Valley of Tribes
rows.short_description: Valley of Tribes is a 1v1v1 strategy game where three tribes battle to be the last tribe standing. Send units and construct buildings to destroy enemy tribes and ensure your tribe's survival.
rows.description_html: Valley of Tribes is a 1v1v1 strategy game where three tribes battle to be the last tribe standing. Send units and construct buildings to destroy enemy tribes and ensure your tribe's survival. The game consists of a day/night cycle where you plan your actions during the night while nobody can see and then those actions are executed simultaneously once it reaches day. Construct Buildings. Buildings are an essential part of keeping your tribe alive. Construct defensive towers to defend your tribe against enemy attacks, or build resource harvesters to boost your tribe's economy. The more resources you have, the more actions you can take. Send Units. Attacking with units is the only way to win the game. Whether you swarm your enemy with mushrooms or send archers to take the other tribes out from afar, just remember that your enemies could have the same idea. Climb The Ranks. Want to prove your skills? Valley of tribes has a ranked ladder where players gain LP to reach rank milestones and show that they can be the best player in the game. Level Up Your Tribe. As you play games you will gather experience towards the tribe you were playing. Reaching certain levels will give that tribe bonuses to help take out your enemies more swiftly.

rows.name: Unfinished 2
rows.short_description: Unfinished 2 continues the story begun with Unfinished.
rows.description_html: A new (horror style, not violent) game in Pixel Art. SURVIVE THE CHASING In Unfinished 2, chases are intensified. There could be chases at any time. So be prepared for every pursuit. THE MONSTERS ARE COME BACK The monsters from Unfinished make a return in Unfinished 2. However, they will assist you for a while, but then they will turn against you again. THE SERIAL KILLER A new antagonist emerges in Unfinished 2. Mike, the serial killer, who seeks revenge on his wife. But he must realize that he should have handled his problem differently. NEW LORE A new and deeper backstory that explains why Mike became a serial killer. MORE INTELLIGENT ENEMIES The enemies are now much more intelligent.

rows.name: Protostar Twilight
rows.short_description: Protostar twilight is a fan-made HoloStars EN SRPG. This game includes art entirely made by our extremely talented team, enticing battles, a completely original story, music, and items. This game is available to play only on Windows.
rows.description_html: Join the Holostars EN TEMPUS idols on an epic survival adventure as they fight to escape the Abyss. Embark on a thrilling quest to uncover hidden treasures, explore mysterious stages, and piece together a long forgotten past that holds the key to their survival. Along the way, you might discover powerful secrets or unexpected rewards that could turn the tide in your favor. Face off against formidable enemies using a vast array of weapons, each with its own unique critical strikes that can change the course of battle. Strategically wield every idol’s special skills, combining their strengths to outwit enemies and overcome the dangers lurking in the depths. Only by working together and mastering their abilities can they hope to break free from the darkness and return to the sunlight above. Are you ready to guide them to victory and uncover the mysteries of the Abyss? GAMEPLAY * Enjoy visual novel scenes between battles showing the journey of TEMPUS within the Abyss. * Use your tactical prowess in grid-based battles against enemies to guide TEMPUS to safety and to escape the Abyss. * Collect items on the battlefield to customize each member of TEMPUS for the most efficient victory! * Level up your favorite TEMPUS member in battle to be the strongest adventurer! rows.name: Across Icaria
rows.short_description: A boy called Ica decide to visit sea.
rows.description_html: A boy called Ica decide to visit sea. Born into a military empire, he was tired of war and inventing weapons. After transforming an old gunboat with stolen Flying Wings, Ica began his journey of escape. It is said that 'ships' were originally used for 'navigation', but in this world, the sea has disappeared for half a century. Features Escape from the battlefield by gunboat, cross the Ikaria continent, and enjoy the vast world outside the restricted area. Dispatch cannons, launch missiles, repair engines However, please note that operating the outdated gunboat system requires manual input of commands. Confront all kinds of enemies - with your observation and typing speed! About This mini game started with a gamejam, and with a passion for classic STG, typing games and 90s anime, we boldly attempted this experimental gameplay combination. After multiple rounds of adjustments and polishing, we realized our wish that more people to try this idea, so we decided to release it for free. The game consists of 6 levels and a carefully crafted fantasy story, hoping you will enjoy it.

rows.name: [ANOMALY TAPES]: Beyond Reality
rows.short_description: Uncover the truth in '[ANOMALY TAPES]: Beyond Reality'. Navigate through haunting levels, survive deadly anomalies with unique mechanics, and piece together a chilling mystery hidden within the tapes. Dare to uncover the secrets?
rows.description_html: Step into the eerie world of '[ANOMALY TAPES]: Beyond Reality,' a retro analog horror game that takes you on a spine-chilling journey through a series of events. Each tape you find brings you closer to uncovering a dark secret, but beware—the anomalies are always lurking. Explore: Navigate through 8 main levels, each filled with unique challenges and atmospheric horror. Survive: Use a handheld camera perspective to document your journey and avoid deadly anomalies that stalk you relentlessly. Adapt: Each entity you encounter has unique gameplay mechanics. Learn and adapt quickly to survive the different challenges posed by each entity. Discover: Piece together the story behind the anomalies and your connection to them. Not everything is as it seems. Analyze: Replay the game to uncover subtle clues and hidden details that reveal the truth behind this place. In a world where reality bends and twists, you are thrust into something sinister. As you navigate a series of haunting environments, each more disturbing than the last, document your journey along the way. But be careful—each step forward brings you closer to a terrifying revelation. As you delve deeper into the mystery, you'll find yourself questioning your own sanity. What dark secrets lie beyond the tapes? '[ANOMALY TAPES]: Beyond Reality' invites you to explore, survive, and uncover the truth—if you dare.
