rows.name: Ramhart
rows.short_description: Ramhart is a small indie game from a single developer with turn-based combat, RPG elements and a story set in the not-too-distant future.
rows.description_html: Ramhart is a small indie game from a single developer with turn-based combat, RPG elements and a story set in the not-too-distant future.  Use the latest implantation technology to develop your character. Immerse yourself in the story of the fighter Ramhart and find out who kidnapped his brother and why, and how the kidnapping is connected to the fateful events unfolding in the world in 2034. 2034: Digital Rubicon In the world of the near future, most creative and intellectual tasks have been transferred to artificial intelligence, many people have been left without work. The main character of the game, Ramhart, is forced to fight in the arena to earn a living. His brother Christian is more fortunate - he is developing new models of Artificial Intelligence. Or rather, he was until recently - Christian disappeared from his home. Ramhart is sure that his brother was kidnapped, and undertakes to find him at all costs. Dance of Steel and Lead The game offers hand-to-hand combat, in which firearms are sometimes used. The battle is carried out in turns, each turn you choose one of the melee attacks or make a shot. Ammo is a scarce commodity, and in a battle of cyborgs reinforced with implants, punches and kicks can be as powerful as firearms. Balancing on the edge of humanity The future has not made people happy, but technology has stepped forward compared to today. In the game, your hero will have access to implantation technologies. Each implant affects 2 characteristics: it increases one, and slightly decreases the other. You will be able to create a unique character build, strengthening it in the chosen directions. Fighters of the new world Not only Ramhart, but also his opponents have access to combat implant technologies. You will face the powerful and unprincipled Abaddon corporation, on whose side not only ordinary mercenaries but also cyborgs fight. In the game, you will find many colorful enemies, both ordinary opponents and bosses.

rows.name: Heaven's Ladder
rows.short_description: Embark on a challenging platforming adventure where precision, patience, and skill are key to navigating breathtaking landscapes and reaching new heights.
rows.description_html: Prepare for an exhilarating journey in this platforming adventure, where every step is a test of skill and perseverance. Ascend towering platforms, execute breathtaking leaps of faith, and navigate the narrowest of paths with precision. You'll find yourself standing in places you never imagined possible. The game’s realistic physics and unique control mechanics demand patience and mastery, offering a rewarding experience for those who rise to the challenge. Immerse yourself in a world of serene landscapes accompanied by a soothing soundtrack, making each climb both a challenge and a pleasure.

rows.name: Oneiro Man
rows.short_description: Oneiro is an office worker who is forced to stay up all night writing reports to avoid losing his job. The game combines typing mechanics with various mini-games. It’s a 30-40 minute experience with multiple endings depending on your performance.
rows.description_html: Oneiro is an office worker who is forced to stay all night drafting reports to avoid being fired from his job. His boss asks him to draft 8 reports and submit them every hour and a half. Each time Oneiro finishes a report, he will fall asleep and have a dream that he must overcome to avoid getting stuck in the dream world (and completely asleep at work). What you can find: It can last 40 minutes or more, depending on your skill. It has 4 endings that depend on the number of mistakes you make. It has 3 difficulty levels. It has 7 challenges (achievements). It has 7 unique minigames. Custom music for each minigame. It has 3 cinematics.

rows.name: The Story Is You - Look Within
rows.short_description: A freely navigable and open first-person real-time 3D reflective experience. Come see what you see in you. Explore a beautiful and immersive environment that touches on lots of areas of life. See what resonates.
rows.description_html: A place where you can come to relax and reflect. Take a look at over 85 illustrations about life in a beautiful, and at times haunting, real-time 3D environment. A subtle background of 30 ambient songs play to mellow you out and get you into an introspective mood. This is not a FPS nor a Myst-style pixel hunt. Aesthetically pleasing, but it's a very different type of 'game.' Freely fly around a beautiful outdoor castle ruins environment, taking a long look at the emotional imagery and captions. The climax is the ones you'll find high-up in the sky, surrounded by snowy mountains! Also, you'll go inside the castle, through dark, torch-lit passages opening into larger rooms. This experience is designed to draw you in, help you get contemplative, and to see what you see in yourself, reflected by the in-game visuals. You may be moved to make a change or try something new in your life. You are encouraged to give these things some thought, and perhaps journal. Features: - Real-time 3D environment; castle ruins, nature, mountains - Contemplative music selection (toggle enable/disable) plays 30 songs in random order (different every time) - Mouse and keyboard controls, including X and Y axis inversion - Zoom with mouse wheel without quality degradation - 85+ High resolution images with captions on many principles of life, to get you reflective - Free fly camera without collision detection, which allows you to explore at will - Automatically saves your preferences and last position, and picks up next time where you left off There are no puzzles, no enemies to kill, just you and this place. Hope you enjoy!

rows.name: World of Squares
rows.short_description: A feel-good MMO with rich mechanics. Paint with your friends, play a cube violin in the woods, discover an ancient ruins, fight valiant knights and dangerous mobs, become a fox sacrificing yourself to a dangerous altar at midnight, chill with a fishing rhythm game, upgrade your gear and character.
rows.description_html: This is the alpha release for World of Squares, a cute social MMO to relax and immerse in. You can pet foxes (and fox-morphed players) with your mouse cursor! Fishing, particle physics, painting, parkour, playing music, cooking, fighting — a plethora of game systems combine together to form limitless possibilities. Add your friends and chat with them online or offline. Emotes let you express yourself to your friends. Hang out together or enjoy each others' presence in an adorable world. Start by choosing your favorite color for your character! On ensuring your enjoyment: - This game exists for your enjoyment and health — a monthly price of a $5 coffee unlocks all content, keeps the servers running, the developer alive, and ensures that the relationship between the game and its players is strictly symbiotic! Game progress, cosmetics, and stash-slots are strictly an in-game fun experience; they cannot be purchased with real world money. - This is a social game. You can still log in, move around the world, and message your friends even if you can't afford membership. Exactly the extent of free-to-play content is to be determined, but that much is the philosophy. - To me, it feels strange to commit time to an MMO if I know my progress is on someone else's server. I promise I will release a playable local version in a timely manner that has all of your progress if the game must go down and stay down (I won't be alive forever, or perhaps the player-base supporting the servers moves on)

rows.name: Entwined Time
rows.short_description: A two time manipulation puzzle game. Two robots, Heavy and Light, have their own timelines that can independently record and rewind actions. Solve hundreds of puzzles across 12+ chapters, learning increasingly time-bending mechanics in the process.
rows.description_html: A two time manipulation puzzle game. Two robots, Heavy and Light, have their own timelines that can independently record and rewind actions. Solve hundreds of puzzles across 12+ chapters, learning increasingly time-bending mechanics in the process. Background Heavy and Light are maintenance robots working onboard the Chrono Station, a fantastical installation in low orbit that takes time from places where it's not needed and transfers it to where it is. Tragically, the station has suffered from chronic understaffing - so when one day the Chrono Helix catastrophically fails, they're the only robots available to deal with the crisis. Flung to the edge of the Chrono Station, they find that the Chrono Station has been blown into hundreds of puzzles, containing increasingly exotic matter the closer you get to the Reactor Lab - and that their timelines have been isolated from one another. They can now move and rewind independently, and learning every consequence and nuance of this will be necessary to make it back in time and fix things before they get worse. Features A turn based, tile based thinky puzzle game. No dexterity elements or hidden information - Build a mental model of how the game works to succeed. Hundreds of puzzles across 12+ chapters, each one introducing new elements, from being able to break and come back to life to exotic matter that alters the very concept of rewinding itself. Copy, paste and scrub through replays, so you'll never go 'wait, I forgot how I did that' again. Gain Insight mode. Stuck? Check out a puzzle that's an easier or remixed version - you still have to solve it yourself, and you might gain the necessary insight in the process. Advanced and post-game puzzles, for those ready to master space-time itself. A level editor and Community Puzzles tab. Hundreds of custom puzzles made by fans, and if you come up with something I haven't seen before, it can be included in the game!

Copy, paste and scrub through replays, so you'll never go 'wait, I forgot how I did that' again. Gain Insight mode. Stuck? Check out a puzzle that's an easier or remixed version - you still have to solve it yourself, and you might gain the necessary insight in the process. Advanced and post-game puzzles, for those ready to master space-time itself. A level editor and Community Puzzles tab. Hundreds of custom puzzles made by fans, and if you come up with something I haven't seen before, it can be included in the game!

rows.name: Idle Dino
rows.short_description: Click to grow dinosaurs and earn gold to unlock upgrades that enable you to purchase new dinosaurs and fill out the viewing scene. Explore the viewing scene to play minigames and unlock powers.
rows.description_html: Idle Dino is an idle game set in prehistoric times. Collect and grow over 60 species of Dinosaurs and watch as the world refills with life. Use the gold you earn to buy upgrades to make help speed up your journey of repopulating the Earth with Dinosaurs!

rows.name: Farming & Supermarket Simulator: Prologue
rows.short_description: Embark on a relaxing yet challenging journey to manage your own supermarket. Grow organic crops, care for your animals, and sell products to your customers. Build and expand your shelves. Can you transform your supermarket into an empire?
rows.description_html: SEE ALSO About the Game 'This Prologue lets you produce and trade with the limited version of Farming & Supermarket Simulator. Grow, Harvest, Use Make the best use of your harvested products: either fill the supermarket shelves or use them as feed for your animals. The choice is yours! Feed and Collect Feed your animals and reap the rewards! Feed your chicken a tomato, collect fresh eggs, and enjoy the fruits of your labor. Invest in Machines Expand your production by purchasing machines! Process your harvested goods to produce valuable items for your supermarket. Cashier Quickly scan items, accept payments in cash or credit, and ensure your customers leave happy with their shopping experience! Build a loyal customer base by increasing customer satisfaction. Grow your supermarket by making strategic plans and attract more customers by offering the best service.

rows.name: Sphere vs Gravity
rows.short_description: Reach the gravity pole and make it fall.

Be prepared—this game is hard and requires time to adapt. Key Features Gravity-Defying Gameplay: Master the art of controlling a sphere as you traverse intricate levels filled with gravitational anomalies. Every surface can be your path if you can defy gravity's pull. Progressive Difficulty: As you advance, the levels become more challenging, introducing new mechanics and obstacles that keep the gameplay fresh and exciting. Content You Can Expect: Multiple Levels: Over 25 levels that increase in complexity. Leaderboards: Compete with players worldwide to achieve the best times.

rows.name: The Crimson Call
rows.short_description: Set in a post-apocalyptic dystopian future, two young men set out on a journey to find The Great Appearance which manifests itself inside mankind's mind.
rows.description_html: In a world ravaged by decay and despair, where civilization crumbles and hope fades, lies the enigma known only as The Great Apperance. Set in a post-apocalyptic dystopian future, two young men set out on a journey to find The Great Appearance which manifests itself inside mankind's mind. Story: In the aftermath of an apocalypse that left the world decaying, survivors live in small societies. The Great Appearance, an unknown presence, communicates with some of the survivors through their dreams or in some other way. The Crimson Call follows the journey of Behich and his friend Yerchi, two young pilgrims determined to uncover the truth behind this enigmatic force. As they traverse a landscape of decay and desperation, they will encounter other survivors and learn their stories. Features: A Rich Story Atmospheric Visuals Ambient Music A Few Puzzle Elements One Ending (However, depending on your choices you might get slightly less or more content.)

rows.name: Just Squat
rows.short_description: Just Squat is a shmup and visual Nobel game that focuses on boss fight by growing up a boy. Grow the boy by encountering various events at the gym and school, and push Babel out with all your might! The difficulty of boss fight and the boy's growth will be determined by the exercise you choose!
rows.description_html: Let’s defeat the Barbell Boss, which is getting stronger! Get Ready to Squat The boy's fear of squats turned out to be a monster! Face new fears as you grow the boy step by step! Just Squat has 12 distinctive barbells! If the boy sweats hard, no matter how slow it is, the barbell moves toward the end! Experience all kinds of funny and absurd stories that happen at the gym and at school! The gym is always full of the sound of iron and the smell of humid sweat, and the school is always loud with the noise of friends. The boy will react and grow with the people around him according to your choice! In Just Squat, you can meet a total of 30 NPCs in 20 omnibus stories! You can experience all sorts of funny and absurd episodes at the gym and watch how the boy overcomes bullying at school! Game Features! 'Just Squat' is a shmup game that combines an omnibus-style visual novel and bullet hell action. Face the barbell armed with various bullets and attack patterns, and succeed in the squat! You have to lift the barbell all the way up! Enjoy your own story! In 'Just Squat', the story branches out depending on your choices! As the boy grows, new talents will be revealed! Lift the barbell with stronger and more unique abilities! Add your own favorite exercises! The boss's attack pattern will change depending on the exercises you add! Grow a boy by meeting all sorts of weirdos at a sweaty gym! Overcome the absurdity and bullying of bad friends with the boy at school!

rows.name: GEO-DEUX
rows.short_description: Do not forget your cosmic origins! Travel the universe to find Jesus and save Christmas once and for all.
rows.description_html: “Wake up, wake up! Can you hear me Geo-Duck? The moment of truth has arrived.” You are but a lowly lizard summoned to greatness by celestial voices. Jesus has gone missing and only you can bring him back alive. Lead a band of angels on a quest to find Jesus and save Christmas from hyper-secularization. Dress those angels up in the latest fashions, including but not limited to khakis, polo shirts, dreadlocks, hotpants, mohawks, and many more. Collect many instruments along the way, each with a unique play style, and use them to dissemble inanimate objects through the power of sound. Never forget your cosmic origins! Walk the line between fantasy and reality in a world that really is out to get you. GEO-DEUX is the long-awaited sequel to Geo-Duck, a 2d musical platformer from the pioneering glitch-hop duo Your Infamous Harp. Based to some extent on a true story, and featuring a lovable cast of characters that were personally trained, housed and fed by the developers. “Are you feeling lonely? Are you tired or depressed? Come visit the CLINIC to get rid of your stress!” Pay a visit to the CLINIC to dissolve your ego and resolve your existential angst - forever. Traverse a 6x6 grid of levels encompassing the entire visible universe and beyond. Described as “fun” by one tester, you just won’t not want to play!

rows.name: Invention 6
rows.short_description: Invention 6 is a 3D shooter with Scrollshooter elements, as well as a small share of logical puzzles that must be solved to complete the level. Learn the story of Casey and Dorian, shoot robots and zombies, and fight powerful bosses to the fiery Heavy Metal.
rows.description_html: Invention 6 is a 3D first-person shooter with Scrollshooter elements. The events unfold immediately after the end of the previous part of the game. Dorian shot down Casey's plane and took his revenge. It would seem that the main villain is defeated. However, this time the player will have to play as Casey Jefferson herself! The girl survived the plane crash and faced trouble: someone named Frederick captured her company and sent robots to kill her. Having tried to call for help, she managed to contact only her enemy - Dorian, who himself would not mind sending the girl to the depths of hell. So what? Will the former enemies be able to unite and fight the new evil - Frederick? Invention 6 is a 3D shooter with Scrollshooter elements, as well as a small share of logical puzzles that must be solved to complete the level. Learn the story of Casey and Dorian, shoot robots and zombies, and fight powerful bosses to the fiery Heavy Metal.

rows.name: Coming From Above!
rows.short_description: In an arcade game somewhere. Aim for a high score while stacking blocks falling from the sky and avoid falling off the stage!
rows.description_html: They're 'Coming From Above!' is a first-person perspective puzzle game. You are playing the arcade game “Coming From Above!' in the arcade game. You control the player and the falling blocks to achieve a high score. 【Play time】 Arcade Mode (Story Mode) 20 ~ 60 minutes ※Excluding EX stage. 【BGM】 You can change the BGM played during the game. Hidden BGM will be released by achieving achievements. 【Rules】 Seven types of blocks fall from the top of the stage. Place the blocks on the stage by manipulating them. The first row of blocks in a row is erased. If two or more rows are erased at once, an item will appear. Keep playing and aim for a high score. Game Over Conditions ・The player falls from the stage. ・The player falls off the stage or touches another block when it appears. List of items ・Super Shock Drop all the floating blocks down until they hit the ground! Also, the dropped blocks don't disappear all at once, but are processed at the same time as the next block falls. Therefore, it is possible to erase four or more rows at once! ・Color Chaser Eliminate the same type of blocks as the falling block. Earn 20 points x the number of blocks eliminated. ・Pay Day Earn 10 points x the number of blocks remaining in the current stage! ・Level Down Decrease the level! Blocks will fall slower. (Current level - 3) * 0.8 Round down to the nearest whole number. ・Hyper Bomb Blasts the 8 surrounding squares that the block touches. Earn 20 points for each block erased. ・Easy Beat Increases the grace period for consecutive block clearing bonus judgment by 2. This effect lasts until the consecutive block clearing bonus ends. ・Jump UP Warps the player to the top. ・Right To Right Move all the blocks to the right. ・Left To Left Move all the blocks to the left. 【Operating Instructions】 ※There is no key configuration function. ※Mouse and keyboard operation only. WASD: Move the Player Space: Jump Q: Rotate Block Left E: Rotate Block Right C: Block Move Left V: Block Move Right Mouse: Move viewpoint Left click: Ground the block instantly Right click: Hold block T: Skip to Next Track 1 or 2: Switch Camera

rows.name: Ocero 3D
rows.short_description: A free, Sega Saturn-inspired 3D fighting game. Soar through the sky and master your powerful techniques!
rows.description_html: A free, Sega Saturn-inspired 3D fighting game. Soar through the sky and master your powerful techniques! Take on Kuro in intense battles with fast-paced, but easy-to-learn fighting controls! Master punches and unleash your ultimate attack to win every battle! Originally started as a junior-year college project focused on developing a game engine from scratch, this game is now maintained as a hobby. Stay tuned for updates, likely coming in mid-2025!

rows.name: Call The Abyss
rows.short_description: 2D Survival Arcade Game packed with Action and Dark Magic. You cannot survive the relentless Forces of Good alone. Better call allies from the Abyss!! Gather Resources and Summon them from your Cauldron. Conquer the worldwide Leaderboard. Completely FREE TO PLAY!! For now...
rows.description_html: You cannot survive the relentless forces of good alone. Better call allies from the Abyss! Gather the necessary ingredients and summon them from your cauldron. Description Call the Abyss is a thrilling 2D survival arcade game packed with action and magic. This unique experience challenges you to push your limits while defending a dark and mysterious world. And the best part? It's completely FREE ! Game Features Survival Mode: Face endless waves of enemies in frantic and strategic combat. Summoning Theme: Developed in three days for Ludum Dare Jam. The theme was Summoning , so the player starts off weak, but don't worry, your summoned allies are the key to victory! Allies: Gather resources and use your magical cauldron to summon powerful allies. Totems: Use totems to boost your team stats while they remain alive. Aim with Your Mouse: Direct all your allies' attacks by aiming with your mouse. Global Leaderboards: Climb to the top of the leaderboard and leave your mark on history. Hand Drawn Style: Enjoy the dark fantasy style with meticulously crafted graphics. 100% Free: Yes, we know, some just do it for the fun. Combat Styles Choose your preferred survival style and adjust your strategy to dominate the battlefield. -------------------------------------------- Melee -------------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------- Ranged ------------------------------------------- --------------------------------------------- Elite --------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------- Totem -------------------------------------------- Download now and dive into the abyss... if you dare!

rows.name: Poker Train
rows.short_description: Poker Train is a VIDEO POKER game where you play scoring hands to keep the wheels turning. Use your best combinations to build steam and run the train as far as you can. Complete quests and find all the secrets the railroad has to offer!
rows.description_html: Poker Train is a western themed casual game that combines VIDEO POKER with incremental stat-building and idle gaming elements. Play scoring hands ( JACKS OR BETTER  and DEUCES WILD ) to keep your steam locomotive moving. Stat Building: Level up and earn special items that provide unique bonuses like Wild Cards and Bonus Draws. Idle Mode: Unlock 35 strategies to set up your train's autopilot. Sit back and relax as your chosen strategy selects the best hands to play for you. Master the art of playing the perfect poker hand! Progressive Progression: Use loot to purchase upgrades to aid you on your journey, and earn poker achievements and stats to track your progress. Prestige System: Allows you to reset your upgrades while keeping your stats and achievements intact, granting you additional consumables for an added edge.

rows.name: Jenny's Adventures
rows.short_description: Play as a cat in this 2D world where you discover new abilities and paths to finally reach the summit. What's there? Even I don't know. Yet. Oh, it now has local co-op.
rows.description_html: Jenny's Adventure is a 2D platformer where you guide Jenny, a cat, through an interconnected world of biomes. Use abilities like wall jumps and sprints while managing stamina to explore and collect flowers. Focused on platforming and discovery, it offers a relaxing, combat-free experience. Features Exploration: With a heavy emphasis on exploration and discovery, Jenny's Adventures is a metroidvania filled with unlockable abilities and secrets. Find your way to the summit using your curiosity as the guide. It features an interconnected world with different biomes. Uncover a world with areas like forests and beaches. Use your skills to tackle several platforming puzzles to find the path to an area. Jumping: Jenny's Adventures uses a slightly different approach to jumping which is commonly seen in traditional platformers. Player needs to hold the jump button and then release it. If the player releases in a specific window, it results in a 'perfect jump' which increases the jump height. Game also features a stamina system. Some abilities like sprinting consumes stamina which can be refilled by collecting flowers or perfect jumps.

rows.name: Hope of Taru
rows.short_description: Find the hints to your past and bring back life to your village in this small indie 2D platformer. Enjoy stunning artwork and an original soundtrack while unravelling the story of the mysterious village Taru in six increasingly challenging levels.
rows.description_html: You wake up to find your world has changed. Can you remember what happened and find a cure to the curse upon the silent village of Taru? Find the hints to your past and bring back life to your village in this small indie 2D platformer. Enjoy stunning artwork and an original soundtrack while unravelling the story of the petrified villagers of Taru in six increasingly challenging levels. You’re not alone in this. Collect all stone fragments lost in the village and deliver them to priest Yuri high up in the temple to fix what is broken. Can you defeat all dangers and reach him in time for the final ritual? ============================== This game was created as our second family summer holiday project (🏝️😎💻🏖️).

Use the clues hidden everywhere to solve the puzzle and take a step closer to the truth.

rows.name: Gulping snake
rows.short_description: Gulping Snake is a simple, but not easy, 2D puzzle game.
rows.description_html: Gulping Snake is a 2D puzzle game inspired by classic snake games. Become a snake and eat all the apples on the screen! Features A total 40 levels Various gimmicks such as ice, button, anti-apple, turn item, duplicate item, etc. Supports the undo feature 1~4 hours play time

rows.name: Mint's Hints
rows.short_description: Mint’s Hints is a cancelled children’s show, and you’ve found yourself on the old set. Find paw-shaped Hints with special ghost-detecting Flashbrights, and discover the secret behind the show’s closure with your Happy-Go-Lucky Notebook, but be careful, the stars of the show are after you.
rows.description_html: WELCOME TO THE SET... As the previous showrunner of beloved children’s TV series Mint’s Hints, you never expected to find yourself on set again - especially after the show had been abruptly cancelled. However, you find yourself corrected after being mysteriously abducted. COLLECT HINTS It’s showtime like you’ve never experienced before. Find paw-shaped Hints with special ghost-detecting Flashbrights, and discover the secret behind the show’s closure with your Happy-Go-Lucky Notebook. Journey through the abandoned studio and its dark corridors, but be careful, the stars of the show are after you. EXPLORE, AND RUN...! Get a glimpse behind the scenes and uncover the secrets hidden beneath the Mint’s Hints original set in this thrilling puzzle adventure horror game. KEY FEATURES: Average playtime: 30 minutes Stunning visuals Made in Unreal Engine Unique yet intuitive gameplay Original characters and lore

rows.name: Climb Quest
rows.short_description: Climb Quest is a challenging vertical platformer where you navigate through a fragmented world of floating islands and overcoming devious traps. Your goal is to ascend to the top, close the source of destruction solo or with your 3 friends.
rows.description_html: Awakened by Death itself, you must ascend through a world shattered into floating islands and fragmented landscapes in Climb Quest . Though you weren't the first choice, you are now the realm's last hope. Your mission is to destroy the Crystal of Chaos—the destructive source tearing the realm apart—and restore peace to the fractured world. Key Features Climb Anything: Navigate a world where every surface is a potential path to victory. Cooperative Play: Team up with friends to conquer challenges and unlock new paths. Precision Platforming: Master challenging jumps and maneuvers as you ascend. Traps: Avoid traps designed to push you back and test your skills. Abilities: As you climb higher you unlock a new ability In this vertical adventure, every step counts. Navigate treacherous environments and master challenging platforming mechanics to uncover the hidden secrets of this shattered realm. Face powerful gusts of wind, collapsing platforms, and a variety of devious traps designed to push you back down. Utilize strategic teleportation runes and collect mystical artifacts that unlock hidden paths, enhancing your journey to stop the chaos. Whether you climb alone or with friends, the fate of countless souls rests on your shoulders. Join the quest, ascend to greatness, and put an end to the destruction before it's too late! Begin your quest, defy the odds and vanquish the chaos!

rows.name: 44 Hidden Naomis
rows.short_description: Embark on an enchanting journey to discover hidden Naomis scattered throughout meticulously crafted scenes. Can you find them all? This cozy hidden objects game challenges your attention to detail and perceptiveness. Capture the simple fun!
rows.description_html: Check out our game of origin! If you love adorable Naomi, don't forget to check out our game of origin 'Uberich: Advent Sinners' . They share the same origin and use the same characters. About the Game The Great Naomi Hunt! In the world of simple lines, Naomi is playing hide-and-seek for mysterious reasons. Your keen eye and sharp observation skills will be put to the test as you search for a large amount of unique Naomis, each with their own quirky charm waiting to be uncovered. Game Features: > Multiple beautifully designed levels! > 44 Naomis per level! > Catchy tunes! > Handy hint button! > Intuitive controls! > 71 achievements in the first 2 levels! > Leaderboards! > Inherit DEMO progress! > Inherit DEMO achievements! > Super adorable Naomis! > Wacky Naomi varieties! > Completely hidden Naomis too! Can you find them all? Capture the simple fun!

rows.name: Super Multitasking GO!
rows.short_description: Yes, YOU can play up to 4 continuously-shuffling minigames at the same time, using just a split screen and a single controller or keyboard! Super Multitasking GO! offers the tools...but YOU unlock your hidden potential!
rows.description_html: How many games can you play at once? Unlock your hidden potential with Super Multitasking GO! It's a special FREE version of Super Duper Multitasking! Using an intuitive control scheme and your amazing gaming skills, you'll soon be playing up to 4 minigames at a time! Discover how far you can go, wow your streaming audience, and compete with players around the world! The screen is split into 4 portions, each controlled by a different part of your gamepad: left stick, right stick, face buttons, and top buttons. You can use your keyboard as well! You'll use these 'mini-screens' to play minigames as they appear and disappear, shuffling in and out. You'll start with just one at a time, but before you know it, you'll be unlocking your hidden talents and playing multiple minigames at once! The Tutorial allows you to learn the basics in just 2 minutes! Then, try the Quickplay mode! It starts off easy and gets tougher as you go. Last as long as possible without making any mistakes! How far can you go? Aim for the top of the Leaderboards! Next, you can take the challenge of Mission Mode's 15 unique scenarios. How many can you clear? If you get stuck, you can adjust the difficulty to make it easier. This infinitely-replayable workout for your brain is full of options and surprises! It's great at parties, for warming up before long gaming sessions, or for pushing yourself to your limits! Your streaming audience will cheer you on and celebrate when you clear tough Missions or set new personal bests! Experience it with your friends for a night of screams, shouts, and cheers! It's wild, unpredictable, and a ton of fun...it's Super Multitasking GO! This unique experience is absolutely FREE! And, if you love it, and want a whole lot more, check out Super Duper Multitasking! Note: Super Multitasking GO! contains a unique subset of Super Duper Multitasking's minigames.  Apart from that, all of the content in this version is contained within Super Duper Multitasking.

rows.name: Ace Squared
rows.short_description: Ace Squared is a multiplayer arena first-person shooter. You can build huge structures and dig tunnels behind enemy lines. Imagination is the only limit. Featuring 32-player servers, different classes and gamemodes.
rows.description_html: Ace Squared is a multiplayer arena first-person shooter. You can build huge structures and dig tunnels behind enemy lines. Imagination is the only limit. Featuring 32-player servers and different gamemodes. Key Features MODIFIABLE WORLD - The world is fully modifiable! Build and destroy structures, and build them back again! Dig tunnels behind enemy lines and collapse their bunkers. GAMEMODES - Includes different gamemodes. Fight other team against kills or steal the enemy flag! COMMUNITY SERVERS - Host community servers with your own configuration as you see fit. MODDING SUPPORT - Create your own mods and configure your server! Play Free Experience the classic mode for FREE! Shoot with mortars, set enemies to fire with flamethrower, capture flags by playing as a team. Unlock full game with DLC Join the game in any of the many modes using DLC classes such as «Zombie», «Team Death Match» and «Capture The Flag». We’ve got a hero for every playstyle and skill level: Commando . A towering powerhouse armed with a minigun and a rocket launcher. Perfect for players who enjoy crushing enemies with raw force. Engineer . True to the classics, deploys turrets and soars with a jetpack. Support your team or push forward aggressively. Sniper . Land precise headshots and control key areas of the map from long range. Miner . Carve tunnels, level structures, and tear through opponents with close-range firepower.

rows.name: Idle Lust - Succubus in Training
rows.short_description: Idle Lust is a unique hybrid of clicker, incremental, idle and harem card battle genres all in one! Unlock dungeons, sinful sexy training stations to extract Lust and upgrade, and summon seductive succubus, each with their own back-story and sizzling hot NSFW adults-only lewd art scenes.
rows.description_html: Sad News! As some of you have already read, we have announced the closure of Idle Lust for early October. We are taking this decision with a sad heart. Yes, the development of the game was bumpy and even if we were hopeful to catch up and iterate often, something prevented its success. Contrary to what some might believe, we have listened to our players throughout the game's lifecycle and we've taken the decision to step back to better move forward. That said, we've taken the decision to 'pivot', and bring back your favorite Succubus in a totally fresh gameplay. We cannot confirm a time frame just yet, but we are hopeful that we can resurge in late December 2025 or early in the new year. In the meantime, we ask that all players spend their stones before the closing date, and stay tuned for more development news. The sad news is for both the Nutaku and Steam versions. Thank you to all the players who have played the game! Evil Twin

rows.name: Dino Clicker
rows.short_description: Tap repeatedly to crack open an ancient egg and collect 9 different dinosaurs, from common to rare and elusive creatures. Try out this addictive clicker game that challenges you to unlock them all through luck and perseverance!
rows.description_html: Embark on a thrilling adventure through time with Dino Clicker, a fun and addictive clicker game where you'll crack open an ancient egg to uncover a vast array of fascinating dinosaurs! With each egg you'll unlock a species, ranging from common favorites to rare and elusive creatures. Will you be able to collect them all? In Dino Clicker, your goal is simple: tap the egg repeatedly to hatch new dinosaurs. The more you click, the higher your chances of unlocking a new species. But beware - some dinosaurs are much rarer than others, requiring luck and perseverance to discover. As you progress, you'll build a collection of prehistoric creatures, each with its unique characteristics. Multiple Dinosaurs: Unlock 9 different dinosaurs, ranging from common to rare species Addictive Gameplay: Simple yet engaging clicker mechanics will keep you coming back for more Randomized Egg Hatching: Each click brings an element of surprise and excitement Casual Fun: Perfect for players looking for a lighthearted, relaxing experience Play Dino Clicker today and start your journey through time to collect all the amazing dinosaurs. Will you be able to crack open the rarest eggs and become the ultimate dinosaur collector? There's only one way to find out!

rows.name: Hide and Seek with Noah
rows.short_description: Where children's games take a captivating turn. A point and click adventure game where you play hide and seek with your friend Noah!
rows.description_html: Join Noah and his friends in a playful point and click adventure game of Hide and Seek! The children's game where somethings are never found again. What starts as a joyful game with Noah, quickly spirals into a suspenseful mystery when Noah vanishes without a trace. As officers and family search for him, they soon discover that Noah's disappearance is just the beginning. A series of bizarre and unsettling events unfold as more people go missing. As you delve deeper into the mystery, you'll uncover hidden secrets and eerie clues that reveal a darker side to this seemingly innocent children's game. What is this game? Can you win the game before it’s too late? You wont be able to hide forever... Suspenseful Gameplay: Engage in a game of hide and seek that evolves into a gripping mystery. Eerie Mystery: Experience a captivating storyline filled with suspense and unexpected twists. Family-Friendly Start: Begin with the light-hearted fun of finding Noah and his friends. Challenging Puzzles: Solve intricate puzzles and uncover hidden clues to unravel the dark secrets of this twisted game. Atmospheric Environments: Explore beautifully crafted yet increasingly ominous settings that draw you deeper into the mystery. Play the game where children's games are not as they seem and every step, every clue brings you closer to hiding from it or seeking out Noah and the others...

rows.name: Monkey Tag Arena
rows.short_description: Hide and run from the hunters, or catch them if you are a hunter. The game has many arenas and 3 modes: - Monkey run mode.- Tag mode.- Open world.
rows.description_html: Monkey Tag Arena - is a fun and adventurous online multiplayer game. The game is very simple and at the same time very interesting. There are 3 game modes: Tag Mode: There are 2 roles, you can play as a hunter or as a runner. If you are a hunter you have to catch all the other runners. If you are a runner, you have to survive without being caught, if you are caught, you become a hunter. The game has 8 great arenas: Aquapark, Spaceship, Magic Forest, Mayhem Castle, Antique Ruins, Pirate Bay, Temple Wilds and Crystal Mine. Each arena has fun challenges and secret hideaways. Monkey Run Mode : The first monkey to reach the finish line is the winner. Open World Mode: This mode allows you to explore all maps and interact with other players. When you create a room, you can share the room name with your friends so they can connect with you and play together. Or you can create a party and join a game with your entire party. You can customise your monkey's skin, texture and outfit. There are lots of clothes and textures to choose from, so don't hesitate to create your own original monkey. Download the game now and start your adventure today!

rows.name: Ink Inside - First Page
rows.short_description: INK INSIDE is a beat-em-up meets dodgeball action RPG featuring the voices of Brian David Gilbert (YouTube, Dropout) and Deneen Melody! (Evangelion, Romantic Killer). Experience the exciting and hilarious prologue with a friend when you play this NEW kind of Saturday morning cartoon together!
rows.description_html: Ink Inside: First Page is the fun prologue to the hand drawn action RPG with the heart of a Saturday Morning Cartoon! Created by some of the minds behind Steven Universe: Unleash the Light , Ink Inside lets you play as Stick, an unfinished doodle trapped in a box of notebooks beneath a slowly leaking ceiling. As the water seeps into the notebooks, it warps the drawings inside and turns once friendly doodles into mindless, soggy monsters. You can fight back against the invading “Sog” by hitting them in the face with dodgeball “CORES!” Hold and aim your attack before letting go at just the right time to trigger unique weapon “perks” - then get in close and knock the wet out of them with a melee combo. Use more unique cores and combo attacks in action-packed dodgeball-meets-beat-em-up style combat that will see you dodging patterns of projectiles, using specials, and mastering a unique form of action RPG combat! Get even more buff by collecting new gear, unlocking stronger abilities, and filling your COOL MOVES bar to BREAK THE RULES and deal extra damage by smashing through the invisible wall protecting your enemies. Explore sprawling, gorgeously illustrated worlds, from the Fuzzball Forest to the Cloud Factory to meet and recruit a colorful team of characters to help you on your journey. From the dependable Detective Fuzz to Traff, the Princess of Cursing, who hits like a truck and talks like a truck driver, there’s plenty of characters to meet and loot to discover! Work together with a friend in local CO-OP to save your allies and battle back the waves of wetness corrupting the world! Experience the first few hours of INK INSIDE in this standalone instalment for FREE! And once your journey is going, you can easily transfer your save to the full game to finish your quest! Bear in mind that you'll need a controller in order to play in local multiplayer!

rows.name: Descenso
rows.short_description: A very short adventure in which you will explore a futuristic world and a handsome deck.
rows.description_html: Descenso is a charming platformer that, while basic and short, delivers an entertaining and rewarding experience. In this adventure, you'll take on the role of a robot, accompanied by your trusty drone assistant, as you explore a mysterious world filled with secrets waiting to be uncovered. Throughout your journey, you'll encounter unique characters and challenges that will test your skills. Though the game is brief in length, every moment is crafted to provide a complete and satisfying experience. Descenso blends classic platforming elements with a simple yet effective narrative that will keep you intrigued until the very end. As this is my first video game, I've poured a lot of effort and passion into its development, and I hope you'll enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed creating it. Descenso is perfect for those seeking a quick but captivating adventure, where every corner hides a new surprise. Embark on this short yet thrilling journey and uncover the secrets that lie within this enigmatic world!

rows.name: Restaurant Owner: Prologue
rows.short_description: Step into the world of a Restaurateur in Restaurant Owner: Prologue, where you create unique recipes, manage your restaurant, and satisfy customers. Unlock ingredients, design your menu, and start your journey toward becoming a top Restaurant Manager. Your culinary adventure begins here!
rows.description_html: Step into the shoes of a Restaurateur in Restaurant Owner —a Prologue version of the full game, offering a taste of the immersive simulation experience. In this introductory chapter, you'll learn the basics of managing your own restaurant by creating unique burger recipes, unlocking new ingredients, and ensuring customer satisfaction. Key Features: Serve customers, increase your Restaurant Level, and unlock new ingredients to create unique recipes. Create your own recipes, add them to your menu, and set prices. Be creative and use all the ingredients to fulfill your customers' needs and ensure they leave your restaurant happy. Manage the day-to-day operations of your restaurant. Take orders, serve a diverse menu, and ensure that your customers leave satisfied. Are you ready to turn your restaurant dreams into reality? Restaurant Owner: Prologue offers a rich and rewarding gameplay experience for simulation enthusiasts and aspiring restaurateurs, with more to come in the full version. * Note: This is a Prologue version of Restaurant Owner and is still in active development. As such, all images, information, and features described on this store page are subject to change as the game continues to evolve.

rows.name: CREAMARE - The Game
rows.short_description: In CREAMARE: The Game, players take on the role of divers to explore 9 real underwater cultural sites in the Mediterranean Sea. They must defeat a monster from the future by solving ecological challenges and puzzles related to the history of these sites.
rows.description_html: As part of the CREAMARE project, we're thrilled to unveil 'Creamare: The Game,' a one-of-a-kind serious game that brings Mediterranean underwater archaeological sites to life in stunning 3D. Our seas are the planet's most precious “museums,” preserving a wealth of cultural treasures like shipwrecks and submerged sites. Yet, they face grave threats from human negligence and growing maritime pollution. In CREAMARE: The Game, players take on the role of divers to explore 9 real underwater cultural sites in the Mediterranean Sea. They must defeat a monster from the future by solving ecological challenges and puzzles related to the history of these sites. This first-person adventure game focuses on immersive exploration and engaging puzzle-solving within an interactive narrative. Get ready for an unforgettable journey, coming soon to PCs! Join us in this adventure to raise awareness about the importance of preserving our underwater cultural heritage and ocean health, all while enjoying a thrilling and educational experience. Let's inspire a passion for protecting these invaluable treasures!

rows.name: RealmScape
rows.short_description: RealmScape: Escape room adventure blending ancient mysteries with futuristic puzzles. Solve cryptic clues, race against time, and uncover hidden secrets in this nostalgic point-and-click indie game.
rows.description_html: Prepare yourself for RealmScape , an immersive escape room adventure like no other. Dive into a world where every room is a puzzle, every clue a key, and every discovery leads you closer to unraveling the mysteries that span across time and space. Traverse from ancient Roman ruins to futuristic spaceships, each brimming with secrets waiting to be uncovered. A Puzzle Adventure Across Time and Space In RealmScape , you'll need to use your wits and keen observation skills to solve cryptic clues, uncover hidden pathways, and unlock the secrets of each unique environment. Collect the Hidden Cubes But that’s not all—each map holds five mysterious cubes, carefully hidden and waiting to be collected. Only by finding all five cubes can you fully unlock the secrets of each realm. Nostalgia with a Modern Twist This game offers more than just puzzles. RealmScape is a nostalgic nod to classic point-and-click games, wrapped in a fresh, modern package. Expect the unexpected as surprises and twists are lurking around every corner. The captivating soundtrack, innovative mechanics, and atmospheric environments combine to create a truly unique indie experience, meticulously crafted by a solo developer with a passion for storytelling and gameplay. Constantly Evolving Gameplay But the journey doesn’t end here. New challenges, phases, and surprises are continuously being added, ensuring that every playthrough offers something new and exciting. Are you ready for an unforgettable journey through time and space, where the past and future collide? Embark on Your Quest Download RealmScape now and embark on a quest to escape the ordinary, unlock hidden secrets, and collect the cubes that hold the key to the ultimate mystery!

rows.name: Blob
rows.short_description: Embark on a chemistry-packed adventure! Collect elements, combine them into compounds, and generate Atoms (clicks per second). Use Atoms to level up compounds, unlocking noble gases and new rows as you build the ultimate periodic table collection!
rows.description_html: Can you unlock the secrets of the periodic table and become the ultimate blob chemist? Collect elemental blobs, watch them drop elements from their periodic table rows, and combine them to create powerful compounds that generate Atoms—your clicks per second! With each element you collect and compound you create, you'll get closer to uncovering noble gases and completing your ultimate collection. Will you master the art of chemistry and dominate both the periodic table and the clicker world? Collecting & Periodic Table Discover the Elements: Explore the periodic table by collecting Blobs that represent real chemical elements. Blob Drops: Claim one Blob per hour for each row where you own at least one Blob . Collect elements from the periodic table and use them to expand your collection and power your discoveries! Complete Rows: Unlock all the elements in a row to reveal its noble gas and gain access to the next row of the periodic table. Combine and Experiment: Use the elements you’ve collected to craft compounds , just like a real chemist! Each compound you create not only unlocks new possibilities but also fuels your Atoms (clicks per second) —and that’s where the clicker fun begins! Educational Fun: Learn about the elements and their compounds while having a blob-tastic time. Collect, combine, and explore the world of chemistry like never before! Clicker Fun Atoms = Clicks : Compounds generate 'Atoms'—your clicks per second. The more compounds you create, the faster you earn clicks! Level Up Your Compounds : Use your clicks to upgrade your compounds, boosting your Atom output and accelerating progress. Idle Progression : Whether you’re actively clicking or letting your Blobs do the work, Blob keeps the chemistry flowing. Prepare to be blobbed in this element-filled adventure where science meets fun, and everything blobs with chemistry!

rows.name: Just War Trains
rows.short_description: Just War Trains is an online shooter where players control heavily armored trains, engaging in intense battles against an opponent. The objective is to outgun the opposing train with precise shooting. You can play with up to 24 people in WAR TRAINS!
rows.description_html: Just War Trains is an online shooter where players control heavily armored trains, engaging in intense battles against an opponent. The game is set on tracks winding through various landscapes, and players must strategically maneuver their trains while aiming to take down their opponent's train. There are four different trains with different types of abilities. The primary objective is to outmaneuver and outgun the opposing train, using a combination of skillful driving and precise shooting. The game is available for free, offering a thrilling experience where only the most skilled conductor will emerge victorious. The game is free to play, making it accessible to a wide audience. With its unique combination of train simulation and tactical shooting, War Trains offers a fresh take on the online shooter genre. Each match is a high-stakes duel where only the most skilled and strategic players will come out on top, turning every encounter into a thrilling battle for supremacy on the rails. Are you in a fight with a former opponent? Was somebody being toxic and calling you bad? 1v1 them in War Trains and settle the debate. War Trains takes skill, only the best come out on top every time.

rows.name: GHUNTER
rows.short_description: Become Ghunter, a cook gnome that will create dishes by cooking creatures... ALIVE!! Use your various cooking based weapons to cook your prey alive and brutally finish them off with your multi-purpose melee weapon! Save the Kingdom by submitting your delicious dishes!
rows.description_html: Become Ghunter , a gnome chef that will create dishes by cooking creatures... ALIVE!! Use your various cooking based weapons to cook your prey alive and brutally finish them off with your multi-purpose melee weapon! Ghunter has the responsability to save the King by providing dishes to his servants and other characters to heal him. FEATURES Unlike other games, GHUNTER fuses the process of hunting and cooking in one. Use your multiple culinary-inspired equipment to create different delicious dishes! The game provides with an interesting and intricate narrative driven by charismatic characters with a dynamic narrative system where your dialogue choices matter. Unveil the mysteries of Gernik by finding lore inside the adventure. By finding different items in the adventure and completing customer orders, you will have the ability to upgrade Ghunter's equipment. GHUNTER's tavern is equipped with a order board where he will be able to pick up dishes to the player's choosing. Once completed, you will submit it to gain satisfaction of said customer. Despite looking so colourful and pretty, the world of Gernik is more unsettling than it meets the eye. Both the narrative and the cooking have a dark side. Unveil the secrets of the world. Discover portals, landmarks, statues, chests and much more! Check all your progress and unlocks in the adventure book. Here you can see the world map, lore entries, creature descriptions, recipes and more. More about this game Game developped as a final project of the Art, Design and Programming masters of the U-tad university of Madrid, Spain. This project mixed all 3 of those departments with the help of other masters such as concept art, 3D modelers, animators and rigging.

rows.name: Terror On The Bayou
rows.short_description: Terror on the Bayou is a 3rd person, exploration horror game where you must navigate your canoe through a hostile bog, alone and afraid. Will you take up the mantle of lighthouse keeper to keep the bayou safe, or will you become prey along the way?
rows.description_html: Terror on the Bayou is a 3rd person (1st-person in VR), exploration horror game where the player must navigate their canoe through a tangled swamp full of hazards and traps, stalked by a mysterious apex predator. Alone and afraid, the players will question if they are merely prey, or if the thing after them enjoys the torture of its victims. Whether they wish to rise to the challenge or row away in fear, they have no choice. They must take up the mantle of lighthouse-keeper and ensure the warning beacon continues to sway those away from the terrors they face. Gameplay features: Players navigate using movement controls that mimic the paddling of a real canoe! As your character gets used to it, so do you! But be careful- the water is anything but still, and mistakes can be deadly. Manage your health and stamina wisely. Make your way through a painterly, immersive landscape filled with unsettling occurrences, dangerous terrain that can be hard to navigate or slow you down, and the threat of becoming lost. Peer behind you to scan for threats, and use your compass to navigate to the lighthouse. Lore bottles are scattered throughout the 3 levels, which a particularly daring player may collect in their journal to uncover the stories of those that have lived here. Headphones are recommended for a more immersive soundscape, but not required. VR mode is available in the settings menu! Accessibility features: Audiovisual accessibility features include multiple contextual audio sliders, closed captions. No cue is delivered through sound or color alone. Cognitive and motor accessibility features include custom key-binds for keyboard and controller, adjustable controller rumble, adjustable monster difficulty, and a toggleable UI bar that tracks the monster's aggression. The menu is always available and pauses gameplay. Content warnings: Mentions/depictions of violence and death, visible blood and gore, and mentions/depictions of suicide . Made by University of Utah's Entertainment Arts and Engineering students, Class of 2024

rows.name: Cats of the Song Dynasty
rows.short_description: Search for adorable cats in the fantastical world imagined by a painter from the Southern Song Dynasty over 800 years ago!
rows.description_html: **Search for adorable cats in the fantastical world imagined by a painter from the Southern Song Dynasty over 800 years ago!** The game is set against the backdrop of Zhao Boju's 'Xianshan Louge Tu' from the Southern Song Dynasty, featuring 100 meticulously illustrated cats that create interesting interactions with the ancient scenes and characters. Zhao Boju's 'Xianshan Louge Tu' from the Southern Song Dynasty is a remarkable masterpiece. It is a hanging scroll, painted on silk, measuring 159.9×84.2 cm, and is currently housed in the National Palace Museum in Taipei. This painting not only showcases Zhao Boju's superb artistic skill and unique style but also contains profound cultural and literary significance, revealing a fantastical, fairy-tale-like world. ----- Game Features ----- - Relax and enjoy ancient art while playing - Over a hundred uniquely styled 'cats' - Comfortable and relaxing ancient music - Adorable cat sound effects - 100 meticulously crafted achievement icons ----- Game Operation Tips ----- - Click on the cover logo to view the high-definition original 'Xianshan Louge Tu' - The ESC key can hide or show buttons in the game - Click the hint button to quickly locate a cat in the scene; can be used once every 60 seconds ------------------------**

rows.name: Mind Weaver
rows.short_description: Mind Weaver is a 2D puzzle platformer built around line-of-sight control. Crack the puzzles, outsmart the goblins, ace some parkour, and don't forget... PAPAYA!
rows.description_html: You wake up as a mage, trapped deep within a goblin-infested dungeon. Fortunately, your trusty butterfly companion manages to set you free. Now, it's up to your imagination and your ability to control minds to find your way out! Get ready for a classic 2D puzzle platformer adventure with a twist—Mind Weaver lets you shift control between different characters. But there’s a catch: you can only manipulate the minds of creatures you can see, so make your decisions wisely. Each level presents its own unique challenges, from puzzle-solving and tricky parkour to dodging aggressive goblins. Along the way, you’ll encounter the quirky merchant who’ll do just about anything for a juicy PAPAYA. This is a solo project, so while there's no game-saving feature just yet (sorry!), I’m eager to see if others find the game as fun and intriguing as I do. rows.about_html: You wake up as a mage, trapped deep within a goblin-infested dungeon. Fortunately, your trusty butterfly companion manages to set you free. Now, it's up to your imagination and your ability to control minds to find your way out! rows.name: Project Shoreline
rows.short_description: Step into the tiny metaphorical shoes of a Muri, entrusted with the important task of exploring, cleaning, and restoring a corrupted and decaying beach, one sparkling satisfying patch at a time, in this cute cozy mini-adventure - Project Shoreline!
rows.description_html: Explore a corrupted beach. Play as a Muri, a fish-mouse creature, and platform your way atop the pillar, run in the grass with pixies, venture to the beach, explore the cave, make your way high atop the mountain, and finally reach the cliff outlook by the beach in your explorations of Shoreline. Cleanse the world of corruption. Use your trusty watergun to bring back the beach's beauty. Utilize your watergun in different ways to get rid of corruption, by using the wide spray or the pressure aim. Aiming can be used to clean, push, or break things while the wide spray is excellent for efficiently cleaning your close surroundings. Make sure also to give the cute little pixie creatures a wash as well, it makes them very happy! Restore the colorful beach's beauty! As you clean the world you will see the color return to the once very grey beach in a highly satisfying way. When you have cleared the pillar, the shell, or the pond, its whole surrounding area is restored and a lily pad will emerge to help create your path to the cliff outlook. Now, get to work fellow Muri! Also, did we mention there are cute critters? *̥ ˚✧

rows.name: Narrow Woods Hotel
rows.short_description: A retro point-and-click horror adventure game that tests the boundries of the genre! In this 'found-footage' horror game you have to navigate the rooms and hallways of the mysterious Narrow Woods Hotel. Collect keys and items and use them to find your way out.
rows.description_html: A retro point-and-click horror adventure game that tests the boundries of the genre! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- The bad feelings started to seep in as soon as you passed the front desk. The hallways are unnaturally dark and you swear they grow more narrow with each step you take. The hotel creaks as if its corridors contorted ever so slowly, trying to crush you in its innards before you get the chance to notice. In this 'found-footage' horror game you have to navigate the rooms and hallways of the mysterious Narrow Woods Hotel. Collect keys and items and use them to find your way out. But be careful, as the dreaded feeling of being alone might actually be a comforting thought. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- How to play: General: -Use the mouse to interact with the environment and navigate through the hotel -'Left click' to interact/move (used for various things) -'TAB' to open inventory -Hold left mouse button to skip cutscenes In inventory: -Hover over items for description -'Left click' item to take out of inventory With item held: -'Left click' to use on objects -'Right click' to put held item back into inventor --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- The game takes about 40-60 minutes to beat on the first playthrough. WARNING: Contains stylized depictions of blood/violence --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Known issues / troubleshooting: If windows defender blocks the game from running, click 'more info' and select 'run anyway'. This happens because the game is from an 'unknown publisher'. If you're using Wave Link, and the game crashes after the splash screen (probably caused by the rerouting of the audio) go to your Windows sound settings, set your default output to 'Wave Link System' and then assign the game's output to 'Wave Link System' aswell. If you can't change the audio back to 'system audio', rename the narrowwoodshotel.exe to anything you like, then start the game again. For problems with other audio rerouting programs, a similar solution might apply.

rows.name: Cursed Loop
rows.short_description: Trapped in a nightmare, every death pulls you back into the same dark cycle. Test your spirit and courage as you escape the depths of a sinister mansion.
rows.description_html: After a night filled with nightmares, you find yourself in an unfamiliar mansion. All you know is that you must escape... But this place is no ordinary building; it’s a labyrinth filled with dark forces that are constantly trying to catch you. In every corner, in every room, dark memories from your past come to life, and every death pulls you back into the same nightmare. The only way out of these dark rooms is to unravel the mystery of the ghost that haunts you and avoid the deadly traps. But remember, every mistake will send you back to the beginning, and each attempt at escape will become even more difficult. Deep within the mansion, you must use all your courage and wits to uncover the truth and break the endless cycle. This game offers a dark psychological survival horror experience, where you will walk the fine line between reality and dream, plunging into the depths of fear with an atmosphere that keeps you on edge at every moment. Masterfully created with the latest technology, be ready to confront your fears in this immersive world. The Critical Importance of Traps In this mansion, every step you take can turn into a trap. Filled with hidden mechanisms, invisible wires, and unexpected dangers, this labyrinth is designed to send you back to the beginning with even the slightest mistake. Each trap is meticulously crafted to stop you and diminish your chances of escaping this horrific cycle. Therefore, you must think twice before taking each step and carefully inspect every corner; survival depends on your ability to outsmart these deadly traps. The Sense of Discovery As you progress through this dark mansion, each new room and corridor holds the thrill of uncovering the unknown. Every corner, every door could lead you to a vital clue or a dangerous trap. This journey of discovery is both intriguing and unsettling, allowing you to deeply feel the tension between fear and curiosity with each step. Gather your courage and keep exploring this place filled with dark secrets, as there are mysteries waiting to be unveiled. Dark Atmosphere and Tension This mansion is enveloped in a suffocating dark atmosphere. With almost no light, the feeling that something is lurking in the shadows constantly builds up. The sounds and moving shadows heighten the tension, making your heart race. In such an environment, predicting what awaits you becomes challenging, and every step is accompanied by an increasing sense of dread. To survive in this terrifying place, sharp senses and calmness are essential.

rows.name: Tale Smiths
rows.short_description: Tale Smiths invites players to explore the literature, folklore, and traditions of Northern Europe. Journey through authentic 3D worlds, meet lifelike characters, and engage with stories using camera-based motion controls.
rows.description_html: Discover the rich cultural heritage of Northern Europe in Tale Smiths , a narrative-driven adventure that blends immersive storytelling with literary tourism. Step into tales shaped by the traditions, poetry, music, and folklore of Finland, Sweden, Norway, Ireland, and the Faroe Islands. Every story is crafted in collaboration with local experts, ensuring an authentic connection to each region’s culture. Explore beautifully recreated 3D environments built with photogrammetry and drone imaging, meet lifelike characters brought to life with motion capture, and interact with the world through innovative camera-based motion controls. Whether wandering through legendary landscapes, listening to traditional songs, or uncovering hidden literary gems, Tale Smiths offers an engaging journey where culture and technology meet. Key Features Cultural Storytelling : Play through interactive stories inspired by local literature and folklore. Authentic Heritage : Experience poetry, songs, music, and traditions seamlessly woven into gameplay. Realistic Worlds : Explore detailed 3D environments based on authentic landscapes. Immersive Technology : Control characters with your movements using camera-based motion tracking. Literary Tourism Reimagined : Travel across five regions through the power of stories. Tale Smiths is both a game and a cultural journey — an interactive story collection that invites players to experience the living literature of Northern Europe.

rows.name: Guns, Blocks, and Steel
rows.short_description: A tactical multiplayer FPS created by a solo developer as a passion project. Featuring a fully destructible, block-based environment. Gather resources to produce weapons, ammo, and vehicles. Play multiplayer PVP/co-op or singleplayer with bots.
rows.description_html: Guns, Blocks, and Steel is a FPS game with a completely dynamic environment . Build defenses , or, more importantly, destroy your enemy's defenses . Mold the terrain to your advantage with the Rocket Launcher . Resources Mine iron to refine and produce steel , which can be used to build vehicles and ammo . Ammo is limited , so be careful not to waste it. Some more advanced weapons of war may require gold , which is a more contentious resource than iron. Instead of boringly digging out each ore block one by one , like some other games, you must blow it up with dynamite . Or just throw the dynamite at the enemy. Whatever you want. Play as you want Your playstyle is your choice . You can stay behind at your base, manage your team's resources and construct weapons of war. Or you can try to gather resources and bring them back to your base. Or you can assault your enemy's base. Or you can do all three . There are no classes to railroad you into a certain role. Fun over competition Most multiplayer games nowadays try to get you addicted by making the game hyper-competitive , which fosters a toxic community. This is not what Guns, Blocks, and Steel does. The game aims to put fun over competition. Winning or losing doesn't matter as long as you had a good time . Your win/loss ratio is not tracked, there is no history of past games played, there are no rankings, and you cannot see the kills and deaths of other players. Game modes Warfare - Deplete your enemy's personnel and eliminate them all to win. Capture The Flag - Capture your enemy's flag and bring it back to your base to win. 100 Kills - First team to 100 kills wins. Assault - Co-op game mode where your goal is to defeat all enemies at their base. Invasion - Co-op game mode where you must defend your base from attacking enemies. Space Race - The first team to build a rocket wins. Weapons Shovel - Very short range Pistol - Short range Assault rifle - Medium range Rocket launcher - Long range Sniper rifle - Really long range Dynamite - Mostly used for mining, but can also be a weapon Vehicles ATV - Useful for getting around fast Humvee - Troop transport Tank - It's tanky Attack Helicopter - Get to the choppa Maps Procedurally generated maps Handcrafted maps Small 256x256 maps Large 512x512 maps Day/night cycle Buildings Blast furnace - Used to refine iron into steel Factory - Used to build ammo and vehicles Barracks - Generates personnel for your team as long as it's not destroyed Loudspeaker - Give orders to bots

rows.name: VHS Collection: Goodnight Me
rows.short_description: VHS Collection: Goodnight Me is a short horror game where reality blurs with nightmares over five eerie days. Experience strange events, unsettling dreams, and unravel a chilling mystery in a remote house. Can you survive the madness, or will the nightmare consume you?
rows.description_html: The Game VHS Collection: Goodnight Me is a spine-chilling, atmospheric horror game that takes players on a disturbing journey over the course of five harrowing days. Set in a remote house where the lines between reality and nightmare blur, this game plunges you into a world of eerie visuals and psychological terror. You play as a lone protagonist who returns home to what should be a peaceful, solitary life. But as the days progress, strange and unexplainable events begin to unfold. It starts subtly—a bizarre TV broadcast showing something it shouldn’t, dreams that feel too real, and objects in your home that move on their own. Each night brings a new nightmare, each day a deeper descent into madness. On the first night, a seemingly innocent episode of a TV show turns into something horrifying , sparking a chain of increasingly disturbing events. As the days go by, your sense of reality unravels. His waking life isn’t safe either—he encounters strange noises, glimpses of a creature lurking in the shadows, and even a haunting memory from his childhood that he thought was long buried. rows.name: Zenith Realms
rows.short_description: Guide Ninami on a heartfelt journey through the realms of a fractured planet. Solve intricate puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and piece together the truth of a shattering past with a mysterious raven.
rows.description_html: Zenith Realms is a 3D top-down cozy adventure puzzle game where Ninami embarks on an emotional journey across the fractured realms of a splintering planet. Can you help Ninami and find the way home before time runs out? DISCOVER A SPLITTING WORLD In a world that is undergoing a planetary mitosis after duplicating everything on its surface, a war had struck between the two sides and led to the death of all but one: Ninami Travel the tranquil yet divided landscapes of the Zenith Realms on a quest to get Ninami back home. FACE CHALLENGES Overcome adversaries by chasing the mischievous Raven who stole the gem that powers Ninami's Home portal, and learn about their shared troubled past.  UNRAVEL MYSTERIES By solving intriguing environmental puzzles, you learn more about the planetary split and explore three beautiful levels full of pre-war history, friendly creatures, and a dark secret past.

rows.name: Doll Catching Simulator
rows.short_description: In the busy life, do you long to experience the fun of catching dolls but are limited by time and space? Now, the doll catching simulator brings you a brand-new entertainment experience!
rows.description_html: This is a 2D cute-style claw machine simulator, bringing you a comfortable claw machine experience. In this claw machine world, there are as many as 41 dolls with different styles and charming cuteness. Moreover, each doll is equipped with its own dedicated claw machine, allowing you to fully experience the exclusive fun of grasping. It is worth mentioning that each doll has been carefully set with 5 quality levels. The higher the quality of the doll, the lower the probability of grasping it, which undoubtedly adds more challenges and thrills to the game. In terms of control, I have simulated the changes in the strength and speed of the real claws, requiring you to consider the angle and timing when operating, just like thinking carefully in front of a real claw machine. And those cute dolls, every detail of them has been carefully crafted, as if they were truly alive. Even more interestingly, there is a cute younger sister in the game to help you hold the dolls. This considerate setting greatly enhances the immersion of the game. It seems that you are not playing alone but have a close partner sharing the happy moments of catching dolls with you. In addition, the game also provides a display cabinet. Here, you can proudly display the dolls you caught with great effort, admire their cute looks, and relive the tension and joy during the grasping. We sincerely expect you to step into this wonderful game world, enjoy the pleasure of playing heartily, and leave your beautiful memories of catching dolls!

rows.name: HexenHold
rows.short_description: Protect your Boss, a necromancer, from waves of incoming enemies in the deepest of dungeons. Buy Towers. Upgrade your abilities. Throw your enemies. Do whatever you can to keep the ritual going!
rows.description_html: HexenHold is a combination of a tower defense and a 2D platformer where you play as a newly summoned minion of an “evil” necromancer that begrudgingly needs some help in fending off an invading force of skeletons and ghosts. Frantically run up and down dungeons to strategically place towers bought with the gems dropped by defeated enemies. If there aren’t enough towers to get the job done, pick up and throw the enemies to get yourself involved in the action! Prove your loyalty and defend your necromancer boss like your life depends on it! You may even get a promotion after all is said and done. 4 unique towers to defend with. Throwable enemies to bash against walls. 3 original dungeons to defend. Optional Endless mode for those wanting to test their strategic prowess. A Necromancer that won't shut up (unless you want them to). This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Drive Thru Miami Prologue
rows.short_description: A simulation of running and expanding a drive-thru shop where players take orders, prepare various beverages and foods, manage supplies, and serve customers efficiently.
rows.description_html: Main Game About the Game Drive Thru Prologue is a drive thru experience game. Its prologue version of drive thru game which represents main concepts of drive thru game. Game Concept: A simulation of running and expanding a drive-thru shop where players take orders, prepare various beverages and foods, manage supplies, and serve customers efficiently. Gameplay Elements: 1. Order Taking: - Receive and input customer orders for both beverages and foods. 2. Preparation: - Choose the correct cup size and shape for beverages. - Prepare food items as requested. 3. Customization: - Customize your shop's brand name. 4. Payment System: - Process payments using cash, credit cards, or mobile payments. - Input amounts, provide correct change, and complete transactions accurately. 5. Supply Management: - Monitor inventory and restock supplies to keep the shop well-stocked. 6. Growth and Expansion: - Improve and expand the shop by upgrading equipment, adding new menu items, and opening new locations. - Invest profits wisely to enhance the shop's reputation and attract more customers. Objective: Efficiently manage and grow the drive-thru, accurately fulfill orders, maintain adequate supplies, and build a positive reputation for your shop. This game offers a dynamic and realistic experience of operating and expanding a drive-thru, managing a wide range of beverages and foods, handling diverse payment transactions, and ensuring a steady supply of goods.
