rows.name: The Dangerous Back-to-School Season
rows.short_description: The Dangerous Back-to-School Season is a pixel RPG where players guide the protagonist through cybersecurity threats . Using dialogue choices and mini-games, players must help the protagonist make the right decisions to ensure a safe enrollment.
rows.description_html: The Dangerous Back-to-School Season In this RPG, you’ll guide the protagonist, who has just received a university acceptance letter, through a series of cybersecurity challenges. On their journey to enroll, they’ll face threats like phishing attacks, ransomware, password breaches, and cyberbullying. By making the right dialogue choices and completing various mini-games, you will help the protagonist recognize and overcome these threats, ensuring a safe and successful university enrollment. Key Features: Pixel art style inspired by the real world Unique focus on cybersecurity Multiple outcomes unlocked through dialogue and choices Levels themed around common cybersecurity threats, including phishing, ransomware, password attacks, and cyberbullying Mini-games blending puzzle-solving and strategy This game is perfect for teens and adults interested in cybersecurity and is a great way to raise awareness about online threats.

rows.name: Infinity Nikki
rows.short_description: Embark on a cozy open-world adventure filled with vast landscape, mystical puzzles and unexpected platforming challenges. Dress up not just for style, but to unravel hidden mysteries, interact with a vibrant environment, and experience the freedom to explore at your own pace.
rows.description_html: In this game, Nikki and Momo embark on a new adventure, traveling across the fantastic nations of Miraland, each with its own unique culture and environment. Players will encounter many characters and whimsical creatures while collecting stunning outfits of various styles. Some of these outfits possess magical abilities essential for progressing through the story. Bright and fantasy-filled open world The world of Infinity Nikki offers a refreshing escape from traditional apocalyptic landscapes. It's bright, whimsical, and filled with magical creatures. Wander through this wonderful land and explore the beauty and charm around every corner. Exceptional clothing design and dress-up experience Express your style with an extensive collection of beautifully designed outfits, some of which even grant unique abilities. From floating and purifying to gliding and shrinking, these outfits unlock exciting new ways to explore the world and overcome challenges. Each outfit enriches your journey, letting you mix and match for the perfect look. Platforming with endless fun In this vast, fantastic world, master skills like floating, running, and plunging to freely explore the land and tackle intricately designed puzzles and challenges. The joy of 3D platforming is seamlessly integrated into the game's open-world exploration. Each scene is vibrant and charming—from soaring paper cranes, speeding wine cellar carts, mysterious ghost trains—so many hidden secrets await discovery! Cozy sim activities and casual fun Relax with activities like fishing, bug catching, or grooming animals. Everything Nikki collects on her journey helps craft new outfits. Whether you're in a meadow or by a river, there's a great chance that you'll encounter enchanting creatures that bring a sense of peace and immersion. Diverse puzzles and mini-games Infinity Nikki is filled with activities that challenge both wit and skill. Traverse scenic paths, enjoy a hot air balloon ride, complete platforming puzzles, or even play a hopscotch mini-game. These elements add variety and depth, ensuring every moment remains fresh and engaging. Thank you for your interest in Infinity Nikki. We look forward to meeting you in Miraland!

rows.name: Sarpedon
rows.short_description: Explore an island at the edge of the world, converse with Greek Gods and Goddesses, and confront monstrosity in this modern reimagining of a classic myth.
rows.description_html: You have arrived at Sarpedon, a surreal island at the edge of the known world. Armed only with a bag, a sword, and your wits, you must continue your task as given: REACH THE ISLAND SLAY THE BEAST RETURN WITH HER HEAD While the island may be cloaked in an isolating fog, you certainly aren't alone. The colorful cast of characters scattered around the island anticipate your arrival, some more anxiously than others. What will they be to you, friend or foe? What will you be to them? Explore the island, discover its inhabitants, and craft your story in Sarpedon, a solo dev's love letter to his favorite myth. Featuring A hand-crafted, open-world island environment to explore Unique interactions with 5+ mythical characters Over 400+ lines of handwritten dialogue Replayable mini-games Discussion of grief, remorse, and the ways in which we cope KNOWN (RARE) ISSUE FOR OLD MACHINES: If you open the game and hear sounds, but only see a black screen, that's an issue with the MSAA settings on your computer, and not fixable on my end. I apologize for the inconvenience. If you want to play, follow the instructions outlined in THIS GITHUB THREAD: to turn your 'Antialiasing - Mode' setting in the NVidia control panel from 'Override any application setting' to 'Application controlled'.

rows.name: Bureau of Contacts: Mansion
rows.short_description: Explore an old mansion full of paranormal dangers alone. Find clues, identify ghosts, collect their dossiers and exorcise them.
rows.description_html: View full game page About the Game 'Bureau of Contacts: Mansion' is a limited free version of the 'Bureau of Contacts' full game, in which you can try the game loop of a full-fledged game based on one of its locations - an old mansion haunted by a ghost. As an agent of the Bureau, you will have to: RESEARCH Use the basic toolkit to search for clues and identify the mansion's ghost. COLLECT DOSSIERS Interact with the ghost in voice or by chat to obtain its personal data necessary for the exorcism ritual. EXORCISE Follow the instructions in the Journal and correctly perform the exorcism procedure to fully complete your mission. SURVIVE Observe and use the features of the ghosts to stay alive as long as possible and have time to do as much as possible for your Bureau. GO TO THE NEXT LEVEL Think you're ready to go to the next level? 'Bureau of Contacts' - more locations, tools and ghosts, co-op mode, and generative AI built into enemies that makes the game even more realistic and unpredictable.

rows.name: PLEASE SAY HI
rows.short_description: a short but incredibly touching experience.
rows.description_html: You wake up, get dressed, shower, down your morning cup of coffee in two scalding gulps, and button on your coat. With that, you are off to catch the bus to work at your monotonous job. You arrive and sit at your desk, hammering away at your keyboard in hour after hour of forced solitude. It is nearly the end of the year, and you can't help but think to yourself that there must be more to life than this. 'It's a bit of a 'walking simulator' but it's a quick little game that is really better described as an 'experience' than a game, and deals with some pretty heavy subject matter for how simplistic it is.'

rows.name: Sime Is Back 3D Old School
rows.short_description: Sime Is Back 3D Old School is a retro-inspired action-platformer set on the Adriatic coast. Play as Sime, an old fisherman with a heart of gold but no swimming skills, as he uses a fish to hilariously battle through obstacles, rescue his cats, and outwit greedy villagers.
rows.description_html: Sime Is Back 3D Old School is a retro-inspired action-platformer set against the picturesque backdrop of the Adriatic coast. Step into the worn-out boots of Sime, an old fisherman with a heart of gold, but one surprising flaw: he doesn't know how to swim! Sime's simple life takes a turn for the worse when the greedy villagers, who only pretended to care about him, imprison his beloved cats after he decides to stop giving them free fish. Now, Sime must embark on a daring adventure to rescue his feline friends and take back what's his! Armed with nothing but his fish, Sime turns the tables on his captors in the most hilarious way possible. Using fish as his melee weapon, he slaps enemies out of his way, smashes through obstacles, and clears paths as he navigates the treacherous landscape. Along the way, you'll guide Sime through a variety of challenging platforms, avoid tricky traps, and outsmart the cunning villagers who stand between him and his beloved cats. Key Features -Old-School Charm: Experience the nostalgia of classic platformers with modern 3D visuals, bringing the best of both worlds together. -Fish-Slapping Combat: Wield Sime's signature weapon—a fish!—to slap enemies and break through obstacles with satisfying, old-school brawling action. -Classic Platforming: Jump, dodge, and weave through a colorful 3D world filled with quirky obstacles and hidden secrets. -Rescue Mission: Save Sime's cats from the clutches of the greedy villagers, each cat more adorable and eager to reunite with their owner. -Whimsical Storyline: Enjoy a heartwarming yet comedic narrative about friendship, betrayal, and the lengths one man will go to for his cats.

rows.name: BECOME THE DEVIL
rows.short_description: Two college students travel to a remote area to interview the owner of a resort. Along the way, locals warn them to stay away from the people at the resort. Since the new owner moved in, strange incidents have frequently occurred. The locals suspect something terrifying must be lurking in the resort
rows.description_html: Become the Devil is a horror game that features combat, escape, stealth, and bomb planting systems. The game also incorporates deep life philosophies within its storyline. Synopsis Two college students travel to a remote area to interview the owner of a large resort. Along the way, locals warn them not to get involved with the people at the resort. Since the new owner moved in, the area has been plagued by numerous strange events, with many people mysteriously disappearing. The locals suspect that something sinister must be happening at the resort, but no one dares to investigate. As a result, the town is nearly deserted, becoming almost like a ghost town. Key Features Combat, bomb planting, escaping, and stealth systems VHS film aesthetic Receive texts from NPCs Player voice activity

rows.name: Prince Rystiya's Starship
rows.short_description: The rebels claimed that they fought for freedom and democracy, yet they built a totalitarian regime instead. As a heroic imperial fighter pilot, you will eliminate waves of rebel scum and hunt down their leader.
rows.description_html: Prince Rystiya's Starship is a simple 2D space shooter. It's a student project made by a student from SMU Guildhall. The rebels claimed that they fought for freedom and democracy, yet they built a totalitarian regime instead. As a heroic imperial fighter pilot, you will eliminate waves of rebel scum and hunt down their leader. Your ship is highly advanced. It has multiple weapons, and its shield can endure extreme damage. However, you must keep a close eye on your energy bar. Your shield, weapons, and engines all consume energy. Without energy, you would be extremely vulnerable.  > 10 waves of enemies. > Manage the energy supply on your fighter. > 3 intense boss fights. > Free to play. Ship control: -Press WASD to move (costs a small amount of energy). (Move the left joystick on the controller) -Press/hold J to fire the shotgun. It's short-range and inaccurate but has a very low energy cost. (Press the X button on the controller) -Press/hold K to fire the default gun, the most versatile and useful weapon. (Hold the A button or press the left joystick on the controller) -Press/hold L to fire overcharge. It's long-range and accurate, but it has a long reload time and high energy cost. (Press the B button on the controller) -Press I to fire anti-matter missiles (one use per life). Use A and D to control the missile, and press I again to detonate. (Press the Y button on the controller) -Press Q to toggle the shield (it takes energy to maintain the shield and absorb damage with it). (Press the top-left button or left trigger on the controller) -Press E to toggle turbo boost (greater thrust, greater energy consumption). (Press the start button on the Xbox controller) -Press Space to repair (very energy inefficient). (Press the top-right button or right trigger on the controller) -Press Tab to toggle minimap, aim-assistance, and pause state text. rows.name: "Otherworldly: Beginning of the Rift" Pre-Alpha
rows.short_description: Is an immersive adventure that challenges you to explore unknown dimensions, solve intricate puzzles, and make choices that impact the unfolding mystery. Dive into the unknown, uncover hidden secrets, and prepare for an experience that could change everything you thought you knew.
rows.description_html: Story In 2040, reality as we know it undergoes profound changes. In a world where parallel dimensions have become part of everyday life, you are a brave explorer tasked with uncovering the mysteries of these enigmatic worlds. Working for a global research laboratory founded in the 1990s, your mission is to collect and decipher mysterious recordings on tapes scattered across various parallel worlds. Each tape not only brings monetary rewards but also a deeper understanding of the hidden layers of existence. To successfully complete your missions, you must also use special devices to measure the parameters of different worlds — temperature, radiation levels, air quality, and electromagnetic fields (EMF). These indicators will help you better understand which parallel world you have encountered and how safe it is for your stay. But be cautious — further immersion into these alternate realities may lead to unforeseen events that could change the course of your mission and the fate of humanity. Gameplay Elements Collecting Tapes: While exploring parallel worlds, you will find tapes containing encrypted data, holding crucial information about each dimension. Your task is to decode these recordings and extract valuable knowledge. Using Devices: You are equipped with tools to measure temperature, radiation, air purity, and EMF. Each of these parameters provides insight into how habitable or dangerous the current world is and helps in identifying its nature. Managing Needs: To survive, you must monitor your character’s basic needs: hunger, thirst, health, and time. To maintain your well-being, you can purchase food, water, and other resources using the money you earn. Analyzing Parallel Worlds: Your success in the game depends on how accurately you can determine which world you are dealing with based on data from the devices. Correct identifications earn you rewards, while mistakes can lead to resource loss. Dangers of Alternate Realities: Some worlds can be extremely hazardous, and staying in them without proper preparation can have severe consequences for your character. You must always be ready to avoid fatal errors.

rows.name: Avakin Life
rows.short_description: Avakin Life is an endless social world waiting for you. Live your dream life, from unique and customizable avatars to stylish fashion outfits and personalized dream homes. Hang out with friends, join parties, and embark on adventures in a world where you are in control of everything.
rows.description_html: Start a life without limits in Avakin Life now!  Discover unlimited ways to be you. Enter a virtual world of endless opportunities, a wardrobe packed with the latest fashion, your dream home in every location imaginable, and new adventures, parties and events happening every day!    This is YOUR life as you want to live it. A world where self-expression is boundless. A virtual universe connecting people from everywhere around the world.     Features   Create an avatar as unique as YOU   Decide how to represent yourself. A reflection of reality or your wildest dreams?  Customise your look with thousands of hairstyles, make-up, and facial features.  Express your personality with animations. Walk like a zombie or strut like a model - you decide.    Define your style Stay ahead of trends with weekly fashion drops.  Whatever your aesthetic, whatever the occasion, create a look that suits you with 30k+ fashion items. Make a statement with head-turning accessories from cute hats to beautiful wings.  Transform your ideas into wearable designs with our Fashion AI Design Tool.     Build your dream home From tropical islands to city penthouses, the home of your dreams is waiting to be discovered. Scandi chic or vamp lair? Decorate to your tastes with themed furniture collections.  Create a home for your pet whether it’s a cute corgi or fierce dragon?  Host parties with all your friends or create the perfect night in. Your place, your rules!    Meet new friends & Join the community   Whether you’d rather go on a cottagecore picnic or spend Saturday night at the rock club, hang out and chat with new friends in hundreds of amazing locations.   Find your virtual family and make lasting friendships in our welcoming community. Participate together in weekly events and collect unique rewards.  Attend parties, live music, and club events every night.  Create videos and photos and share your creativity with other Avakins.    Begin your adventure Explore with no limits. Travel to outer space, road trip across the USA or relax in the Amazon rainforest. Live your roleplay life in epic locations with endless costume and animation options.  Get involved in gripping stories. Join the community to unpack mysteries and complete quests for unique rewards.  Unlimited ways to be you! This is Avakin Life. Who will you be today?

rows.name: Prince Rystiya's Starfleet
rows.short_description: Conquer the entire galaxy or fight quick custom battles in this free space RTS!
rows.description_html: Prince Rystiya's Starfleet is a free 2D space RTS. It's a student project made by a student from SMU Guildhall. Commander, the Lizardfolk Empire is pushing forward, and our new Lizardfolk followers are under threat. The Rystaurian Church shall not abandon its believers, no matter their past or status. However, our Lizardfolk followers are outnumbered and outgunned, and no other militaries can provide help. You are our only hope, commander. --Prince Rystiya's Starfleet has 4 game modes, including a galactic conquest mode (inspired by classics like Total Wars and Star Wars: Empire at War) and a skirmish mode (inspired by classics like Command and Conquer and Homeworld). If you just want a quick match, then challenge levels and custom mode are made for you. --There are more than 15 units, each having unique strengths and weaknesses. This game is optimized to support 1000+ units fighting on the screen at the same time. --The game's combat system is inspired by real-world naval combat. There's no armor type. Instead, each unit has an armor value. Low-damage projectiles will struggle to overcome the target's armor, while most high-damage projectiles can be intercepted by rapid-fire weapons.

rows.name: Frontier: Battle Royale
rows.short_description: Frontier is a classic battle royale game where you fight to be the last one alive. Play with friends, randoms, or bots as you explore a stylized map, loot up weapons, and rack up eliminations. Unlock skins as you level up—no microtransactions, just pure gameplay!
rows.description_html: Play Frontier for Free Today! Frontier is a classic battle royale where you can play solo or with friends, fill your game with bots, and choose between Classic Royale or the respawn-friendly Respawn Royale mode. No matter which one you pick, the goal is simple—be the last one alive! Loot a variety of weapons, stay inside the zone, and fight your way to victory. Matches last 6-9 minutes , with continuous lobbies so you can keep playing with minimal wait. You can also use the in-game text chat to talk with friends or other players. Earn XP by getting kills and placing highly to level up and unlock new heroes . Heroes don't grant any competitive advantage—they are simply cosmetic and cool to have! Reach level 50 to unlock this season’s ultimate hero!  With challenging bots, cartoony graphics, and competitive gameplay , Frontier is perfect for casual games or even tournaments, which are hosted by the Frontier Discord community. Play today—100% free!

rows.name: Toriki: The Castaway Island
rows.short_description: A companion app necessary for playing the Toriki: The Castaway Island board game from Lucky Duck Games. Toriki: The Castaway Island is a cooperative family game of adventure, exploration and survival mixing an app with physical components.
rows.description_html: This application is a digital companion for the Toriki: The Castaway Island board game from Lucky Duck Games. Toriki: The Castaway Island is a cooperative family game where players try to survive on a deserted island by exploring various locations, obtaining resources, discovering new species and crafting new items. You need the board game to be able to use this app. The game is a digital hybrid mixing physical components with the app. The players move their meeples around the map and scan QR codes printed on cards to perform actions. The app provides narration and describes the results of the players’ actions, as well as playing background sounds. The game is played as a single continuous adventure that takes about 6–8 hours to complete, though you can pause and save it at any time.

rows.name: Find My MOM
rows.short_description: Find Your MOM
rows.description_html: Wade still needs his MAMA. Find your MOM by overcoming the obstacles, the narrator, and the traps that stand in your way. The player moves forward, covered in objects scavenged from the streets — a wobbly basketball, a rusty barrel, even a burning box.  There’s only one goal: to find and reunite with the missing mother. Find My Mom is the life story of a man who has lost his mother amid a powerless, stagnant life. Does wearing a barrel on your head seem like a stupid idea? thank the developer. The narrator usually mocks you... but sometimes, he might actually help. Listen carefully to what he says. The path forward is painful. A calm BGM might be the only thing soothing your heart. Try rolling forward with a barrel over your head, or jumping high with a basketball instead. Whatever it takes—keep moving. There is a quit button. Just remember one thing: WADE still needs his mom. If the game feels too difficult, please contact your professor instead of the developer. This game is a student project — the difficulty is the result of the professor’s orders.

rows.name: Coreless: Prologue
rows.short_description: Coreless is a single-player roguelike action game set in a sci-fi world, featuring a unique meta-progression system for deep customization. Experiment with diverse avatars, abilities, and powers to tackle challenging bosses in this dynamic adventure.
rows.description_html: Coreless is a third-person, single-player action roguelike that brings a fresh twist to meta-progression through its flexible talent and power systems. Choose from a wide variety of avatars, enhance them with talent points, and equip them with distinctive addons. Each adventure promises unique challenges and experiences. Highly Customizable Avatars Shape your playstyle using a rich combination of talents, addons, and in-session powers. Whether you envision a spellcaster striking from afar, a melee warrior dealing stuns and damage over time, or an assassin summoning minions to create distractions, the choice is entirely yours. Unlock new avatars, powers, and addons to forge a truly distinctive build! Tick-Based Addon System As you progress, surviving tougher encounters earns you Ticks—your performance currency. These Ticks unlock addon drops and Affix Milestones that enhance those addons. Addons are central to your build: passive addons may grant powers at session start, plague enemies periodically, or provide shields or extra lives. Event-based addons activate based on the socket they're placed in—some let you double-dash to collect nearby buffs, others trigger effects during Overdrive abilities. The more Ticks you gather in a session, the higher your chances of powerful drops. Simply put: the longer you survive, the better the rewards. Optimize your growth during every encounter before the Heat Meter hits 100%, triggering a boss battle. Defeating these unique enemies rewards you with gear to power future runs. Unlock new difficulty levels, environments, and enemy types for escalating challenge and reward. Continuous Progression Even in defeat, progress continues. Earn permanent upgrades such as talent points, addons and resources. Each step forward opens up new strategic possibilities for future attempts.

rows.name: Piece Yourself Up
rows.short_description: Slash and shoot enemies with spoons and use their parts to piece your broken body up! Survive in this 2D pixel-art top-down dungeon crawler game based on chronic mental and physical conditions.
rows.description_html: Your large spoon acts as a sword. It has a large area of attack, can deflect projectiles and costs a fraction of your spoon reserves. The maximum number of spoons you can hold is 12 (referencing spoon theory - more below), and every attack costs, so plan your moves carefully to make it count! Your little spoons act as projectiles. They are precise and cost a full spoon from your reserves but deal immense damage. Your robot body is unstable, and your parts will fall off, whether it be from attacks or the passage of time. Use the parts of your fallen enemies to replace your missing limbs and survive the day. Piece Yourself Up was made in response to the inKUbator Game Jam 2024 theme 'Everything Falls Apart', interpreting it through the lens of those with mental and physical health conditions. The player is represented by a robot, which is our interpretation of the feeling of dissociation. Their body is unreliable and needs constant upkeep, a sentiment many people can relate to. Simple daily tasks such as writing essays, checking emails and cooking can become obstacles that must be fought to successfully complete the day. Spoons are used as weapons to represent energy levels, which is a nod to Christine Miserandino’s famous 'Spoon Theory'. The theory proposes if you were given 12 spoons at the start of the day and each task you wanted to complete in the day cost a spoon, how would you spend your day? It highlights the invisible struggle of these conditions - energy. Energy is limited, and energy management becomes a crucial skill that can get overwhelming. This is the experience of many people with chronic mental and physical conditions. For more information, please visit Christine's original heartfelt post 'The Spoon Theory' on her blog. Piece Yourself Up was made by three first year students and a third year student at University, and although it may change in the future, there are no current plans for any major changes to the game as we are putting more time into our other, more complex, projects. We hope you enjoy our game and we can't wait for our future endeavors.

rows.name: Backyard Basketball '01
rows.short_description: Return to the blacktop with your favorite Backyard athletes! The original Backyard Basketball 2001 is back and now enhanced to run on Steam. Dribble, shoot, and take that ball to the hoop!
rows.description_html: HOOP DREAMING Slip on those high tops and hit the courts with the first basketball game in the award-winning Backyard Sports Franchise, Backyard Basketball ‘01, now enhanced to run on Steam.  The Backyard athletes are teaming up with the kid version of hoops legend Lisa Leslie in Backyard Basketball ‘01! Customize your uniform, pick your fab five, and get ready for four quarters of hoops! Play single games or a whole season. Track stats in Season play and create custom players to watch their skills improve over time! HOOPS FOR EVERYONE Ball like it’s 2001! 30 Iconic Kid Athletes 9 Unique Basketball Courts Comical Power-ups Hilarious Bloopers Lively commentary from Sunny Day and Barry Dejay THE GOAT Backyard Basketball featured arguably the most iconic video game athlete of the 90s or any era - Pablo Sanchez. Play with the legend himself or choose your favorites and relive what made Backyard Basketball 2001 an award-winning classic.  Game Modes include: Pick-up Game: Instant play! The computer chooses a random team for you and itself and the game starts immediately. Season Play: Pick your team name, uniform colors, and players to compete in the Backyard Basketball League. Manage the team through a basketball season for your chance to win the Championship! We’re talking about practice! Hone those basketball skills while getting a feel for every court in practice mode! Then, it’s game time! Play a Pick-up Game or a Full Season with your favorite players. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION At our core, we are fans first – not just of video games, but of the Backyard Sports franchise. Fans have asked for accessible and legal ways to play their original Backyard titles for years, and we are excited to deliver. Without having access to the source code, there are hard limitations on the experience we can create. As an example, we can’t use the original 32bit code to support modern macOS, as even with an incredibly clever wrapper, macOS can’t execute the binaries. Backyard Basketball ‘01 runs well, looks better than ever, is stacked with Steam achievements to test your mettle, and creates a new installation for digital preservation within the Backyard Sports catalog that allows the next generation of fans to fall in love with the game.

rows.name: Everything Ends In 0
rows.short_description: The world ends in 1 hour. It can't be saved. Wanna chat?
rows.description_html: Special thanks to Violet. Without her sacrifice, this game would not be here. Everything Ends In 0 is a game about the end of the world, but you are not a hero destined to save it. In fact, it can't be saved at all - from the moment you start playing, The World is already doomed. No twist, no fine print, no loopholes, no technicalities. Everything. Will. Die. All you can do is wait for it to be over. And hey! while you're at it, why not strike up a friendly conversation? I hear you're quite similar to a couple of those girls, and quite intriguing to a couple others. Besides, it's not like the awkward moments will really matter in just a little bit. So listen to them for a while, to pass the time! Or don't. Again, it really does not matter. You are going to die. CONTROLS: [Z] select [X] 'return' [ARROWS] lose yourself [MOUSE] admire your new forever home [W] move forward [Z] gather

rows.name: Hidden Pass Skirmishes
rows.short_description: Chart a course for mystical adventure in this fusion of Tactical Turn-Based RPG and Strategy. Become a Wanderer - explorer, warrior, leader and tactician all in one. This is a small tactical adventure where you have to go through the prologue of the main Story.
rows.description_html: Master tactical turn-based battles on land and in the air as you out-manoeuvre a plethora of powerful foes. Multi-layered Combat: Combat in Hidden Pass Skirmishes takes place across three map layers, each presenting their own tactical challenges, although flying units are free to move between them and outflank more limited fighters. Elyrium Madness: Magic is your most powerful weapon, and potentially your undoing. Every ability used brings you closer to the brink, the power of Elyrium slowly driving your units mad. There's a potential method to this madness, though - the further you push to the edge, the more powerful your abilities become. Passing the Baton: Field your four best and brightest units in each battle, but plan for attrition. Casualties can be swiftly replaced mid-battle with reserve units from your Tower - don’t accept defeat! Automatons: Not all of your units are flesh and blood. Your home base’s Factory can manufacture powerful Elyrium-fueled automatons with unique abilities and strengths. Expertise System: Keep your troops alive and they’ll reward you in kind. Each class has unique abilities, giving the opportunity to play differently.

rows.name: Escape Depths of Immanis
rows.short_description: Escape the treacherous depths of Immanis, where danger lurks at every turn. Navigate through dark and mysterious caverns, harvest valuable resources, and outsmart relentless enemies as you fight to reach the surface. Will you survive the depths and find your way to freedom?
rows.description_html: Uncover the perilous story of Immanis town. Deep in the treacherous caverns lies the Vitality Vessel, key to the town's survival. Harvest resources, outsmart enemies, and restore its energy. Will you save Immanis and escape the depths? Mine Harness the power of specialized mining equipment to extract valuable resources from established mines. As you tap into each deposit, you gather the essential materials required for your journey and technological advancements. Your success in mining operations is crucial for survival and uncovering the mysteries that lie ahead. Combat Prepare for intense battles where you'll face waves of relentless enemies. Develop your combat skills to fend off the creatures of the deep and survive their increasingly fierce attacks. Your survival depends on your ability to adapt and overcome the adversities of this hostile environment. Upgrade Progress through the game allows you to upgrade your engineer's abilities, enhance your ship's capabilities, and augment your weapons to increase their power. Strategic upgrades are essential to withstand tougher enemies and explore more treacherous zones.

rows.name: War Lands
rows.short_description: War Lands is a fast-paced strategy game where you battle for global domination on dynamically generated maps. Expand your territory, manage resources, and outsmart adaptive AI opponents in a constant struggle for supremacy. Think quickly, act decisively, and paint the world in your colors.
rows.description_html: War Lands is about being a strategist, fighting adversaries and taking over the world one territory at a time. Paint the map your color in this fast-paced battle of wits and territory. Key Features: Dynamic Map Generation: Every game starts on a freshly generated map, ensuring no two battles are ever the same! Strategic Expansion: Grow your territory, but beware – expand too quickly, and you'll leave yourself vulnerable. Resource Management: Balance your units carefully. Every piece of land needs protection, but spread yourself too thin, and the AI will exploit your weaknesses. Adaptive AI Opponents: Face off against computer players that analyze your strategy and actively seek out your vulnerabilities. Fast-Paced Gameplay: Think quickly and act decisively. In War Lands, hesitation can cost you everything. Gameplay: In War Lands, you're thrust into a world of constant conflict and opportunity: Start with a small territory and work to expand your influence across the map. Manage your resources wisely, deciding when to claim new lands and when to reinforce your borders. Deploy units strategically to defend your territory and prepare for offensive maneuvers. Analyze your opponents' strategies and adapt your own tactics to counter their moves. React swiftly to the ever-changing battlefield, where a single misstep can turn the tide of war. Perfect For: Strategy game enthusiasts looking for a fresh challenge Players who enjoy games that blend thoughtful planning with quick decision-making Fans of procedurally generated content that ensures high replayability Those who love outsmarting AI opponents in a battle of wits and tactics Dive into the world of War Lands and prove your strategic prowess. Can you expand your empire while fending off relentless AI opponents? Every game is a new test of skill, speed, and strategy!

rows.name: Jellitito
rows.short_description: Get ready for some sweet fun with our antistress Jellitito game! Just clicking to collect amazing skins and exchange them with other players. Build your collection of rare skins! It's simple, addictive, and endlessly enjoyable! Start clicking today!
rows.description_html: What comes to mind when you see jelly? Want to tap it? Then Jellitito is just for you! This fun clicker game lets you pick your favorite jelly look and dive into a meditative squishing experience. With appealing graphics, calming music, and captivating jelly jiggles with every click, what could be better for unwinding after a long day? Play, relax, and collect a unique jelly collection! Jellitito is a simple anti-stress clicker. You don't need to do anything but click on the jelly, enjoying the process. During the game, you have an opportunity to get skins for the jelly or table, which will be notified by the Steam notification service. By clicking on the “inventory” button, you can replace the standard colors with those skins that you like more from the available ones. And if you want something new, you can always exchange skins with friends or use the opportunity provided by Steam! In the game, you may: Click on the jelly. Contemplate the jelly without clicking on it. Collect drops as in-game items, such as jelly and table skins. Swap jelly and table skins. Exchange skins with other players. Utilize other Steam features related to skins! Currently, there are over 50 table skins and 30 jelly skins of varying rarity in the game! To be able to get a skin drop inside the game, you need to launch it and wait for one minute. You can receive a new skin every 4 hours! Chance of getting a skin depending on the rarity. Chance of drop out and the number of positions will change over time. Items in the game now have these rarities:: Common. Rare. Unique. Legendary. Mythic. Epic. Q: Will there be achievements in the game? A: Yes, there will be! We plan to add not only achievements but also other features: a leaderboard, competitions, a community workshop, new skins, and much more! Q: Is it a scam? A: No, it's a simple anti-stress clicker game. There is no scam involved, as the game is completely free for players. The drop of skins is determined solely by luck. We utilize Steam features, which is not a scam (player-to-player exchange and the Steam trading platform). We do not encourage or advise players against taking risky actions. Q: Is the game going to close soon? А: For those worried that the game might shut down: no need to worry, everything is under control! 😊 The game is hosted on Steam servers, so as long as the platform is running, the game will be available. We trust Steam, and we’re sure you do too. 😉 Q: What can I do with skins? A: Everything that the game and Steam allow! You can collect them, showcase your collections in the game community, share them with friends, sell them on the Steam marketplace, and more.

rows.name: SKYGUARD
rows.short_description: Hordes of robot marauders have been attacking airships en route to the city. Join the SKYGUARD and shoot bots, buy guns, and fly your way to victory (and a paycheck) in this action-packed, couch co-op, third-person shooter.
rows.description_html: Hordes of robots have been attacking airships en route to the city! Join the SKYGUARD and shoot bots, buy guns, and fly your way to victory (and a paycheck) in this action-packed, couch co-op, third-person shooter. Xbox controllers required. Skyguard Mercenary Co. Armed with nothing but guns and attitude, play as a team of up to 4-players or strike it solo as you defend against waves of robots bent on grounding the fleet of airships you've been hired to protect. Glide from ship to ship to keep up with the robots' onslaught, and find some pocket change to spend at the gun upgrade shop while you do! Shoot with style Upgrade your gun with a variety of barrel and ammo types to really start bringing the firepower in your own, unique way. A BYU Center for Animation Student Project This project was planned, designed, and developed by a team of undergraduate students over the course of a year as a capstone, senior project for the BYU Center for Animation. We are extremely proud of the what we have accomplished during that time. With that said, you will probably encounter bugs and other issues during your gameplay experience that reflect both our experience (or lack thereof) and our tight development cycle. Many of us are moving on to jobs or graduate school, meaning updates post-release are very unlikely. Regardless, we appreciate your time and feedback, and hope you enjoy your time with SKYGUARD!

rows.name: Ultimate Chopsticks
rows.short_description: Chopsticks is a logic hand game with its origins in Japan. Players take it in turns to tap each others hands to knock each other out and win.
rows.description_html: Chopsticks is a logic hand game with its origins in Japan. It is played the world over. Players extend hands to towards each other with one finger out and take it in turns to tap each others hands. The tapped hand extends more fingers equal to the fingers on the hand that tapped it. A hand full of fingers is 'knocked out'. There are many variants of rules, many of which are captured here, including splitting fingers between hands, different number of hands and different number of fingers per hand. Play against an AI or another human or try and complete a set of challenges.

rows.name: Dusty
rows.short_description: Dusty is a third-person puzzle game focused on explore beautiful environments. Join archaeologist Dusty on his search for a mysterious civilization. Explore equipped with your extensible cane and notebook to resolve the past, the ways of the civilization and his technology of light.
rows.description_html: For years archaeologist Dusty has traveled the world discovering ruins, sharing his findings. One day, on one of his explorations, he finds a mysterious notebook. It contains a forgotten language, a location and list of dates written in his handwriting, but he doesn't remember ever writing them down. Following his instinct, he picked up his cane ready to unravel the mystery. Inspired by the Canary Shepherd's Leap , explore a world hidden in sand and stone, by jumping between canyons and landslides. Interact and see fauna and flora among beautiful landscapes . Understanding the past will take you into the depths of the planet. An intricate light technology covers the remnants of this lost civilization. Among its ruins solve its mechanisms and decipher its language in a system of various puzzles. Use your cane and observe the wildlife to solve it. Each step will lead you to the great discoveries. Always guided by your notebook, write down every discovery. Each new clue and each new relic has its own story. How did they live? Who did it? What did they think? What does it have to do with you? Follow your instinct and solve the past. This game is an university project by students at U-tad. The masters involved are design, art, programming, concept, modelling, animation, rigging and production from U-tad and the master's degree in musical creation and production from Loyola University.

rows.name: MatchOOlu
rows.short_description: A card matching game like no other. Test your memory. Test your dexterity. Explore your mind.
rows.description_html: MatchOOlu is a card matching game based on the age old game of using your memory to find and remove matching cards. There have been many versions of this type of game over the years, but rarely do these games offer more than a basic experience. MatchOOlu aims to surpass all previous entries into this genre by providing more tables, layouts, decks, and modes that have ever been available. Each deck, mode, and layout is designed to challenge your memory and dexterity in different ways. Are you better at memorizing shapes, colors, numbers, or letters? Perhaps it is easy to remember the position of a card in a grid, but what about a layout that is more complex? These are questions that you can explore in MatchOOlu as you test yourself and learn more about how your short-term memory works. You may also learn or discover new methods to memorize things that you can apply to other aspects of your life. MatchOOlu is not just a memory game though. The sight match mode will test your speed in recognizing and selecting card matches with all cards face up. This mode rewards sharp eyes as well as fast, accurate fingers and is a great way to show-off your skill with a mouse. Features 4 Different Match Modes: Blind, Sight, Study, Combo. 4 Different Match Counts: 2 card, 3 card, 4 card, variable card. Several Decks: 6 unlockable decks, each with 54 cards. Additional decks available for purchase. Several Tables: 15 different table materials to play on. Lots of Card Layouts: 25 different card layouts ranging from 12 to 54 cards. Additional layouts are available for purchase. About Monetization In order to reach as many players as possible, MatchOOlu is free to play game. That said, the free experience is substantial with the following content unlocked via the completion of in-game achievements: All game modes 6 decks 25 layouts 15 tables Additional layouts and decks will be purchasable as DLC. MatchOOlu contains no 3rd party advertisements, or paid consumables.

You may also learn or discover new methods to memorize things that you can apply to other aspects of your life. MatchOOlu is not just a memory game though. The sight match mode will test your speed in recognizing and selecting card matches with all cards face up. This mode rewards sharp eyes as well as fast, accurate fingers and is a great way to show-off your skill with a mouse. Features 4 Different Match Modes: Blind, Sight, Study, Combo. 4 Different Match Counts: 2 card, 3 card, 4 card, variable card. Several Decks: 6 unlockable decks, each with 54 cards. Additional decks available for purchase. Several Tables: 15 different table materials to play on. Lots of Card Layouts: 25 different card layouts ranging from 12 to 54 cards. Additional layouts are available for purchase. About Monetization In order to reach as many players as possible, MatchOOlu is free to play game. That said, the free experience is substantial with the following content unlocked via the completion of in-game achievements: All game modes 6 decks 25 layouts 15 tables Additional layouts and decks will be purchasable as DLC. MatchOOlu contains no 3rd party advertisements, or paid consumables.

rows.name: Chior Chapter 1: Hall Of Pillars
rows.short_description: You had a pretty rough fall. Trying to regain your composure you try to look around before realizing you can't see anything. Hope that your other senses will serve you better.
rows.description_html: When you lose your most valuable senses, a combination of the rest has to do. Feel, scream, smell, and manage. The game uses a variety of senses to aid the player throughout their journey. Feel: You feel around your surroundings in order to gather information from your current location. Smell: smell the surrounding environment in order to get a good indication of what kind of challenges may lay ahead. Scream: Scream out loud in order to deter your foes as well as draw attention from other NPCs. Step: Forwards, Backwards, Left, Right. Watch out for those who can see you, for there are plenty. There are several enemies who will take you into even deeper darkness. These enemies have unique ways of posing threats, whether by harming you directly, damaging one of your senses, or moving around. Make sure to learn how to deal with them in order to make sure you don't give them satisfaction. Solve puzzles and do anything and everything in your power in order to escape from this hellscape. Feel and hear to get clues and solve intriguing and challenging puzzles. Use all that is within your inventory to harm anything that tries to get in your way, and make sure you don't bump your head into walls when walking. Interact with dwellers in an unseen place. They have many stories and secrets to tell. There are many characters throughout the journey who can help you learn more about your surroundings and help you with your troubles. In an unknown place, having the ability to communicate properly with the locals is mandatory.

rows.name: Nalani: Legacy of the Ancients
rows.short_description: Embark on a mystical journey through the ancient world of Nalani, where forgotten legacies and dark secrets await. Master elemental forces, confront powerful foes, and uncover the hidden truths that shape the fate of the realms. A deeply immersive action-adventure experience.
rows.description_html: Nalani: Legacy of the Ancients - DEMO, is an immersive action-adventure game set in a mystical world where ancient powers collide with modern-day survival. As Nalani, a warrior chosen by the ancients, you must navigate a world filled with dark forces, uncover lost secrets, and harness elemental powers to restore balance to the land. The game combines intense combat, exploration of a rich, detailed environment, and a deep storyline that unfolds through a series of epic quests. Key Features: Epic Storyline: Embark on a journey that intertwines the destinies of gods and mortals, revealing the hidden truths of an ancient civilization. Dynamic Combat: Master the elements and engage in fast-paced combat against formidable enemies. Exploration: Discover breathtaking landscapes, from mystical forests to ancient ruins, each filled with secrets waiting to be uncovered. Character Customization: Evolve your abilities and tailor Nalani's powers to your playstyle as you progress through the game. Atmospheric World: Immerse yourself in a beautifully crafted world with stunning visuals and a hauntingly atmospheric soundtrack. Nalani: Legacy of the Ancients is currently available for Windows PC, with plans to expand to other platforms. Follow us on social media to stay updated on the latest developments and support this project as we continue to expand and bring the full vision to life.

rows.name: NOWV
rows.short_description: This game is inspired by Ningning, a member of the South Korean idol group aespa. It conveys the message that even one's flaws can become strengths through inner growth.
rows.description_html: 'NOWV' is a project for celebrating NingNing(a member of the South Korean idol group aespa) Play as a character who has disability of an eye and face challenges. It might be tough to get through, but you will finally find it possible to overcome the challenges by transforming the disability into the power of inner sight. This project has a set progression and ending; the player will experience the following message. 'Disability even could be the power to find the answer.' 'We can overcome whatever we think it as a defect by changing our mind.' [About Game Play] As a puzzle game, you will face a quest. Find the 'Real Key', and put it on the altar. You have only three chances. If you fail, you will get into the deeper mind, where you can get a hint to find the key. Finally, if you succeed, you can get the message of this game.

rows.name: GunStar's Gambit
rows.short_description: 'Really it's just a Clicker Game.' But.. The thrilling prospect of discovering hidden gold every three hours has captivated both adventurers and wealth seekers. GunStar's Gambit to provide players and sensation of constant and incremental progress.
rows.description_html: The capacity of GunStar's Gambit to provide players an sensation of constant, incremental progress and forward momentum even while they're idle is what makes it so captivating. These games can be left running in the background while a player attends to other chores. They can return at a later time to gather their resources and use them to purchase further improvements. The reward centers of the brain are triggered by this 'idle' gameplay loop, which results in an unquenchable urge to click. Wealth seekers and explorers alike have been enthralled with the tantalizing and exhilarating idea of finding hidden wealth every three hours. Fairy tales and legends are made on the very notion of finding priceless relics, priceless gems, or even lost fortunes on a regular, almost clockwork-like schedule. But, the alluring prospect of discovering such a cache of unexpected riches almost constantly could prove to be the experience of a lifetime for anyone brave enough to accept the task. Features (Clicker) (Multiplier every 100 Clicks) (Drops are currently in progress)

Move the sun from side to side to dodge lethal obstacles and collect stars to maintain your energy as you face increasingly hazardous challenges. ☀️ Dodge over 90 types of obstacles. ☀️ Master different game modes. ☀️ Complete special missions. ☀️ Upgrade your equipment. ☀️ Write your name at the top of the global leaderboards. DIFFERENT GAME MODES Collect stars and unlock new types of game modes. Each offers unique gameplay, giving you a fresh way to face the chaos. SPECIAL MISSIONS Take on unique challenges in special missions. Will you be able to complete each mission? EQUIPMENT UPGRADE Improve the different boosters to increase their positive effects and eliminate the negative ones. LEADERBOARDS AND ACHIEVEMENTS Compete for the top spot on the leaderboards, earn challenging achievements, and prove you have what it takes to control the sun's power.

rows.name: Inversed
rows.short_description: A short, interactive visual novel set in the mid-19th Century, in which a poet fights against time as she's writing the most important work of her life. Poetry is the answer, but what is the question?
rows.description_html: Inversed is a short, interactive visual novel set in the mid-19th Century, in which a poet fights against time as she's writing the most important work of her life. Poetry is the answer, but what is the question? <1,000 words (10-15 minutes of playtime)! Fully voiced! Animated mid-19th Century poet/goth girl! Choose words and create mysterious poems (minigame style)! Atmospheric narrative (lights out and headset on for maximum effect)! A Steam achievement! This game was made for the O2A2 VN Jam 2024, a micro Visual Novel jam with strict asset limitations and a 1000 word limit.

rows.name: Penelope Syndrome Preview
rows.short_description: You are not a hero. You are just an everyday average mechanic. You can fight, but without having the resources to repair damaged systems, you will die trapped with them.
rows.description_html: Deep in a heavily industrialized city, you find yourself trapped with numerous hostile cryptid monsters. Your only means of defense is a heavy wrench; the last thing from your life before all the chaos began. Fix and repair damaged systems that would allow you to progress and fight for your life until you can escape. Not everyone can be the hero... In this Standalone preview build of Penelope Syndrome you will get a small taste of what the full installment will have to offer. Including: Scavenging In the sewer systems and back alleys of IF City, you'll find scraps of useful material scattered in the far corners. Can you find enough to get by? Resource Management You will often find yourself in situations forcing difficult choices. Spend or save? The true question. Real Time Combat If you have the resources to fight, excellent. But knowing when to fight and when to run is a vital, if tricky, skill to master. Enemies will always be hunting you down, and you won't always be ready to face them. Randomizer System Every time you start a level, the items are procedurally placed. Meaning what you found may not be where you last found them on previous runs, or even there at all. This includes the monsters you face... Brought to you by Sakura and Crit

rows.name: Gridlink
rows.short_description: Gridlink is a fun, minimalist puzzle game with a simple premise - connect the numbers on a square grid with a single, continuous line that traverses all squares and does not cross itself.
rows.description_html: Gridlink is a fun, minimalist puzzle game. While the rules of the game are simple and easy to understand, the game offers enough complexity to keep you entertained for a few minutes or a few hours. The aim of the game is to draw a continuous line starting from the smallest number on the grid, to the next number in an ascending order and ending the line on the largest number on the grid. Each part of the line can be drawn separately, as long as it still respects the rules and at the end everything connects up to a single line. The puzzle is solved when all the numbers are connected, each cell in the grid has been passed and the line does not cross itself. If you make a mistake at any point in the game, you always have the option of unlimited UNDOs or clearing the board entirely. The pre-generated levels not to your liking? No problem! Use the custom level generator and setup the game grid with the size and difficulty of your choosing. FEATURES 150 pre-generated levels ranging from easy (6x6 grid) to difficult (20x20 grid) A custom level generator allowing you to choose any difficulty you want Minimalist design Relaxing background music Unlimited UNDO options if you make a mistake Dark Mode

rows.name: Frontline Inferno
rows.short_description: Step into fast-paced WWII combat with Frontline Inferno! Choose your side and engage in chaotic, arcade-style battles with dynamic respawns, customizable loadouts, and vibrant low-poly visuals. Join the fight and dominate the battlefield!
rows.description_html: Step into the boots of a soldier from the Axis, Soviet, or Allied forces and engage in thrilling, rapid-fire battles across colorful, stylized battlegrounds. Frontline Inferno is an action-packed FPS arena shooter that combines the historical setting of World War II with an arcade twist, delivering frantic gunfights, instant respawns, and total freedom in how you gear up. Non-stop, fast-paced combat – The action never slows down. Sprint, shoot, and respawn as quickly as you fall, keeping the gameplay constantly intense and dynamic. Whether you're flanking or charging head-on, there’s no time to breathe. Vertical, multi-layered maps – Battle across uniquely designed arenas inspired by real WWII locations. From bombed-out cities to underground bunkers, each map offers vertical gameplay and dynamic layouts that keep players on their toes. Master the environment to gain the upper hand! Vibrant low-poly visuals – Forget gritty realism – Frontline Inferno delivers the war in bright, bold, and colorful low-poly graphics that bring a playful and approachable vibe to the intensity of the action. It’s World War II like you’ve never seen it before. Customizable characters – Stand out from the crowd with a variety of customization options. From helmets and uniforms to accessories, personalize your soldier's look and hit the battlefield in style. Experience frantic multiplayer deathmatches where you choose your side in a battle between Axis, Soviets, and Allies. Join the fight in team-based skirmishes across small, intense maps designed for high-octane combat. No complex strategies – just raw, arcade action. Frontline Inferno is perfect for players who crave fast-paced, skill-based shooters with a nostalgic arcade feel. Ideal for both casual gamers looking to jump into quick, action-packed sessions and FPS veterans who love chaotic, no-holds-barred gameplay.

rows.name: REVEREX: DX
rows.short_description: REVEREX: DX is a 2-player asymmetric experience that blends platforming action and microgames on a visually stunning trip through the mind. Don the roles of Lab Technicians operating an experimental Coma Treatment device, explore the deepest reaches of the subconscious and rescue your patient!
rows.description_html: REVEREX: DX is the expansion and Steam release of the award-winning game, REVEREX. The scientists at the Zlyodomov Biomedical Manufacture Concern (ZBMC) think they’ve created a device which can pull people out of comas: the REVEREX. As their top technicians, its up to you and a friend to operate the machine through it’s maiden voyage, ensuring the stability of your patient’s mind and body through the entire ordeal. Navigate stages rife with unusual geometry, shifting gravity, and strange visuals. Complete challenging maintenance tasks to make traversal easier. Get out again before the dream world, or your patient, are destabilized for good. Run, Jump, and Parkour your way through the dream world. Work with your Vitalist to stay buffed and complete the operation. Execute stunts, skips and gravity defying tricks to reach the end before your patient is destabilized. Master minigames to keep your Navigator & patient stable. Clear debuffs as fast as you can to keep the simulation going. Give the Navigator powerful buffs to allow skips and access to hard-to-reach spots. Please note that REVEREX: DX contains flashing lights, bright colors and other visuals that may cause adverse effects to individuals with photosensitivity issues including Epilepsy. Exercise caution before playing if you have a history of photosensitivity.

rows.name: PUMPKIN PANIC
rows.short_description: COME TO THIS COZY FARM! Plant crops, take care of the plants, go fishing, or whatever you prefer, but have a good time! But be carefull, they say that strange things are happening in the area...
rows.description_html: Enjoy life on your small farm You have a lot of work to do. Plant, water, and harvest. This cozy and peaceful farm nestled in the heart of the forest has much to offer. Relax with some fishing Need a break? Fishing is just what you need! It's also a great way to earn some extra money. Beware of the darkness Perhaps things weren’t as pleasant as they seemed, it's become a bit eerie. Will you manage to survive? It won't be easy.

rows.name: Blood Rising
rows.short_description: This is a roguelike game with card battles as its core. Players need to play as a vampire ancestor to resist the attacks of a large number of adventurers and defeat three great heroes to achieve ultimate victory.
rows.description_html: This is a game about a vempire to against the adventurers. 1. You can use your skills to kill enemies and convert them to your servants to help fight, which is the only way for you to produce combat units. 2. Servants killing enemies will evolve into higher-level units, and the small dot in the middle of the card represents the number of enemies that need to be killed for evolution. 3. Killing enemies has a chance to drop items into the item compartment in the bottom right corner, items can assist in combat. 4. Killing enemies will drop souls, and you can upgrade skills on the talent interface after the battle is over with these souls. 5. When the player's health becomes zero, the battle fails. 6. There will be a total of three heroes and a large number of adventurers coming to attack. Defeating all enemies will lead to victory.

rows.name: Unholy Village Free Version
rows.short_description: Joseph and his two friends set out for their village to attend his sister's funeral. However, they strangely have an accident on the way. After the accident, Joseph's friends go missing. While trying to find his friends in an abandoned town, Joseph encounters strange events.
rows.description_html: Buy Original Version Buy Now Original Version of Unholy Village About the Game Unholy Village Free 1-Hour Version | This game provides access to 1 hour of free gameplay in Unholy Village. UNHOLY VILLAGE is a single-player thriller and survival game. The village you visit for your sister's funeral has actually been taken over by a demon, and you must try to break its curse. Once a peaceful village, it faced a mysterious curse. The village began to live in fear because of the infected entities that suddenly appeared. Over time, the village became an uninhabitable and cursed place. Try to save your friends After the car accident, you must search for your friends' traces in the abandoned village and find them before they die. rows.name: GGWG: Goose Game Without Goose
rows.short_description: A fantasy boardgame where you play an intrepid hero on a mission to free the kingdom from evil. Guide your adventurer through a dark abandoned castle filled with monsters, traps, and rival other paladins racing for glory. So, roll the dice. Your quest awaits!
rows.description_html: Roll-and-Move race boardgame where you become a intrepid hero on a quest to free the kingdom from an evil enemy. You will control your adventurer's moves and actions thrugh a gloomy abandoned castle, up to the last room. Monsters and traps will try to stop you from reaching your goal and other valiant paladins will race you to the glory. So, roll the dice. Your quest awaits! Advance in the castle, reach the last tile and be the first player to defeat the final boss! Strategically use 4, 6 and 8 sided dice to survive turn after turn! Face skeletons, ghosts and the legendary Black Knight! Get magical treasures like the Sacred Sword or the Lucky Amulet! Use shortcuts to advance faster through the castle! ...and above all, don't trust mirrors! rows.name: Keyboard Soldier
rows.short_description: A fast-paced action-survival game where you fend off hordes of zombies by typing words, level up to unlock powerful items, and strategize to survive as long as possible in an ever-challenging environment.
rows.description_html: Survive the Undead Onslaught with the Power of Words! In this thrilling action-survival game, you find yourself in a forest under siege by relentless zombies. But these aren't just any zombies—they are fueled by words. To fend off the undead, you'll need to type the words displayed above their heads. Each correct letter sends a bullet flying, and completing the word takes down the enemy. The words vary in difficulty, becoming more challenging as you progress through the stages. Level Up and Equip Powerful Items: As you eliminate enemies, you'll gain experience and level up. With each level, choose from a selection of common, rare, or legendary items to enhance your survival chances. Strategize your loadout with powerful items that can dramatically impact the outcome of the game, helping you survive longer against increasingly difficult waves of zombies. Master the Art of Survival: Explore three unique maps, each with its own difficulty curve, as you fight to survive wave after wave of undead. Face off against four different types of enemies: Normal Zombies: Regular words that keep you on your toes. Confusing Zombies: Their words shuffle every second, making them tricky to defeat. Rubbish Zombies: A chaotic mix of random letters and numbers. Small Zombies: These enemies have a single-letter word but are very fast. Harness Special Words and Combos: Use special word types to gain advantages in battle: Purple Words: Instantly kill three visible enemies. Blue Words: Freeze all visible enemies in their tracks. Gold Words: Achieve double gold amount. Build up your combo bar by typing accurately, multiplying your score as you chain together correct words. Be careful—one mistake can reset your combo and cost you valuable points. Certain rare and legendary items interact with the combo bar, adding even more strategic depth to the gameplay. Visit the Shop for Strategic Upgrades: Earn gold by defeating zombies and use it in the shop to fortify your defenses. Purchase barricades to block enemy advances, mines to decimate groups of zombies, mud to slow them down, and torches to light up the night. Careful management of your resources can make the difference between life and death, especially when darkness falls and the zombies become even more dangerous. Climb the Leaderboards: Test your typing skills and survival instincts as you aim to last as long as possible. Your performance will be ranked on global leaderboards based on your score and typing accuracy. Will you rise to the top and prove your mastery of words and survival? Key Features: Unique Typing-Based Combat: Use your typing skills to fend off hordes of zombies. Strategic Leveling System: Choose from a variety of items to customize your playstyle. Dynamic Shop System: Purchase and deploy defensive items to increase your chances of survival. Diverse Enemy Types: Each with unique challenges to overcome. Special Word Types: Gain powerful effects by typing the right words. Combo System: Enhance your score with accurate typing and strategic play. Challenging Maps: Three maps with distinct difficulty levels. Global Leaderboards: Compete against other players and show off your skills. Can you survive the zombie apocalypse using only your wits and your words? The undead are waiting...

rows.name: ArsGoetia
rows.short_description: In ArsGoetia, a thrilling platformer, you must navigate through treacherous traps and perilous landscapes to rescue kidnapped children and escape a dark, mysterious realm. Can you overcome the dangers and save them all?
rows.description_html: In ArsGoetia, you plunge into a world shrouded in darkness, where you must rescue kidnapped children from a hopeless and desperate situation. You must overcome rapidly moving traps and deadly obstacles, putting everything on the line to ensure the children’s safety. This perilous journey will push your reflexes and problem-solving skills to their limits. Each level is designed with new challenges and maze-like structures, filled with unforeseen threats and traps. As you rescue the children one by one, you must find a way to escape the forces of darkness. You will experience a desperate journey that goes beyond simply overcoming obstacles to saving the children. Moreover, as you save the children, you will encounter dialogues filled with their gratitude and fear. This game is not a series of easy choices. You must gather wisdom and courage to make difficult decisions, and if you fail, you will have to start over from the beginning. But do not be discouraged. Each failure teaches you a new lesson, helping you move one step closer. Show your courage by rescuing all the children from the dark castle and leading them to safety.

rows.name: PlayCOQ: The Coop Defender
rows.short_description: Prove your COQ's might in epic battles to save the coop from numerous foes! The Game is still in development!
rows.description_html: The game is in development and not completed yet, feel free to report to us all bugs and errors! Welcome to ' PlayCOQ: The Coop Defender ' – the game where humor meets heroism, and your courage is as big as your $COQ! Dive beak-first into a world where the stakes are high, and the adversaries are plenty. It's not just a game; it's a battle cry for all rooster warriors ready to defend their coop with honor, wit, and a bit of COQy attitude. In this feathery adventure, you’ll embark on a journey through 30 egg-citing levels, each with its unique challenges and adversaries. From the sneaky 'Fox Frenzy' to the explosive 'Tank Terminator' showdown, your mission is to peck, cluck, and crow your way to victory. Show those pesky pigs in 'Pig Panic' who’s boss, scatter 'Haystack Havoc' across the fields, and don't let the 'Coyote Clash' catch you off guard! As 'The Coop Defender,' your arsenal will be as diverse as the enemies you face. With every level, from 'Corn Convoy Crush' to the daring 'General's Last Stand,' your skills will be tested. Will you rise as the feathered hero the coop needs? Or will you end up as just another chicken crossing the road? But wait, there's more than just your beak and bravery. 'PlayCOQ' is evolving! What starts as a single-player journey to glory will soon expand into a multiplayer battleground where you can show the world how big your $COQ is. Compete against friends or foes in real-time battles to see whose COQ reigns supreme. And for the visionary poultry enthusiasts, 'PlayCOQ' is not just a game; it’s an entrance into the web3 universe. Soon, you'll be able to earn, trade, and show off your $COQ in ways you never imagined. The future is bright, and it’s filled with feathers! 'PlayCOQ: The Coop Defender' is not just about the battles; it’s about the laughs, the strategy, and the sheer joy of showing the world the size of your courage. With hilarious puns, egg-ceptional challenges, and a community of players ready to ruffle some feathers, this game is set to become your new favorite. So, are you ready to flap your wings, sharpen your beak, and defend the coop with every feather you've got? Now, download 'PlayCOQ: The Coop Defender' and let the world hear your battle cluck. It’s time to play, laugh, and let your COQ fight the good fight. Join the flock today and become the hero the coop deserves!

rows.name: 4fools1
rows.short_description: 4Fools1 is game combined bullet-hell with interactive-fiction. Player will play as an imperial soldier, navigating through choices to uncover different endings in the story mode. Alternatively, one can engage in direct combat with diverse enemies in level mode, striving to become the last survivor.
rows.description_html: This game is divided into story mode and level mode Story mode: You will play the role of an Imperial Assault Soldier, 4th Generation Dirty Blade, Person, fighting and achieving meritorious service from your hometown's Guard to joining the Imperial Army. Due to its exceptional combat capabilities, you became the captain of the Empire's secret special unit, Hidden Shadow, specifically responsible for clearing out those who are 'unfavorable' to the Empire. As retirement approaches, your biggest wish is to start a leisurely life with a pension. However, a task near your retirement breaks your original life trajectory, and according to your choices, you will embark on a new journey in life. Level mode: At present, there are 20 levels in the design. You will choose an initial character template and engage in a life or death space military competition with various enemies. All Try your best to survive! Game Features Each character has exclusive special abilities, such as the protagonist's decelerate greatly: Music and characters that match different scenes and storylines, as well as store sign girls with limited patience Difficulty and control adjustment, players can adjust the difficulty according to their needs in the settings interface: 135 items+33 weapons, randomly sold in the store, waiting for your selection Background of the story: 1562 years before the protagonist's story began, civilization had advanced to the point where it could harness the entire solar system's resources. Yet, even with this vast array of resources, the escalating population crisis persisted, and the resulting conflicts and struggles failed to be adequately contained. Eventually, this led to a devastating world war that engulfed the entire solar system, compelling all factions to engage in this horrific conflict. Over the course of thirteen centuries, this prolonged war continually accelerated technological advancements, promoted the emergence of interstellar voyage technology. There are constantly forces leaving for various reasons, embarking on interstellar voyages in an attempt to find new habitable planets. Ultimately, the war in the solar system was brought to an end by a new imperial power, a highly centralized entity born from the conflict. This empire sacrificed flexibility for efficiency, with everything theoretically under the rule of the emperor. After the war's conclusion, the empire entered a period of recuperation lasting 80 years. However, as the war ended and education became more widespread among the populace, an increasing number of people could no longer tolerate the myriad issues that accompanied the empire's monolithic structure. Beneath the empire's serene facade, turmoil brewed. In response to various considerations, the authorities began to gradually expand outwards, aiming to alleviate internal contradictions and seek to reclaim the various forces that had previously departed, incorporating them into the empire's domain in the hope of achieving a new balance. After a long voyage and a fierce competition for habitable planets, only a small fraction of spaceships that left the Solar System survived. The remaining spaceships, upon reaching the Eternal Stellar System and achieving stability, established the Interstellar Alliance 187 years ago. The primary objectives of the Alliance are to maintain the stability of the Eternal Stellar System and foster collaboration among all forces within it. The Alliance adopts a seat system, where each force holds a certain number of seats. 182 years ago, when the Empire began its expansion, the Alliance engaged in protracted confrontations and diplomatic negotiations with it, while gradually drawing in neutral forces to enhance its capability to counter the Empire's expansion. Prior to this, people who settled on other habitable planets aboard spaceships formed various neutral forces. These neutral forces developed their unique characteristics based on the demographics and traits of their respective spaceship populations, such as the business-oriented Free Planet PeaceRealm. The competition for habitable planets during interstellar voyages had led to lingering distrust among these neutral forces when interacting with each other. It was only after the Empire began its expansion that these neutral forces gradually set aside their prejudices and began seeking cooperation. However, some martial factions were not among them, as they preferred to develop through plundering, exemplified by the Planet Sinful, which, after three centuries of development, had become a haven for outlaws. The Interstellar Heroes organization was initially founded by a group of people who held a strong sense of justice. Having witnessed the rapid decline of morality under the influence of war and long voyages, they decided to join together with like-minded individuals to uphold chivalry and righteousness, with the hope of gradually restoring social justice in the interstellar society. 984 years ago, the ancestors of the WisdomScript tribe were also a group who fled the Solar System, with their spaceship filled with scientists and scholars proficient in biology or machinery. Prior to their arrival on Planet WisdomScript, the two schools of Life and Machinery gradually evolved. For 793 years after reaching Planet WisdomScript, the two schools have always helped and supported each other, working together to research technology and create many amazing innovations, with potential conflicts and disagreements largely concealed. One day, a significant mutation occurred among a large number of life forms, causing them to lose their sanity. Simultaneously, the control logic of newly produced machinery was tampered with and sabotaged by unknown individuals, leading to the experimental subjects and machines going haywire. The uncontrolled experiments and machines inflicted severe damage on the planet, destroying and burying most of the achievements of the planet's civilization, turning it into a desolate wasteland. Even today, one can still see the wandering, irrational mutants around the planet. The survivors became interstellar refugees, forced to flee Planet WisdomScript. Additional Info: When I was developing this game, I was in a very bad state and the final product I made did not meet my expectations. Therefore, I decided to make this game free and open source the code on GitHub:
