rows.name: Odyssey: Realm of Echoes
rows.short_description: A game that blends exploration and adventure , offering two modes. In the dynamic RPG mode, players confront powerful bosses and equip weapons and armor to build their strength. In the solo platformer mode, players navigate treacherous environments filled with obstacles to reclaim lost powers.
rows.description_html: A game that blends exploration and adventure , offering two modes. In the dynamic RPG mode , players confront powerful bosses and equip weapons and armor to build their strength. In the solo platformer mode , players navigate treacherous environments filled with obstacles to reclaim lost powers. Open-World RPG MODE - Solo and Multiplayer Explore an expansive open world filled with mysteries and challenges. Play solo, join friends, or connect to a server to team up with other players from around the globe. Journey across three diverse regions in search of answers about a long-lost fourth region . Equip weapons and armor to build your strength, improve your character's abilities and uncover secrets in a rich, interconnected world designed for cooperation and discovery. PLATFORMER MODE - Solo Only Step into the shoes of a legendary adventurer who disappeared 1,000 years ago. This solo-only mode focuses on precise platforming and reclaiming lost powers as you navigate challenging environments.

rows.name: Trapped
rows.short_description: Don't be TRAPPED by your life.
rows.description_html: Are You Satisfied With Your Current Situation? Are You Feeling the Pressure From Life? Are You Trapped By Life? A girl accidentally came to a world full of different caves, and she and a smiley face cube were looking for a way out. You will control this little girl to pass the levels and reach new caves one after another. The appearance of the cave is determined by the girl's cognition and memory. [Key Features] Explore caves, solving puzzles and find the exit. Having conversations with your smiley face cube fellow in each cave/level. 16 levels in total 4 different caves, 4 different topics(school, family, workplace, marriage). [tips] Keep an eye on the shiny areas in each cave/level. In order to make the exit/portal appear, the completion degree has to reach 80%, which mean you have to dig at least 80% of the soils in each cave. You may have to grab the keys to unlock the locks in the cave first. You may face spiders and other dangerous items, be careful!! Be aware that some of the content may be a little scary. [Special thanks] Russian localization: prosto_ratchet Special thanks to prosto_ratchet for testing the game and helping me find bugs!

rows.name: Tangram Collection
rows.short_description: Rediscover tangrams with Tangram Collection, a modern twist on the classic puzzle, offering over 100 challenges to solve.
rows.description_html: Tangram Collection reimagines the classic tangram puzzle with a modern twist. Originating from China, tangrams challenge players to fit seven geometric pieces, or tans, into a specific shape without overlap. In Tangram Collection , you'll be presented with five diverse bundles, totaling over 100 puzzles , which promise to get you through a minimalist and relaxing experience. The clean and intuitive interface sets you in a world where you solve complex problems, making it perfect for both tangram enthusiasts and casual puzzle lovers. Key Features: 5 diverse bundles of tangrams Over 100 puzzles to be solved Minimalistic design for serenity Find the evolution of Tangrams with Tangram Collection .

rows.name: Changeling VR
rows.short_description: ChangelingVR is a virtual reality first-person interactive mystery. Enter the thoughts of each one you touch: A different memory, a different world, a different story.
rows.description_html: ChangelingVR is a virtual reality first-person interactive mystery. You play as detective Aurelia Walker, a private eye gifted with the unique ability to dream-walk, allowing you to see the thoughts and memories of anyone you touch. This gift leads the Summers-Manalo family to hire you, their last resort in discovering what is wrong with their baby. As you make contact with the mother, the father, and their two kids, you must use your mystical powers, as well as your skills of deduction, to enter their minds and make your way through their manifested hopes and fears to save the young child. Currently we have a curated story mode experience that includes our 4 most developed levels. The Acts: The Detective You begin within the mind of Aurelia. Here you are introduced to player controls. After awakening in your apartment, you will make way to the Monelo-Summers home and meet people in the neighborhood. With a touch you may see their memories along the way. Angela: Mother's Fear As Angela, you float through the detritus of memory trying to capture her family before they disappear. you will use shoot out ties to both move and grasp your family. Dylan: I Got This Dylan, the father, is faced with a series of puzzles. This level has physical puzzles set in first his commute which bleeds into his home. The level is in prototype stage. Douglas: Scribbles and Dreams Dougie is trying to understand what is happening to his family through his drawings. In this level you slingshot your way through puzzle platforms in his sketchbook.

rows.name: Leapventure: Countless Biomes
rows.short_description: Test your skills in this obstacle-packed platformer! Dodge enemies, avoid the terrains features and aim for the highest score!
rows.description_html: Show off your skills as you leap through diverse lands filled with deadly obstacles. Start on easy difficulty to master the movement mechanics before taking on tougher challenges. You play as a wisp with the unique ability to wall-jump, which will help you dodge enemies and navigate hazards. This mobility is key to conquering the different areas. Play solo or team up in local co-op to tackle all levels together. Only one player needs to reach the checkpoint, with others being teleported to it automatically after it's reached. Aim for the highest score in increasingly challenging levels, including hard boss levels. Your score will be based on several factors, such as time taken, total deaths, lives collected, and levels completed. Wall jump will be present throughout the whole game. So learn and master them! Don't forget to dodge enemies! Complete challenges to obtain special skins for your character, emotes or accessories. Check Steam achievements and ingame achievement level for more.

rows.name: Avoidy Virus
rows.short_description: Survive lockdown with 4-16 players in this viral co-op game of tag. Avoid the virus, grab vaccines, and save your fellow humans. But beware - get sick and you'll join the viral invasion!
rows.description_html: Play with 4-16 players online in this co-op action game as you try to survive a viral outbreak! A pandemic has hit the world hard and Humans are stuck in lockdown. Viruses chase down the Humans who are running against time, and Humans are desperate for lockdown supplies (like toilet paper)! Will you avoid the Viruses and help to save humanity? Or will you get infected and become a Virus yourself? Find out in this quirky, intense game of tag, where you can play with your friends and survive the pandemic together! Ready to save the world? Then enter at your own risk...it's addictively sick! Win by avoiding infection until the timer runs out. React quickly to dodge Viruses and collect vaccines!] Use vaccines to cure yourself or teammates in the sick state. Collect toilet paper and coins while you avoid the Virus. Strategically use vaccines and work together to maximise your chance of survival. One or more random players start as Viruses. Chase and infect Human players by bumping into them. Coordinate with other infected players to corner Humans. Prevent Humans from curing each other to increase your numbers! Win by infecting everyone. Infected Humans enter a 15-second sick state with slowed movement. Sick players must find a vaccine or be cured by a teammate before time runs out. If not cured within 15 seconds, sick players turn into Viruses! Features Customisation: Choose your character's appearance with various Human and Virus skins (more coming soon!. Purchase skins and customization items with coins. Unlock special skins and items with toilet paper! Quick-join option to find online games fast. Cross-platform play between PC, Android, and iOS! Cool and crazy maps (more coming soon!)

rows.name: Spellchanted 2D Hidden Object Puzzle Adveture Tile-Matching
rows.short_description: Enter a magical world filled with legendary Fairy Tale characters. Become the greatest wizard. Help a young witch break an evil curse and save the Fairy Tale kingdoms!
rows.description_html: A Magical World In Peril In this world, every Fairy Tale you know is brought to life. Sleeping Beauty, Rapunzel, Prince Charming, Snow White and the Seven Dwarves are all here, ruling their own Kingdoms. But right now, they are in great peril... When a promising amateur witch named Alice decided to become a student of the great enchantress Circe, she certainly didn’t expect she would end up trying to save the Fairy Tale Kingdoms. And without your help, she won't succeed! Together you must stop Circe from becoming an evil Queen and taking over the world, in order to do that, you must break her curse! An Original Puzzle Gameplay Play addicting and original levels, where you try to find pairs or triples of identical objects before the time runs out. Remember that every level offers you a new mechanic. The objects you need to find could be differently colored, broken in halves, or of different sizes. You won’t see such innovative and challenging pair finding levels anywhere else! By playing these levels, you will earn stars, that you can spend on renovating your very own Wizard Mansion! As you renovate your adobe, it will be filled with flying brooms, mutant plants, and magical artifacts. Nobody knows what waits for you in the depth of the manor, keep on playing levels and earning stars to find out! A Magical Manor To Restore Every time you finish a set of tasks in your mansion, you’ll be able to play a jigsaw puzzle and unlock a new chapter of the story. Restoring your manor is fun and all, but remember we still need to stop the evil witch Circe! Every new chapter offers you different levels with original mechanics as well as unique locations to learn about. You can visit the Deep Dark Woods, Circe’s Tower, the Kingdom Of Sleeping Beauty and so much more! And if you ever feel stuck on a level, the magical power-ups, made for you by Alice, will surely help! Use the Fireflies to high-light a pair that is tricky to find, or the Time-Freezing Powder to have some extra playing time, your possibilities are endless! And Other Spellchanted Features: Choose your wizard and dive into a fantasy tale Help Alice stop the evil witch and become a master spell crafter Become an expert in 12+ pair finding mechanics Summon magical power-ups to find pairs and stop time Earn stars and rebuild your magical manor Unlock new story parts by solving jigsaw puzzles

rows.short_description: Ferret Frenzy is a compilation of four minigames with variants made for Pirate Software's 2024 Game Jam. Starring Ferrets and made for fun by Team Suspiciously Inconspicuous. It's FREE, what are you waiting for?!
rows.description_html: Ferret Frenzy is a free compilation of four minigames with three variants each, originally created for Pirate Software's January 2024 Game Jam.   Access the variants by going to Level Select or in the settings menu, changing the Variant Dropdown, and then clicking Play on the main menu. Requires a mouse for some minigames. Animal Wrangler: Play as Thor and try to wrangle some ferrets Catch as many as possible within the time limit ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── Find Us Ferrets: Find the ferrets in a simple hidden object minigame Variants will spice up the gameplay and make it so you have new rules to win! ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── Invasion: Invade and colonize Earth! Go crazy and make your perfect sandwich, or just aim for a high score

rows.name: Dairy of the Dead
rows.short_description: Embark on a cozy post-apocalyptic adventure! Join Alex and his snarky feline companion, Missus Whiskus, as they navigate the bizarre landscape of zombified suburbia in search of the ultimate treasure: MILK! Solve puzzles, engage in witty banter, and keep Whiskus happy in this comedy puzzle game.
rows.description_html: Gameplay Overview Dairy of the Dead is a short, point-and-click, narrative-driven casual adventure where the player must help out several denizens of the post-zombie apocalyptic world to feed your grumpy, undead cat! Throughout the game, you as the player will: Feel like you are traveling with a moody, zombie kitty who constantly wants your attention (but it also really hates your guts for some reason!) Be entertained by the interactions with the humans and zombies you encounter. Have fun playing simple puzzles that needs little to no directions Key Features Solve Puzzles: Help Milwaukee crack the code to the zombie outbreak, rescue Missus. Whiskus from the Divine Office Overlord Helen, help Grocery Attendant Tiffany the Zombie find her missing eye, and crack the Krypt Currency Bank vault to get Missus. Whiskus her MILK! Talk to zombies: These zombies are friendly… just a little slower and stiffer. Talk to them and learn more about the world and what society is like 7 days after the zombie apocalypse. Story Your zombie-cat, Missus Whiskus needs milk and the online delivery site is down! Play as Alex and brave the streets during the zombie-apocalypse. Meet zany characters both living and dead, solve their puzzles, and find Missus Whiskus her milk! You wouldn’t want to get on her bad side would you? World/Setting Sometime in the very near future, a virus broke out that turned half of the world’s inhabitants - animals and humans alike - into zombies. No one knows the cause or how it started… And at this point, nobody cares. After the initial panic, the living realized the undead weren’t the hostile, brain-eating hoard often portrayed in the media. The zombies retained their identity; they just often lost their train of thought, didn’t need certain bodily functions, and - as one newscaster put it - “they move at a very leisurely pace”. It was less of an apocalypse and more like the invasion of grandparents. Thus, humanity continues to march forward… Albeit more slowly and stiffly.

rows.name: Alpaca Party
rows.short_description: Alpaca Party is a free VR Party game. In this game, you can enjoy thrilling Werewolf gameplay, strategize with friends. You can also explore mysterious realms through portals,Whether you love strategic puzzles or relaxed social play, Alpaca Party has something for everyone.
rows.description_html: VR Werewolf Game You find yourself on a mysterious island where day and night alternate, and each moment is filled with challenges. During the sunny days, players transform into clever explorers, completing various mini-tasks to accumulate favor for their respective factions. This is the time to demonstrate your strategic and cooperative skills, as each choice may influence your fate. When night falls, the game enters its intense second half. Players are assigned to different factions by a mysterious force, and each faction has its unique missions. Your tasks may be secret or public, but the key is to complete them in order to secure victory. But don't forget, danger may lurk in the darkness, so always stay alert and protect yourself! Tour Mode While waiting for other players to join the Werewolf party, why not jump into our level mode to make your wait fun and challenging! Currently, we have two fantastic maps for you to explore: the Candleland filled with ghosts and the Mushroom Kingdom with giant mushrooms. Here, you will become a brave adventurer, using your jumping skills, carrying ladders, and other ingenious means to navigate through various meticulously designed levels. At the same time, don't forget to collect those shiny coins during your adventure; they can be used to participate in lotteries, winning accessories and items, and there are also Revival Stars for you to collect. Use them to exchange for unique special accessories and furniture, making your gaming experience even more enjoyable!

rows.name: Submerged Mystery: Takodachi
rows.short_description: Brave the Labyrinth and obtain lost powers to overcome great challenges in this Roguelike Dungeon-Crawler adventure.
rows.description_html: Synopsis Unravel the mysteries of the Ancient Ones in this top-down Dungeon Crawler RPG that features the Takodachis by Ninomae Ina'nis from hololive English, unlock new abilities from within and call upon the skills of past Takodachis to reach the Ancient Ones. Collect potent items as you traverse the Labyrinth and utilize a plethora of Elemental Affinities to defeat the many Takodachis who guard the Labyrinth. Danger looms with Abyssal Mode which causes Takodachis to be lost forever should they be defeated in battle. Controls Z : Confirm / Normal Attack X : Cancel (Hold to run) C : Grid View A : Item Menu S : Set Move D : Diagonal Walk Enter : Menu (Control bindings can be remapped in game for both keyboard and controller.) The Lexicon Found on the second to last floor of every Labyrinth is an archive of past Takodachis as well as the abilities they had once possessed. Takodachis who use the Lexicon will be able to learn a variety of Assist Skills that they would not be able to learn through leveling up. The very first floor of the Labyrinth even has a special Lexicon that grants access to any Skill that has been previously recorded, including Melee and Magic based Skills. Affinities Melee and Magic based Skills will oftentimes possess an elemental Affinity which deals double or half damage to certain kinds of enemies based on their innate weaknesses. Using a Skill that an enemy is weak to will grant an Encore that lets the user perform another action before their turn ends. Enemies are also able to receive an Encore by dealing effective elemental damage. Elemental Affinities in Submerged Mystery: Takodachi are classified as Fire, Aqua, Elec, Wind, Light, and Dark. Skills are divided into three categories, Melee, Magic, and Assist. Melee Skills require a percentage of the user's HP in order to be used and the damage is determined by the user's Strength stat as well as the enemy's Defense stat. Magic Skills require a fixed amount of the user's MP in order to be used and the damage is determined by the user's Magic stat as well as the enemy's Resistance stat. Assist Skills require a fixed amount of the user's MP in order to be used and perform a variety of effects such as raising stats, lowering the enemy's stats, recovering health, and more. Ailments Certain offensive Skills have a percent chance of inflicting an Ailment onto a Takodachi on hit, there are even Assist Skills that are guaranteed to inflict an Ailment if they are not avoided. These Ailments have many different ways of affecting combat before they wear off after a certain number of turns. Burn : Deals a fixed amount of damage across 4 turns. Poison : Deals damage that gradually increases across 4 turns. Shock : Increases the odds of taking a Critical hit. Lasts for 2 turns and wears off upon taking damage. Dizzy : Greatly lowers the accuracy of Skills and attacks. Lasts for 2 turns and wears off upon taking damage. Blind : Halves the damage dealt by offensive Skills and prevents the evasion of incoming attacks. Lasts for 3 turns. Seal : Prevents Assist Skills from being used and causes any selected Assist Skills to fail. Lasts for 3 turns. Stats Each Takodachi possesses a distinct Stat spread that becomes more pronounced with each Level Up. Consult the Status Menu to see if a particular Takodachi is a balanced, mixed attacker or if they specialize in one kind of attacking type. HP : The amount of Health Points a Takodachi has to withstand hits. MP : The amount of Magic Points a Takodachi has for Magic based Skills. Strength : Determines the amount of damage dealt by Melee attacks. Defense : Reduces the damage that would be taken from Melee attacks. Magic : Determines the amount of damage dealt by Magical attacks. Resistance : Reduces the damage that would be taken from Magical attacks. Speed : Determines the turn order for using Skills and attacks. Affects the accuracy and evasion of attacks. Luck : Increases the Critical hit chance and decreases the odds of taking Critical hits. Affects the accuracy and evasion of ailments. Filters Within the Settings Menu of the Main Menu is a distinct feature that applies a palette of 4 colors onto the game for added replay value. Select between 22 palettes that are themed around hololive English as well as 3 retro inspired palettes. Swap between the modern and classic 8-bit soundtracks for the vintage experience. Disclaimer Submerged Mystery: Takodachi is not affiliated with hololive or Cover in any way. This project was made within the hololive Derivative Works guidelines. All visual and sound effect assets were specifically made for this game. All music assets within the game were derived from content belonging to hololive and Dova-Syndrome.

rows.short_description: Welcome to the Fap&Click world. Fap&Click is a new, breathtaking clicker with elements of a collection game. Here your main task will be to click on a gorgeous Anime girl, gather coins and collect cards. Click, enlarge your collection and remember to put your hands on the table. See you in the game.
rows.description_html: About Fap&Click This is a new game in the clicker genre where you have to click on the attractive Anime girl and earn points. For these points you can add more cards to your collection. Don't worry, if your mouse breaks, you will get a new collectible card every 3 hours. Game Features: More than a hundred unique cards of varying levels of rarity and nudity Girls for every taste and color Ability to exchange cards with other players around the world Pleasant visual style Sound accompaniment recorded by the real masters of their craft

rows.reviews_html: “Can someone please tell my brain that collecting a quintillion gold coins is not humanly possible? But here I am, hours in, tirelessly mining pixels for a goal that literally can't be reached. Plot twist: it's just a demo! The game stops, my addiction doesn’t. I’m convinced the developers have mastered some kind of mind control. My entire life now revolves around chasing digital gold like it’s the fountain of youth, even though the last level is essentially a mirage. 10/10 would recommend – for anyone looking to ruin their sleep schedule!” ☢️💤

rows.name: Zombie Murder 3
rows.short_description: Take control of a powerful steel mech and smash crowds of zombies to pieces with driving heavy metal! Zombie Murder 3 is a new part of the Top Down Shooter game with a bunch of levels, bosses and upgrades.
rows.description_html: Zombie Murder is back! Take control of a powerful steel mech and smash crowds of zombies to pieces with driving heavy metal! Zombie Murder 3 is a new part of the Top Down Shooter game with a bunch of levels, bosses and upgrades. The game is back after many years and this time it goes 3D! The upgrade option has reached a new level: now you have as many as 25 skills that can be developed to enhance the robot's abilities. As well as permanent skills: Dash and Red Barrier, which allow you to dodge enemy attacks or completely absorb enemy shots, converting them into health and energy. Four difficulty levels: from the simplest, which everyone should be able to handle, to the insanely difficult one, where you will have to masterfully control the mech and wisely use all the resources of your robot. - 3D Top Down Shooter! Take control of a steel Mech and destroy zombies! - 25 skills to upgrade. - 4 difficulty levels. - Various monsters and bosses! - Dynamic gameplay to the fiery Heavy Metal!

rows.name: STAaRS
rows.short_description: In STAaRS, you play as a volunteer investigating unknown activities in a simulated environment. During a 24-hour test, events appear randomly, and you enter the virtual house via a portal to investigate. Observe, categorize, and report events based on Space, Time, Anomalies, and Reality.
rows.description_html: Step into the Unknown Welcome to STAaRS, a unique investigative simulation where you take on the role of a volunteer tasked with uncovering unknown activities. In STAaRS, you will navigate a 24-hour test where strange events appear randomly in a virtual house. Investigate and Report When an activity is detected, you'll enter the virtual house through a portal to investigate. Your mission is to observe, categorize, and report these activities, which are divided into four key areas: Space, Time, Anomalies, and Reality. Test Your Skills This simulation challenges your observational abilities and decision-making under pressure, preparing you for real-world scenarios. Key Features 22 unique mysterious activities to investigate and uncover. Dynamic 24-hour test with random event occurrences (each test up to 25-30 real-time minutes). Interactive portal-based investigation system. Detailed categorization and reporting mechanics. Immersive environment designed to test your skills. STAaRS offers a challenging and immersive experience where every decision matters. Are you ready to face the unknown?

rows.name: It Paints Me
rows.short_description: Take the role of a painter struggling to finish his masterpiece in this short Gothic horror visual novel about art, pain and love.
rows.description_html: Every night, you awaken in your studio and paint your masterpiece. Or, at least, you try to. Oh, if only your muse would return. If only lifting your brush didn't fill your fingertips with agony. It Paints Me is a short Gothic horror visual novel about art, pain, and love. It features: 3.9k words 3 endings hand drawn artwork original music partial voice acting Art, music, story, programming & sound design by ENDYSIS. Casting by Phebe Fabacher Voice Mixing by Mark Mullens Cast Sam - Callum Sanders Marie - Shellah Sam's Mother - Maria Corcobado Sam's Father- Ethan Grant

rows.name: Death Becomes You: Yuri Onsen Vacation
rows.short_description: Alice and Sophie finally have the time to go on an onsen retreat. However, their trip gets inturrupted by mysterious magic. The last straw: 'MY FOOD!!!' Will the couple be able to find the culprit and finally enjoy their vacation?
rows.description_html: 'Magic exists all around; your whole body and mind can be a conduit.' Alice and Sophie have been in a long distance relationship since they graduated from the Ira Royal Academy for talented magic users. Sophie has stayed on campus as a researcher, while Alice ventured to the world outside of academia. Finally, Sophie gets some time off, and the couple reunites for an onsen vacation! However, things are not how they seem at the hot spring hotel... several mysterious events appear to target the Alice and Sophie. Is the hotel haunted, or is there a powerful magical enemy afoot? *Death Becomes You: Yuri Onsen Vacation* occurs after the events of *Death Becomes You*. It is not required to have read *Death Becomes You* or *A Summer with the Shiba Inu* by our developer friends, but there are some references to the two games that readers may appreciate. Features Kinetic visual novel (no choices) ~8,000 word story Original sprite art, and 2 CGs (cutscenes) Extras gallery Exclusive developer Q&A Steam achievements Original game jam version launch option

rows.name: Clicker Cuties - Anime Idler
rows.short_description: 💗 Idler Clicker + Dating Sim 💗 Meet virtual cuties, care for them, and get to know their stories!
rows.description_html: ✨ Features: [*] Unlock 20+ Virtual Cuties with unique personalities and stories [*] Collect, click, and craft Eggs to hatch rare Cuties [*] Unlock full storylines [*] Lightweight idle design — runs minimized [*] Deeper updates coming every few weeks 🍵 Let’s get cozy Love comes to those who click in this comfy, chaotic casual idler. Get a random new cutie every 3 hours — or even sooner if you tap fast and use the right strategy. Some cuties are ultra-rare. Some are… legendary. 💘 Build your dream collection Each cutie has her own personality, dialogue, and now — a full story you can unlock as you bond. Meet tsunderes, yanderes, dommy mommies, goth gfs, bunnygirls, weirdos, hackers, artists, witches, dreamwalkers, disaster lesbians, and more. New cuties and features are added with every update. Whether you’re a casual collector or a long-term simp strategist, there’s always someone new to fall for. 🥚 Crafting, Clicking, Candies & More Not just luck — you can now collect shards and craft Eggs to hatch your favorite cuties. Tap to build affection, reduce cooldowns, and earn higher-tier drops. The deeper your account level, the better your chances at scoring rares. And yes — candies are still here. But they’ve been… rebalanced. 🍬 📖 Storylines & Secrets Each cutie now has a full storyline you can unlock right in their gallery. Learn their pasts, obsessions, heartbreaks, philosophies, and maybe… what they think about you . 😳 Some are funny. Some are spicy. Some are deeply unwell. You’ll love them all. 🌸 Runs on a potato Clicker Cuties runs on just about anything. Minimize it, let it idle in the background, or go full speedclicker — it won’t complain. ~ I can’t wait to meet you, anon ~

rows.name: Short Memories
rows.short_description: A short story about life shared through the conversation of two women sitting on a bench.
rows.description_html: Short memories is a very short game about two women discussing on a bench. This game is about normalizing being and becoming old . You'll navigate trough different minigames, led by a dialogue, that will show you different aspects of elderliness. Being or becoming old and all that it implies, is a very normal part of your life. Short Memories tries to not talk about what we are scared of during this stage in life (sickness, death or other difficulties). But just showing two people that are living it having a normal conversation. The game is playable only with your mouse and you'll have to finish 3 minigames to reach the end of it. All of those minigames are difficult in their own way, and they try to translate what difficulties older people can encounter. All that translated to clunky game mechanics. You'll also follow a short conversation between our 2 ladies on their favourite bench, talking about what life was, what it is and what it will be. Hope you enjoy Short memories , it was made with love ! ✨✨✨

rows.name: Crystal Cave
rows.short_description: Can you focus and conquer the trials set by the three wizards? Don’t waste a moment—dive into this unforgettable adventure now!
rows.description_html: Crystal Cave is a labor of love from three passionate developers, designed to immerse you in a magical world that will linger in your heart long after you’ve finished playing. Darkness has fallen over a once-prosperous kingdom, defeating its only protector — Princess Ailina. It’s up to you to step in and rescue the princess from her dark chains. To do so, you must overcome trials to obtain the magical flower Nilúria, which holds the key to saving Ailina and the entire kingdom. What Awaits You: Stunning Graphics: Explore the enchanting Forest of Dreams, where a green-clad wizard reveals your quest. In the Sunset Meadow, where the sun never sets, meet two more wizards and face their trials. First, you’ll guide the flow of water through darkness and light. Then, you’ll strategically place crates in their hidden shadows. Your journey culminates in the breathtaking Cave of the Moon Falls, where you can fill your flask with magical water before returning to the Forest of Dreams to complete your quest. Engaging Dialogues: Uncover the deep secrets behind the kingdom’s power struggles. Perhaps the princess isn’t who she appears to be. Along the way, the World Bees will impart three important lessons. Challenging Mini-Games: Experience simple yet satisfying mechanics like dragging objects and directing water flow. Hints are available to guide you, including shadows for crate placement and a full-fledged hint system in the water channeling mini-game. A Short but Sweet Adventure: While the journey includes several mini-games, it’s designed to be completed in a concise and fulfilling playthrough. .

rows.name: A Shade Darker Than Gray
rows.short_description: Short dark comady, casual story game about 15 minutes in length for a play through. There're 6 different endings and 8 collectibles, and 3 different mini games. Over 100+ funny quotes to find throughout and loads of side events to interact with.
rows.description_html: Short. casual, dark comady story game based in a fictional gray world. You go to school and make your way through the day while trying to survive. You may be bullied, insulted, bruised, and cut but at least your alive right? It's like a visual novel but with walking to make you feel more alone! This game only has one available language, which is English. Come down the rabbit hole of depression, exploring a boring color scape as you try to make sense of the world in one day. This game uses primarily four to five colors to give off that extra sense of dread. Where better to go than school! Missing the bus here is no big deal you can walk. But remember it's just a game! About 15 minutes in length for a play through. There're 6 different endings, 8 collectibles, and some mini games. Side content such as small event. and funny quotes. Over 100+ different quotes to find throughout. Unfortunatly there is no controller support as of this version.

This game uses primarily four to five colors to give off that extra sense of dread. Where better to go than school! Missing the bus here is no big deal you can walk. But remember it's just a game! About 15 minutes in length for a play through. There're 6 different endings, 8 collectibles, and some mini games. Side content such as small event. and funny quotes. Over 100+ different quotes to find throughout. Unfortunatly there is no controller support as of this version.

rows.name: Pick Me Pick Me
rows.short_description: Pick Me Pick Me throws you into the battlefield of love where you face off against a friend to charm quirky AI characters powered by a Large Language Model. Play your cards right to outflirt your rival to score the perfect date; embarrass yourself or fail to impress, & you'll get kicked to the curb!
rows.description_html: Get ready to charm, sabotage, and survive the most ridiculous speed dating showdown ever.  Will you win love - or get left in the dust? What Players Are Saying: 'I had to bite my tongue to not laugh when I saw your character turn around with that clown nose!' - Realsleepy, Discord member Compete against friends in chaotic AI speed dating! Flirt, sabotage, and outwit rivals to win bizarre characters' hearts. Fast, funny, and full of surprises-who scores the perfect date? Compete directly against your friends in fast-paced speed dating battles! Use your wit and strategic sabotage cards to out-charm your rival and win the affection of bizarre, unforgettable AI characters. It’s a hilarious test of friendship and flirting skills! Love is war. Flirt accordingly. Want to practice your game or just enjoy some digital romance? Chat one-on-one with over 20 unique AI characters-from smooth talkers and adorable weirdos to fantasy creatures with very human problems. Build relationships at your own pace without interference. Not a fan of the official cast? Design your own bizarre dating prospects! Upload custom models, set personalities, and challenge friends with your creations. Share your wildest characters with the community and keep the chaos fresh. 🎮 Key Features   Dynamic AI conversations: Experience unique, real-time interactions every playthrough powered by a Large language model 20+ dateable characters: Meet distinct personalities with unique quirks and stories Cross-platform play and save: Challenge friends anywhere on PC and mobile. Strategic skill cards: Buff yourself or sabotage your rival's romantic moves for hilarious outcomes. Multilingual matchmaking: Play with friends around the world, supporting English, Spanish, German, French, Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, Cantonese, and Portuguese. User-Generated Content: Create and share your own characters via Workshop for endless dating possibilities Global leaderboards: See how you rank in the chaotic speed dating scene. Players speaking different languages can play together! Since Pick Me Pick Me is available in multiple languages, you can face off against your friend even if you don't speak the same language. Argue in the language you’re most comfortable with and challenge your opponent, no matter what they speak! 'Pick Me Pick Me' is a perfect party game for players who enjoy competitive, yet lighthearted, gaming experiences with a unique AI twist.   💸 Free Trial + In-Game Currency Unlocks Start playing for free - everyone gets trial rounds to experience the chaos! Full access requires purchasing in-game currency (which covers AI token costs) to unlock unlimited dating battles, custom characters, deeper relationship building, and premium storylines. rows.name: 9 Years of Dreaming
rows.short_description: 9 Years of Dreaming is an action-adventure game where you explore the subconscious of Jacob, who has been in a coma for nine years after a car accident. Trapped in a surreal dreamscape, Jacob meets Lumby, a mysterious guide who helps him on his journey to wake up.
rows.description_html: 9 Years of Dreaming is an action-adventure game that takes you deep into the subconscious of Jacob, a man who has been in a coma for nine years following a devastating car accident. While his body remains in the hospital, Jacob's mind is trapped in a surreal dreamscape where he meets Lumby, an enigmatic character who seeks to guide him towards awakening. Within this dream, Jacob must journey through five unique worlds, each representing a different aspect of his psyche. These worlds are guarded by powerful bosses that Jacob must confront and defeat if he hopes to escape his prolonged slumber and return to reality. Throughout the game, Jacob unlocks three distinct abilities that aid him in his quest, offering new ways to overcome challenges. Mastering these abilities is key to progressing through each world and ultimately piecing together the path to his awakening. Along the way, Jacob will encounter a variety of NPCs—each with their own stories, struggles, and conflicts. These characters add depth to the world, revealing fragments of lore and engaging Jacob in arguments. The enemies that Jacob faces are manifestations of his inner fears and doubts, though they are unaware of the role they play in his dream. Instead, they exist as obstacles that Jacob must overcome, representing the internal battles he must face to regain consciousness. Will Jacob manage to wake up and escape the labyrinth of his own mind? Or will he remain lost in the dream forever? 9 Years of Dreaming is a poignant exploration of the human spirit, resilience, and the power of the subconscious.

rows.name: Dungeon CEO Demo
rows.short_description: Take on the role of a Victorian-era Dungeon CEO. Manage resources, recruit monsters, and customize your deck to dominate turn-based fights. Outwit your opponents, acquire coins, and lead the Dungeon Company to victory in a world teeming with adventures and gods.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Dungeon CEO's chaotic world, where Victorian-era charm meets strategic mayhem. As the newly appointed CEO of Dungeon Company, you are forced into a world where gods, adventurers, and strange entities lurk beyond the dungeon's walls. What is your mission? Keep your monster workforce alive, manage resources effectively, and earn as much gold as possible—all while striking a delicate balance between profit and danger. Every decision in this roguelike strategy card game matters. Hire the best personnel, build a powerful deck, and be ready for tough turn-based fights. Each card in your deck can change the tide of battle by commanding and boosting your forces, allowing you to outwit and overpower your opponents. Defeat enemies to earn cash, grow your dungeon empire, and bring the Dungeon Company to the pinnacle of grandeur. Will you take your firm to new heights, or will you fall to the turmoil that lurks below? **Note : This game is a free demo. The dev team needs support and feedback to continue development.

rows.name: Garden Rivals
rows.short_description: A PvP game where 4 to 8 players in teams of 2 use spells, stealth, and sabotage to grow their flower and outsmart the competition.
rows.description_html: 🌱 Garden Rivals Garden Rivals is a team-based competitive multiplayer game where strategy, bluffing, and chaos collide in fast-paced, intense matches. Play in teams of two and battle around a central objective: the fertilizer . Sabotage, defend, deceive, and cast your spells at the right moment to gain the upper hand and lead your team to victory. Every match is different. Every decision matters. ⚔️ Tactical, Fast-Paced Gameplay Short and intense matches, perfect for playing with friends Risk management: attack, defend, or fake your intentions Gameplay focused on reading your opponents , not just reflexes 🧙‍♂️ Unique Classes to Master Choose your playstyle among several classes with distinct mechanics: Blinker – mobility and repositioning Trapper – area control and traps Harbinger – pressure and long-range threats Echomage – strategy and action duplication Each class brings a new way to play… and to surprise your opponents. 🎮 Online Multiplayer & Team Play Online multiplayer for up to 8 players Team-based gameplay (2v2) Integrated voice chat Dynamic lobbies with team management Coordination and communication often make the difference. 🎁 Progression & Cosmetics Experience-based progression system Seasonal Battle Pass with 25 unlockable skins Purely cosmetic rewards — no gameplay advantages Customize your look and show off your progression ❄️ Seasonal Content The winter season brings a wave of new content: Dynamic snowy maps Updated visual and audio atmosphere Exclusive seasonal rewards 🌼 A Game in Constant Evolution Garden Rivals is actively updated with: New content Balance adjustments Performance optimizations UI and usability improvements Community feedback plays a key role in shaping the game’s future. 🌿 Enter the arena.

rows.name: OVER ROAD
rows.short_description: An engaging grab action game that takes place on a road floating in the air
rows.description_html: Enjoy the BIC 2024 exhibition game “OVER ROAD” on Steam! “OVER ROAD” is a game where a household robot that lost its owner in a sudden disaster floats into the air and moves through the destroyed roads with one robot arm. Grab action on destroyed roads From safety poles to CCTV, the roads are full of robots that don't like fragile household robots. “Pull” and “drag” with your robot arm to avoid danger and move through the roads. How home robots solve problems If you manage to get through the line of fire and grab the enemy, their weapon is now in your hands. Grab the safety pole to shoot a laser, and grab the CCTV to jump far! Towards the end of the collapsed city When the power is turned on, all that remains is the coordinates of the last detected location of the owner. Can the small household robot meet its owner again along the shattered road?

rows.name: Parkour Chief: Chapter Secret Agent
rows.short_description: In the future, you must retrieve a stolen hyper-advanced CPU from the CyberQuark Corporation before they use it to create destructive AI robots. In Parkour Chief: Secret Agent, you'll use your parkour and stealth skills to infiltrate CyberQuark's headquarters and recover the CPU.
rows.description_html: In the distant future, a hyper-advanced CPU has been developed by the government. The CyberQuark Corporation has stolen this powerful technology to create a fleet of destructive AI robots. As a secret agent, your mission is to retrieve the stolen CPU and prevent CyberQuark from unleashing their deadly creations. In Parkour Chief: Chapter Secret Agent, you'll need to combine parkour and stealth skills to infiltrate CyberQuark's headquarters. Navigate and fight your way through a series of obstacles and challenges to recover the CPU. Do you have what it takes to stop them? The game, developed entirely by Mustafa Soltanian Fard Jahromi, complements his Parkour Chief YouTube series.

rows.name: Onto Maizilind Unto Infinity
rows.short_description: OMUI is a first-person narrative horror game set in an alternate reality 1970s Iran. A playful childhood afternoon in Tehran descends into the trauma of the Iranian Revolution, transforms into a nuclear apocalypse, and concludes with the suicide of my Uncle Ramin.
rows.description_html: Onto Maizilind Unto Infinity (OMUI) is a first-person narrative horror game about humankind’s suicidal instincts, interweaving grand geopolitical destruction with personal tragedy. It unfolds as a world-ending nightmare: a playful childhood afternoon quickly descends into the trauma of the Iranian Revolution, transforms into a nuclear apocalypse, and concludes with the sudden death of my Uncle Ramin. Players should expect a deeply personal and tragic experience designed to place you in the shoes and eyes of a child in my own family as the Islamic revolution came and went, followed by the Iran-Iraq War, scattering us in a hundred different directions and uprooting thousands of people from their ancestral land. Except, in this reality, the nuclear apocalypse comes in its place - and who but Ramin can stop it? You will take on his impossible quest to save his family as the nightmarish reality collides with hallucinations of his real life. What features should one expect?  Explore a 1970s style Tehran apartment in a first-person perspective.  Play with toys, examine photographs, and struggle to understand the relationships of an Iranian family. Watch the Shah on TV, try to flip the channels, and piece together the dynamic political situation of Iran from the arguments of the adults.  Listen to the Shah's final speech to the Iranian people. Run for your life and seek shelter. Control Ramin as a pilot in his battle against nuclear demons and repressed memories.  Confront Ramin in his final moments.  Immerse yourself in the primeval destruction of Iran.  Find your family in the spirit world and prepare for your journey to the Upper Realm. Coming to peace with what happened was a long and arduous process. Making this game helped me immensely, but sometimes what was meant to be a way to let go grows into a means to hold on. It is with gratitude to the spirits and to history that I present the complete first edition of Onto Maizilind Unto Infinity in time for the tenth anniversary of a world without Ramin. It's true that the past is the past, but that doesn't mean we can't change how we feel about it. For the world to heal, we too must mend.  Let us end the war with reality together.

rows.name: ALFRED IS A BAD GUY
rows.short_description: ALFRED is a BAD GUY is a multiplayer board game that combines dice duelling, lying and investigation. Each player has a secret role and a different objective in the game. Bring out your dice and your lying skills to win in ALFRED is a BAD GUY!
rows.description_html: ALFRED is a BAD GUY is a board game for 4 to 8 players in which you have to team up to defeat the Boss of the board in a dice duel. But beware: some players won't have the same objective as others. Secret roles are assigned at the start of the game, dividing players into 2 teams. The good guys, whose aim is to defeat the Boss, and the bad guys, whose aim is to keep the Boss alive and eliminate the good guys. To achieve your goals, you'll need to roll dice to scour the board for items, bonuses and extra dice. You'll start the game with a 6-sided die, while the Boss will have a 100-sided one. You'll need to move around the board to find the bonus squares you need to better equip yourself before facing your opponents. The Boss is accompanied by 4 lieutenants who give him bonuses and strengthen him. But he can also count on the players who will take on one of the bad guy roles, among them: - The Reaper , who will cut off the heads of pawns who talk too much. - The Puppeteer , who will take control of another pawn and do whatever he likes with it. - Marc , who will mark your dice to make them explode in front of the Boss. The good guys won't be left out in the cold, either: - The Hero , who will have a more powerful die for his fights. - Urgle , who will defy death and make the Grim Reaper bow. All other players will be Simple Pawns . In short, gather your friends, log on to your favorite voice chat software, grab your dice and your investigative skills to find out who the bad guys are and defeat the Boss of ALFRED is a BAD GUY!

rows.name: The Icarus Experiment
rows.short_description: Plumb the depths of a doomed leviathan on a mission to save a dying solar system. Unravel a mystery that could alter the fate of humanity. Created with Adventure Forge, this showcases the power of the no-code tool that lets you craft your own narrative-rich experiences.
rows.description_html: Gameplay Overview The Icarus Experiment is a narrative-driven, choice-based adventure game set aboard the UNE Hyperion, a spaceship that harbors deep secrets following a catastrophic experiment gone awry. In this tension-filled, sci-fi universe, players navigate through a series of puzzles, moral dilemmas, and hidden dangers, unraveling the mystery of what led to the ship's demise. Key Features Branching Narrative: Choose how you wish to proceed with different events throughout the game. Each decision can have an impact on what you learn throughout the game and can influence what you choose to do. Environmental Investigation: Discover what happened on the UNE Hyperion by inspecting terminals, reading ship logs, and discovering clues in the environment. Point & Click Puzzles: Players navigate the space station, interact with objects and solve puzzles through a simple 2D point-and-click interface. Customize your character: Choose from 3 distinct uniforms and access unique dialogue options based on what you choose. Solve the Mystery: Find out what the mission of the UNE Hyperion is, who you are, and what happened to the ship. Story You wake from hypersleep on the seemingly deserted UNC Hyperion, with no memory of your identity or your mission. Discover the truth behind the disaster that befell the ship and its crew. What is The Icarus Experiment and what happened to it? Explore 4 distinct areas within the UNC Hyperion: The Hypersleep Chamber, Crew Quarters, Engine Room, and The Bridge.

rows.name: Streamer's Journey 💖
rows.short_description: Streaming for attention seemed harmless at first... but Tania’s dive into online fame quickly spirals into a dangerous world of exploitation and desire. Will she find herself, or lose everything? 😈
rows.description_html: STORY Tania is a young streamer with low self-esteem who, manipulated by her friend Eidzoku, dives into the world of explicit photo shoots and online exploitation. In search of validation and confidence, she receives a flood of attention, but her life gradually spirals out of balance. Her dependence on online approval deepens, and her real-life relationships fall apart. As Tania becomes entangled in manipulative, toxic relationships and subjected to humiliation by a group known as 'The Aristocrats,' she is victimized by violence. However, her inner traumas and deviant tendencies only intensify. As she sinks further into this dark world, Tania loses control of her life, becoming a victim of her own insecurities and destructive desires. GAMEPLAY This story-driven visual novel delves deep into the emotional and psychological journey of the protagonist, Tania. The game focuses on exploring her inner struggles, insecurities, and the impact of toxic relationships through a captivating narrative. Players will experience detailed and explicit sexual scenes that are integral to revealing Tania’s state of mind, reflecting her complex emotions and evolving psychological state. The linear storyline emphasizes the character’s development, offering a raw and immersive exploration of her life. The game also features a wealth of high-quality artwork, ensuring that every scene, whether intimate or emotional, is depicted with careful attention to detail and artistry. FEATURES • Exciting story • Thrilling art

rows.name: 鸭蛋Duck Eggs
rows.short_description: Welcome to 《Duck Eggs》, an innovative game that mixes desktop pet, collection, trading, clicking and surprise elements together. In this world, you'll collect all kinds of rare and fantastic duck eggs . Eventually, you can exchange them for money to help the duck go back to her original world.
rows.description_html: Game Introduction Duck Eggs is an electronic pet currency trading game that will lay eggs for you when placed on your desktop! These eggs can be traded on the Steam marketplace for real currency! Duck Eggs can also serve as your electronic pet, placed on your desktop without any unnecessary pages obstructing your view, with a pure lace design that allows you to change the size of the duck at any time. Every 3 hours, the duck will lay an egg, increasing your collection of various types of eggs, making your Duck Eggs egg collection more diverse. The drop probability of each level egg: Common egg: probability of obtaining 60% Premium egg: probability of obtaining 39% Rare egg: probability of obtaining 0.99% Legendary egg: probability of obtaining 0.01% Game Features: The duck lays eggs, increasing your collection of various types of eggs Won't take up too much of the screen, with a lace-in design that allows you to place it on your desktop, giving you your own electronic pet. At the same time, we will continuously update and add various new types of eggs, so that you can continuously obtain a variety of Duck's egg eggs. Story Introduction: Li Yaya is the younger sister of Li Haoya, a popular live streamer. One day, she followed her usual routine and traveled to the forest for a trip, but on her trip, Li Yaya got lost and accidentally traveled to the cyberspace, getting trapped as a desktop pet here. Li Yaya cannot leave, but she gained a strange ability, that is, randomly summoning items from other worlds, but the items summoned by Li Yaya will all turn into eggs and be born by her, this power is uncontrollable, Li Yaya will unconsciously lay an egg every three hours. Originally, she was troubled by this, until she found out that these eggs can be sold for money, and with money, it seems that she can trade with the cyberspace god and leave here. To leave here, Li Yaya asks for your help, as long as you help her sell the eggs, she will share her profits with you and serve as your electronic pet always

rows.name: IdleTale
rows.short_description: IdleTale is an incremental clicker RPG game. Kill enemies to gain Gold, use it to produce even more Gold while you're not playing and complete quests, explore dungeons, collect loot to gear up and improve your character with all the Talent trees and the further Ascension Upgrades!
rows.description_html: Idletale Is An Incremental/clicker Rpg Game. You'll find yourself in a world where everything can only get bigger - specifically talking about numbers! Kill enemies to gain Gold, use it to produce even more Gold while you're not playing and complete quests, explore dungeons, collect loot to gear up and improve your character with all the Talent trees and the further Ascension Upgrades! All of this will only lead to your power skyrocketing like you would never imagine. Start this journey slowly, and day by day unlock more features until there's nothing left to achieve - or so you'll think. Then you'll reset your progress. But for good! This will only multiply your next game's numbers and experiences by a LOT! (And unlock even MORE features) The basic mechanic isn't much different from any other incremental game - tap the screen, get resources. Use those resources to buy more resources that will exponentially generate more of that same resource, breaking the barrier of the thousands, millions, billions or quintillions.The way you get resources (in this case, Gold) is by killing monsters. You tap the screen, you land a hit. Enemies have HP, you deal damage. Enough hits, the enemy will die. Then there's a respawn time, which is affected by upgrades too. You can, like in any other incremental game, buy passive income upgrades (a.k.a. gains per second), which will grant you Gold each second, depending on the upgrades you bought and the number you have. There's also the other type of upgrades - the one that boosts everything else, such as 'enemies drop more gold', 'this thing gives you more gold per second', or 'you deal more damage with each attack'. Then there's the Skills tab - your character will progress through these. More Strength, more raw damage. There's a number of factors that alter the value of Strength that you will discover along the game. Agility increases your critical strike chance, and Wisdom increases the damage bonus each critical hit benefits from. Then there's the Gear tab. Like in any other RPG, you will loot gear and equip it to benefit from its stats. Mostly addressed towards combat, but remember combat is your main Gold source. There's the Dungeons , which are small instances with a few waves of enemies and then a final boss. Kill the boss, get XP and loot. Ez pz. You won't be able to spam dungeons to level up, as your character will have another resource called 'Stamina' and you will run out of it rather quickly. Stamina is also used to travel between places. Codex . Here you'll gather information about all the enemies you come across. You can level those enemies up to make them drop more gold, XP and loot (but they'll also have more HP!). Talents . They will be your bread and butter as you progress through the game. Not only they will look cool and make you feel you're rushing through the content, but also they'll synergize with other features to skyrocket your power. There'll be three different trees. Glory (Ascension) . Just like in any Incremental game, there's an Ascension system, which will boost your stats by a LOT and unlock interesting features. Raids . We talked about Dungeons before, and now there's Raids! Some sort of Dungeons but with several floors, way harder and intended for end-game content. Their rewards are stronger than most items, and you can defeat a raid once a day. There's also an Achievements system!

rows.name: Skylax! The Lab Runner
rows.short_description: Skylax! The Lab Runner is an FPS game that presents you with tight gameplay and good mechanics. In the game, you can pass levels either by hiding using the invisible mechanic or by fighting against enemies. And after each level you will upgrade your weapons and utilities!
rows.description_html: (IT'S ONLY WINDOWS SUPPORTED FOR NOW. YOU MAY ENCOUNTER UNEXPECTED BUGS WITH LINUX & MACOS) Skylax! The Lab Runner is an FPS game. The game presents you a tight gameplay and a little story behind. If you like run and gun games with good graphics, you are in the right place! The story begins when people realize that the evolving and powerful artificial intelligence is somewhat out of control. Robots that do every human job 100 times more efficiently and better than humans are now starting to take over the world in terms of population. In this case, while humanity is trying to cope with both increasing unemployment and corruption, it decides that robots should be taken under control and if necessary, they should regress to the technological level of 100 years ago. For this reason, the robots are now politely blocked and locked in laboratories. When the robots realize this situation, they search for a life source that they can be self-sufficient in. In the meantime, they create an artificial life source called a life sphere, which is similar to the soul in humans. The robots that integrate these into themselves also now have human emotions compared to normal robots. Here, our main character, SKYLAX-#0001, is the robot that has opened its human emotions the most among all robots. In fact, it has reached a level that can be called half-human - half-robot in terms of feelings. The main purpose of conducting tests in the laboratory is to create a useful but also controlled robot prototype. Skylax, the last test subject of the laboratory, is subjected to a final test for both humanity and himself due to the resources that are now running out. An offer is made to Skylax in the laboratory. If he passes the test, the life resources that have been taken from the robots by humans so far will be given back to them and all robots of the same race as Skylax will be reorganized and offered to come back to life, and thus the adventure begins.

Skylax, the last test subject of the laboratory, is subjected to a final test for both humanity and himself due to the resources that are now running out. An offer is made to Skylax in the laboratory. If he passes the test, the life resources that have been taken from the robots by humans so far will be given back to them and all robots of the same race as Skylax will be reorganized and offered to come back to life, and thus the adventure begins.

rows.name: Mythos Interactive Game Collection
rows.short_description: Mythos Interactive Game Collection is a diverse anthology of 9 indie games, each offering unique gameplay experiences across various genres. From thrilling action to mind-bending puzzles, this collection showcases the creative spirit of Mythos Interactive.
rows.description_html: Mythos Interactive Game Collection is a curated anthology of 9 diverse and captivating indie games, brought to you by the creative minds at Mythos Interactive. This collection showcases the studio's unique approach to game design, offering a variety of genres and experiences that cater to all types of players. Whether you're seeking the thrill of fast-paced action, the challenge of mind-bending puzzles, or the joy of immersive storytelling, the Mythos Interactive Game Collection has something for everyone. Each title is a labor of love, crafted with attention to detail and a passion for innovation, ensuring hours of entertainment and discovery. Key Features: 9 Unique Games: Dive into a wide range of genres, including action, puzzle, adventure, and more. Each game offers a distinct experience, with its own unique mechanics, art style, and narrative. Engaging Gameplay: From strategic challenges to heart-pounding action, these games are designed to keep you engaged, whether you prefer solo play or competitive fun. Creative Freedom: Explore worlds and stories brought to life by passionate developers, with original concepts and fresh takes on classic genres. Indie Spirit: Support an indie studio dedicated to pushing the boundaries of game design and delivering high-quality experiences without the constraints of mainstream development. hether you're a long-time fan of Mythos Interactive or discovering their games for the first time, this collection is a must-have for any gaming enthusiast. Join the adventure, explore new worlds, and experience the magic of indie game development with the Mythos Interactive Game Collection! Game Included in this collection: Hefty Heights - Test your stacking skills and precision as you carefully balance everyday objects to hit the perfect weight. Every move counts in this thrilling challenge of balance and strategy! To The Last - Dice are your biggest weapon. The Dice-slinger is a fearsome cowboy who uses magical dice as ammunition. Reload your shotgun with dice and blast your demonic enemies right back to Hell, but be warned, if you run out of dice, it's Game Over. 25 Vikings - Fight to the bitter, icy end as you control a clan of desperate Vikings captured by the hordes of Helheim. Brave the cold and free your warrior brothers and sisters as you battle the enemies of the All Father. Internal Medicine - Play as a young professional in the medical industry as she struggles with the taking care of her ailing patients, while attempting to maintain a modicum of sanity. The Case of the Deviant Detective - Follow the case work of Charlie, a new detective on the force, whose Uncle happens to be a part of the mafia, and needs a few favors. Are you ready to REWIND the tapes in this puzzling Noir mystery, and set the fate of these suspects forever? Runaway Robot - Aid a mad scientist as he attempts to regain control of an army of little robots. Help these little robots find their way in the world. Test your smarts in this cute and cuddly robotic adventure! What could go wrong? Terminal Charge - Take on the role of a desperate air-traveler as they zig-zag through a bustling airport while attempting to reach their gate and keep their phone alive. Rush from outlet to outlet and evade your fellow pedestrians as you make your way to your gate. But beware, gate changes are frequent and this airport was built by a madman! Kinoko Dash - A short, fast-paced casual game about clicking and dashing around while chopping angry mushroom enemies into tiny bits. Keep your enemies at a distance while timing your clicks just right to execute a SUPER DASH! Prepare to Re-Pair! - Help these cute robot friends find their way back together in this charming and hectic puzzle action game.

rows.name: Mariana
rows.short_description: In Mariana you are dropped into an unknown trench to explore. You will find fantastical creatures and rare artifacts. Fight bosses and mini-bosses in order to dive as deep as possible and uncover the mystery of the trench.
rows.description_html: Mariana is an underwater exploration and Metroidvania indie game. In this game you are dropped into an unknown trench to explore. You will find fantastical creatures and rare artifacts. Fight bosses and mini-bosses in order to dive as deep as possible and uncover the mystery of the trench. Warning: Game contains imagery that may be harmful to players with photosensitive epilepsy or similar condition. Features: Fight in adrenaline filled boss battles against giant sea creatures. Explore strange worlds and discover fantastical creatures. Customize your character with fun equipment. Tame and fight alongside a pet catfish. Original Art and Soundtrack. Horror elements with a sprinkle of humor. An original (hot) character with trades and dialogue. Hidden lore and mysteries to be uncovered.

rows.description_html: WELCOME TO DEMONOPHOBIA COMPANY! Demonophobia Company is a RPG + Visual Novel game that shows 'Angel of glory, Gloria' experiences after she disguises herself as 'Demon of vanity, Burbary' and joined the company. Synopsis 'Angel of glory, Gloria' got a mission to disguise as 'Demon of vanity, Burbary' and joined 'Demonophobia Company' to find the hell's significant secrets, since hell's atmosphere will be much relaxed due to the big festival. Burbary tried to pretend like a normal demon, however, she met 'red eyes' and fainted. Some translation might be not smooth. I ask for your understanding.

rows.description_html: Game Features Quick & Addictive Gameplay Aye Leon is a bite-sized blast of fun! With a full play through clocking in at around 20 minutes, it's perfect for quick breaks or replayable marathons. Easy to pick up, tough to put down. 7 Unlockable Achievements Turn a 20-minute run into a full-on challenge! Test your reflexes, find every hidden gem, and snag all 7 achievements. Quick game, lasting bragging rights. Original Soundtrack by Jetset2one6 Immerse yourself in a unique audio experience with exclusive tracks crafted by music producer Jetset2one6. Two Distinct Game Modes Choose your challenge: Lives Mode : How long can you last with limited lives? Timed Mode : Race against the clock. Can you finish the game before time runs out? Gravity called. Leon declined.... GO LEON!

rows.description_html: Create your own aquarium and collect fish. Swimming in a comfortable environment, the fish will bring you peace and happiness. You can do other tasks or whatever you want. rows.name: Deathblossom
rows.short_description: Deathblossom is an action / kinetic novel hybrid about love and mortality. Enjoy visual novel-style written scenes and high-octane top-down action as you shoot, kick and blast your way through an erotic revenge thriller. Featuring a fully illustrated story by Zoquete!
rows.description_html: A hard-boiled private eye finds herself stranded in a forgotten corner of New Mexico after following a mysterious paranormal lead. All seems lost until the case finds her instead - and once the truth is revealed, there's nothing holding back the lusty desires of the dead. Deathblossom is an action / kinetic novel hybrid about love and mortality. Enjoy visual novel-style written scenes and high-octane top-down action as you shoot, kick and blast your way through an erotic revenge thriller! In Deathblossom, get ready to: Experience a fully illustrated story by Zoquete Reach a variety of lewd scenes with different situations, noncon and occasional bondage Enjoy custom SFX mixed with the help of the OpenNSFW project Wield your revolver and kick some undead ass in bullet time with challenging but accessible action gameplay Explore a supernatural Western noir setting with existential themes Meet a colorful cast of period-inspired characters And don't forget the spectacular soundtrack by the underground musicians of Newgrounds: featuring Creo, Tanger, JamesHeart, Demonicity, AriaLowo, the Lemons, and many more amazing artists! There's no going back from a deal with Death itself. If you enjoyed this free project and want to get some behind-the-scenes content, consider buying the supporter pack, available as DLC on Steam! This is an optional way to support the solo developer if you want to see more fun, unique NSFW projects in the future. Thank you for your support and enjoy the game!

rows.name: The Tower of Aether
rows.short_description: Welcome to the Tower of Aether—a labyrinth filled with countless doors, At the heart of this Tower lies the Heart of Aether, an artifact of unimaginable power, coveted by all who enter. But only one player will emerge victorious, claiming the ultimate prize.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the Tower of Aether —a sprawling labyrinth filled with countless doors, each one leading to untold mysteries and treasures. At the heart of this Tower lies the Heart of Aether , an artifact of unimaginable power, coveted by all who enter. But only one player will emerge victorious, claiming the ultimate prize. In Tower of Aether , players must navigate this ever-changing maze, learning the hidden lore of the Tower and uncovering its ancient secrets,. Will you forge alliances and collaborate with others, or betray your companions to secure your own path to the final door? The choice is yours. Key Features: Open one door per hour in the mysterious Tower, each leading to hidden realms—choose wisely, as every decision could bring you closer to the ultimate goal or further from it. Work with or deceive players from around the world, as only one correct door exists on each floor—cooperation or betrayal could be the key to finding it first. Discover and trade ancient relics, mysterious artifacts, and powerful tokens tied to the Tower's factions, each revealing deeper secrets about its hidden lore. Only one player will claim the ultimate victory—will it be you?

rows.name: Small Dragon Big Appetite
rows.short_description: 'Join Chompie as he explores the enchanted bunny kingdom, hunting down bunnies to satisfy his insatiable appetite! How many days can you go without starving?'
rows.description_html: Welcome to a world where bunnies aren't just cute—they're your key to victory! In this fast-paced, score-chasing adventure, your goal is simple: eat as many bunnies as you can to rack up points and dominate the leader board. But beware—these bunnies get stronger the deeper you go, offering greater rewards but also tougher challenges. Will you rise to the top by devouring the fiercest bunnies and claiming the highest score? It’s time to find out—happy hunting! Hunt as many bunnies you can before the day cycle ends. Avoid incoming attacks from stronger bunnies, survive as long as possible during your hunt runs. Find potions that aid you with abilities such as invisibility and faster movement.

rows.name: Knuckle Knockout
rows.short_description: An action-packed 2D platformer fighting game for 2-4 players. Brawl with friends across three unique maps with the first player to win three rounds taking the crown!
rows.description_html: Knuckle Knockout is an action-packed 2D platformer fighting game for 2-4 players. Brawl with friends across three unique maps: clash in the lush greenery of Misty Mountains, battle amidst the rotating chaos of Pinwheel Pyramid, and face off atop the towering heights of Zero Hour Tower. Be the first to win three rounds and claim the crown! Master Knuckle Knockout’s unique Extend-o fist mechanic to punch opponents or launch yourself for thrilling platforming maneuvers. Customize your play style with 8 distinct emotes —4 for your character's face and 4 for their fist. Supports 2-4 gamepads , including Xbox One and PS4 controllers, for an engaging multiplayer experience. Designed for accessibility , the game offers features to support players with color blindness, dyslexia, and motion sickness. Everyone can join the fight! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.description_html: It's a game where you can clear stages using a keyboard. In this game, if you play the stage, the character walks to the right. It's a simple game where you press the alphabet key on the keyboard to safely let the character pass through before you reach this character. If the character passes through, the word clear will appear in the background. If so, well done, you cleared one stage. If you can't press the right alphabet key on the keyboard, the game won't be able to clear.
