rows.name: Play Together
rows.short_description: Play Together is a popular casual social networking game enjoyed by players worldwide. Express yourself through character customization, decorate your home and host Home Parties for a fun time with friends. Enjoy tons of content with friends from all across the globe!
rows.description_html: It's the most popular social networking game chosen by players worldwide with over 200 million downloads! Play Together offers more convenience by letting you link your mobile device with Steam. Log in and start making friends with various people from all over the world in Play Together! Key Features Create a character that is uniquely you and make all kinds of friends. Customize your character from head to toe in your unique style. The possibilities are endless with a variety of skin tones, hairstyles, body types, and costumes to choose from. Maybe, you'll find that special someone in your life as you chat with and befriend various people from around the world! Turn your humble abode into the home of your dreams and invite friends over for a Home Party! Choose a house from a wide range of styles and concepts and a countless number of furniture pieces to make your dream home fantasy a reality right before your eyes. Invite friends over or visit their homes to catch fish, play games, chit-chat, and role-play together for hours of fun! Have a blast playing fun-filled minigames with friends. Demonstrate your mad gaming skills in minigames such as Game Party, where the last one standing from 30 players wins, Zombie Virus, Obby Race, Tower of Infinity, Fashion Star Runway, Snowball Fight, Sky High, as well as an assortment of additional minigames found only in school. Go around various fishing spots to catch new species of fish and show them off to others! Catch over 600 species of fish in places such as a pond, the sea, and even a swimming pool. It's never a dull moment as new fish to catch are constantly added to the game. Every fishing spot has fish not found in other spots, so visit them all to complete the collections listed in the Illustrated Book and show people what you've caught! Catch insects and lizards with your friends in various locations or go excavate rare ores and fossils. Over 300 species of insects are thriving throughout the in-game world! Also, look forward to a unique and fun experience digging up dinosaur fossils and rare diamonds. Sell your findings directly or show off your accomplishments to your friends by beautifully displaying them for double the satisfaction. Take good care of pets of all shapes and sizes. Add a spoonful of happiness to your life in Play Together with one of many adorable and ever-present pets that follow you around, such as puppies, kittens, ponies, and more. Take walks with your critter friend or cruise the streets together in your dream car. Also, don't miss your chance to own special limited-time pets available only during specific periods.
rows.about_html: It's the most popular social networking game chosen by players worldwide with over 200 million downloads! Play Together offers more convenience by letting you link your mobile device with Steam. Log in and start making friends with various people from all over the world in Play Together! Key Features Create a character that is uniquely you and make all kinds of friends. Customize your character from head to toe in your unique style. The possibilities are endless with a variety of skin tones, hairstyles, body types, and costumes to choose from. Maybe, you'll find that special someone in your life as you chat with and befriend various people from around the world! Turn your humble abode into the home of your dreams and invite friends over for a Home Party! Choose a house from a wide range of styles and concepts and a countless number of furniture pieces to make your dream home fantasy a reality right before your eyes. Invite friends over or visit their homes to catch fish, play games, chit-chat, and role-play together for hours of fun! Have a blast playing fun-filled minigames with friends. Demonstrate your mad gaming skills in minigames such as Game Party, where the last one standing from 30 players wins, Zombie Virus, Obby Race, Tower of Infinity, Fashion Star Runway, Snowball Fight, Sky High, as well as an assortment of additional minigames found only in school. Go around various fishing spots to catch new species of fish and show them off to others! Catch over 600 species of fish in places such as a pond, the sea, and even a swimming pool. It's never a dull moment as new fish to catch are constantly added to the game. Every fishing spot has fish not found in other spots, so visit them all to complete the collections listed in the Illustrated Book and show people what you've caught! Catch insects and lizards with your friends in various locations or go excavate rare ores and fossils. Over 300 species of insects are thriving throughout the in-game world! Also, look forward to a unique and fun experience digging up dinosaur fossils and rare diamonds. Sell your findings directly or show off your accomplishments to your friends by beautifully displaying them for double the satisfaction. Take good care of pets of all shapes and sizes. Add a spoonful of happiness to your life in Play Together with one of many adorable and ever-present pets that follow you around, such as puppies, kittens, ponies, and more. Take walks with your critter friend or cruise the streets together in your dream car. Also, don't miss your chance to own special limited-time pets available only during specific periods.

rows.name: The Demon's Bride
rows.short_description: Run from the Demon Bride, where you must outwit and escape from the clutch of the Demon Bride to save your niece, Nina. Solve challenging puzzles while hiding from the relentless Demon Bride in the world of Indonesian cult horror experience.
rows.description_html: You must save your niece, Nina, while escaping the merciless the Demon Bride You have 5 days to find her and escape before it’s too late. Will you survive or become her next victim? Hide and outsmart the Demon Bride. Watch your step! Every move counts to stay alive. Uncover the mystery to help you escape. Use the items around you! Enjoy retro graphics reminiscent of classic games, delivering a deep sense of nostalgia and a chilling horror atmosphere. Experience a gripping horror atmosphere inspired by local Indonesian folklore and stories. Choose from three characters, each with unique abilities and strategies. Can you save Nina and escape in time?

rows.name: Countdown
rows.short_description: Countdown is a short visual novel that tells the story of an ordinary individual's journey through their thoughts and emotions as their life approaches its end. The plot includes critiques and discussions of social issues such as life, family, the workplace, and the healthcare system.
rows.description_html: Game Description Countdown is a short visual novel that tells the story of an ordinary individual's journey through their thoughts and emotions as their life approaches its end. The second playthrough of this game is intended for revisiting the story. The content is exactly the same as the initial playthrough, with no changes whatsoever. Experience Emotional Interaction: Although the game does not have branching choices, players can connect with the protagonist's emotional journey through reading the text, enjoying background music, and viewing beautiful illustrations. Immersive Storytelling: Every page is carefully designed to ensure that players are fully immersed in the protagonist's world. Reflection and Contemplation: The narrative includes critical reflections and discussions on societal issues such as life, family, workplace, and healthcare systems.

rows.name: Veil Transfer
rows.short_description: An atmospheric, arcade first-person horror game where your sole job is to root out the Veils who take on the identity of humans. Interrogate and execute monsters that hide within people, and protect yourself while managing your ammunition and transfers.
rows.description_html: 'Congratulations and welcome onboard as a new enforcer of the NVTP, the New Veil Termination Program! Feel proud as we work together to protect our country from this unforeseen threat.' Veils are a rising threat as they hide within human bodies in order to carry out malevolent will. As an NVTP enforcer, your job is to pick out and execute any Veils who hide among the human population. You may interrogate, threaten, torture - whatever it takes for you to determine someone's innocence. If you accidentally let a Veil through, you'll have to make sure they don't get their revenge on you while you continue your job. A short, replayable horror experience I made for fun. First person gameplay PSX + Analog horror styled graphics AI generated dialogue for unique interactions Deduce someone's innocence by carrying out your own tests Carry out your own executions with your trusty shotgun Resource management - carry out your tests while dealing with any intruding Veils. You only have a few shells, shall you save them for executions or defend yourself? Infinite, replayable gameplay Upgrade system Unique yet simple Veil types to discover and learn Hidden mechanics to discover and learn

rows.name: Blood Strike
rows.short_description: Gather your friends and dive into the action-packed Battle Royale, Squad Fight, or Hot Zone like there's no tomorrow! Blood Strike offers a wide range of playable Strikers, each with a unique active and passive ability letting you deploy drones, shield walls and everything in between.
rows.description_html: Gather your friends and dive into the action-packed Battle Royale, Squad Fight, or Hot Zone like there's no tomorrow! Blood Strike offers a wide range of playable Strikers, each with a unique active and passive ability letting you deploy drones, shield walls and everything in between. Customize your weapons to your liking and get ready to prove that you have what it takes to come out on top! Adrenaline Packed Combat Having the guts to pounce on your enemies and pursue them in tense firefights is key to your success in Blood Strike. Tactical decisions matter, but don’t expect to camp a spot unchallenged! Meet The Strikers & Their Deadly Abilities Pick your favorite hero each with their unique active and passive skill and bring defeat to your opponents! Enhance Your Arsenal Take it to the next level by customizing your weapons and selecting unique loadouts. Team Up For The Perfect Strike Blood Strike lets you team up and play team-based modes quickly. Finding your friends, adding them to your squad and jumping in a firefight as a team couldn't be easier! Intuitive Controls. World Class Precision. Blood Strike offers the smoothest aiming, shooting, running, and gliding experience. Enjoy smooth graphics and responsive controls, even on low-end machines, and fully immerse yourself in the action without hardware worries. Let nothing stand between you and that perfect victory.

rows.name: Steel Swarm: APOCALYPSE
rows.short_description: SSA is a 5v5 twin-stick shooter MOBA with vehicular combat in a fully destructible city. Fight huge swarms, complete missions, and blast through buildings to ambush your enemies. Positioning matters and every shot is a skill shot!
rows.description_html: - ONLY A USERNAME IS NEEDED FOR ACCOUNT CREATION; NO OTHER INFO IS REQUIRED - Move Swiftly, Strike Vigorously You command a mighty Xalium Battle Tank (XBT) with WASD controls. Click to move is possible too, but swift positioning is vital because XBTs take more damage from the sides and even more from the back. That makes positioning key to landing your shots. In fact, you must aim well with every shot, because every shot is a skill shot! Battlefield of Swarms With 100+ minions per team, per avenue, per minute , the battlefield is teeming with thousands. Whether you are obliterating minions in clusters, swarming heroes, or overwhelming turrets, once you adapt to this new scale of war, no other MOBA will compare. Mission Dictates the Plan Danger and riches abound in the streets of Rotnor. The city is divided into two halves, each with four neighborhoods inhabited by neutral factions: police, military, pirates, and Xorm. Decide who to ally with, undertake missions for them, and secure vital upgrades that can shift the balance of power. Once you’re strong enough, rally your team to challenge mighty Mantis , the rogue XBT, for a reward that could change the outcome. Tactical Commander Select the battle tank and pilot that align with your team role from an ever-growing pool of options. Every five levels, enhance your skills with modifications . Acquire upgrades and gears  to tailor your tank to your distinctive playing style. Every Obstacle is a Road You have the  power to destroy anything in your path. Create new routes between lanes through the jungle, ambush enemies from behind, or surprise them with backdoor attacks just when they think they’ve won. Stop the APOCALYPSE Gear up, Commander! The swarm is relentless, the city is yours to reshape, and victory demands TRUE SKILL . Assemble your team, strategize your build, and carve your path through the chaos to stop the Apocalypse!

rows.name: Security: Stories by the fans
rows.short_description: Every time you die, a new story begins. In this prologue to Security: The Horrible Nights your job is to monitor the hospital and fix problems when they happen. Every night, a new horror tale based on fans’ ideas will unfold.
rows.description_html: In this prologue to Security: The Horrible Nights , you take on the role of a security guard at a hospital. From your small office, your job is to watch the entire hospital through security cameras. If you see a problem, you must run out and fix it! You can fix nearly every problem by pointing your flashlight at it and yell! But some problems can be deadly, so you have to be careful if you want to survive all the stories in this anthology horror game. All the stories are based on fan-submitted ideas. It is still possible to get your idea included in a free DLC for the main game if you visit the Security: The Horrible Nights Steam page. There is a thread called: 'Make a Story for the Game.' You get 4 unique stories based on fan ideas. You will encounter ghosts, monsters, and other horrible beings while trying to keep the hospital safe. The main game, Security: The Horrible Nights , will be released later in 2024.

rows.name: Legends of Boom
rows.short_description: Legends of Boom is a fast-paced RTS-Lite Battle game. Collect and upgrade cards, and challenge both human and AI opponents online, all while experiencing over 4 hours of commentary by our vice-laden puppet sportscaster, Flip Rimrod (voiced Tim Kitzrow, legendary NBA JAM announcer)
rows.description_html: Legends of Boom is a fast-paced RTS-Lite Battle game, designed for players who crave quick, intense matches where you strategically place bases, weapons, defenses, and events on one of 24 different battle maps. Dive into the single-player Path of Boom to earn experience, upgrade your cards, and unlock powerful strategies. Or, take your finely tuned deck-building skills online to face off against opponents while the puppet sportscaster, Flip Rimrod (voiced Tim Kitzrow, legendary NBA JAM announcer), delivers play-by-play of every match.

rows.name: Mirrored Phantoms
rows.short_description: Trapped in a nightmarish mannequin factory where reality itself is shattered, unravel the secrets of Mirrored Phantoms. Explore a deeply atmospheric world, solve the mystery of the mirror shards, and survive the terrors that await in this slow-burning, first-person horror experience.
rows.description_html: Prepare to be consumed by Mirrored Phantoms , a chilling descent into a decaying mannequin factory where reality itself has fractured. This first-person psychological horror experience preys on your deepest fears, immersing you in an unsettling atmosphere where the line between what is real and what is imagined blurs with every haunting step on your journey to escape.   The decaying walls whisper secrets of a dark past, while the lifeless eyes of countless mannequins follow your every move. Explore the oppressive corridors, piecing together the mystery of the shattered mirror shards that hold the key to your escape. But be warned, the silence is deceptive. There are things that lurk in these halls that never want you to leave, and they are always listening.   Steel your nerves for chilling encounters that will test your sanity. Uncover the sinister history of the factory, decipher the clues etched into its decaying walls, and confront the phantoms that haunt your every waking moment. Dare to escape the clutches of this nightmarish reality, or risk being forever trapped within its mirrored depths.   Key Features: A  Shattered Reality : Descend into a nightmarish mannequin factory where the walls warp and reality itself is a twisted reflection. Prepare for an unsettling experience where your senses will be challenged and your sanity strained. Psychological Terror : Confront the chilling dread that seeps from every corner of this decaying world.  The ever-present gaze of lifeless eyes, the unsettling silence, and the unnerving feeling of being constantly watched will prey on your deepest fears. Unveiling the Mystery : Explore the oppressive environment, piecing together the dark history of the factory and the curse that binds you to it. Search for clues hidden within the shadows, solve the enigma of the mirror shards, and uncover the truth behind the horrors that haunt you.

rows.name: Imvi: Echoes of Harmony
rows.short_description: Imvi: Echoes of Harmony is a third-person experience where you use the attractive and repulsive forces of black and white singularities to explore an ancient alien civilization to recover your lost memories.
rows.description_html: Soar among the stars in  Imvi: Echoes of Harmony,  a third-person open-world experience from SMU Guildhall that invites you to slow down. Harness the attractive & repulsive forces of Black & White Singularities to traverse and explore an ancient, wonder-filled world as you collect and revel in the memories of those who came before Overview Soar among the stars in  Imvi: Echoes of Harmony,  a third-person, single-player, open-world experience developed by students at SMU Guildhall Cohort 33. In  Imvi , harness the attractive & repulsive energies of Black & White Singularities to sling yourself across & interact with an alien, wonder-filled, shattered world. Waking up with no memories, Imvi must learn to navigate an unfamiliar world while guided by an unknown mentor. By collecting Memory Shards scattered across a sweeping landscape of floating islands, Imvi embarks on an odyssey to discover the world…and herself. Features: Explore a Wonder-Filled World Linger among the serenity and soft sadness of a shattered alien world, featuring floating islands and a unique blend of vegetation, creatures, and landscapes in an experience that invites you to slow down Unique Movement & Gravity Mechanics Harness the attractive & repulsive energies of Black & White Singularities to navigate and traverse a broken world, with gravity twists that will always keep you seeing the world in new ways Fully Localized with Original VO & Soundtrack Explore the lost stories of the world and discover your own in English, Spanish, or Simplified Chinese, supported by an intimate original soundtrack

rows.name: Gripshot
rows.short_description: Master the grapnel and jet into action in Gripshot, a skill-driven movement shooter that will challenge your coordination and reflexes as you strive for air supremacy.
rows.description_html: Equip your Gripshot and jetpack to soar high, using speed and momentum to outmaneuver your opponents for aerial supremacy and blast all who stand below you. The Grappling Hook will give you the upper-hand in combat, but it is the tool of elite operatives and your reflexes must be as sharp as your wits! Reliable and effective, the Jetpack will save you many times and may give you the upper hand in combat. Your weapons are the Machinegun and the Rocket Launcher designed for maximum aggression and control of the arena. In Gripshot , every match is a fast-paced test of aerial precision and tactical thinking, as you grapple between structures, dodge incoming fire, and seize high ground for the ultimate advantage.

rows.description_html: Deathly Dominion is an action-packed survival game that pits players against endless hordes of zombies in a post-apocalyptic world. In this grim setting, players must use all their skills and resources to fend off increasingly challenging waves of the undead. Each horde brings new dangers and challenges, requiring quick reflexes and well-thought-out strategies to survive. With a tense atmosphere and intense combat, Deathly Dominion offers an immersive and challenging experience for fans of survival games.

Arm yourself with an arsenal of futuristic weapons and defend your home as its invaded by a disgusting infestation of slime scum. Run, Blast, Survive! and whatever you do...DON'T GET SLIMED
rows.description_html: In this 2D arcade shooter, you will play as Lemonhead while he fights to defend his home as it's invaded by evil enemy slimes. Survive as long as you can and go for a high score along the way!! The more slimes you blast the higher your score. You will encounter a variety of enemies who have their own way of getting to you and stopping you from getting a high score. Do your best to prevent this with a selection of futuristic weapons; A ray-gun Assault Rifle, An ungodly laser and a cool little shotgun.

You will encounter a variety of enemies who have their own way of getting to you and stopping you from getting a high score. Do your best to prevent this with a selection of futuristic weapons; A ray-gun Assault Rifle, An ungodly laser and a cool little shotgun.

rows.name: Beast Brawl
rows.short_description: Beast Brawl is a unique rougelike which pits teams of primal beasts against one another in a battle for survival. Thousands of combos and strategies to try and evolve your team into the apex beasts of the kingdom.
rows.description_html: BEAST BRAWL is a strategic roguelike auto-battler which pits teams of primal beasts against one another in a battle for survival. Thousands of Combos – Choose from over 30 unique beasts to form your champion team. Mix and match from 15 traits and over 15 upgrades to empower your team with new abilities. Discover overpowered combos and more! Survival of the Fittest – New beasts enter the fray every round, you must upgrade and be on your toes or be left behind! Chill or Tryhard – Wanna just chill? There’s a chill mode for you! Want to really test your skills? There’s a tryhard mode with advanced difficulty for you too! SELLING POINTS FOR NERDS Like to geek out about game systems and math out the optimal strats? Then this section is for you! Deterministic Battles – Zero randomness in the battle system, every battle and its results can be recreated with the exact same inputs and outputs. See someone else’s team that looks strong? Replicate it with the exact same results! Superposition Turn-Based System – Despite the visuals, beasts do not take “turns” acting in battle. Everyone acts at the same time during a turn and every action is resolved simultaneously in our unique superposition battle system. Emergent Systems – Beast Brawl is designed around letting players discover new and broken combos, evolving their teams into the ultimate apex beasts. JOIN OUR COMMUNITY DISCORD Discuss strategies and share your victories, join with the link in the sidebar on the right! 🢂🢂🢂🢂

But the fun doesn’t stop there, it can also be enjoyed on a PC with 10 full casino games included! rows.name: KAZEKAO
rows.short_description: KAZEKAO is a fast-paced, challenging platformer that will put your precision and speed to the test. Are you ready to dash through the challenges and save Grandma Miauko's cakes?
rows.description_html: KAZEKAO is a fast-paced, challenging 2D platformer that will put your precision and speed to the test. Step into the paws of the blue cat Kazekao on a mission to retrieve Grandma Miauko's lost cakes scattered across 8 uniquely designed levels. Each level demands quick reflexes and perfect timing as you dash, jump, and maneuver through obstacles and enemies. The game combines tight controls with increasingly difficult levels, creating a satisfying experience for those who love a good test of skill. Can you find all the cakes and return them to Grandma Miauko before time runs out? Prepare to dive into a world where every second counts, and every move matters. Precision Platforming Navigate through tight spaces with smooth, responsive controls. Speedrun Challenge yourself to beat your best times. 8 Unique Levels Each level presents obstacles and challenges to master. Charming Pixel Art Enjoy a retro-inspired game with charming pixel art graphics. Achievements Challenge yourself by trying to unlock more than 20 achievements!

rows.name: Cult of Persona
rows.short_description: Craft your strategy to outsmart your foes in the top-down marble game 'Cult of Persona.' Build a formidable army and gather unique cards that embody historical figures from World War II. Immerse yourself in tactical gameplay as you harness the strengths of these personas to secure victory!
rows.description_html: Card seasons Dear Players, We’re excited to share that once we reach our target player base, we will be poised to launch our Season 1 item cards, which you can preview in our game screenshots. We have already designed and prepared cards for four seasons, with new releases scheduled every three months. Please note that this timeline may be adjusted based on your feedback and preferences. We can’t wait to embark on this journey together! Future Plans Dear Players, We have ambitious plans to enhance our gameplay! We're excited to introduce features like a Steam Workshop for custom maps and units, new units, and an expanded, dynamic pinball field. Additionally, we’re working on our magnum opus: a competitive multiplayer mode featuring unique traits, bonuses, depending on personality cards you could earn by playing. The success of these plans relies on your support and enthusiasm for our project. We're a small team of passionate gamers who set out to create something simple yet enjoyable. Dive into our concept, snag our beautiful cards early, and become part of a vibrant future (if we’re all fortunate enough to see it)! Season 1 Items About the Game Cult of Persona is a clicker game dedicated to historical figures of the 20th century. In this game, you will battle using a pinball field By clicking, you trigger the generation of your warrior balls. You need to bring your army to victory - capture the enemy base. If you succeed, you will receive a random card featuring one of the historical characters. See you on the battlefield, Persona!

rows.name: Rugby Tycoon Rugby Rovigo Delta
rows.short_description: An immersive and strategic game experience focused on the management of a rugby club.The game combines tactical decisions with the management of the team, financial planning and competition in a world of rugby.
rows.description_html: Roadmap High priority Match simulation algorithms (85%) Multi-role player generation (40%) Stadium infrastructure (70%) Youth Academy (70%) Gym (70%) Training Camp (70%) Infirmary (70%) Low priority Stock dividends(80%) Investment banking(80%) Feedback About the Game An immersive and strategic game experience focused on managing a rugby club. The game combines tactical decisions with team management, financial planning and competition in a world of rugby. Grow your team on and off the pitch, and make strategic decisions regarding training, player transfers, playing tactics, and financial management. Scout and recruit new prospects or talented professionals from a randomly generated pool of athletes, each player will have unique attributes and potential (stats). Train, buy, sell or lend players to unlock their full potential, and improve team performance. Analyze the upcoming opponents to devise a match strategy, choose the starting lineup and substitutes, and set team tactics, formation, and style of play. They will be simulated within the UI, and you will be able to watch the game actions and results that follow one another. You will be able to advance through the agenda, view it, and choose whether to skip the simulation or not. You will also receive real-time updates during matches, including key events and player performances. rows.name: Jumping Jack
rows.description_html: One morning, Jack was torn from his ordinary life and trapped in a strange world. Armed with nothing but an old pogo stick, he began his ascent through the mysterious dimension's unknown heights. In this realm where gravity behaves oddly and the ground is unreliable, Jack's only goal is to climb higher. But no one knows what awaits at the top—a way out or an even greater mystery? The only thing he’s sure of is that he’ll never find out unless he reaches the end. One mistake is all it takes! In Jack’s world, there are no second chances. With no save button or checkpoints, a single misstep can send you crashing back to the beginning. This unforgiving challenge will push your patience to its limits, testing your ability to bounce back—literally. Overcome the unpredictable! The world around Jack isn't just a backdrop; it's full of elements that can either help or hinder your progress. From unexpected aids that give you a boost, to traps designed to knock you off course, you'll need quick reflexes and a sharp mind to make it through. Laugh, cry, rage—repeat! Jack’s journey is not just about climbing but about the emotions you’ll feel along the way. The game's difficulty curve is punishing by design, giving you a true sense of accomplishment with every hard-earned victory—and plenty of frustration along the way. Key Features: No saves—each mistake sends you back to the start. Built-in speedrun timer and height tracker for competitive play. Both helpful elements and hazards make every climb unique. A surreal, gravity-defying world full of unpredictable challenges. A challenging difficulty curve that will test your perseverance.

rows.name: Latent Leftovers
rows.short_description: Latent Leftovers is an arcade puzzle game where you play as an underdog wizard crafting potions from leftover reagents. With help from a mysterious benefactor, master 9 unique scenarios and rise to the rank of Arch Wizard—all for free!
rows.description_html: Latent Leftovers is an enchanting arcade game that combines Tetris-inspired mechanics with a whimsical tale of magical mischief. Step into the shoes of a struggling wizard, living in the shadow of a more successful rival, and embark on a quest to prove your worth. Just outside the grand wizard tower, you’ll find yourself crafting potions from leftover reagents tossed out of the open window. But not all hope is lost—a mysterious benefactor sees your hidden potential and offers a helping hand. Master the art of potion brewing across 9 unique scenarios as you climb your way to the prestigious title of Arch Wizard! Key features: Tetris-Inspired Potion Brewing : Engage in fast-paced, puzzle-based gameplay where you combine discarded magical reagents to brew powerful potions. Charming Narrative : Follow the story of an underdog wizard striving to prove his worth and rise to the top of the magical world. 9 Unique Scenarios : Challenge yourself with a variety of levels. Free to Play : Enjoy the full experience without spending a dime—Latent Leftovers is completely free to download and play. Step into the enchanting world of Latent Leftovers. Whether you’re a puzzle enthusiast, a lover of magical adventures, or simply looking for a fun and engaging experience, this game offers something for everyone. Ready to brew your way to greatness?

rows.name: Condo Desires
rows.short_description: An adult visual novel where you navigate the lives and fantasies of alluring women in a community condominium. As the new trustee, create relationships, uncover secrets, and trigger in intimate encounters. Will you master the art of seduction, or will you crave more? Your choices, your desires.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Condo Desires , a provocative and immersive adult visual novel that thrusts you into the heart of a community condominium filled with captivating women, each with their own secrets and desires. As the new trustee of the condo, it’s up to you to navigate complex relationships with the diverse and alluring female residents, uncovering their hidden fantasies and fulfilling their deepest cravings. Gameplay and Features : Daily Loop System : Experience a dynamic daily cycle with distinct morning, afternoon, evening, and night phases. Your choices throughout the day impact relationships, unlock scenes, and progress different character arcs. Relationship Development : Each female resident has a unique personality and backstory, with individual routes that can lead to different outcomes. You can deepen relationships through dialogue, gifts, completing specific tasks, and making the right choices. As trust and intimacy build, more explicit scenes and unique events become available. Task and Condo Management : Take on responsibilities as the condo’s trustee. Completing daily tasks, solving minor problems, and keeping the condo running smoothly aren’t just for appearances; they directly influence your relationships with the residents and unlock further opportunities to engage with them. Adult Content : Condo Desires offers a wide range of adult content, including intimate and explicit H-scenes, voyeuristic moments, and playful encounters. The scenes range from light-hearted and flirtatious to intense and passionate, all with fully developed, unique character interactions. Multiple Characters, Unique Stories : Interact with a diverse group of women, each with her own secrets and personality: Emily - A sweet and slightly naive waitress. Luna - A bold and outgoing streamer with a penchant for exhibitionism. Sophie - A nurturing yoga instructor who values mindfulness. Valerie - A strong-willed doctor who hides her softer side. Mia - A powerful CEO who is confident and in control. Customization : Earn in-game currency to buy outfits and accessories, such as maid outfits and school uniforms, for the residents. Use these outfits to explore different sides of each character and unlock unique dialogue and interactions. Exploration and Events : Spy on the residents through spy cameras, peek into private bathroom moments, or discover secrets while they sleep. The game offers a mix of light-hearted voyeurism and deeper, consensual experiences, providing a range of content that evolves as your relationships grow. Dive into Condo Desires and explore the seductive, mysterious lives of the condo’s residents. With a blend of story-driven experiences, erotic content, and engaging decision-making, Condo Desires offers players the chance to indulge in a game that doesn’t shy away from provocative themes. Every choice you make will shape your journey. Explore, engage, and enjoy every tantalizing moment.

rows.short_description: Mini Monsters Gravity Consensus is a charming 2D puzzle game with a unique gravity control mechanic. Perfect for a relaxing evening, it offers simple yet engaging puzzles that progressively challenge you as you unlock new levels and gameplay mechanics, making each step forward more exciting and fun.
rows.description_html: Mini Monsters: Gravity Consensus About the game 💡 Totally free and ready to challenge your brain with gravity-defying puzzles! Step into Mini Monsters: Gravity Consensus, a free-to-play, bite-sized puzzle game where every move matters. The goal? Reach the key and escape the level – simple, right? Think again! Each puzzle will twist your perspective and leave you rethinking how gravity works. 🧩 Ready to challenge your brain with gravity-defying puzzles? Step into Mini Monsters: Gravity Consensus, a free-to-play, bite-sized puzzle game where every move matters. The goal? Reach the key and escape the level – simple, right? Think again! Choose your own character 🌍 A Minimalistic World, Packed with Surprises Don’t let the clean and simple design fool you – beneath the surface lies a world of tricky puzzles. Whether you're winding down or revving up for a challenge, Mini Monsters will keep your mind and mood in sync. 🧠 Unlock, Progress, Conquer! As you progress, new mechanics and challenges await, transforming the game into a brain-bending playground. rows.name: Chibi Reboot 2
rows.short_description: Chibi the little yellow robot returns to you on the monitor! Accompany Chibi the little robot again and this time guide him through even more dangerous dangers and enemies.
rows.description_html: Chibi the little yellow robot returns to your screen! ‘Chibi Reboot 2’ is a Pac-Man-like game in which you have to help a little robot and his companion solve a mysterious case. With Chibi you have to collect energy crystals and face various dangers. Underwater sharks, rocket fire or penguins sliding on their bellies. Steer Chibi through the new open world and face the dangers to restore balance. What's new in Chibi 2? A total of 64 stages, including 21 optional bonus stages. 8-bit & 16-bit music. Over 30 in-game achievements to achieve. Chibi will be able to move around an overworld this time. The player can choose for himself. 6 different items to collect to fight enemies. 2 different difficulty levels.

rows.name: The Doors That Led to Nowhere
rows.short_description: Wake up lost in a void of darkness. With no other option, press onward through cryptic dimensional doors, wielding a mysterious blade created by the fallen entities that came long before you in this heart-pounding First Person RPG.
rows.description_html: Darkness hides in the recesses of everyone's mind... A normal man finds himself trapped in an alternate reality enveloped in darkness and twisted, bloodthirsty creatures. Explore and uncover secrets about this aberrant world as you find your way back home. Features A unique take on old-school 3D RPGs, drawing elements from FPS and Parkour games. Explore an unnerving, atmospheric world with 5 hours of content. Precise movement and combat with a high skill ceiling. Find arcane abilities scattered throughout the world and channel the powers of chaos through your sword! Dash and slice through your foes, teleport around the battlefield, and harness the strength of lightning! 10 otherworldly bosses to discover and overcome! Find lost souls and remnants of chaos to upgrade your HP and Damage and transcend into an unstoppable force! A storyline with many mountains and valleys—gain a second chance at life and save yourself and your loved one from the dark dimension.

rows.name: Shallow Blue（浅蓝计划）
rows.short_description: You are No. 13, a new game tester joining the Shallow Blue project. Following orders from your superiors, complete the testing of this mech game. But don't forget to maintain a healthy life and take care of the essential tasks that must be done.
rows.description_html: Shallow Blue is a 2D pixel-style Metroidvania game, featuring multiple freely explorable environments and hidden storylines waiting to be uncovered by players. You will play as Tester No. 13, controlling a mech in the game, using platforming skills and combat abilities to defeat various enemies and clear levels. While immersing yourself in the mech action, don’t forget to ensure that No. 13 maintains a balanced diet and adequate sleep for optimal performance. Levels and Combat: Control your mech as you run and jump through industrial sci-fi-style environments, exploring scenes and uncovering the storyline. Defeat a wide variety of enemies and face the final boss in epic confrontations. Build Your Own Mecha: Purchase powerful equipment in the module shop and freely customize your mech. Combine modules to create a mech warrior that suits your playstyle, enhancing mobility, offensive power, and defensive capabilities to dominate the battlefield. Role-Playing: Players take on the role of Tester No. 13, living in a closed-off base filled with rooms and public spaces to explore freely. The base is rich with interactive environmental objects and NPCs, offering a deep and immersive experience as you uncover secrets and progress through the game. Game Features:: -Pixel Art -Realistic Time and Health System -Hidden Storylines and Easter Eggs It is known that some computers may experience screen flickering when playing the game. This issue involves overall performance optimization and cannot be resolved for the time being. We are very sorry if this situation causes players to have a bad experience.

rows.name: The Short Bread Game
rows.short_description: The Short Bread Game is a cozy platformer where you help a piece of bread get to the bakery for breakfast. Though your path there may not be the most direct, you'll get to explore charming places. Jump high, run from enemies, and engage in witty dialogue with your odd new friend. Adventure awaits!
rows.description_html: Being a piece of bread, you naturally crave a stack of pancakes for breakfast. To start off your day and, more importantly, fill your stomach, you set off on a journey to get the best pancakes in town. However, you soon realize you have no clue where the bakery is. Thankfully, it seems like an intruder in your house may just know where you can find it... In this casual platformer, you explore environments ranging from your home to space. Though getting to your end goal doesn't seem hard at first, you soon find that the path there is a tad convoluted, with enemy desserts jumping around at every turn, trying to stop you. Not to mention, your new friend seems to enjoy messing around with you a bit.  If you're looking for a low-stress way to take a break, this may just be the game for you. :)

rows.name: Magic Sword
rows.short_description: Magic Sword is a medieval CRPG with synchronous turn-based strategy where you develop your character, explore the map, and compete for victory points in Combat, Knowledge, Capital, Reputation, and Fellowships.
rows.description_html: Magic Sword is a captivating CRPG that thrusts you into a richly detailed medieval world where strategy and skill are your greatest assets. Choose from one of 14 unique cities as the birthplace of your hero, and step into the role of a Swordsman, Wizard, Musketman, or Mage. Whether you prefer to wield physical might, arcane power, or the disciplined force of a trooper, your journey will be defined by the choices you make and the path you carve. Compete in a dynamic, synchronous turn-based strategy environment, where all players take their turns simultaneously, pushing the limits of your tactical thinking. You can play singe-player or up to 14 players- play within your household or port-forward to host the game to the world. Victory is achieved by mastering five key aptitudes: Combat, Knowledge, Capital, Reputation, and Fellowship. But it doesn’t stop there—collect rare Magic Sword fragments, earn prestigious Titles, and outmaneuver your rivals to accumulate the most victory points before the game concludes. As you explore vast maps and engage in quests, you'll develop your character, forge alliances, and test different strategies. Will you dominate through sheer force, outsmart your opponents with knowledge, or rise through the ranks by gaining influence and wealth? The choice is yours in this intricate and competitive world. Key Features: 14 Diverse Cities : Each city offers unique benefits and challenges, influencing your character’s journey from the start. Four Playable Classes : Choose between the Swordsman, Wizard, Musketman, or Mage, each with distinct abilities and combat styles. Multiplayer Option : Experience the thrill of simultaneous turns in a strategic, turn-based environment, competing against others or refining your solo strategies. Five Aptitudes to Master : Gain victory points in Combat, Knowledge, Capital, Reputation, and Fellowships to prove your superiority. Magic Sword Fragments : Discover and collect rare fragments to increase your power and tip the scales in your favor. Title System : Earn prestigious Titles to boost your victory points and showcase your achievements. Strategic Map Exploration : Navigate and explore diverse terrains, uncover secrets, and plan your moves with precision. Magic Sword offers endless possibilities and strategies, encouraging you to experiment and find your path to victory. Will you rise to become the ultimate champion? The choice is yours—dare to resurrect the Magic Sword.

rows.name: Tiny Pixel Planets
rows.short_description: Explore the pixel cosmos, jumping from star system to star system. Land on fully procedural planets, and make them your home.
rows.description_html: Travel throughout the galaxy, finding new and interesting things in each star system. Pilot your space ship in star systems and land on the 11 different fully procedural planets. Click on planets to find information on the planets before you land, some require special gear. Warp to the shop planet to sell and buy useful items. Find a planet and make it yours. Use the ability to bookmark planets to be able to travel back to your planet no matter where you are in the galaxy. Build with almost 300 different blocks and items. Farm crops and sell them to become the richest person in the galaxy. Beware off the hostile inhabitants of these worlds, they will put up a fight. Discover the hidden secrets of the galaxy. Conquer multiple different procedurally generated dungeons, and claim the rewards. Upgrade your weapons and armor to survive these challenges. Locate the endgame planet and destroy the boss.

rows.name: cr4ckr
rows.short_description: cr4ckr is a puzzle game about cracking passwords.
rows.description_html: cr4ckr is a puzzle game about cracking passwords. Piece together the missing components of the password using the hint letters provided and the clues from the surrounding words. You'll only have access to the first and last components. Guess correctly, and the next piece of the puzzle is revealed. But be warned—time is running out! As you race to crack the code, the police are hot on your trail, tracing your connection with every passing second. Can you outsmart the system and crack the password before the trace is complete? Or will the authorities catch up with you, ending your hacking spree once and for all? Only the sharpest minds will prevail in this game of speed, strategy, and wordplay.

rows.name: Beyond the Marion
rows.short_description: A 3D First Person walking simulator and puzzle game. You will interact with your alien crewmates and repair your spaceship in order to escape a time loop. Explore space in a ship straight from the 70’s, and meet your companions - brought to life with a funky claymated style!
rows.description_html: Take charge of the Polaris Mk 0 and repair your damaged ship, learn from your crewmates, and discover the true nature of what lies beyond existence… before you do it all over again. Follow the core tenants of the Sectorian Collective as you: Seek Knowledge Each loop in the game will offer you new insights into how to efficiently rectify the Polaris Mk 0’s many misfortunes whilst traveling through the Marion. Along the way, you’ll pick up tools that persist through your runs and aid you in your quest to save your crewmates. Solve Problems As you breach the Marion, your crew’s situation becomes more dangerous. It’s your job to fix mechanical failures and keep everyone alive! You’ll need to solve puzzling crises, assist your crewmates, and reach the bridge in time to save your ship. Always Put the Crew First Meet a colorful cast of aliens from all over the universe whom you get to call your crewmates. You’ll help each other as you make choices that will affect the success of the mission and your survival. Join us… Beyond the Marion!

rows.name: The Stairway
rows.short_description: A 3D parkour game through the memories of a life. The goal is to reach the top, sometimes the way forward is not obvious.
rows.description_html: Built as a 3D platformer, The Stairway invites you to ascend through a floating world that feels both strange and familiar. Puzzling paths twist around impossible architecture; distant structures drift like memories on the horizon. Each surface is shaded as if by hand, blurring the line between dream and drawing. There are no enemies or dialogue. It's just you and yourself, and the climb which you endure. For you, The Stairway  could mean parkouring with precision through challenging and exciting obstacles. It could also mean something deeper. That's for you to find out. Atmosphere Unique graphics and atmosphere Shading resembling a colored pencil drawing, like the memories from childhood Story Indirect storytelling Meaning unfolds through the climb itself Large objects in the distance...a hidden meaning Gameplay Multiple checkpoints, quiet moments of rests. No need to stress :) Gameplay is easily paused at any point to be resumed later Choose whether you play casually or competitively through your own pace Speedrun for the fastest time

rows.description_html: In Block Dude Deluxe, your mission is simple—reach the exit in each level. But to do that, you'll need to strategically stack and move blocks to create pathways, staircases, and bridges to navigate complex environments. Every level presents a unique puzzle that will challenge your problem-solving skills and test your ability to think ahead. Features: Challenging Puzzles: Each level is designed to push your strategic thinking with increasing difficulty as you progress. Block Manipulation Mechanics: Move, stack, and reposition blocks to solve intricate puzzles. Varied Environments: Explore different settings that add new twists and obstacles to your path. Simple Controls, Complex Challenges: Easy to pick up but difficult to master, Block Dude Deluxe is accessible to all players while offering deep puzzle gameplay for those who seek a challenge. Level Progression: Unlock new, more difficult levels as you master the mechanics and solve earlier puzzles. Whether you're a casual player looking for a fun puzzle experience or a dedicated gamer seeking to master intricate levels, Block Dude Deluxe offers an engaging and rewarding challenge.

rows.name: Impersonal
rows.short_description: Impersonal is a game about lights, about relationships and how these relationships can affect people.
rows.description_html: Impersonal is a game about light, relationships, and how those relationships can influence people. In the game, you control a ball of colored light navigating through a maze. Your goal is to explore how different lights and colors interact with one another, discovering multiple potential endings. The core of the game lies in understanding these interactions, making choices, and unraveling the maze of possibilities in this cyclical experience. This game was created in 2014, inspired by a talk from Jonathan Blow (the renowned game designer behind Braid and The Witness). In that talk, Blow discussed the concept of dynamical meaning in games, referencing The Marriage by Rod Humble as an example. In The Marriage, the game is filled with obscure interactions and symbols that only begin to make sense through exploration, it kind of have a narrative shaped by its mechanics. Though Rod states that he feels it is flawed from his own perspective because people don't seem to really get how the rules explains marriage. This approach to storytelling captivated me. Although I too recognize Impersonal has its flaws in narrative delivery (the same way rod said), I believe it still offers an intriguing and unconventional way to tell stories—one rooted in interactions. To me, this is how games should convey their stories: through the player's engagement with the world and its systems. At the end of the day It's a pretentious game, with minimal and experimental art. It's not a game made with the idea of ​​being a good game, in fact the attempt here was to focus on dynamical meaning. Where the game mechanics are responsible for telling a story and not the art or story embedded in the game itself. The game contains: 4 different endings an open map where you can explore some puzzles Thank you for playing.

rows.name: Tobacco Shop Simulator: Prologue
rows.short_description: Run your tobacco shop in this free prologue version of the game. Sign contracts with leading brands, order products, and meet customer needs. Play with friends or go solo, and enjoy the growth of your shop.
rows.description_html: [Tobacco Shop Simulator: Prologue is a free prologue version of Tobacco Shop Simulator. In this game, you'll have a limited amount of contracts.] This is a first-person simulation game where you step into the role of a tobacco shop owner. Work alone or with friends to expand your humble shop into a huge tobacco shop. Co-Op Mode and Single Player Share the duties with your friends in co-op mode (for up to 4 players). The more players in the store, the more demanding customers will visit your store. Also, you can go solo and manage everything in the store. You can invite your friends anytime if you change your mind. Store Workflow Sign contracts with leading brands, order new products with an in-game computer or with your tablet while walking in the store, unpack the boxes, place the products into your store, and set the prices for your products. Consider the market prices while setting up your product prices in the store for customer satisfaction. Always keep your store clean so as not to lose any customers. Also, be careful with the thieves to avoid some box losses that would cause a leak in your finances. Products Please make sure your customers find all their needs in the store. Always expand your product portfolio and satisfy your customers. Cigarettes, lighters, pipes, cigars, ashtrays, hookahs, e-cigarettes, tobacco, and smoking accessories... Be aware of the market prices and purchase more products when they're cheap. Customers Place a sufficient number of checkouts to reduce the waiting time for customers. Scan products and collect payments whether in cash or with card purchases. Don't forget to fulfill the online orders. Expansions and New Teammates Expand your store and warehouse by leveling up your store and budget. Hire stockers to fill the racks. Purchase more cash registers and hire new cashiers to minimize long queues at the checkouts and to reduce waiting time for customers.

rows.description_html: Do you want a farm of your own? Want to experience the joy of planting? How about interacting with animal villagers, trading, and building friendships? Welcome to Bunny Farm! Sowing, watering, harvesting – the little bunny will handle it all for you. All you need to do is choose what to plant, click the 'Start Working' button, and then wait. rows.name: The Vanishing
rows.short_description: The Vanishing is first person horror game. Explore an abandoned town where shadows whisper and secrets lie buried deep. Uncover the truth behind a vengeful spirit awakened from an ancient slumber. Solve puzzles, face your fears, and survive a mystery that claimed so many before you. Can you escape?
rows.description_html: In The Vanishing, you enter an abandoned town shrouded in mystery, a place where time itself seems to have stopped. Once a thriving community, the town is now eerily silent, with crumbling buildings, deserted streets, and a dark history buried deep beneath the surface. Your journey begins with a single question: what caused the town’s sudden demise? As you explore the empty houses, forgotten diaries, and hidden corners, you uncover a chilling secret. Years ago, during the final days of the local mine’s operation, the miners discovered ancient ruins and unearthed a body—an enigmatic woman, preserved beyond the reach of time. Her spirit, filled with rage and sorrow, has awakened and now haunts the empty town, seeking vengeance for the wrongs done to her in life. You must navigate through the town’s ghostly streets, decipher cryptic clues, and confront the spirit that lingers in the shadows. Solve puzzles, unlock secrets, and piece together the story of what truly happened. As you delve deeper into the mystery, you’ll realize that the town is not as empty as it seems, and that the spirit won’t rest until every trace of life has vanished. Will you be able to uncover the truth and put the spirit to rest, or will you become the next victim in The Vanishing?

rows.name: Cannon Guys
rows.short_description: Build your weapon deck and outsmart your enemy in turn-based one-on-one battles. Become the leader of three fighters, create a strategy and shoot! Enjoy epic hits. Collect and upgrade weapon cards. Win and get new weapons for your collection!
rows.description_html: Build your own deck of weapons and outsmart the enemy in turn-based, one-on-one battles. Become the leader of three fighters, create a strategy and shoot! Enjoy epic landscape-destroying hits. Collect and upgrade weapon cards. Win battles and move to new arenas to unlock powerful new cards in your collection! Get chests from which you can get rare and legendary weapons and fighters! Climb the rankings in online battles or challenge a friend! You have many options for how to destroy your enemies, and the arena changes from explosions. Create your own team of three unique fighters and choose the weapon you want to fight with. Weapons differ in their capabilities and mechanics, which makes the game even more fun. You can jump up and shoot three times in the air at once thanks to time dilation! All fighters have weaknesses and defenses to certain types of damage. Use the fighter's mana, spline, or spend a lot of mana on one powerful shot on the group or make several cheap shots but on the enemy's weaknesses?  The game combines elements of arcade, action strategy, and shooting games. You can organize a battle round with your friends online or play with a virtual opponent. You have a whole arsenal of weapons at your disposal, and it's time to use them. Have fun and enjoy the process! WHAT'S IN STORE FOR YOU? - Multiplayer and online games with friends: you can play with your friends, as well as against a virtual opponent. Fight and show everyone who's the best shot! - Tactics: even online shooters can't do without strategy. Think of a battle plan! You can implement your most interesting plan and combine melee and ranged weapons, or simply unleash an armageddon on everyone; - Locations: the coolest multiplayer games cannot do without a large-scale world. There are many different maps in the Cannon Guys universe, play in a pirate bay, frozen lands, or near a volcano; - Characters: our online game involves many heroes with different abilities. We have prepared more than 30 fighters for you to choose from. Each of the fighters has its own character, weaknesses and defenses. Some of them take more damage from fire and some take less damage from explosions, try to create a universal team for you and conquer the rating with it. - Progress: level up your character by sending him to the battle royale, level up your weapons and become an increasingly dangerous opponent, unleash the potential of your weapons to the maximum level. The enemy will be crushed like a worm; - Weapons: we have prepared dozens of weapons, gadgets, magic and more for you: fireballs, rockets, teleporters, swords and shurikens. All for a fun multiplayer game! - Fun! Funny cartoon characters from the Cannon Guys universe will give you a lot of emotions. It's especially nice when the strategy works and after accurate aiming the projectile hits the target, giving you a victory.

rows.name: Shards of the Mirror
rows.short_description: Shattered Reflections: Navigating a Labyrinth of Multiple Endings
rows.description_html: Gameplay Playtime: 15-30 minutes Shards of the Mirrors is a story-driven puzzle game where the protagonist, trapped in a mirror world by chance, must find the scattered mirror shards around the house to escape. Explore and discover various endings as you solve the puzzles. Game Story Shards of the Mirrors begins after the protagonist returns home from their day. Quickly falling asleep, they are awakened by a loud noise. In the storage room, they discover a strange compass, and upon inspecting it, they feel someone behind them. Startled, they drop the compass and are suddenly pulled into the mirror world. What will the protagonist encounter in this mysterious place? Developer's Note Shards of the Mirrors was inspired by the concept of non-determinism, learned during a CSE355 class. While the game may not be highly polished, it's my first game, and I plan to fix bugs with frequent updates. Distribution: If you stream or share a video, I would appreciate it if you include the game's title or a Steam link in the description. It would be a great help to a solo developer. We are not responsible for any damages caused by unauthorized distribution of game videos.

rows.name: DUST II | The Infinite Zero Point
rows.short_description: As a key player within the Seven, your task is urgent: beat the clock to nab that elusive zero point before it wrecks everything, including you. The game plan? Move quick, take it out, and make sure it's gone for good, securing a future where it can't mess things up again.
rows.description_html: (EARLY ACCESS) Welcome to DUST. Set in 2025, you and your crew must locate the Zero Point. If you're daring enough, venture alone and face the consequences of your choice. The path is yours. Choose your own fate. DUST's story is based on the Fortnite storyline. You are The Visitor, One Of The SEVEN . After Earth went to hell because of the war against the IO and the seven, the Zero Point decided to escape and hide. Your mission is to locate the Zero Point and control it, but it won't be easy. Every hallway, every room, there are IO guards waiting for you; they are ready to kill you in any way. But you have a trick up your sleeve, you can clone yourself until your suit overheats! Don't like Story games? Play Sandbox! Your imagination is your limit.. and some other things. Explore The Maps We have a variety of maps to choose from. GUN PLAYGROUND PIER HOUSE (Coming Version 12) EMPTY TESTING SITE (Now with a race track!) Don't like the weather? Alternate the map! Choose from Spring, Winter, Fall, and much more! WEAPONS Test out a handful of weapons on dummies, crates, or gas tanks. Or just blow yourself up and everything around with a grenade. Similar to BONEWORKS, BONELAB, GARRY'S MOD, and HARD BULLET. Your world is a physical mess. Use a crowbar's Curved ends to hold multiple objects at the same time, or use a clipboard to fling yourself into a building, or put a ladder at your feet and pick it up and make it launch you into the sun, or even pick up a car with your own fists! And yourself? Well, maybe someday you will become a physics object.

rows.name: Fair and Square
rows.short_description: Fair and Square is a fast-paced bullet hell platformer roguelike where everything revolves around squares. Survive relentless enemy waves, upgrade your skills in the shop, and face epic bosses. Customize your playstyle, adapt on the fly, and prove your mastery in this chaotic challenge!
rows.description_html: Fair and Square Prepare for the ultimate test of precision, reflexes, and strategy in Fair and Square , a fast-paced bullet hell platformer roguelike where every move matters, and every decision shapes your journey. Ready? Square-Based Action : Navigate vibrant arenas where everything – from characters to enemies to bullets – is cleverly designed around squares. Wave-Based Chaos : Survive increasingly challenging waves of enemies, each more relentless than the last. Adapt quickly or face defeat! Strategic Upgrades : Between waves, visit the shop to buy, upgrade, and customize skills that will define your playstyle. Will you focus on firepower, mobility, or defense? Boss Battles : Face off against towering square bosses with unique mechanics and escalating difficulty. Only the sharpest skills will see you through to the final showdown. Roguelike Replayability : No two runs are ever the same. Experiment with different builds and strategies to see how far you can push your limits. Are you ready to conquer the chaos and prove yourself fair and square? Play now and carve your name in the annals of square greatness!

rows.name: Legends of Elysium
rows.short_description: A fantasy strategy game that combines collectible card and board game mechanics. Build custom decks, choose powerful heroes, and engage in tactical, turn-based battles in competitive PvP leagues and battlefield tournaments.
rows.description_html: Legends of Elysium is a Free-To-Play strategy game combining collectible card and board game elements set in a rich fantasy world. Players build custom decks, choose heroes with unique abilities, and compete in intense, tactical battles. The game features multiplayer PvP leagues and battlefield tournaments, offering a deep and immersive experience. Master strategic gameplay to rise through the ranks and claim victory in epic battles. UNIQUE BATTLE SYSTEM Engage in turn-based battles. Strategically build lands to control the board. Summon powerful units with unique abilities. Cast devastating spells to dominate the battlefield. Outsmart your enemy and destroy them to win. COLLECT POWERFUL CARDS Collect powerful cards. Discover Legendary units and spells. Build your ultimate deck to dominate the battlefield. Key Features : Strategic deck-building and hero customization. PvP leagues and competitive tournaments. Epic fantasy world with diverse races and classes.

rows.name: Bloody Painter Dating Sim
rows.short_description: You have unfortunately been captured by a serial killer, and you must increase your chances of survival within seven days. Your choices will determine how he treats you and the outcome of your relationship. What will your final relationship with him be...?
rows.description_html: INTRODUCTION This is an official romantic horror visual novel game created to celebrate the 10th anniversary of the character from 'Bloody Painter' and to give back to the fans for their support. It is a spin-off based on the 2017 version of the story. STORY You have unfortunately been captured by a serial killer, and you must increase your chances of survival within seven days. Your choices will determine how he treats you and the outcome of your relationship. What will your final relationship with him be...? Will there be a change in the relationship between the killer and his prey? CONTENT WARNINGS ．This game contains some graphic scenes of violence. ．If you encounter a murderer, please call the police first.It's unrealistic to develop a romantic relationship with a murderer. ．This is a romance game♥ FEATURES ．Fully voiced. ．There are a total of 14 CG illustrations. ESTIMATED PLAY TIME 40 minutes for an good ending. NUMBER OF ENDINGS 6 bad endings + 4 good endings. STREAMING PERMISSION Feel free to stream and play this game live! If you encounter any bugs, please leave a comment to let us know. For players choosing the English language, it is recommended to go to settings and adjust the speed to the fastest. OPERATING SYSTEMS Windows 7 and above. CREDITS Development. Story. Programming by 迪鹿DeluCat @DeluCatOfficial Graphics by 牛奶 @milk890522 Background Art by kurumi2179、迪鹿DeluCat Logotype by サヤカ@laipeng16 Voice Acting by Easton@eastonandemmary Trailer by ZAO@ZAO_Studio_ Font by 翰字鑄造 - TaipeiSansTCBeta-Regular Special Thanks to 南翁、LoS-Light Game Teste by 七七

rows.name: Backrooms: Found Footage
rows.short_description: Backrooms: Found Footage is a single-player horror game where you are the main character trying to survive the Backrooms. Curiosity wins and you decide to explore this weird place that you got trapped in. What could go wrong?
rows.description_html: Backrooms: Found Footage is a single-player horror game where you are the main character trying to survive the Backrooms. Curiosity wins and you decide to explore this weird place that you got trapped in. What could go wrong? This game is a Found-Footage style horror game where your main objective is to find the way out of the Backrooms . You play as Young Alex who got trapped in the Backrooms , not knowing anything about it. You decide to record this little adventure, but you manage to capture something really weird. Not recommended for lower-end systems. *Inspired by Kane Pixels

To help you in this endeavor you will recruit the help of different items and upgrades like seeds, fertilizer, helpers, and harvesters! Pumpkin Clicker is an indie game developed by a single developer. I am actively developing the game and it will continue to receive updates over time. Try it out and see all the features! - Collect pumpkins and spend them to earn even more pumpkins - Upgrade your items to reach your true pumpkin-producing potential - Check your stats to see how many pumpkins you've earned since the beginning of time

rows.name: My Boss Is Scaring Me
rows.short_description: Oliver, coming from a small town to London, seeks to improve his life and help his mother, who had an accident months ago. At the new newspaper, he discovers his creative and investigative potential, diving into a complex story. There, he grows closer to his enigmatic boss. Is he trustworthy?
rows.description_html: Oliver came from a small town to the charming city of London to improve his life and financially support his mother, who had an accident months ago. There, he realized that his creative and investigative skills, which he hadn't fully used in his hometown, were much more valuable at the new newspaper, and he dove headfirst into a complex story. This story will demand so much of his abilities that, after countless extra hours, he starts interacting more with his boss, a man of few words and a dark, mysterious expression, hiding much in his past. Can he be trusted? My Boss Is Scaring Me is a short, linear BL game with deep reflections on life, problematic relationships, and decisions. Short story, approximately 10k words. Two endings, but only one decision. Linear storyline. Original CGs. Screenplay, artwork and development: B.G.Riccetto and M.Graymoon General support: M.Graymoon Backgrounds: Original VN Maker and DLCs Sounds and Musics: Original VN Maker, Cynicmusic, Rony D.Kid and OwlishMedia A special thanks to M. Graymoon for staying with me and my grandmother, who always believed in my creative ability, and now watches over me from heaven.

rows.name: Sword Road
rows.short_description: Make your best sword! Fight monsters in dungeon, collect items and craft a various sword.
rows.description_html: Inspired by the flash game 'Strengthening Sword', this game was created. Combat is the same as the 3D Vampire Survival genre, but other content is point-and-click. The player has nothing but 2000 gold that was initially given. I recommend you buy a wood sword with that sword, because you have to kill the monster to get the item! Once you get the item, you can build a sword that is stronger than a wood sword. If you make a sword, you can go to the store and sell it. Weapons only, material items cannot be sold. Think about how to make gold and survive to the end by monsters for 2 minutes. Controls Move Player - WASD Attack Key - Q Move Item - Drag and Drop

rows.name: 鯤島行者 Echoes of Formosa: Agent Reborn
rows.short_description: Embark on a journey through Taiwan’s rich history in 'Echoes of Formosa: Agent Reborn.' Play as Li Bin, a secret agent awakening in the prison of Stad Zeelandia, on the brink of war. Unravel mysteries, explore ancient streets, and reclaim lost memories in this immersive adventure.
rows.description_html: In the heart of Taiwan, an island steeped in history and mystery, lies the ancient fortress of Stad Tayouan, also known as Stad Zeelandia. Step into the shoes of Li Bin, a covert operative whose fate is entwined with the secrets of Stad Tayouan. Waking up in the depths of Zeelandia's dungeon with no memory of how he got there, Li Bin must navigate the perilous streets of 1660, just before the outbreak of the infamous Siege of Fort Zeelandia War in 1661. As players delve into the game's four gripping chapters, they will uncover the hidden truths of Tainan's past, piecing together clues from archaeological discoveries and historical accounts. The meticulously crafted streetscapes draw inspiration from 'La ville et le cháteau de Zélandia dans l'ile de Tayovan,' transporting players to a meticulously recreated world where every corner whispers echoes of a bygone era. With stunning visuals and a rich narrative, this game invites players to immerse themselves in the history of Stad Tayouan, exploring its secrets and unraveling the mysteries that lie within. Are you ready to embark on this unforgettable journey through time? Prepare to discover the Echoes of Formosa: Agent Reborn and uncover the lost memories that linger within.

rows.name: Esports History: Prologue
rows.short_description: Esports History: Prologue is a free RPG simulator about the era of the birth of eSports. Start from scratch and work your way up to an eSports career. Use your resources and time wisely to develop a unique character and win tournaments.
rows.description_html: Esports History: Prologue is an RPG simulator combining time management, character development, and deep mini-games. You will take the role of an ordinary student and develop him into a professional eSports player. Defeat bosses in tournaments, raise your reputation in the community, and become the best! TIME-MANAGEMENT The race with the strongest players never ends. Properly manage your time to train and earn money, but control stress and fatigue to come out of the battle as a winner. MINI-GAMES Enjoy alternative versions of hit games of the past. Develop in one of the eSports disciplines: strategies or shooters. Training skills, upgrading your skill tree and mental state affect your character's strength in mini-games. CREATE A UNIQUE CHARACTER Form your own play style. Upgrade your characteristics and talents as you wish. Will you train AIM to improve marksmanship or Strafe to become elusive? Develop an economy by dominating resources or micro-control to emerge victorious? It's up to you.

rows.name: Ananas - Pineapple Idle Game
rows.short_description: Ananas is free Play-to-earn relaxing clicker game where you're gonna get pineapples to trade! Dropped/bought items has their use and have a fair chance to get bought for random value by dev on upcoming live streams, that's where Ananas differs!
rows.description_html: Howdy, partners! Let me introduce you to Ananas. Ananas - Pineapple Idle Game is our first of “Play to earn” game series. It is a relaxing clicker game in which you click a pineapple (or more conveniently hold key or even use the Lazy button) to get in-game money to buy upgrades or to play minigames (one is available at the moment, others will be added). Whenever you reach certain amount of in-game money, you're offered prestiging, which will enhance your future progress. You'll get random pineapples over the course of playing to grow your collection, trade with friends, sell to strangers or use to attend random picks! Ananases (pineapples) drops vary in rarity and their count is limited. No worries, drops are based on player’s gaming activity, not your in-game results ;-) And the best thing? We’ll be picking random values and for such random values we’ll be buying your items from Steam marketplace! Frequency of such events is based on gamers activity on Steam market. To ensure transparency, these events will be happening live on Developer broadcasts and Twitch streams. Chances and values are totally random, which means that there’s same chance percentage of developer buying item for an equivalent of 0.03$, 2.000$ or any value in between! Feel free to play to get -or even stock up- because the stock is limited. Soon we’ll even add support to exchange common ananases into random lottonases too! The game Ananas is and will always remain Free to play! Support Ananas and get your Supporter perks, or play it for free! Features: Drops Ananas Companion app (behaving as launcher) making sure you get your drops on time Coded by human (AI just gave us some graphics and songs for launch) Pineapples, who would have say? =P Achievements Redeemable codes (try 'ananas') Compact 1024x768 resolution to fit any display Prestige system, upgrades and minigame, save system to keep progress Discord server for votes or anything that players have on their mind Coming: Ananas Companion will be updated with ability to exchange lower quality pineapples for higher quality ones and to pack/unpack items into/from bundles Picks of random values for which higher quality items will be bought from gamers on live streams (starting December 2024 or January 2025, depending on Marketplace activities/Supporters) More items Discord community competitions with rewards (starting Q1 2025) In-game music player More minigames Applicable skins Whenever we surpass Steam popularity milestones, Steam Trading cards and Steam Badges will be added to level up and decorate your Steam profile Made in Czech Republic

rows.name: Soccer Manager 2026
rows.short_description: Manage elite football clubs and lead your dream team as a football manager!
rows.description_html: Become the ultimate football manager in Soccer Manager 2026. Take charge of your favourite football clubs and players , navigate the transfer market , and become title-winning champions in this football management simulator . Soccer Manager 2026 gives you unrivalled tactical control over your football club, with every element of your soccer club at your fingertips. With over 90 leagues , and 54 countries to experience, Soccer Manager 2026 is our most realistic football simulation yet. New for the Soccer Manager 2026 Season: Fully overhauled UI with a sleek design, new colour scheme, and more intuitive elements. It is now easier than ever to manage your football team.
