rows.name: Reconquer Online
rows.short_description: An new indie MMORPG inspired by OSRS! Train, battle, quest, and explore a dynamic world. Solve puzzles, conquer dungeons, and fight epic battles. This game builds upon time-tested mechanics with barricades, fires, player controlled resources, endless raids, macroing, and a caravan system!
rows.description_html: Reconquer Online is an indie MMORPG that prioritizes fun and player freedom rather than grinding. This game introduces fresh mechanics like lever-controlled flame throwers, barricades, damaging fires, player collision, quests with alternative endings, lateral thinking puzzles, and different environmental interactions. There are currently 13 trainable skills, 11 quests, several bosses and challenges, and a competitive raid with high scores . Reconquer online has many unique features. These include: Player-controlled Resources: There is currently a player controlled mine and dock. Monsters sometimes drop 'essences' which can be used to guard these resources. Whoever owns the resource has access to the items it generates. Other players can defeat the guardian monsters and claim the resource for themselves. Barricades and Fires: Barricades can be used to block others while fires can be used to injure them. Mechanically unique bosses: Fight against bosses that spawn projectiles, drop boulders, switch attack styles, and more. Endless raids with high scores for those who have advanced the furthest. In-game macroing to automate the repetitive parts of game play. A caravan system instead of bank notes for transporting items. A Tiered PvP System: The PvP damage multiplier starts at 0% and slowly increases as you venture further. Public Enemies: PvP outside of the wasteland is punished with fidelity loss. Those with negative fidelity are designated 'public enemies' and are vulnerable everywhere. Alternate Endings: Choose a side in certain quests and reap different rewards. This is a game whose content will continue to grow with the player base. We believe the game will end up better by slowly introducing higher level content rather than all at once. Our goal is to release a new tier of content (+5 levels) about every three months. In addition, there will be four new biomes. Each biome will have its own major quest-line, raid, and unique items. Desert (up to level 40 content) Jungle (Up to level 60) Arctic (Up to level 80) Wasteland (Up to level 99) The long term goal is to monetize solely through memberships. Membership currently gives you the ability to choose a custom name. In the future, membership will also give you access to content above level 20. 3 months - $5 6 months - $10 1 Year - $15 Membership can be purchased in game through Steam.

rows.name: Idle Sphere
rows.short_description: Stunning sphere-themed idle/incremental game. Experience simplicity's beauty.
rows.description_html: Introducing Idle Sphere, a stunningly beautiful incremental game that revolves around the captivating world of spheres. Prepare to be amazed as countless spheres come to life using cutting-edge technology. The game's graphics are seamlessly synchronized with the in-game currency, ensuring a mesmerizing visual experience. As you progress, you'll encounter increasingly complex, beautiful, and colossal spheres that will leave you in awe. Idle Sphere's gameplay is built on simple yet engaging upgrades, allowing you to enjoy the game intuitively. Immerse yourself in the satisfying experience of zooming in and out, admiring the exquisite beauty of the spheres. The game features an extensive prestige system that adds depth to your journey. Although some upgrades may reset when you prestige, fear not! You'll emerge stronger and quickly regain your former power, ready to take on new challenges. Despite its simplicity, Idle Sphere offers a wealth of content for you to explore and enjoy. Dive into this captivating world of spheres and embark on an unforgettable incremental gaming adventure!

rows.name: Relictus: Blackout
rows.short_description: Relictus: Blackout is a grounded, tactical multiplayer shooter designed for players who crave a focused and intense combat experience. Combining the fast-paced action of classic shooters with deliberate, class-based gameplay, Relictus puts strategy and skill at the forefront of every match.
rows.description_html: A World in Conflict In the year 2028, tensions boil over in the remote Tarkhos Province. The fragile ceasefire between NATO-backed Global Intervention Corps (GIC) and the insurgent Red Vostok shatters as full-scale war ignites. The fight isn’t just for territory—it’s for dominance, ideology, and survival. Dive into a variety of game modes, from traditional Team Deathmatch and Free-For-All to the unique and nerve-wracking Blackout Raid . In this night-time elimination mode, you'll rely on night vision, sound (like footsteps) and pure instinct to outsmart your opponents in a no-respawn, no-killstreak environment. Choose your path with a distinct class-based loadout system that prevents overpowered 'meta' builds. Specialize as a heavy-hitting Support , a nimble Assault , a patient Sniper , or a close-quarters Engineer , each with a unique set of weapons and tactical pros and cons. With a fully reworked progression system, every match you play contributes to unlocking new weapons, emblems, and cosmetics. Experience a game where every detail matters—from the enhanced weapon SFX and immersive audio to the optimized maps with improved lighting and post-processing. Key Features: Intense, Class-Based Combat: Master four distinct classes, each with a unique role and loadout. Old-School Progression: Level up to unlock new weapons, calling cards, and cosmetic items. Optimized & Polished: Enjoy a smoother experience with reworked gunplay, improved AI, and visually enhanced maps. Streamlined Experience: Less clutter and more focus on core gameplay, providing a clean and engaging UI. With a fully reworked progression system, every match you play contributes to unlocking new weapons, emblems, and cosmetics. Experience a game where every detail matters—from the enhanced weapon SFX and immersive audio to the optimized maps with improved lighting and post-processing. Game Modes Relictus: Blackout features a growing roster of modes designed for different player mindsets and levels of intensity: Skirmish (FFA) : Solo survival in its rawest form. Every combatant is your enemy. Contact (TDM) : Classic team-on-team warfare. Secure the highest kill count through discipline and coordination. Blackout Raid (Elimination) : Squad-based, one-life-per-round tension. When you’re down, you’re out—until the next round. Dynamic Battlefields Mirzov District (Night) – Shadowy urban alleys with flickering lights and sudden ambushes. Dravon Estates – Suburban strongholds and open courtyards under fire. Tarkhos – Vehicle lanes, industrial chokepoints, and strategic rooftops. Drelsk Ridge – Mountain warfare with long-range sightlines and dangerous flanks. Core Experience Relictus: Blackout is a gritty, dark, infantry-focused multiplayer FPS that strips away arcade excess and replaces it with uncompromising realism and tension. Choose Your Side : Join the disciplined GIC or the relentless Red Vostok. Each faction has unique operators with distinct visual designs and gear reflecting their culture, training, and battlefield philosophy. High Replayability : Thanks to a blend of operator variety, dynamic maps, and multiple game modes, no two matches ever feel the same. Host Your Own Servers : Players can run dedicated or peer-hosted matches, set their own rules, tweak map rotations, and cultivate unique communities. Progression Without Paywalls : No battle passes. No pay-to-win. Earn your progression through gameplay alone. Unlock cosmetic options, insignia, and operator gear by playing and winning. Why Relictus: Blackout Stands Apart Authenticity at Its Core : Weapons feel weighty and lethal, movement is deliberate, and firefights are fast and decisive. Operator Identity : Choose from visually distinctive operators for each faction, representing the ethos of their side—from GIC’s high-tech tactical gear to Red Vostok’s rugged, scavenged combat rigs. Built by Players, for Players : Server hosting, custom rule sets, and clan support mean the community shapes the war. No Fluff, Just Grit : No fantastical gadgets, no out-of-place cosmetics. This is modern warfare stripped to the bone. Dynamic AI Bots : For training or filling servers, bots act aggressively and unpredictably, offering both practice and challenge. The War Continues In Relictus: Blackout, there are no safe zones. Every match is another chapter in a war without end. The GIC fights to stabilize the province and maintain global order. Red Vostok seeks to burn that order to the ground. Your role is simple: pick a side, gear up, and survive. This is not a war for glory. It’s a war for survival. Relictus: Blackout — The darkness has a name.

rows.name: Off Trail
rows.short_description: Off Trail is a procedurally generated infinite downhill skiing game. Discover the beauty, life, and treachery, of the mountain.
rows.description_html: Off Trail is a procedurally generated infinite downhill skiing game. Land tricks, discover unique biomes, and ski alongside countless creatures. Procedural generation - Explore an infinite downhill mountain with new terrain in every run Unique biomes - Explore unique biomes, from the Andes to the Japanese Alps Hazards - Ski as far as you can on each run, while avoiding trees and animals XP system - Earn XP on each run, allowing you to unlock items and venture further down the mountain Day-night cycle - Ski through days and nights, taking in the beauty of the sunset and sunrise Weather - Survive the toughest blizzards and ski through rainy thunderstorms Dog companion - Feeling lonely on the vast mountain? A dog companion accompanies you on your journey, helping to scare away dangerous predators

rows.name: Everlusting Life
rows.short_description: Everlusting Life — classic auto-chess game set in a fantasy world. Assemble a squad of beautiful girls to aid you on your quest to save the magical realm. Triumph in battles with strategy and win hearts with undeniable charm!
rows.description_html: EVERLUSTING LIFE NOW RELEASED About the Game           Step away from the dull routine of everyday life and open the door to a magical realm of endless possibilities and stunning beauties. In this isekai adventure, you'll dive into an exciting story and build deep relationships with captivating girls. Unravel the mysteries of this new world, master thrilling auto-chess battles, and win the hearts of rebellious Demigoddesses. The fate of this world rests in your hands — can you save it and rise as its legendary hero?        Immerse yourself in a whirlwind of passion with the enchanting inhabitants of this magical realm. Share the Cosmic Seed to save their world from destruction! But beware — Eternitas' grand plan isn't welcomed by all. Her daughters, the rebellious Demigoddesses, have defied her will and gone into hiding among mortals. Track them down and use your unmatched charm to convince them that the magic of the Cosmic Seed — wielded only by you — is their last hope for salvation!        Charm your way into the hearts of beautiful girls with your wit and charisma! Connect with them through the magical mail — a unique way of communication in this enchanting world. Exchange letters, uncover their secrets and ignite the flames of passion!        To save this world, you must unlock the heart of every woman you meet along the way. Only with their help can you win over the rebellious Demigoddesses. Once you fill them with the Cosmic Seed, magic will flow through this realm once more, restoring balance and ensuring its survival. There's no turning back —The Mistress of Space and Time, the mighty Eternitas, won't let you return home until your mission is complete. So, get ready to go all in. Melt the hearts of these stunning girls and become the hero this world desperately needs!

rows.name: DECIDIT
rows.short_description: Decidit is a fast FPS roguelike in which you must use all the arsenal and movement abilities at your disposal in order to progress in an unstable demonic maze. Be fast, precise but also strategic using all the demonic weapons and abilities collected on the way to create powerful synergies.
rows.description_html: Leave hope at the door of Dante's hell and plunge into the deep abyss of Gehenne. Will you have the courage to defeat Gluttony's teratological hordes, and will you be able to survive in the foul cesspool of viscous entrails that serves as his macabre sanctuary? DECIDIT is a fast-paced roguelike FPS in which you must use all the arsenal and movement skills at your disposal to progress through an unstable pandemonic maze. Steal mutations from the creatures you face, modify your weapons and abilities , and use them synergistically to create the most devastating combos to pulverize your enemies. Each run is unique , and the difficulty modes on offer are sure to challenge every type of player. DECIDIT is a student project made by nine passionate devs in one year as a graduation project. DECIDIT won the excellence award and was finalist at the Rookie Awards 2024 under the Game Of The Year category and was Finalist at the Flip Festival 2024 .

rows.description_html: Join us in celebrating twenty five years of GameMaker with GameMaker 25th Anniversary! Manage your development house, keep your employees happy and squash bugs as they come up in this minigame filled, top down management and strategy game! Starting from a single programmer, you'll select features to develop for your game engine, buy new furniture for the office to improve the performance of your team, hire new developers, and collect posters for the office! Select upgrades for your office to improve worker movement speed, productivity and more. Pick cool features to add to your engine from a list  and develop them! Keep your workers happy by clicking thought bubbles to send them through the office. Repair broken objects by playing over a dozen minigames. Click-and-squash bugs as they come up. Release new engine features, gain popularity and collect posters based on the history of GameMaker!

rows.name: Stop and Breathe
rows.short_description: A 3D puzzle platformer that teaches you a breathing technique to help with your anxiety! Calm your mind by performing the breathing technique, Belly Breathing! Traverse a school environment, solve puzzles, move platforms, all while being accompanied by your companion, Zen!
rows.description_html: Game Overview Discover the importance of breathing during moments of stress or anxiousness. Learn how to control your breathing to achieve serenity and calmness. Solve a series of fun puzzles with a multitude of gameplay mechanics. The Story Ace is a young teen who starts to feel anxious about kicking off their day at school. As they head towards the school entrance, their anxiousness begins to grow and intensify until they experience an intense panic attack. Feeling scared and overwhelmed, Ace gets closed off into a warped mind world where they now need to find a way out. With the help of their companion Zen, Ace learns the proper timings and physical stance for the Belly Breathing technique, which they can now utilize to expel their anxiousness and colour the way forward. Gameplay In this mind world, Ace must navigate a disjointed version of their school by performing a series of simple platforming challenges, breathing the anxiousness away, and solving an array of puzzles. Upon entering each new section of the school, mental blockers and a lack of colour fill the surrounding area, making it difficult for Ace to achieve their goal of escaping. By finding a calm space to center themselves, Ace can perform Life Breathing to bring colour back bit by bit and remove their mental blockers. Use the power of controlled breath when interacting with breathing terminals to inflate and deflate large balloons, change the directional air flow of fans, and rotate platforms to move forward. To progress to the next section, find and place large books into their proper shelves to open doors and move on to the next page of the Ace’s journey.

rows.name: Arcane Afterfall
rows.short_description: A 2D MMORPG with turn-based combat, dungeons, PvP, PvE in a unique world with story driven content.
rows.description_html: ✨ Arcane Afterfall Update: Bug Fixes, Improvements & Exciting Changes Ahead! 🔮 🔮 Hey everyone! Thank you for your active feedback – we carefully read all your comments and suggestions, and it's because of you that Arcane Afterfall keeps getting better with every update! ⚒️ What’s new? - We’ve fixed multiple bugs to make the game more stable and enjoyable for all players. - Added a location map to help you more easily navigate the world that has lost its magic! - Faction restrictions in the Arcane Tower have been removed – groups are now formed solely based on player levels: 9-12, 13-16, 17-19, 20+. This change will help you take on challenges more easily - You can now discard unnecessary quest items if the associated quest is not in your journal – no more cluttered inventory! - System messages that previously might have appeared in the wrong language will now be displayed in the selected language. ✨ What’s next? We’re already working on new updates with exciting improvements and content. Stay tuned to be the first to know about upcoming changes! 💬 Share your thoughts, let us know what you love and what could be improved – your feedback truly matters to us! About the Game 🎮 Welcome to Arcane Afterfall – a role-playing game inspired by the classics of the genre, where magic no longer reigns, and those who dream of restoring it must fight for their cause. This is a world where people from Earth arrived in search of the last drop of magical energy-only to discover new mysteries, ancient threats, and the struggle for survival. 🔍 Explore a mysterious world filled with intrigue and unexpected encounters. Join secret organizations, solve riddles, and hunt for rare Easter eggs 🎭 hidden in the most unexpected places. Here, every choice has consequences, and knowledge is power 📖✨. TACTICAL BATTLES AND DEADLY ENEMIES 🔥 The Arcane Afterfall combat system is designed for true strategists. Turn-based battles require a thoughtful approach-use unique abilities ⚡, combine talents, analyze enemy weaknesses, and find vulnerabilities 🎯 to gain the upper hand, even in the most challenging fights. 👹 But the real trials await you in boss fights. Gigantic demons 😈, ancient artifact-bound entities 🔮, and mechanical titans 🤖-each boss requires a unique strategy. Defeating them grants legendary rewards 🏆, but to triumph, you must rely not only on strength but also on cunning 🧠. DUNGEONS, PVP, AND THE 'TOWER OF ARCANA' ⚔️ Venture into dark dungeons-alone or with a group. Every labyrinth holds its own secrets and deadly traps ☠️, and in its depths, powerful bosses and treasures 💎 await. For those who enjoy battling other players, PvP arenas are open, where you can test your skills in team fights 🏅. And in the Tower of Arcana, you’ll start with no equipment and must find different ways to emerge victorious-only your skill determines the outcome. A WORLD FULL OF MYSTERIES AND POSSIBILITIES 🔮 Unravel the secrets of the nameless City by penetrating its Inside Out. Challenge the Shaved Sisters gang or become a paladin of the Last Order. Become a warrior of the Swamp Legion or set out to explore Zone 51 👽. Discover what lies hidden within the Confluxion and find your way through space and time in star sneakers. There’s always something to do in Arcane Afterfall - explore, fight, solve mysteries, and become part of a great story!

rows.name: Mangoo
rows.short_description: Casual mini games.
rows.description_html: Mini game collection. Existing games: shooting, ball rolling Shooting Collect props and destroy the enemies you see. There will be 10 waves of enemies, and the number and health of enemies will increase each time. Players collect props scattered on the map to enhance their own strength. Props: 'Mango-white' increases the number of lives 'Amount-blue' increases the number of shots 'Power-red' increases attack power 'Speed-yellow' increases attack speed Eliminate all enemies and win. Ball rolling Control the ball to jump on the platform and avoid obstacles to reach the destination. Always free.

rows.name: Face to Face
rows.short_description: 😘A satisfying action puzzle game that merges the physics of Suika Game with a SUPER COOL set-matching mechanic.😄
rows.description_html: 😘Face To Face is a satisfying action puzzle game that combines the Physics of Suika Game with a SUPER COOL Set Matching mechanic.😅 🟦 How to Play🟪 1. Tap Shapes to give them a face. 2. When faces touch, They kiss and disappear! 3. Faces can kiss through other objects, as long as each shape has one thing in common with the one before. (this would be a valid example -> 😘🟡🟢🟩🟨😅) 4. Create longer chains for more points. 🟦 About the developer🟪 Samuel Leigh is a game developer, writer and adjunct professor based in New York. His work spans from Interactive fiction, to puzzle and action games. His other games, Conversation with a Rock, Annoy this Guy, The Way Down, Blow Out and Moving Jigsaw Puzzles can be played on Steam now!

rows.name: JAMs
rows.short_description: JAMs is a clicker game with Steam items themed around art and music, served in jars.
rows.description_html: JAMs is a clicker game with Steam items themed around art and music, served in jars. Initially, the scope of the game will be a quite simple clicker game with items but will evolve over time to become something special.   The game is free to play so everyone will be able to get drops, but with the Extra Drops DLC you will get a few more, it will be a fair distribution and there may be a few special items only available through the item shop in the future, but for now the daily drop creations are all that we have ever had. The schedule of items being removed from the drop pool will be a reliable thing and rotate quite frequently, so you will need to idle the game all the time in order to get all the drops.  The game is art-and-music themed, so if you are an artist (or just love it!) be sure to join the JAMs Discord Server and follow along with the project as we grow!

rows.short_description: Ekphrasis is a 2D puzzle game where you can solve and examine a collection of artifacts. Piece together historical artworks, arrange musical notes, and decipher codes. Uncover the secrets behind the artifacts and those that curated them through a branching story.
rows.description_html: Five mysterious beings have gathered to create an archive that contains all forms of knowledge. As the primary archivist, converse with each entity to learn from their discoveries, and collect their findings to complete the archive. Decide whether to uncover their secrets and seek out their intentions. Key features: Unique puzzle design Branching, choice-based narrative Minimalist art-style and soundtrack

rows.name: Sleepy Joe's Adventures (Bye!Den, GO!)
rows.short_description: A satirical 2D platformer in the spirit of the classic physics-based puzzle game QWOP. Help President Den finish his tasks, getting caught in absurd situations and making decisions that lead the country to chaos. A unique blend of humor and absurdity awaits you in every mission!
rows.description_html: One fine day, President Den realized that his time in office was running out, but there were still mountains of tasks left to do. Time to hit the road! Each action is a small challenge. Help Den complete all of his tasks, without avoiding embarrassing and absurd situations, and leave a legacy as the president who failed almost every challenge... Will Den manage to finish all the tasks and leave the country in chaos? It's all up to you! How to Play: Your task is to guide President Den through the level without letting him fall and while completing all the mission objectives. The character is controlled using the QWOP keys on a keyboard (or corresponding buttons on the screen in the mobile version): Q — Jump W (hold) — Move Forward O/P — Balance the Character. The goal of the game is to reach the end of the level without falling. Failure occurs if the character loses balance or does not complete the task. Disclaimer: Warning – humor ahead! All characters and events in this game – even those based on real people – are entirely fictional. All voices are impersonated.

rows.name: Reconquista
rows.short_description: Reconquista is a large-scale battle strategy game with the rules of a deck-building board game with a mood of late Medieval. Carefully refine your strategy, build the best deck, and to win the battles.
rows.description_html: Experience the Iberian Peninsula in the late Reconquista era through a board game. Granada, once the hegemony of Al-Andalus, after centuries of Reconquista War, is on the verge of collapse. Meanwhile, it was also a long time ago that the three Christian kingdoms of Castilla, Aragon, and Portugal fought under the cause of a holy war. The Iberian Peninsula is now in an era of warring states where each country's beneficial relationships are intertwined. There are two victory conditions. One is to have the most territory at the end of 32 rounds, and the other is to win 3 times of battle in which all 4 countries participate every 10 rounds. Each country's units have their own characteristics. Among these, noble class units can only be acquired by its own country, while militia and men at arms can be acquired by other countries as well. Castilla: High defense, overall decent stats Aragon: High defense, excellent melee troops Portugal: Excellent ranged ability, weak melee troops Granada: Granada's units have low overall stats and are heavily reliant on noble cards, but they can be excellent at both melee and ranged. Game Systems 1. Kingdom phase This is the strategy phase in the form of a board game. All the player's strategic decisions are made only in this phase. Roll the dice, move, and decide on actions at the destination. 2. Deck building When you get cards in the Kingdom phase, you can adjust the positions of the cards in the deck. If between the flags there are only cards of the same country, each card gains a beneficial effect. 3. Battle Units are placed from the rear starting from the left of the deck. Battle is automatic and turn-based, greatly inspired by many tabletop wargames. You should observe the battle to refine your deck or improve your grand strategy. Multiplayer Up to 4 players can compete directly via local multiplayer or Remote play.

rows.name: Fire in the Dark
rows.short_description: Online duel isometric arena-shooter where the best witch wins! Use the power of fire and ice, navigate the shadows and hidings to defeat your opponent in a duel in the darkness. Use the light, hide in a bush, and show your friend who's the best witch in town!
rows.description_html: Fire in the Dark is a multiplayer-only isometric arena shooter in which you can invite a friend to play against you. In a medieval fantasy small city, you become two witches facing each others in a duel at night. Play with the shadows and hide in bushes, chase down your opponent to defeat him and prove who's best! Use fireballs to deal damage, kindle up torches or burn down bushes! Alternatively, rely on frostbolts to slow down your enemy and extinguish light sources in order to discreetly hide and wait for the right occasion to strike!

rows.name: you're just imagining it
rows.short_description: A chronic illness simulator. You think you have a chronic illness, but you don't know what. All you know is you are always in some state of pain. You've been to too many doctors to count... but you still have to live your life.
rows.description_html: Caution: This game is not meant to be medical advice. It's also not very fun. A chronic illness simulation game. You think you have a chronic illness, but you don't know what. All you know is you are always in some state of pain. You've been to too many doctors to count... but you still have to live your life. How long will it take for you to get a diagnosis? Play time is ~30 minutes. FEATURES Stressful schedule management as you try to balance living your life and dealing with pain Different doctors who tell you your chronic pain is made up Cool and minimal soundtrack by sdhizumi

rows.name: Full Manual Tower Defense
rows.short_description: 3D Tower Defense! Run! Build it yourself! Connect power yourself! You should build your tower manually!
rows.description_html: 🛠️ Run, Build, and Defend! A New Take on First-Person Tower Defense Traditional tower defense games put you in the shoes of a city planner, looking down from above as you place your towers. But not this time. Here, you are the worker on the ground — running, building, and holding the line yourself. 🏭 Game Features: First-Person, Hands-On Tower Defense Mine resources, build towers, and connect power lines — all from a first-person perspective! Time is limited, and enemies keep coming. Move fast and stay sharp. Limited Power Management Your power supply is finite. Decide carefully which towers to power and where to spend your resources. Efficient management is the key to survival. Collect Resources & Spend Wisely You'll need to recover resources directly from defeated enemies. Gather minerals, build new defenses, and upgrade your systems to prepare for the next wave. Defend Against Incoming Attacks You have one clear mission: Protect your precious power source from incoming enemy forces. Survive through every stage, hold your ground, and stop them before everything falls apart.

rows.name: Milky Way Idle
rows.short_description: Milky Way Idle: A multiplayer idle RPG where automation replaces grinding. Level up skills, gather resources, craft powerful items, and battle monsters—all while AFK. Trade in the marketplace, join a guild, team up for party combat, and socialize in chat as you progress effortlessly.
rows.description_html: Step into Milky Way Idle , a multiplayer idle game that combines classic RPG elements with automated progression and an active community. Level up skills, manage resources, craft equipment, and battle monsters - all while progressing effortlessly, even when offline. Automated Progression : Queue up a sequence of actions with offline progress of 10+ hours (or days!). No manual grinding - plan smart and play at your own pace. Level Up Skills : Level up 10 non-combat skills and 7 combat skills. Choose how to allocate your time and resources to optimize your growth. Gather And Craft : Gather resources and craft them into consumables, equipment, and more. AFK Combat : Battle monsters, bosses, and dungeons with diverse combat styles while fully AFK. Auto-activate consumables and abilities with configurable conditions. Multiplayer : Trade valuable items, party up for dungeons, socialize in guilds, and climb the leaderboards. Long-Term Depth : Unlock hundreds of items, hunt rare drops, enhance your equipment. Enjoy content designed to last months or even years. Active Development : New features and updates arrive every 1-2 months to expand your journey.

rows.name: ODouzy!!!
rows.short_description: In ODouzy!!!, guide a cute rectangle through colorful levels, dodging bomb traps and collecting beans and douzy. With a blend of simple movement mechanics and challenging puzzles, navigate vibrant worlds and gather enough the douzy to emerge victorious in this lighthearted, strategic adventure!
rows.description_html: ODouzy!!! is an exciting and dynamic action game set in a cute, minimalist world made entirely of geometric shapes. In this unique game, players control a rectangular character as they navigate through vibrant levels filled with aliens, bombs, and beans. The goal is to collect beans, avoid bomb-tracking missiles, and swallow aliens to score points. Unlike traditional games in the same genre, ODouzy!!! introduces more randomness, with unexpected challenges that keep every moment fresh and unpredictable. The game features a unique alien update system powered by Douzy, providing players with a sense of accomplishment similar to the feeling of cleaning as they complete tasks. With simple yet challenging mechanics, a colorful geometric world, and dynamic alien updates, ODouzy!!! offers a fun and rewarding experience, perfect for players who enjoy casual, light-hearted gameplay.

rows.name: Light the Candles in Hell
rows.short_description: Light the candles in hell, a journey for those you hold dear.
rows.description_html: Disclaimer: This game is a simple walking simulator with only one interaction. I aimed to create a meditative experience inspired by Camino de Santiago pilgrimage in Spain, but it didn’t turn out as planned. Reviews are negative, with players feeling it's a bit of a time waster, instead of taking it down from Steam, I’ve left it up. This was my first game, made in just three days, and it’s far from optimized. I wouldn’t necessarily recommend playing it. Playtime: 2 minutes You light the 11 candles. There is no sound, no one around. In the vast open world, a single monolith stands, marking your time in hell. The sole purpose is to keep the flame alive. The game offers very simple gameplay. Players light 11 candles one by one and aim to light them all. When all candles are lit, the ending appears and the game is complete.

rows.name: Umamusume: Pretty Derby
rows.short_description: Umamusume: Pretty Derby, winner of Best Mobile Game at The Game Awards 2025, is ready to race! Scout featured trainees and supporters as you navigate the immersive sports life simulation through the game's in-depth training system and top-of-the-line 3D graphics!
rows.description_html: -- Umamusume. They are born to run. They inherit otherworldly names, and are inspirited by dreams most dramatic and wonderful. Now, they run ever forward. That, is their destiny. No one knows how the races that lie in their futures will end. Even so, they continue to run, aiming only toward the goal in front of them. -- Each and every one of the runners sports a unique charm. It's up to you, the trainer, to lead them down the path of victory! You have but one goal—raise your Umamusume to her fullest potential and help turn her greatest dreams into reality. In order to reach these newfound heights, it's your job to participate in—and win—as many races as possible! Triumph awaits those who train hard and work to communicate. Only by cooperating will you take the crown! -- Experience the thrilling stories of historic racers, such as: Special Week (Voice: Azumi Waki) Silence Suzuka (Voice: Marika Kono) Tokai Teio (Voice: Machico) Oguri Cap (Voice: Tomoyo Takayanagi) Gold Ship (Voice: Hitomi Ueda) Vodka (Voice: Ayaka Ohashi) Daiwa Scarlet (Voice: Chisa Kimura) Mejiro McQueen (Voice: Saori Onishi) Symboli Rudolf (Voice: Azusa Tadokoro) Rice Shower (Voice: Manaka Iwami) Haru Urara (Voice: Yukina Shuto) Nice Nature (Voice: Kaori Maeda) ...and so many more—over 20 Umamusume are searching for a trainer to help them achieve their goals! -- Cheer for your favorite Umamusume and immerse yourself in exhilarating races and stunning performances in breathtaking 3D graphics. Up to 18 Umamusume compete in races against each other for first place—watch them go as you tune in to the game's incredibly realistic live commentary. And of course, stick around after the race to support the victor during a dazzling winning concert! Whether on the racetrack or the stage, raise the roof to each exciting new performance!

rows.name: Pascal's Requiem
rows.short_description: Embark on an epic journey to change the past in this 2.5D adventure RPG! Conquer turn-based minigame battles to unravel a story of fate and self-discovery. Will you accept your fate, or forge a new destiny?
rows.description_html: “Will you accept your fate, or forge a new destiny?” The discovery of MANA has revolutionised technology. RoboCorp harnessed its power and abundance to fuel their line of intelligent robots, bringing peace to the world. But everything comes at a price, and the public is yet to learn the cost of progress... Join Pascal in this unforgettable story as you unravel the mystery behind MANA technology, RoboCorp, and a mysterious figure who claims to be from the future. Do you have what it takes to change the past? Key Features:  Turn-Based Minigame Combat Engage in turn-based combat where every attack is a minigame! Whether that be dodging projectiles, pressing buttons in time with music, or mashing inputs, minigames provide a fresh twist on the classic turn-based RPG formula. Explore a Vibrant Solarpunk World Discover a futuristic setting fuelled by MANA . Four unique areas await, including peaceful villages, lush forests, and bustling urban cities. Learn about the future → unlock new attacks! You'll find Memory Crystals throughout your journey, which will uncover the secrets Pascal seeks. Use those memories to unlock combat modifiers and brand new attacks!

rows.name: Snails & Potions
rows.short_description: Dive into Snails & Potions, a fun-filled party game where you race snails against another player! Use your quick wit to brew potions that boost your snail or sabotage your rival's. There are no rules, just a rush to the finish line!
rows.description_html: Snails & Potions is a fast paced party game, where you and one friend are tasked with getting your respective snail to the finish line. Forage items from around the map to brew potions. You can then use these potions to boost your snail, or perhaps sabotage your opponents snail. There are no rules, so employ whatever tactic you think will help you win. This game was made by a team of 5 students during the course 'Game Projects' in the bachelor program Digital Arts and Entertainment at Hogeschool West-Vlaanderen in Belgium.

rows.name: Nexus Station
rows.short_description: Social First are bringing you an Early Access of a brand new kind of social sandbox MMO! In our free-to-play cross-platform game, you can create your own worlds and challenge your friends to epic adventures. Join our awesome community now!
rows.description_html: THIS IS OUR EARLY ACCESS WHICH HAS LIMITED CONTENT Nexus station is still in early development and not yet feature-complete. We will be adding features and content to the game as we develop it further. By joining our Early Access, you help us as developers to check and validate some technical aspects, and gather feedback on our project. A NEW KIND OF SOCIAL SANDBOX MMO We are developing a one-of-a-kind cross-platform Social Sandbox MMO! In our free-to-play cross-platform game, you can create your own worlds, trade with friends, play official game modes to earn XP and progress through the season, and even have your worlds featured as official playable content for the community. With so much more to come, we look forward to sharing more with you as the game develops. BUILD WORLDS WITH LEVEL EDITOR Create and edit your own worlds and explore the worlds made by your friends! We will choose player-made worlds to feature as official competitive and co-op features for the wider community.  WANNA PLAY A DROP GAME? Check out our latest game mode - be the last one standing to win! Survive for as long as you can by moving between the crumbling platforms. You only get one life so tread carefully! COMPETE FOR YOUR BEST TIME IN PARKOUR Race in our daily parkour worlds, or create your own parkour worlds for others to compete in. WHATEVER YOU DO… DON’T DIE! Avoid dying in a level filled with deadly hazards! The less you die, the higher you score. Play the ‘don’t die’ levels from the official portals, or check out ones made by your friends from the world finder. COLLECT LIMITED ITEMS AND WEARABLES Progress in Nexus Station with our season pass and get your hands on exclusive items that you won’t get anywhere else! Trade wearables with your friends to get the perfect set and customise your character in our dedicated customisation screen. SHOOT THE HOOPS WITH YOUR FRIENDS Work together to score as many points as you can in our shoot the hoops feature. Enter the portals from the Hub World to play the official hoops worlds and earn rewards. BE A PART OF THE COMMUNITY Join our online community on Discord and Instagram where you can get the latest updates on the game and hang out with the community. We also share sneak peeks of the game’s development so you can get hyped about what’s coming next!

rows.name: Pizzapocalypse
rows.short_description: A game made by students in twelve weeks. As a chef, master your pizza moveset to traverse a corporation-ridden town in this cartoony 3D platformer!
rows.description_html: Pizzapocalypse 2 Pizzapocalypse 2 is now available to be wishlisted on Steam!  Bounce, swing, drive and slide through many new countries in this upcoming sequel- all in a colourful new art style! About the Game Pizzapocalypse is a short game made in twelve weeks by second-year university students. The Story It feels like the world has forgotten about the joys of authentic, handmade pizza since the oppressive Pizza Corps moved into town with their 'cheap and efficient' pizza-in-a-can... but one pizza chef is determined to deliver rich, traditional Italian cuisine. Gameplay Pizzapocalypse is a cartoony 3D platformer for all skill levels! As a chef, use your pizza to dash and bounce your way across rooftops, and fight robot minions as you traverse a corporation-ridden town to make a delivery to your loyal customers! Take your time exploring every corner of the beautiful town, and collecting toppings to get the highest score possible! Or master your toolkit to get the fastest time, and attempt to complete bonus challenges. All play styles and skill levels can enjoy Pizzapocalypse! The game takes place in one level. Explore the three beautiful and distinct areas, each with multiple paths to uncover, and their own unique gameplay challenges and aesthetic!

rows.name: Diluvian Ultra: Awakening
rows.short_description: Diluvian Ultra: Awakening shows a never-before seen part of Diluvian Ultra's story, preceding the events of the main game. As a young Diluvian Knight, stage a heroic defense against insurmountable odds, in this single-player FPS with a retro aesthetic and fast-paced, strategic combat.
rows.description_html: Continue your adventure in Diluvian Ultra! About the Game Witness the events preceding the story of Diluvian Ultra in this free, stand-alone FPS. Embody a young Diluvian Knight, Qasar, and face the brutal Myrmidon invasion of your tomb-ship. Find and protect the sarcophagus of Attila, your Lord, and ensure he survives to set in motion the events of Diluvian Ultra. Featuring a brand-new level, new characters, story and dialogues, Diluvian Ultra: Awakening is an excellent introduction for new explorers of the game’s universe, as well as an interesting new addition to veterans who have already completed the first chapter of Diluvian Ultra. Strategic combat Diluvian Ultra’s combat is built around a dual-damage system where you have to combine weapons to be effective. Armour absorbs damage, but some weapons are designed to quickly strip it off your targets - unable to kill them, but exposing them for a single lethal blow. You have to be careful though, as enemies will mix their attacks in the same way. Collect and consume blood to upgrade your weapons and pick up various power-ups at the opportune moment, to become vengeance incarnate - if only for a while! Keep it moving Surviving in Diluvian Ultra is all about mobility. Dodge enemy fire while you chain together ranged attacks with close combat blows and devastating ground slams. Double-jump, dash, find cover and even deflect projectiles with your sword, but never stay in one place for too long! Organic philosophy Your spaceship home is a living combination of flesh and stone, and so it is with your arsenal of weapons; use both traditional Tech weapons as well as grotesque, living Organic armaments, and don’t forget to take good care of your closest companion, your sentient Squire Gun. Epic story Diluvian Ultra may be an over the top retro FPS filled with frenetic action, but all that carnage is set on a background of an epic, tragic story tackling the themes of fanaticism, trauma, betrayal and hope for redemption, playing out in neo-gothic architectural set pieces and immense, cathedral-like spaceships.

rows.name: Super Ricko’s Islands
rows.short_description: A FREE 3D platformer-collectathon with dynamic movement controls. Explore different worlds as you master the controls to perform different movement combos and collect all the cores and coins!
rows.description_html: A FREE 3D platformer-collectathon with dynamic movement controls. Explore and jump your way across different worlds as you master the controls to perform different movement combos and collect all the cores and coins! Inspired by Super Mario Odyssey's movement, you have 3 different movement action buttons: jump, dash, and force. Then by combing those together, you can perform 6 other different move combos to traverse the world and platform your way around in the most dynamic and satisfying way possible. We've made sure that the movement in the game is as fun as possible. Extremely fun and satisfying movement once controls are mastered 500~ cores to collect across 9 different islands Xbox controller or keyboard & mouse support Provide your feedback so we can make the movement better and make more games like this!

rows.name: Zozo's Show
rows.short_description: Welcome children, this is the show of your lives, your last greatest game, we promise nothing less than a great show full of fun and entertainment... For someone at least.
rows.description_html: This is a horror game about a program from the deepest layers of the internet, where children go through deadly games, with a distorted idea of ​​a children's program. The game will be part of a series of original games that together will complete the game's story. In this first game, the player controls a child who is taking part in the games, participating in puzzles and avoiding being killed by enemies.

rows.short_description: 优尔·阿莱夫和妹妹安雅·阿莱夫在幼年时因病被父母抛弃，后被爱尔兰都柏林的一家酒馆的老板娘西尔莎收留。在一次出差过程中，优尔意外的邂逅了自己梦中来历不明的少女，后得知对方的名字叫做艾尔温。面对这个熟悉又陌生的少女，优尔和她踏上了收集手稿和解开过去真相的旅程。

rows.name: Dustgrave: Prologue
rows.short_description: Dustgrave: Prologue will let you experience the first hours of Dustgrave: A Sandbox RPG, which is set to release later this year! Start your journey in the Prologue, change the world with your choices, and then continue playing with your save once the game is released!
rows.description_html: The mighty Dahlan Empire is falling, ravaged by a mysterious plague and internal unrest. While surviving powers and invading nations fight among themselves, adventurers and mercenaries venture inside this land full of opportunities. Create your character and embark on an epic journey, enjoying complete freedom in a true sandbox RPG experience. Everything you do affects the world and its people. All important events are recorded. All characters will interpret what’s happening based on their morality and their faction. Dustgrave: Prologue will let you experience the first hours of Dustgrave: A Sandbox RPG , which will be released later this year! Start your journey in the Prologue, and then carry on with your save into the final game, where you will be able to join factions and level up without restrictions! The characters will judge your good and evil deeds based on their personality or faction. You may be a robber, despised by common folk, but selling stolen goods could kick-start your career in the local crime groups! Factions will fight against each other, pillaging and conquering settlements. Some may become major players in the area. Others may be destroyed forever. Create and customize your main character in every aspect, and roleplay your alter-ego in any way you want, without any external constraint. Carve your own path, whether you join the Astralite clergy to fight against the heretics or steal apples from commoners! Many paths are available to you: criminal mastermind, righteous hero, ruthless mercenary, or wise archeologist. Smash your enemies with a complex yet accessible turn-based combat system! Thanks to a unique combat system you can experiment with Skills and Items combinations. Find overpowered combos and destroy everyone stupid enough to fight you! Use a stealth system to do anything you want. Steal something? Check! Assassinate someone? Check! Watch people sleep? Check! Pickpocket Marco during a quest and use his keys to rob his house while he's still kidnapped? Quite specific, but still doable! Enjoy Several hours of playtime and saves compatible with the final release version , so that you won't lose any progress!

rows.name: Pet Cam
rows.short_description: Every night, you get a strange call from your father—never missing a day. But one night, he breaks into your house. Can you escape the terror of your own father?
rows.description_html: 'Pet Cam' is a small horror story game where the player takes on the role of a female protagonist named Arya. Over time, the girl's shocking past unfolds before her eyes. Gameplay : Within a gameplay time of  25-30 minutes , the game offers multiple endings for players to explore. This game is primarily a first-person walking simulator , focusing on everyday tasks and exploration in both Arya’s house and a mysterious location Key Features: Immersive Daily Life Simulation : Help Arya navigate her day-to-day routine, from getting ready for work to completing small tasks in her home. Unnerving Atmosphere : Explore Arya’s home and areas where the atmosphere becomes increasingly unsettling with every step. Exploration-Based Narrative : Dive deep into a story driven by environmental clues and interactions as you unravel the mystery behind the horror. Walking Simulator Mechanics : A slow-burn, immersive experience that rewards players for taking their time to explore and pay attention to details.

rows.name: NEETNectar's Abysmally Small Assortment
rows.short_description: A collection of very simple 1-3 input games.
rows.description_html: DESCRIPTION NEETNectar's Abysmally Small Assortment is a collection of minimalistic games with a maximum of 3 inputs per game. All the games will be score based, and we may add new games as we think of them. The games currently available are: Air Walk Ninja - An endless side scrolling platformer Paddle Hero - A paddle style game where the ball is a weapon Symbol Says - A casual memory based game Clicker Boss - An idle type game with brutal conditions Asteroids and Aliens - A simple shoot 'em up type game Fist Bump - An endless side scrolling beat 'em up

rows.name: Earthquake: Margarita School - Definitive Edition
rows.short_description: A horror game set in a school, in which you will be a police officer who will have to investigate an earthquake. You will have to complete puzzles and face the paranormal events that occur. You have to be careful, the school covers a fairly dark past that you will be able to discover.
rows.description_html: Main story Step into the shoes of a police officer assigned to investigate an earthquake at the renowned 'Santa Margarita' school at year 2003. Your mission is to uncover the truth behind the incident and reveal the school's dark, hidden history. Throughout your investigation, you'll encounter various paranormal events that defy explanation. Or can you unravel the mysteries? Additionally, you must complete a small list of puzzles that you must discover throughout the first floor of the school. Game features: Duration of 1.5 hours Exploration Realistic graphics VHS style Set on Halloween dates NORMAL level puzzles Contains gory material and may be sensitive for some audiences THE GAME WILL BE GETTING MORE CONTENT AS UPDATES GO BY Contact the team: papus.studio2024@gmail.com We will be happy to bring you new content and solve problems in future updates!

rows.name: Project Nihilum - Zero
rows.short_description: Project Nihilum Zero is a narrative-driven Visual Novel. Discover the twisted story from different points of views and make your own choices. Discover 1 or 3 abilities: Mind Glimpse, Shape Shift and Hybrid. Use your ability wisely to see the past, influence the present and shape the future.
rows.description_html: Stuck in an underground laboratory without any memories, you witness horrible crimes. Knowing you will be next one day, you start planning your escape. Who can you trust? How can you control the power you feel inside of you? And will you ever fully recover your lost memories along with the truth? -x- Project Nihilum Zero is a narrative-driven Visual Novel set in a futuristic, dystopian world where reality and illusion collide. As brainwashed, kidnapped inmate in an underground laboratory, you will navigate a web of secrets, strange entities, and choices that will give you insight into different points of view of the story. -x- “They whisper in the dark. Do you hear them? The Origin calls to you, following you through floor after floor of the laboratory. You’re not the first to walk these corridors, and you won’t be the last. But maybe, just maybe, you’ll be the one who finally understands. Step into the void, make your choice, or let the choice make you. What will you become? You have nothing left to lose. Except… some fingers, a leg, maybe a kidney or two? -x- Features: STORY: Experience a dark narrative filled with twists, hidden lore, and choices that pull you deeper into a world where nothing is as it seems. VOICE ACTING: Every character's dialogues are voiced by our talented voice actors. MUSIC: The game features original soundtracks. You can unlock and listen to them in the game's music gallery. UPDATES: The game will be updated with new episodes, adding new gameplay to each of the 3 routes. CENSOR MODE: A censor mode can be activated at the beginning, allowing the player to experience censored versions of some scenes. IMAGE GALLERY: Unlock various images throughout the story and view them in the game's gallery. MEMORIES: Discover the past of the characters in snippets by using a certain ability. ABILITIES: Play with 1 of 3 abilities: Hybrid, Shape Shifting or Mind Glimpse. Depending on the ability, you can unlock certain scenes, memories or routes. MAIN CHARACTER: The main character will not be shown in the game. A custom name and pronouns (he/she/they) can be choosen. STORY: Discover what happened to you before your memories were taken from you and chose your new 'familiy'. ROUTES: Play 1 of 3 routes and discover the overall story through different perspectives. AVAILABLE ROUTES THE LABORATORIES: The organization that kidnapped you. Why on earth would you join and help them? (Because you want to spend time with the smart science people, we know.)They will use you for their benefit, but you can do so as well. What will you encounter in the endless corridors? And will you make it out alive or become one of them? TRUE PARADISE: You want a found family? This is the route you want to play. After all, everyone will show up here for shelter. Some of them are victims, some are former employees of the Labs. And - of course - a few of them are involved in shady business, playing every trick to accomplish their plans. THE BOUNTY HUNTERS: A mysterious organization, found by an individual who is told to be no human at all. Money, hunting, and lies make it hard to believe any of them. Are you a streamer? You can stream this game IF you add a creative aspect (audio commentary, ...). Recording the game and uploading it without adding anything to it, is not allowed. We want to promote creative content creators and NOT want our game to be used for clicks and views without putting creative effort into it.

rows.name: Forgotten Dreams
rows.short_description: The best dreams are to be forgotten, for they will destroy if not. A strange and abstract first person game that explores the forgotten. Navigate through maps and environments while completing objectives critical for survival.
rows.description_html: The best dreams are to be forgotten, for they will destroy if not.   This game is based on nothing, the nothing that was something, now unthinkable. Because of this, no description would be adequate.  However, I must try: A game heavily centered on its scenery and artistic nature. A game that is enigmatic, cryptic, and remembered. First person adventure game Navigate through liminal spaces and environments Complete 'objectives' and 'minigames' Survive against  ' enemies' and 'monsters' Progress through levels. Each level has its unique map generation. Do nothing, see nothing, hear nothing, feel nothing. That's how you remember it.

rows.name: Project Bengal
rows.short_description: Welcome to Project Bengal, an open-world action-adventure set in the vibrant, bustling streets of Bangladesh. Immerse yourself in a richly detailed world where you can free-roam, engage in intense action, and live out your own criminal empire story—all in Bangla language.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Project Bengal , an open-world action-adventure set in the vibrant, bustling streets of Bangladesh. Immerse yourself in a richly detailed world where you can free-roam, engage in intense action, and live out your own criminal empire story—all in Bangla language. Key Features: Explore a Living, Breathing World : Roam the streets, hills, and cities of a detailed, open-world environment inspired by real-life Bangladesh. Whether you're cruising through crowded markets, speeding down highways, or navigating rural backroads, every corner of the world is packed with life. Role-Playing Story : Dive into a series of immersive, narrative-driven roleplay stories inspired by the world of crime, power struggles, and gang warfare. Each mission and event unfolds a deep, branching storyline with unexpected twists and turns. Free Roam and Dynamic Action : Free-roaming gameplay lets you take control of the city, explore every nook and cranny, and interact with a diverse range of characters. From high-speed car chases to intense shootouts, the world is your playground. Engage in thrilling firefights, escape from the law, and climb your way up the criminal ladder. Vehicle Combat & Driving : Jump behind the wheel of a variety of vehicles, from luxury cars to motorcycles. The game features smooth driving mechanics and vehicle combat, allowing you to race, chase, or shoot your way out of any situation. Character Customization : Customize your protagonist’s appearance, from outfits to tattoos, hairstyles, and more. Build your character to match your unique style and preferences as you rise through the ranks in the criminal underworld. Mixed Visual Style : Experience a world that blends realism with stylized art. The game offers a visually striking balance, where the environments feel immersive, yet the characters and world carry a unique, artistic flair. Bangla Language and Local Culture : The game’s rich narrative and dialogue are fully localized in Bangla, bringing you closer to the culture, atmosphere, and language of Bangladesh. From the bustling streets of Dhaka to the serene rural villages, every aspect of the game draws inspiration from the real-world setting. No Multiplayer, Pure Single-Player Fun : While the game focuses on a rich, story-driven single-player experience, you can enjoy all the depth and freedom of an open-world RPG without the need for online play. Immerse yourself in a world of your own making.

No Multiplayer, Pure Single-Player Fun : While the game focuses on a rich, story-driven single-player experience, you can enjoy all the depth and freedom of an open-world RPG without the need for online play. Immerse yourself in a world of your own making.

rows.short_description: ECCHI / EROTIC (Single route/linear) Visual Novel about a bizarre GIANT WOMAN. Discover all the mysteries behind her and enjoy her company, if you can.

One route/linear/Kinect Ecchi Visual Novel  about a woman who is...kinda tall.  Discover all the mysteries about her. Dive into madness. Control your urges. Features Unique and original Art Style drawn by hand. Many illustrations and animations Original Sound Track with 12 songs made by professional musician. 40 Minutes worth of Content. (35 to 40% of the total of the story). It's linear, but you do have some choices. Continue the main story or discover many lose scenarios and unlock extra content along the way. Unlock a extra Pet Mini-Game. (Play with her, keep her alive and click to talk). A minimalist UI coupled with an aesthetically-pleasing 4:3 resolution. Free.

rows.name: Game Of Thrallan
rows.short_description: Game Of Thrall'an is action RPG developed by CGArt, Jsc, inspired by the iconic character Thrall from the World of Warcraft universe. Players will take on the role of an Orc character named Thrall'an on a journey to the icy land of Alterrac filled with enemies to destroy the Ice Lord - Lookholar.
rows.description_html: Game Of Thrallan Embark on an epic journey in Game of Thrallan, where you assume the role of the fierce Orc warrior, Thrall'an. Your quest takes you deep into the frozen wilderness of Alterrac, a land shrouded in ice and peril. Arm yourself and battle through hordes of savage enemies, mystical beasts, and cunning adversaries, all standing between you and the formidable Ice Lord, Lookholar. With intense combat mechanics, thrilling encounters, and a richly crafted world to explore, only the bravest warriors will have the strength to confront Lookholar and shatter his reign over the frozen lands. Will you rise to the challenge and bring warmth back to Alterrac, or succumb to the eternal frost? The game utilizes the latest Unreal Engine 5 technology along with numerous features and effects to provide an AAA-- level gaming experience with stunning visuals. The gameplay mechanics, moveset system, character design, combo and skill systems, and diverse, beautiful effects are inspired by other renowned Hack and Slash and Souls-like games.

rows.name: Relentless Expanse
rows.short_description: Capture and upgrade planets, outsmart your enemies, and conquer the galaxy! Simple yet addicting, you can play alone or outsmart your friends in this 2D top-down space RTS. Completely free, no monetization, just fun!
rows.description_html: Capture and upgrade planets, outsmart your enemies, and conquer the galaxy! Simple yet addicting, you can play alone or outsmart your friends in this 2D top-down space RTS. Completely free, no monetization, just fun! Relentless Expanse was made by a small team to gain experience, we don't care about money, we just want you to have fun!  The goal of the game is to send your ships to capture other planets and defeat every other enemy in the galaxy. Upgrade your planets using energy to make them more powerful, and strategically outsmart your enemies with your superior tactics!
